### [1] [Multi-level Constrained Learning for Underwater Image Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39183)
*Wangtao Bao,Liping Xie,Kanjian Zhang,Huimin Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MCL-UIE，通过对复原操作与训练目标施加结构化约束，实现成对监督下的水下图像增强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水下图像因波长相关衰减、散射与噪声导致颜色失真和细节退化；成对参考监督仅约束输出相似性，无法显式规定颜色映射方式、局部细节修正强度以及与退化观测的一致性。

Method: MCL-UIE由三部分组成并共享一个复原网络：(1) 单调色变换MCT，在log-LMS空间用正对角项与有界跨通道系数约束全局颜色映射；(2) 不确定性门控小波重建UGWR，用基于归一化小波重建误差校准的学习置信门控调制高频残差；(3) 参考锚定退化重放RADR，用共享潜在退化代理分别渲染增强图与参考图，促使二者重现输入；RADR仅用于训练，不增加推理开销。

Result: 在16项全参考数据集-指标比较中13项排名第一，并在无参考基准上取得有竞争力的视觉效果；消融表明置信校准在与重放监督结合时最有效。

Conclusion: 结合结构化颜色校正、局部受控细节恢复与参考锚定重放可有效约束水下增强，验证了操作级与目标级双重约束的互补性。

Abstract: Underwater image enhancement aims to correct color and recover detail degraded by wavelength-dependent attenuation, scattering, and noise. Paired-reference supervision constrains output similarity, but does not by itself specify the color mapping, the strength of local detail corrections, or consistency with the degraded observation. We propose MCL-UIE, a paired-supervised framework that addresses these requirements by constraining restoration operations and the training objective. Monotonic Chromatic Transform (MCT) restricts global color mapping in log-LMS space through positive diagonal entries and bounded cross-channel coefficients. Uncertainty-Gated Wavelet Reconstruction (UGWR) modulates high-frequency residuals with a learned confidence gate calibrated against normalized wavelet reconstruction errors. During training, Reference-Anchored Degradation Replay (RADR) renders the enhanced image and its paired reference using shared latent degradation proxies, encouraging both to reproduce the input. The three components share a restoration network that combines structured color correction, locally controlled detail recovery, and reference-anchored replay. MCL-UIE ranks first in thirteen of sixteen full-reference dataset-metric comparisons and produces competitive visual results on no-reference benchmarks. Objective ablations indicate that confidence calibration is most effective when combined with replay supervision. RADR is used only during training and adds no inference-time computation. Our code is available at https://github.com/Wangtao-Bao/MCL-UIE.

</details>


### [2] [STRATA: Reinforcement-driven Active Sampling with Tri-paradigm Adaptation for Efficient 3D Spatial Transcriptomics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39151)
*Junchao Zhu,Ruining Deng,Chongyu Qu,Zhengyi Lu,Yanfan Zhu,Yuechen Yang,Yu Wang,Shilin Zhao,Haichun Yang,Yuankai Huo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出STRATA，一个强化学习驱动的主动采样框架，结合三范式自适应预测器，从稀疏体素级空间转录组测量中重建稠密3D转录组图谱，提升采样效率与重建精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D体空间转录组（ST）采集成本高昂，AI方法精度有限；而现有2D逐切片ST仍依赖稠密网格采样，导致测量冗余与信息区域欠采样。因此需在稀疏采集条件下高效重建稠密3D转录组图谱。

Method: 构建融合H&E形态与单细胞先验的3D图；采用强化学习智能体估计形态稀疏性与转录组信息量，实现预算感知的信息化spot选择；对稀疏测量使用自适应三范式预测器（检索、回归、跨层插补），通过轻量融合动态加权各分支贡献。

Result: 在多个数据集上实验表明，采样效率与重建精度均有提升，尤其在低预算设置下优势明显。

Conclusion: STRATA通过主动采样与三范式自适应预测，为低成本、高精度的3D空间转录组重建提供了有效方案，代码已开源。

Abstract: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) enables joint characterization of tissue morphology and gene expression. However, 3D volumetric ST acquisition remains expensive. AI-driven methods offer a low-cost alternative but remain limited in accuracy, while recent 2D section-wise ST acquisition still rely on dense grid sampling, resulting in redundant measurements and undersampling of biologically informative regions. To bridge the gap, we propose STRATA, a reinforcement-driven active sampling framework with tri-paradigm adaptation for reconstructing dense 3D transcriptomic maps from sparse voxel-wise ST acquisition. STRATA constructs a 3D graph integrating H&E morphology with single-cell priors and employs a reinforcement learning agent to estimate morphological sparsity and transcriptomic informativeness, enabling budget-aware selection of informative spots. Given these sparse measurements, an adaptive tri-paradigm predictor combines retrieval, regression, and cross-layer imputation through lightweight fusion, dynamically weighting their contributions. Experiments across datasets demonstrate improved sampling efficiency and accuracy, particularly under low-budget settings. Code is available at https://github.com/Junchao-Zhu/STRATA.

</details>


### [3] [PulmoWorld: An Asynchronous Multimodal Medical World Model for Longitudinal Pneumonia Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38289)
*Cheng Tang,Xinyu Zhang,Jiawei Chen,Minghui Zhang,Shaocong Wei,Wei Li,Yuxing Chen,Kongcheng Zhang,Chun-Mei Feng,Nanqing Dong,Xinyuan Zhu,Ziyan Huang,Junjun He,Yirong Chen,Lingtong Huang,Min Cen,Ming Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出PULMOWORLD——一个面向纵向肺炎动态的世界模型，统一了异步状态估计、递归模拟与证据约束规划，在MASS队列上实现具有竞争力的递归预测与预后判别，并在MASS-Syn环境中降低决策遗憾。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 肺炎状态在呼吸、炎症与器官功能多个维度上变化，而描述其状态的测量在时间上异步到达且常不完整。现有方法难以在观测稀疏、不同步的条件下统一建模状态演化、预测与决策。

Method: 1) 历史感知滤波：将状态传播与观测驱动的校正解耦，仅在测量被观测时更新共享信念；2) 基于该信念进行临床数值与模态表示的递归预测及未来预后摘要；3) Cap-MBRL：在授权动作集内搜索想象轨迹，仅当候选满足风险预算并具备预测成本边际时才替换冻结的fallback策略。模型在公开MIMIC-IV-CXR胸片与临床轨迹上分别训练。

Result: 在MASS肺炎队列上，递归预测与任务专用序列模型相当，模拟未来状态保留预后信息；预后判别优于最新值融合，在锁定肺炎面板上长时程误差具竞争力；在5个已知机制的MASS-Syn环境中，Cap-MBRL相比直接执行fallback降低了选择遗憾。

Conclusion: 将异步状态估计、递归模拟与证据约束规划耦合为统一世界模型，可在不完整、异步的肺炎观测条件下同时支撑预测与安全的决策规划。

Abstract: Pneumonia changes across respiration, inflammation, and organ function, while the measurements that describe it arrive at different times and are often incomplete. We introduce PULMOWORLD, a world model for longitudinal pneumonia dynamics that connects asynchronous state estimation, recursive simulation, and evidence-constrained planning. History-aware filtering separates state propagation from observation-driven correction, so a measurement updates the shared belief only when it is observed. That belief supports recursive forecasts of clinical values and modality representations, and summaries of future prognosis. Cap-MBRL searches imagined continuations inside an authorized action set and replaces a frozen fallback only when a candidate meets the risk budget and a predicted-cost margin. On the pneumonia cohort MASS, recursive forecasts are competitive with task-trained sequence models, and simulated future states retain prognostic information. Trained separately on public MIMIC-IV-CXR chest radiographs and clinical trajectories, this model improves prognostic discrimination over latest-value fusion in development and is competitive on long-horizon error on the locked pneumonia panel. In five known-mechanism MASS-Syn environments, Cap-MBRL lowers selection regret relative to direct fallback execution.

</details>


### [4] [ConvRoute-ViT: Convolutional Token Routing for Efficient Vision Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38284)
*Manish Das,Shiv Ram Dubey,Satish Kumar Singh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ConvRoute-ViT，用卷积路由在选定层保留类令牌注意力高的patch，其余令牌空间重组压缩为卷积摘要令牌，按层级构建紧凑判别表示，在CIFAR-100与TinyImageNet上兼顾效率与精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ViT自注意力相对令牌数二次增长，计算开销大；标准实现对所有层所有patch令牌等同处理，导致冗余计算，并削弱对最具判别性物体区域的关注。

Method: 基于类令牌注意力的卷积式令牌路由：在选定层保留最相关patch令牌，其余令牌经空间重组并压缩为紧凑的卷积摘要令牌，从而缩短序列长度而不彻底丢失低信息令牌的上下文；路由分层级施加，为深层构建紧凑且具判别性的表示。

Result: 在CIFAR-100和TinyImageNet上，相较基础ViT，ConvRoute-ViT在保持分类精度的同时提升计算效率。

Conclusion: ConvRoute-ViT表明按注意力重要性进行卷积路由的层级令牌约简，可在不牺牲精度的前提下降低ViT计算成本。

Abstract: Vision Transformers (ViTs) achieve strong image recognition performance, but their self-attention increases quadratically with the number of input tokens and makes them computationally expensive. The standard implementation of ViT models treats all patch tokens with equal importance across every layer of the model. This uniform treatment introduces redundant computation and may reduce the model's focus on the most discriminative object regions. In this paper, we propose ConvRoute-ViT, a convolutional token routing mechanism for efficient vision transformers that performs token reduction through convolutional routing. Our model preserves the most relevant patch tokens according to class-token attention at selected layers, while the remaining tokens are spatially reorganized and compressed into a compact set of convolutional summary tokens. This design reduces the sequence length without completely removing the contextual information of the less informative tokens. By applying the routing process hierarchically, the proposed framework constructs compact and discriminative representations for deeper layers. Experiments on CIFAR-100 and TinyImageNet show that ConvRoute-ViT improves computational efficiency while maintaining classification accuracy compared with the base ViT.

</details>


### [5] [Anatomical Prior-Guided Routing for 3D Lung Tumor Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39414)
*Uihyeon Maeng,Jonghun Kim,Hyunjin Park*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出解剖先验引导路由模块（APRM），利用每个图像块所属解剖区域的先验信息确定性地选择门控，在共享专家适配器池上做稀疏特征路由，实现解剖区域自适应的肺肿瘤分割。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D肺肿瘤体积占比小、跨解剖位置表现异质；基于patch训练与滑窗推理时，裁剪块缺乏全局解剖上下文，使位置相关异质性被放大，模型难以按patch所属解剖区域自适应调整特征处理。

Method: 对每个图像patch获取区域占据的解剖先验信息，确定性选择解剖路由门（anatomical routing gate）；被选门在共享专家适配器池（shared expert adapter pool）上执行稀疏特征路由，从而在跨区域共享专家容量的同时实现解剖特异的特征适配。

Result: 在两个数据集、多种骨干网络上评估，相对基线模型均取得一致性提升；特征可视化显示APRM在不同patch位置产生差异化特征响应。

Conclusion: 解剖先验引导的稀疏路由机制能够依据解剖上下文有效适配特征处理，是一种可用于3D肺肿瘤分割的通用增强模块。

Abstract: Accurate lung tumor segmentation in computed tomography (CT) is essential for treatment planning, response assessment, and quantitative imaging analysis. However, 3D lung tumor segmentation remains challenging because tumors occupy only a small portion of the whole volume and exhibit heterogeneous appearances across anatomical locations. In patch-based training and sliding-window inference for 3D medical image segmentation, location-dependent heterogeneity is further amplified because cropped image patches provide limited global anatomical context, making it difficult for a model to adapt its feature processing according to the anatomical region from which each patch is extracted. To address this limitation, we propose an Anatomical Prior-guided Routing Module (APRM) for lung tumor segmentation. For each image patch, we obtain anatomical prior information of regional occupancy and deterministically select an anatomical routing gate. The selected gate then performs sparse feature routing over a shared expert adapter pool, enabling anatomy-specific feature adaptation while sharing expert capacity across regions. We evaluate APRM on two datasets with various backbone networks and demonstrate consistent improvements over baseline models. Furthermore, feature visualizations show that APRM produces different feature responses depending on patch location, indicating that the proposed routing mechanism effectively adapts feature processing according to anatomical context.

</details>


### [6] [YOLOF-MLD: A Multi-Level Distillation Framework for Efficient Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39408)
*Xiaolong Wu,Liming Zheng,Zitong Liu,Yue Zheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出YOLOF-MLD：以YOLO26n为骨干、YOLOF单输入单输出（SiSo）颈部替代参数密集的FPN，并用多级蒸馏（MLD）弥补精度损失，实现CPU端高效边缘目标检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 烟火监测等安全关键应用需在资源受限边缘设备上高效检测；但YOLO26等轻量框架仍依赖参数密集的多分支FPN，难以充分发挥轻量优势。改用YOLOF的SiSo颈部虽可减参，却带来显著精度下降。

Method: 构建由YOLO26n骨干、SiSo颈部与多级蒸馏组成的框架：在骨干处进行切片语义匹配（sliced-semantics matching），在颈部进行感受野匹配，并在响应层进行对齐蒸馏。

Result: 在D-Fire与AFS数据集上，参数减少35.7%，Raspberry Pi 5上加速62.3%；mAP@50分别为71.6%与59.9%（YOLO26n为75.5%与60.0%）。

Conclusion: YOLOF-MLD在边缘部署中取得具竞争力的精度—延迟权衡，验证了以蒸馏补偿SiSo颈部精度损失的可行性。

Abstract: Efficient object detection on resource-constrained edge devices is essential for safety-critical applications such as fire-smoke monitoring. However, current lightweight frameworks, such as YOLO26, still rely on the parameter-dense multi-branch Feature Pyramid Network (FPN), preventing full exploitation of their lightweight advantage. Replacing FPN with YOLOF's single-input-single-output (SiSo) neck is a promising solution but causes substantial accuracy loss. To alleviate this, we propose YOLOF-MLD, a CPU-efficient multi-level distillation (MLD) framework that combines a YOLO26n backbone, a SiSo neck, and MLD. It aligns features at the backbone via sliced-semantics matching, neck with receptive-field matching, and response levels. On D-Fire and Annotated Fire-Smoke (AFS) datasets, YOLOF-MLD reduces the parameter count of YOLO26n by 35.7\% and achieves a 62.3\% speedup on Raspberry Pi 5, attaining 71.6% and 59.9% mAP@50, respectively, compared with 75.5% and 60.0% for YOLO26n. These results demonstrate a competitive accuracy--latency trade-off for edge deployment. Our code is available at https://github.com/XiaolongWU111/YOLOF---MLD/blob/main/README.md.

</details>


### [7] [SymKL: A Unified Representation-Space Measure of Signal Degradation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39403)
*Dhananjaya Jayasundara,Sudarshan Rajagopalan,Vishal M. Patel*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 SymKL：基于隐式神经表示（INR）的模态无关全参考退化度量，用原始参考拟合一次 INR，以对角 Fisher 信息刻画局部信息几何，将参考与退化观测下的参数敏感度剖面的对称 KL 散度作为退化分数；并给出 SIREN 对角 Fisher 的精确闭式表达，实现高效计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有全参考退化度量本质上是模态特定的（图像、音频、3D 各有专属指标），缺乏跨模态统一、且无需知道退化过程与强度的度量方法。

Method: 1) 对原始参考信号拟合一个 INR，仅拟合一次；2) 以该表示的对角 Fisher 信息表征学习表示在参数空间中的局部信息几何；3) 分别用原始参考与退化观测评估 Fisher 信息，得到两组参数敏感度剖面；4) 以二者对称 KL 散度定义退化分数；5) 推导 SIREN 对角 Fisher 的精确闭式解以提升计算效率。方法仅需参考与退化观测，不依赖退化类型或严重程度先验。

Result: 在图像、语音与体素化 3D 基准上，SymKL 能准确跟踪退化严重程度；在传统指标饱和或失效的区间仍保持单调性，并提供统一的模态无关退化度量。

Conclusion: SymKL 以 INR 的 Fisher 信息几何为核心，构建了跨图像、音频、3D 数据的统一全参考退化度量，兼具理论闭式表达与实证有效性；代码将在评审后公开。

Abstract: Quantifying degradation between a pristine signal and its degraded observation is fundamental to signal processing, yet existing full-reference measures are inherently modality-specific. We introduce SymKL, a unified full-reference degradation measure based on implicit neural representations (INRs). An INR is fitted once to the pristine reference and characterized by its diagonal Fisher information, which captures the local information geometry of the learned representation. Evaluating the Fisher information with the pristine reference and a degraded observation yields two parameter-sensitivity profiles whose symmetric KL divergence defines the degradation score. The proposed formulation requires only the reference and degraded observation, without knowledge of the corruption process or degradation severity, making it applicable across images, audio, and 3D data. We further derive an exact closed-form expression for the diagonal Fisher of SIREN, enabling efficient computation. Experiments on image, speech, and volumetric 3D benchmarks demonstrate that SymKL accurately tracks degradation severity, remains monotonic where conventional metrics saturate or fail, and provides a unified modality-agnostic measure of signal degradation. Code will be made publicly available after the review process.

</details>


### [8] [ACD-GS: Asymmetric Curvature-aware Densification for 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39399)
*Houqiang Zhong,Tianchi Zhu,Qiang Hu,Xiaoyun Zhang,Li Song,Wenjun Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ACD-GS，利用二阶深度响应作为结构先验，实现非对称曲率感知的致密化控制，并引入多视图光度一致性约束与容量自适应调节，在训练中直接抑制冗余高斯生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3DGS训练时的致密化高度依赖启发式规则，现有方法主要依靠一阶屏幕空间梯度触发克隆与分裂，无法区分真实几何不连续与高频纹理或噪声残差，导致高斯冗余增殖与几何重建不准确。

Method: 核心洞察是二阶深度响应能为密度控制提供更可靠的结构先验。据此设计非对称的克隆/分裂调控以更好捕捉几何不连续；引入多视图光度一致性约束抑制单视图瞬时误差；并提出容量感知的自适应调节策略，在训练中平衡致密化与剪枝，从根本上避免冗余高斯生成，而非事后压缩或量化。

Result: 在多个数据集上一致优于现有方法，高斯数量与存储降低近60%，同时保持有竞争力的渲染保真度。

Conclusion: ACD-GS通过曲率感知的非对称致密化与训练期自适应调节，实现了紧凑且几何感知的3D高斯优化，证明训练期直接抑制冗余优于事后压缩路线。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for real-time photorealistic novel view synthesis. However, its training-time densification remains largely heuristic, often resulting in redundant Gaussian proliferation and inaccurate geometric reconstruction. Existing methods predominantly rely on first-order screen-space gradients to trigger cloning and splitting, which fail to distinguish true geometric discontinuities from high-frequency textures or noisy residuals. To address this limitation, we propose ACD-GS, an Asymmetric Curvature-aware Densification framework for compact and geometry-aware 3D Gaussian optimization. Our key insight is that second-order depth responses provide a more reliable structural prior for density control, enabling asymmetric regulation of cloning and splitting to better capture geometric discontinuities. Building on this, we introduce a multi-view photometric consistency constraint to suppress transient single-view errors, together with a capacity-aware adaptive regulation strategy that balances densification and pruning during training. Unlike post-hoc compression or quantization-based approaches, ACD-GS directly prevents redundant Gaussian generation during training, yielding inherently compact representations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method reduces nearly 60% of Gaussian count and storage while maintaining competitive rendering fidelity, consistently outperforming existing methods across multiple datasets. Our code is available in https://waveviewer.github.io/ACD-GS/.

</details>


### [9] [CASE: Concept-Aware Segmentation from Positive and Negative Visual Exemplars](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39396)
*Yi-Jen Tsai,Yen-Yu Lin,Chien-Yao Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文将"正负视觉提示共同指定目标概念"的分割任务形式化为Specified Visual Prompt Segmentation (SVPS)，构建CASE基准（基于COCO/PACO，含排除、隔离、并集及属性层面共六类任务族），发现冻结SAM 3不能稳定将负提示作为排除证据，并提出保守的LoRA适配基线CPA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统少样本语义分割仅依赖单语义类的正样本支持，正提示往往欠约束：如"红色汽车"易与所有颜色汽车混淆，"车辆"可能包含应排除的汽车，材料定义对象可能跨多类别。实现精确请求需正例提供包含证据、负例提供意图约束以完成排除与消歧。

Method: 将任务形式化为SVPS，目标概念由正、负视觉提示共同指定（视觉示例为边界框指定的支持图像区域）；构建CASE基准（基于COCO与PACO），覆盖六类类别级与属性级任务族：排除、隔离、并集、属性排除、属性隔离、属性并集；在该设定下评测SAM 3，并提出Concept Prompt Adaptation (CPA)——一种保守的基于LoRA的适配基线，用于改善正负提示解读。

Result: 冻结SAM 3虽具备强大的仅正提示少样本分割能力，但在SVPS下并不能一致地将负视觉提示作为排除证据；CPA在CASE上改善了正负提示解读能力，同时在仅正提示少样本分割设定下保持有竞争力。

Conclusion: 正负视觉提示联合指定概念是必要且现实的设定；现有强模型在负提示利用上存在系统性不足，轻量保守的LoRA适配可作为有效基线，提示后续需专门设计负提示理解机制。

Abstract: Few-shot semantic segmentation typically identifies target objects based on positive support examples of a single semantic class. In practice, however, positive cues alone are often underspecified: for instance, "red cars" may be confused with cars of all colors, "vehicles" may include cars that should be excluded, and "material-defined objects" may span multiple categories. Fulfilling precise requests requires positive exemplars to provide inclusion evidence and negative exemplars to act as intent-defining constraints for exclusion and disambiguation. We formulate this setting as Specified Visual Prompt Segmentation (SVPS), where the target concept is specified by both positive and negative visual prompts. In this work, visual exemplars refer to support-image regions specified by bounding-box prompts. To study SVPS, we introduce CASE (Concept-Aware Segmentation from Positive and Negative Visual Exemplars), a benchmark built on COCO and PACO. CASE encompasses six category- and attribute-level task families: exclusion, isolation, union, attribute exclusion, attribute isolation, and attribute union. We evaluate SAM 3 under this setting and find that, despite its powerful positive-only few-shot segmentation capability, frozen SAM 3 does not consistently treat negative visual prompts as exclusion evidence. To address this, we present Concept Prompt Adaptation (CPA), a conservative LoRA-based adaptation baseline that improves positive-negative prompt interpretation on CASE while remaining competitive under positive-only few-shot segmentation. Code is available at https://github.com/WongKinYiu/FSS-CASE.

</details>


### [10] [Telling Is Not Seeing: Textual Personas Rarely Make Vision-Language Models Answer Like the People They Describe](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39331)
*Jiawei Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 人物设定（persona）提示并不能让视觉语言模型"像"所描述的人那样看；它只是让模型复述其关于人群的知识，而非复现真实的感知差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前研究常用"你患有低视力"等人物设定提示来模拟真实的用户群体，以便在用户研究中替代真人。作者质疑这种替代的有效性：persona 是否真的让模型获得了被描述者的视觉/感知特性。

Method: 将 persona 提示下的模型回答与真实测量的低视力、色盲或听力损失人群作比较，并与仅使用 persona 所陈述事实的简单规则基线对比。实验覆盖 14 个模型；对"模糊"描述与真实图像模糊进行对照；并检查开源模型内部的图像表征与答案概率是否改变，以及模型是否能估算模糊与错觉对人的影响。

Result: persona 从未胜过简单规则基线，且抹平了群体间与个体间的真实差异。在全部 14 个模型中，"描述模糊"不改变识别表现，而真正模糊图片则会像对人一样降低表现。开源模型内部，描述既未改变图像信息，也未改变答案概率。然而模型能够估计模糊与错觉对人的影响。

Conclusion: "告知不等于看见"：persona 让模型说出它所知道的关于人的知识，而非看见这些人所看见的东西。因此用 persona 替代真实残障用户做用户研究是不可靠的。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly prompted with personas, such as "You have low vision", to stand in for people in user studies. We ask whether a persona makes a model see like the person it describes. We compare persona answers with measured people with low vision, color blindness or hearing loss, and with simple rules that use only the facts the persona states. The persona never beats these rules, and it erases the real differences between groups and individuals. Describing blur leaves recognition unchanged in all 14 models we test, while blurring the photo lowers it as it does for people. Inside open models, the description changes neither the image information nor the answer probabilities. Yet the models know the effects they fail to show: they can estimate how blur and illusions affect people. Telling is not seeing: a persona makes a model say what it knows about people, not see what they see.

</details>


### [11] [MemoryFusion: Cross-Temporal Memory Learning for Multimodal Video Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39322)
*Meiqi Gong,Hao Zhang,Jiayi Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MemoryFusion：一种两阶段视频融合框架，通过跨时间记忆学习与渐进式时间精化，实现长时程利用与时间一致性的融合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频融合方法主要依赖短程时间交互，长时信息未被充分利用；同时融合表示不一致会引发闪烁伪影，破坏时间连贯性。两类问题相互耦合。

Method: 两阶段框架。第一阶段：结合短期记忆库（局部时间引导）与长期记忆库（面向融合的更新策略保留可靠历史信息），并用时间平滑模块借助软运动线索做粗粒度背景稳定，得到融合先验。第二阶段：轻量级3D残差时间精化模块，修正剩余时间不一致并增强结构细节。

Result: 大量实验表明，MemoryFusion 在融合质量与时间一致性上优于现有基于帧和基于视频的融合方法。

Conclusion: 通过记忆驱动的长短期时间建模与渐进式精化，可同时提升视频融合的保真度与时间连贯性；代码已开源。

Abstract: Multimodal videos contain rich temporal cues that can facilitate faithful fusion. However, existing video fusion methods mainly rely on short-range temporal interactions, leaving valuable long-term information underexplored. Moreover, inconsistent fusion representations can cause flickering artifacts, undermining temporal coherence. To address these coupled challenges, we propose MemoryFusion, a two-stage framework integrating cross-temporal memory learning with progressive temporal refinement. Considering the complementary roles of adjacent and distant frames, the first stage combines a Short-Term Memory Bank for local temporal guidance with a Long-Term Memory Bank that preserves reliable historical information through a fusion-oriented update strategy. To mitigate temporal fluctuations, a Temporal Smoothing Module leverages soft motion cues for coarse background stabilization. Building upon the resulting fusion prior, The second stage further employs a lightweight 3D residual Temporal Refinement Module to correct remaining temporal inconsistencies while enhancing structural details. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MemoryFusion achieves superior fusion quality and temporal consistency over existing frame-based and video-based fusion methods. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/Meiqi-Gong/MemoryFusion.

</details>


### [12] [Youtu-Parsing-Omni: One Encoder, One Schema, All Modalities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39301)
*Yunhang Shen,Zhangquan Chen,Xiaotian Li,Zhongpeng Cai,Qing Zhou,Zekai Zhang,Kun Zhang,Zezhong Wu,Jian Hu,Haihan Gao,Heting Gao,Xin Li,Yinsong Liu,Deqian Jiang,Di Yin,Haoyu Cao,Xing Sun,Bing Liu,Yanqiu Qu,Yunfei Wu,Kun Yin,Zhixiang Wei,Yongxiang Hua,Qianyu Li,Xiaoxing Hu,Peiyuan Zhang,Lijiang Li,Dong Xu,Zhenchuan Yang,Yiliang Jiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出全模态解析器Youtu-Parsing-Omni，用单一编码器与统一schema将文本/图像/音频/视频解析为时空可定位的结构化记录，单5B模型在OmniDocBench v1.6、OmniParsingBench等多项任务上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文档解析系统多为单模态或任务专用，缺乏跨模态（音频/视频）的时空对齐能力，难以作为智能体的感知层提供可定位、可引用的证据；且不同解析任务输出格式各异，难以用统一目标联合训练。

Method: 1) Youtu-Omni-Encoder：由预训练语言模型初始化以增强文字阅读，所有模态共享权重并编码于统一时空坐标系，少量融合层使视频帧关注同步音频，将跨模态融合与时间对齐内化到感知阶段；2) OmniSchema：统一十种解析任务的输出格式；3) OSAD（OmniSchema-Aware On-Policy Distillation）：基于token角色的共享目标，每轮用模型自身rollout、以“参考条件化自复制体”的token级目标监督，并刷新参考模型，实现解析器与监督信号协同演化。

Result: 单个5B参数checkpoint在OmniDocBench v1.6上取得96.96 Overall的SOTA；OmniParsingBench上以75.08 Avg.领先所有开源权重模型，优势集中于音频与视频；图表解析总体得分最佳（95.02）；化学指纹精确一致率最高；排版乐谱字符级转写匹配专用光学乐谱模型，显著优于通用系统。

Conclusion: 以“一模态一编码器、一任务一schema”为核心的设计可在单一中等规模模型中实现跨模态统一解析与时空可定位输出，验证了统一schema下在线自演化蒸馏的有效性，可作为智能体多模态感知层；代码与权重已公开。

Abstract: We present Youtu-Parsing-Omni, an omni-modal parser that converts documents, images, audio, and video into structured records grounded in space and time, providing a perception layer for agents that read, locate, and cite evidence across modalities. Its design rests on one encoder for every modality and one schema for every task. Youtu-Omni-Encoder, initialized from a pre-trained language model to strengthen text reading, encodes all modalities with shared weights in a unified space-time coordinate system, and a few fusion layers let video frames attend to concurrent audio, bringing cross-modal fusion and temporal alignment into perception itself. OmniSchema unifies the outputs of all ten parsing tasks, allowing a single self-evolving post-training procedure, OmniSchema-Aware On-Policy Distillation (OSAD), to provide a shared token-role-based objective across tasks. In each round, the model is trained on its own rollouts against token-level targets from a reference-conditioned copy of itself, which is then refreshed with the trained weights, so that the parser and its supervision co-evolve. With a single 5 B-parameter checkpoint, Youtu-Parsing-Omni achieves state-of-the-art performance on OmniDocBench v1.6 (96.96 Overall) and leads all open-weight models on OmniParsingBench (75.08 Avg.), with its advantage concentrated on audio and video. It also achieves the best overall chart-parsing score (95.02) and the highest exact chemical-fingerprint agreement among compared systems, and matches a dedicated optical-music model in character-level transcription of typeset sheet music while staying far ahead of general-purpose systems. Code and model weights are publicly available.

</details>


### [13] [REEL: Same Frames, Different Answers and Different Costs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38158)
*Xin Liang,Jiangpeng He*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 REEL 评测框架，在相同观测帧下对比三种"视频记忆"表示（Text / Visual / Prefix State）与全量重处理（Frames），用配对正确性变化、累计 GPU 时间和存储开销区分"复用计算"与"丢弃信息"这两种被混同的效率来源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长视频问答中，逐问题重处理不可扩展，于是系统倾向"看一次、建记忆、后答题"。但记忆内容在问题未知时就已确定，被丢弃的信息无法恢复；而现有评估只用 token 数量衡量节省，token 变短不等于模型真正复用了已算结果，平均准确率也掩盖了逐题的答案漂移。需要一种能把"记忆造成的差异"与"帧观测差异"解耦的可测评测。

Method: REEL 固定完全相同的观测帧，仅改变保存的表示：Text（简短的文字事件记录）、Visual（保留编码器输出）、Prefix State（额外保留语言模型前缀），并与 Frames（全量重处理）对照。指标为逐题配对正确性变化、累计 GPU 时间与存储占用；在 6 个视觉语言模型和 2 个基准上评测。

Result: Text 与 Frames 在 20%–29% 的问题上正确性不同，即便平均准确率几乎一致；Visual 与 Prefix State 则明显更接近 Frames。存储无限时，Prefix State 在所有模型、两个基准上都是"几乎保住 Frames 全部答对题目"的记忆中累计 GPU 时间最低者；代价是存储，每视频最高约 21 GiB，而 Text 仅需 KB 级。

Conclusion: 复用计算与丢弃信息表面上都表现为"效率"，但后者移除了后续问题可能需要的证据；平均准确率与 token 数都无法区分二者。REEL 使这一差别对任何"一次记忆、多问答题"的系统可量化。

Abstract: Video understanding keeps moving toward longer recordings, and the longer a recording is, the more questions can be asked about it. But processing it again for every question does not scale, so many systems watch the video once, build a memory, and answer later questions from it. Yet what to remember is decided before anyone knows what will be asked, and whatever is left out cannot be recovered later.
  Moreover, whether the savings pay off is judged by token counts, which fall when the input gets shorter but not when the model reuses what it has already computed. We present REEL, an evaluation framework that compares three saved representations built from exactly the same observed frames, so that a change in answers can come only from what the system remembered. Text writes a short record of what happened, Visual keeps the encoder outputs, and Prefix State also keeps the language-model prefix. Each is compared with full reprocessing (Frames) by paired correctness changes, cumulative GPU time, and storage size. Across six vision-language models and two benchmarks, Text and Frames differ in correctness on 20\% to 29\% of questions, even when their mean accuracy is almost the same. By contrast, Visual and Prefix State stay much closer to Frames. With unlimited storage, Prefix State is the cheapest in total GPU time among memories that keep almost all of the answers Frames gets right, for every model on both benchmarks. The trade-off is storage: Prefix State keeps up to about 21 GiB per video, whereas Text needs only kilobytes. Reusing computation and discarding information both look like efficiency, but only the second removes evidence that later questions may need, and neither mean accuracy nor token count tells them apart. REEL makes that difference measurable for any system that answers many questions from one saved memory.

</details>


### [14] [StepControl: Long-Horizon Human Motion Generation from Foot-Contact Schedules](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38153)
*Hojun Jang,Jinseok Bae,Donggeun Lim,Taesun Kim,Seungbin Jeong,Younghwan Lee,Yong Seok Kim,Young Min Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出StepControl——一个以未来左右脚触地时间表为唯一条件的自回归扩散模型，实现全身动作的可控生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可控人体动作生成多关注"做什么动作"（语义提示）或"身体往哪走"（根节点/空间轨迹），而"何时触地"这一时间维度接口被忽视；作者研究仅通过指定每只脚的触地时刻能否控制全身动作。

Method: 以未来二值化的左/右脚触地时间表为条件，构建自回归扩散模型，无需目标根节点与身体姿态或语义提示；将触地表示为显式时间事件，通过专门的交叉注意力注入，并结合无分类器引导；另引入随机混合噪声调度与warmup策略以稳定长时程自回归生成。

Result: 相比将现有空间引导动作生成器改造为触地约束的方案，StepControl更精确地遵循给定触地时序；在长连续 rollout 中保持有效的触地控制，并能响应节拍变化、走走停停的停顿、跛行步态与双脚跳跃等编辑后的时间表。

Conclusion: 实验表明，最小化的脚部触地时间表是一种有效且直观的时间接口，可用于可控动作生成。

Abstract: Controllable human motion generation has largely focused on specifying what action should occur or where the body should move. We study a complementary question: can full-body motion be controlled by specifying only when each foot contacts the ground? We introduce StepControl, an autoregressive diffusion model conditioned on a future binary left/right foot-contact schedule, without requiring target root and body poses, or semantic prompts. StepControl represents contact as explicit temporal events and injects them through dedicated cross-attention with classifier-free guidance. We further introduce a stochastic mixture noise schedule and warmup strategy for stable long-horizon autoregressive generation. Experiments show that StepControl follows prescribed contact timing more accurately than adapting existing spatially guided motion generators to contact constraints. It maintains effective contact control over long continuous rollouts and responds to edited schedules such as cadence changes, stop-and-go pauses, limping gaits, and bilateral jumping. Our results show that minimal foot-contact schedules provide an effective and intuitive temporal interface for controllable motion generation.

</details>


### [15] [Hierarchical Diffusion for Camera-controlled Autoregressive Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37983)
*Kaihua Chen,Yiming Gong,Deva Ramanan,Tarasha Khurana*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出轻量级框架 WanAR+FixAR，将自回归生成与分层长上下文去噪结合，并以"变形+修复"形式注入相机控制，实现单图条件下的长视频相机可控生成，在 RealEstate10k 与 DL3DV 上优于既有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主流自回归长视频生成存在两大问题：(1) 误差累积/漂移，远端帧以生成结果为条件而非真值；(2) 相机控制注入方式不明确。常规解法（self-forcing、显式 6-DOF 位姿条件）要么计算开销大，要么随时间产生几何漂移。

Method: 借鉴前馈新视角合成，将视频生成重构为 warping-and-inpainting 问题以对齐输入相机几何；采用 FixAR 分层去噪：先用即时历史条件生成帧，再用时间下采样得到的长程历史作为条件的第二去噪器精修，以 fine-to-coarse 方式实现全局一致性；整体基于自回归生成器 WanAR。

Result: 在 RealEstate10k 和 DL3DV 数据集上，WanAR+FixAR 在相机可控长视频生成任务上超过先前方法，结果兼具时间稳定性与对输入相机轨迹的一致性。

Conclusion: 通过"变形-修复"式相机条件与分层长上下文去噪，可在不引入高成本的前提下让每帧有效利用完整时序上下文，缓解漂移并保持场景几何与相机一致，为长视频可控生成提供简洁高效的方案。

Abstract: We address the task of long-video, camera-controlled generation from a single image. The dominant autoregressive paradigm suffers from two key limitations: (1) error accumulation over time, as distant frames are conditioned on previously generated outputs rather than ground truth, leading to drift; and (2) ambiguity in how to incorporate camera control. Standard solutions to both--such as self-forcing and conditioning on explicit 6-DOF poses--either incur significant computational overhead or produce drifting scene geometries over time. We propose a simple and lightweight framework that combines autoregressive generation (WanAR) with hierarchical long-context denoising (FixAR). To enforce scene geometry remains consistent with input cameras, we draw from feed-forward novel-view synthesis and reformulate video generation as a warping-and-inpainting problem. To mitigate drift, we introduce a hierarchical denoising strategy in which different stages condition on different temporal histories. Specifically, we first generate frames conditioned on the immediate past, and then refine them using a second denoiser conditioned on a temporally subsampled long-range history to enforce global consistency. This fine-to-coarse scheme enables each generated frame to effectively condition on the full temporal context without incurring a prohibitive cost. Experiments on RealEstate10k and DL3DV demonstrate that WanAR+FixAR outperforms prior methods for camera-controlled long-video generation, producing results that are both temporally stable and consistent with input camera trajectories.

</details>


### [16] [Intersectional Invariant Learning for Fair Deepfake Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37881)
*Uzoamaka Ezeakunne,Taiwo Olabamipe,Deevesh Jain,Xiuwen Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Intersectional Invariant Learning (IIL)框架，从特征学习层面而非仅输出约束来缓解深伪检测的交叉人口群体公平性差异，实现AUC>99%、FPR<2.5%且交叉公平性差距最低的Pareto最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深伪检测模型整体准确率高，但不同人口群体（如性别×肤色交叉群体）间假阳性率差异显著。现有公平性方法仅约束模型输出以均衡群体预测，未处理特征层面的偏差，导致模型仍可能依赖肤色纹理等人口属性作为检测的间接线索。

Method: IIL交替执行两步：识别最具挑战性的人口分组划分，并学习在这些划分间保持一致的（不变）特征表示；同时引入假阳性率（FPR）公平性目标，并在六个性别×肤色交叉群体上采用群体平衡采样。

Result: 在含逾百万图像、10个基线检测器、21项公平性与效用指标的大规模公平性基准上评估，IIL达到Pareto最优：AUC>99%、FPR<2.5%、交叉公平性差距（FMEO）最低；在21项指标中的绝大多数优于既有公平性方法，FPR与交叉公平性差距较最强基线降低数倍。

Conclusion: 从特征层面对齐交叉群体表征比单纯输出层约束更有效，可同时提升效用与交叉群体公平性，为深伪检测的公平性研究提供了新方向。

Abstract: Deepfake detection models achieve high overall accuracy but exhibit large performance disparities across demographic groups, causing some groups to experience substantially higher false-positive rates than others. Existing fairness-aware methods address this by constraining model outputs to equalize group predictions, but do not tackle the underlying feature-level bias. As a result, models may still rely on demographic characteristics, such as skin texture, as indirect cues for detecting manipulated content. To address this problem, we propose Intersectional Invariant Learning (IIL), a framework that improves feature learning rather than only adjusting model outputs. IIL alternates between identifying the most challenging demographic partitions and learning features that remain consistent across those partitions. The framework also includes a false-positive-rate fairness objective and group-balanced sampling across six gender x skin-tone intersectional groups. We evaluate IIL on a large-scale fairness benchmark containing over one million images, 10 baseline detectors, and 21 fairness and utility metrics. Results show that IIL achieves Pareto-optimal performance, simultaneously attaining an AUC above 99%, a false-positive rate under 2.5%, and the lowest intersectional fairness disparity (FMEO) among all compared methods. Abstract: Multi-Object Tracking (MOT) requires localizing multiple objects and maintaining their identities over time. While SDCs provide superior precision and reliability within a closed vocabulary, VLMs offer strong semantic generalization and broad taxonomic coverage, particularly through structured JSON targets and verify-calibrate reranking (hierarchical F1 of 0.559). Abstract: Detecting whether and in particular how two data distributions differ is a fundamental statistical problem. For example, we might be interested in which concepts (expressed in natural language) differ between two classes, the outputs of different generative models, or the same model with different prompt specifications. When working with large and complex image datasets, we intuitively think that first selecting concepts from a broad list using fine-grained patch embeddings, and then optimizing the concepts to better fit the data is an effective workflow. However, prior work instead uses MLLMs to propose concepts and image-level embeddings to select them. Therefore, we systematically compare these techniques and find that selecting concepts from broad lists can replace MLLM-proposals at obviously lower cost. Additionally, by designing a new benchmark that focuses on low-prevalence and multi-concept distinctions, we find that selecting nonredundant concepts instead of only the most distinguishing concepts matters, and we introduce techniques for how to effectively do this. Abstract: Recent advances in generative image editing enable complex transformations such as background replacement, object manipulation, and pose adjustment from natural language instructions. Motivation: 检验生成模型是否已在匹配真实数据统计特性上"达到完美"，即真假数据是否已统计不可区分；并探究已知的低层伪影（如棋盘格伪影）是否只是识别伪造的全部依据。

Method: 训练深度神经网络作为真假分类器并观察测试准确率；构造渐进式抽象（模糊、降采样、裁剪、RGB转边缘/语义图等）以试图抹除低层伪影，再在抽象空间中重新做可分性测试。

Result: 几乎没有任何抽象能使伪造数据与真实数据不可区分；分类器仅在抽象程度极高（如将256×256人脸降采样至4×4）时才失效。该趋势在MNIST、CelebA、FFHQ、GenImage四个复杂度各异的数据集及GAN、VAE、扩散模型上均成立。

Conclusion: 伪造伪影从低层延伸到高层语义层面，并非仅由低层噪声导致；生成图像与真实图像的差异比通常认为的更显著，生成模型尚未实现统计意义上的不可区分。

Abstract: Images produced by generative models appear strikingly similar to real ones. In this work, we study whether perfection has been reached by generated content in terms of matching the properties of real data. We train deep neural networks to separate real data from fake and observe their test accuracies. Only a chance performance has any scope of proving statistical indistinguishability. However, since generative models are known to sometimes introduce small errors, e.g., low level checkerboard artifacts, we create progressive abstractions of the original real/fake images to potentially bring them to a space where those artifacts get wiped away. These include operations such as blurring, downsizing, cropping, converting RGB images into edge/semantic maps, etc. To our surprise, almost none of the abstractions are able to make fake data indistinguishable from real. The only cases when neural network based classifiers fail to separate the two categories is when the data is abstracted to such an extent that the original content seems mostly lost to the human eye, e.g., downsizing a $256 \times 256$ RGB image of human face to $4 \times 4$ resolution. The simple implication is that fake images are much more different from real than we are used to think.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Embodied world models should not only imagine plausible futures, but also perceive the geometric, semantic, and motion structure of the evolving world. We present GenSight, a unified embodied world model that brings future video generation and dense perception into a single pretrained video diffusion transformer. GenSight uses a unified spatiotemporal representation for video, depth, embodiment segmentation, and first-frame-relative 2D flow. Built on a shared DiT backbone, GenSight uses lightweight task modulation to predict all modalities within the same architecture. All tasks are jointly optimized within a unified velocity prediction space. At inference, GenSight supports two complementary modes: multi-step future video generation with aligned dense predictions and single-step dense perception from an observed video. By unifying modality representation, model architecture, and prediction space, GenSight avoids separate modality-specific pipelines and couples appearance, geometry, semantics, and motion in a shared representation. It promotes cross-modal consistency and allows dense perception to benefit from the spatiotemporal priors learned through video generation. </details>

*Sihyun Kim,Sanghyun Jo,Kyungsu Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 编辑后终点图像作为图像到视频过渡的显式条件会保留源图布局上下文，从而在视频终态产生时间伪影；作者提出只约束编辑相关区域的Partial条件方案，实验证明其在不降低过渡完成率的前提下显著减少时间伪影。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 使用编辑后的终点图像进行全帧条件化，虽能明确过渡目标并提升过渡完成度，但同时把源图布局上下文变成对视频终态的硬性要求，诱发时间伪影。作者希望厘清这些伪影的成因（是约束范围本身，还是编辑相关区域之外的上下文约束），并寻找更合理的终点条件化方式。

Method: 用三项指标量化伪影：Hard-Cut（HC，不连续切换）、Background Motion Reversal（BMR，后期背景反向运动）、Dynamic Degree（DD，运动抑制）。在5个视频模型（涵盖免训练与学习式终点条件化）上观察伪影的模型特异性表现。提出Partial方案：基于图像编辑器的注意力估计出编辑相关区域，仅对该区域施加终点约束，其余终态内容交由视频模型自由生成。在TC-Bench-I2V上用三个骨干网络验证，并设计两组对照实验：(1) 统一弱化条件强度；(2) donor-context干预，即保留全帧条件但仅将编辑相关区域之外的上下文替换为Partial视频的末帧。

Result: 相对全帧条件化，Partial在三个骨干上降低时间伪影，且TCR（过渡完成率）无显著差异；统一弱化条件强度无法复现上述伪影下降。donor-context干预在HunyuanVideo-1.5上降低HC与BMR，在Wan2.2-Turbo上降低BMR并恢复DD，TCR均无显著差异。

Conclusion: 伪影不能仅由约束范围解释，编辑相关区域之外的上下文约束是关键因素。编辑后终点图像应被视为"部分未来目标"；同时，编辑相关性并不保证该内容在视频未来状态中仍然有效。

Abstract: Edited endpoint images make the target of an image-to-video transition explicit and can improve transition completion, but also preserve context in the source image's layout. Full-frame endpoint conditioning turns this preserved context into requirements on the video's final state, potentially inducing temporal artifacts. We measure discontinuity with Hard-Cut (HC), late background reversal with Background Motion Reversal (BMR), and motion suppression with Dynamic Degree (DD). These artifacts appear across five video models spanning training-free and learned endpoint conditioning, in model-specific forms. We study Partial, a selective conditioning scheme that constrains only an edit-relevant region estimated from image-editor attention and leaves the remaining terminal content to the video model. Across three backbones on TC-Bench-I2V, Partial reduces temporal artifacts relative to full-frame conditioning, with no significant difference in Transition Completion Ratio (TCR); on Wan2.2-Turbo, uniformly weakening conditioning does not reproduce these reductions. A donor-context intervention keeps full-frame conditioning and replaces only the context outside the edit-relevant region with the final frame of a Partial video. It lowers HC and BMR on HunyuanVideo-1.5 and lowers BMR while restoring DD on Wan2.2-Turbo, with no significant difference in TCR, so constraint extent alone does not account for these artifacts. Abstract: Aligning a partial, real-world 3D face scan to a canonical representation requires solving two coupled problems at once: estimating the rigid pose that brings the scan into a common frame, and completing the facial shape in regions the scan never observed. Existing pipelines typically decouple these steps, running a generic point-cloud registration front end followed by a separate non-rigid fitting or deformation stage. Building on the GeoTransformer superpoint-matching architecture, we propose a single network that predicts both a rigid pose and a shape-complete point cloud in one forward pass: a cross-attention regressor, conditioned on transformer point features and predicted coarse correspondences, maps a partial scan to per-patch coefficients of a 3D morphable face model learned offline from a corpus of 8,000 identities. </details>


### [28] [FDSML: Formula-Driven Supervised Metric Learning with Parameter-Aware Triplet Loss](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39423)
*Hina Otake,Shinei Arakawa,Keitaro Tanaka,Yoshihiro Fukuhara,Hirokatsu Kataoka,Shigeo Morishima*

Main category: cs.CV

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有FDSL将预训练建模为对离散化标签的分类，丢弃了图像生成过程中的连续性信息，监督信号受限，尤其不利于识别之外（如检索）任务的迁移。

Method: 构建FineFractalDB（类内变化更大、结构更稳定的分形数据集），并设计Parameter-Aware Triplet Loss（PA-Triplet），依据迭代函数系统（IFS）参数空间中的距离分配正负样本，使嵌入遵循由参数导出的相对相似性序关系。

Conclusion: 参数导出的关系型监督比基于标签的分类提供更强的合成预训练信号，尤其有利于超越识别范畴的迁移任务。

Abstract: Formula-Driven Supervised Learning (FDSL) enables vision pre-training without real images, but existing methods cast pre-training as classification on discretized labels, discarding continuity in the generative process. We propose Formula-Driven Supervised Metric Learning (FDSML), which derives relational supervision from image-generation parameters beyond discrete class labels. FDSML combines FineFractalDB, our refined fractal dataset with higher intra-class variation and more stable structures, with a Parameter-Aware Triplet (PA-Triplet) Loss that assigns positives and negatives according to distances in the underlying Iterated Function System parameter space. This objective trains embeddings to respect parameter-derived relative similarity orderings. Experiments show that FDSML improves transferability to image retrieval while remaining competitive on downstream classification and improving robustness under several corruption settings. On ResNet-50, Recall@1 improves from 65.6% to 74.0% on Stanford Online Products and from 56.2% to 78.4% on Stanford Cars over FDSL pre-training. These results suggest that parameter-derived relational supervision provides a stronger synthetic pre-training signal than label-based classification for transfer beyond recognition.

</details>


### [29] [Diagnosing the Reference Gap: What Visual Scaffolds Can and Cannot Fix in Multimodal Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39419)
*Guizhen Chen,Weiwen Xu,Wotao Yin,Anh Tuan Luu,Hou Pong Chan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文指出多模态大模型视觉推理失败的主因是"指代鸿沟"（语言无法绑定到视觉实体），并提出配对基准ReGap-Bench验证：任务匹配的外部参照（如编号）可提升准确率至多25%，而不匹配参照无益甚至有害。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大模型能识别视觉内容，但在多步推理（如计数）中会"看到所有物体却丢失已数过的对象"。这类失败常被归因于感知能力不足，作者认为其实质是语言与视觉实体/区域/位置的绑定失败，即"指代鸿沟"；受视觉程序理论启发，欲检验外部参照能否缩小该鸿沟。

Method: 构建ReGap-Bench：涵盖五类视觉推理任务的配对基准，控制场景、问题与答案不变，仅改变参照形式，从而分离"指代"这一变量；对比任务匹配参照与不匹配参照的效果。

Result: 任务匹配的参照使准确率最高提升25%；不匹配的参照收益甚微，甚至导致性能下降。

Conclusion: 指代鸿沟是区别于视觉感知的独立瓶颈；构造任务适配的视觉参照可作为一种免训练的视觉技能，用于提升多模态推理性能。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models can recognize visual content yet struggle to reason reliably over it across multiple steps. In counting, a model may see all objects but lose track of which ones it has counted. We argue that such failures, commonly attributed to perception, reveal a reference gap: the failure to bind language to the relevant visual entities, regions, or locations. Motivated by the theory of visual routines, we test whether external references such as numbering can narrow this gap. We introduce ReGap-Bench, a paired benchmark of five visual reasoning tasks in which the scene, question, and answer are fixed and only the reference varies. Results show that task-matched references improve accuracy by up to 25\%, while mismatched references provide little benefit or even hurt performance. These findings identify the reference gap as a bottleneck distinct from visual perception and show that constructing task-appropriate visual references can serve as a training-free visual skill for improving multimodal reasoning.

</details>


### [30] [Efficient Covariance-Aware Vicinal Latent Diffusion for Continuous Conditional Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39277)
*Xin Ding,Shuo Huang,Zhenglong Ding,Sen Zhang,Nenglun Chen,Peibei Cao,Yongwei Wang,Fei Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CAViLD：面向连续条件生成的高效潜在扩散框架，通过净化条件感知潜空间与协方差感知渐进蒸馏，在类别不平衡/长尾下缓解数据稀疏，并实现仅4次NFE的单分支条件采样。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有连续扩散模型在标签分布不平衡且长尾时面临严重数据稀疏，导致视觉伪影与条件不一致；同时推理阶段的classifier-free guidance与稠密像素空间积分带来巨大采样开销，限制实际部署。

Abstract: Continuous Conditional Generative Modeling (CCGM) aims to synthesize high-dimensional data conditioned on continuously valued scalar labels. However, existing continuous diffusion models face severe data sparsity under imbalanced and long-tailed label distributions, which can lead to visual artifacts and condition inconsistency. Moreover, inference-time classifier-free guidance and dense pixel-space integration introduce substantial sampling overhead, limiting practical deployment. To address these challenges, we propose CAViLD, an efficient latent diffusion framework for continuous conditional generation. CAViLD first constructs a purified condition-aware latent space through density-adaptive vicinal learning, auxiliary semantic regularization, and NIQE-guided negative data augmentation. It then internalizes the conditional guidance direction through an EMA teacher, enabling single-branch conditional inference, and introduces covariance-aware progressive distillation for label-dependent probability-flow ODEs, supporting sampling down to four NFEs. Experiments on RC-49, UTKFace, and Steering Angle demonstrate a favorable trade-off among generation fidelity, continuous condition consistency, and sampling efficiency.

</details>


### [31] [MEV: A Multi-Event Video Dataset for Long-Take Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38241)
*Peiyuan Zhu,Shaoan Xie,Yifan Shen,Wen Tian,Zijian Li,Guangyi Chen,Kun Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出多事件长镜头视频数据集 MEV，含精确时间边界与细粒度事件标注，并给出从视频切分到全局/事件级结构化描述的标注流水线，支持时间定位条件的长镜头生成与以事件为中心的评测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文生视频数据集多为单一事件的短片段或粗粒度描述，缺乏对长镜头时序依赖的监督，导致描述多事件时生成结果时序不一致。

Method: 构建 MEV 数据集：真实视频中主体执行一系列互不重叠的独立事件，标注精确时间边界与细粒度过程信息；设计标注流水线将视频切分为时间对齐事件并生成全局级与事件级结构化描述；在事件中心评测协议下，基于 MEV 以时间定位事件条件进行微调。

Abstract: Current datasets for text-to-video generation are largely limited to short clips depicting a single event or coarse-grained captions. As a result, they provide limited supervision for modeling long-take temporal dependencies, often leading to temporally inconsistent generations when describing multiple events. In this paper, we introduce MEV, a multi-event video dataset designed for long-take video generation. MEV provides high-quality real-world videos where subjects can perform a sequence of distinct, non-overlapping events, featuring precise temporal boundaries and fine-grained procedural annotations. This event-centric discretization reduces confounding factors and enables models to support temporally localized conditioning and build long-take videos from atomic event units. Furthermore, we introduce a comprehensive annotation pipeline that segments videos into temporally grounded events, and generates structured captions at both the global level and the event level. In addition, under an event-centric evaluation protocol, we conduct multi-event generation experiments by fine-tuning on MEV with temporally grounded event conditioning, leading to improved long-take event transitions and more coherent content. We believe this work provides a publicly available resource for multi-event fine-tuning and event-centric evaluation, together with practical insights into learning from temporally structured video-text data.

</details>


### [32] [Classifying Urban Locations by Cyclist Facility Usage and Directional Alignment: A Validated Camera-Based Framework from Multi-Site Observations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38045)
*Ao He,Mohit Gupta,Deborah Salon,Ricardo Eiris,Vivian W. H. Wong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究用多地点运动触发相机（19 次部署、17 个地点）观测自行车设施使用模式，发现部署可分为自行车道主导、人行道主导与混合三类，且自行车道使用份额与逆行率高度负相关（ρ=-0.87）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 管理机构投资建设自行车设施，却缺乏评估骑行者是否按设计方式使用的工具；因此需要检验使用模式是否随设施配置变化，以及自行车道使用率更高是否伴随更少的逆行骑行。

Method: 2023 年在亚利桑那州坦佩 17 个地点进行 19 次运动触发相机部署；人工复核识别 1,963 次骑行事件，剔除 20 次穿越后保留 1,943 次标注事件。自动处理管线在同一影像上计数达到人工总数的 92.9%（分部署 r=0.99），所有自动逆行判定均经人工目视核验。依据设施使用份额阈值对部署进行分类，并用 Spearman 相关分析份额与逆行率的关系。

Result: 部署被分为自行车道主导（9 个）、人行道主导（6 个）和混合（4 个）。自行车道内逆行事件占 4.6%，人行道上逆向近侧车流方向占 49.6%。部署层面自行车道份额与逆行率负相关（Spearman rho=-0.87，p<0.001，n=16）；同城独立志愿者计数呈现类似的人行道方向模式（rho=0.79）。

Conclusion: 该研究将多地点静态相机观测与全人工核验的基准相结合，刻画了设施使用与行进方向；该流程为规划者提供低成本筛查工具，用于识别人行道骑行比例高、逆向近侧车流方向突出的地点，并支撑后续详细现场调查。

Abstract: Objectives: Agencies invest in bicycle facilities but lack tools to assess whether cyclists use them as designed. We examine whether usage patterns follow facility configurations and whether higher bike lane usage is associated with less wrong-way riding.
  Methods: Motion-triggered cameras covered 19 deployments at 17 locations in Tempe, Arizona, in 2023. Manual review identified 1,963 cycling events; excluding 20 crossings left 1,943 labeled events for analysis. An automated pipeline on the same captures counted 92.9 percent of the full manual total (per-deployment r = 0.99), and every automated wrong-way call was visually verified. Deployments were classified using thresholds on facility usage shares.
  Findings: Deployments were bike-lane dominant (9), sidewalk dominant (6), or mixed (4). Cyclists in bike lanes rode against the flow in 4.6 percent of events; on sidewalks, riders opposed the near-side traffic flow in 49.6 percent. Across deployments, bike lane share and wrong-way rate were negatively correlated (Spearman rho = -0.87, p < 0.001, n = 16). An independent volunteer count in the same city showed a similar sidewalk-direction pattern (rho = 0.79).
  Novelty: The study combines multi-site still-camera observations with a fully hand-verified benchmark to characterize facility use and travel direction.
  Practical Applications: The workflow offers planners a low-cost screen for locations with high sidewalk cycling and travel against the near-side traffic flow, supporting more detailed site investigation.

</details>

*David Soeiro-Vuong,Andre-Louis Rochet*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文发布了一个345条标注、8段多视角片段的网球弹跳/击球事件基准，提出免训练的仲裁层RallyArb，并揭示监督模型在非转播视角严重失效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 网球统计依赖弹跳与击球事件，但单目视频中二者极易混淆；现有监督式事件定位器多在转播画面权重下训练，缺乏跨视角（手机、场地视角、固定高机位）的客观评测。

Method: 构建帧级标注基准：8段片段（转播/固定高机位/手机/场地视角）、冻结的开发-测试划分、混淆感知匹配器、片段级bootstrap置信区间，以及3段片段的盲二次标注。评测三类方法：带公开转播权重的监督式精确定位器、两个零样本视觉语言模型，以及RallyArb——基于球轨迹与球员姿态的仲裁层，在事件标签上不拟合任何参数。另做从转播权重出发的留一片段交叉微调实验。

Result: 监督定位器在转播素材近乎完美，在手机与场地视角几乎失效（E2E-Spot合并弹跳F1仅0.130）；RallyArb在三段手机/场地片段上弹跳F1>0.8（其中两段参与调参），在留出片段上11次弹跳命中8次，但击球定位偏离接触帧；视觉语言模型在各视角均能检出事件，接触帧误差约0.1 s；留一片段微调后，两个手机/场地片段弹跳F1约0.8，擦边手机视角仅0.2。

Conclusion: 跨视角泛化是网球事件检测的主要瓶颈：转播权重不可迁移，免参数几何仲裁方法在检测率上更稳健但时序精度不足，视觉语言模型时序较准但定位粗糙；作者公开标注、评测器与全部冻结预测以支持可复现对比。

Abstract: Ball bounces and racket hits are the events from which tennis statistics are derived, and on monocular video the two are easy to confuse. We release a benchmark of 345 bounce and hit annotations at frame level on eight clips that mix broadcast, fixed elevated, phone and court-level viewpoints, with a frozen development and test split, a confusion-aware matcher, clip-level bootstrap intervals and a blind second annotation of three clips. On it we score supervised precise spotters with published broadcast weights, two zero-shot vision-language models, and RallyArb, an arbitration layer over a ball track and player poses that fits no parameter on event labels. The supervised spotters score near-perfectly on broadcast footage and almost nothing on phone and court-level footage, where the pooled bounce F1 of E2E-Spot is 0.130. RallyArb keeps a bounce F1 above 0.8 on the three phone and court-level clips, two of which were used to tune it, and finds 8 of 11 bounces on the held-out one, but it places hits too far from the contact frame to match human timing. The vision-language models detect events on every viewpoint and miss the contact frame by about 0.1 s. Fine-tuned leave-one-clip-out from its broadcast weights, the spotter reaches about 0.8 bounce F1 on two phone and court-level clips and stays at 0.2 on a grazing phone angle. The annotations, the evaluator and the frozen predictions of every scored row are released.

</details>


### [34] [SpectralTF-MAE: A Pre-trained Spectral Foundation Model for Tokamak Fusion Plasma Diagnostics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38593)
*Xiao Wang,Zhijie Lu,Duoqing Yang,Jiangtao Yu,Jin Tang,Zichao Lin,Hongming Zhang,Guosheng Xu,Bo Lyu,Qiang Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 SpectralTF-MAE，一个面向托卡马克等离子体光谱诊断的自监督光谱基础模型：在配对的 CXRS 与 XCS 测量上以掩码光谱重建预训练，结合峰感知掩码与峰增强重建目标，并通过共享 Transformer 编码器实现跨诊断模态的迁移表示，在多个下游任务上验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 光谱诊断能提供托卡马克等离子体状态的丰富信息，但现有基于学习的方法通常针对单一任务设计且严重依赖标注数据，缺乏通用、可迁移的表示学习框架。

Method: 1）以掩码自编码（MAE）式自监督预训练，输入为配对的电荷交换复合光谱（CXRS）与 X 射线晶体光谱（XCS）；2）引入峰感知掩码策略（peak-aware masking），使掩码集中于特征谱峰区域；3）设计峰增强重建目标（peak-enhanced reconstruction），强化对诊断关键光谱结构的建模；4）共享 Transformer 编码器学习跨诊断模态的可迁移表示；5）预训练模型微调至等离体参数预测、跨诊断光谱生成、谱峰分析等下游任务。

Result: 在 EAST 诊断数据上的实验表明，该框架在各下游任务上均取得有竞争力的性能，且自监督光谱预训练带来一致的性能增益。

Conclusion: SpectralTF-MAE 具备作为等离子体光谱诊断通用、可迁移表示学习框架的潜力，为跨模态、跨任务的光谱诊断建模提供了统一范式。

Abstract: Spectroscopic diagnostics provide rich information for characterizing plasma states in tokamak fusion experiments, while existing learning-based approaches are often designed for individual tasks and rely heavily on labeled data. In this work, we propose SpectralTF-MAE, a self-supervised spectral foundation model for tokamak plasma diagnostics. The model is pretrained on paired charge-exchange recombination spectroscopy (CXRS) and X-ray crystal spectroscopy (XCS) measurements through masked spectral reconstruction. To better capture diagnostically important spectral structures, we introduce a peak-aware masking strategy together with a peak-enhanced reconstruction objective, encouraging the model to focus on characteristic spectral regions. A shared Transformer encoder is employed to learn transferable representations across different diagnostic modalities. The pretrained model is further adapted to several downstream tasks, including plasma-parameter prediction, cross-diagnostic spectral generation, and spectral peak analysis. Experiments on EAST diagnostic data demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves competitive performance across different tasks and consistently benefits from self-supervised spectral pretraining. These results indicate the potential of SpectralTF-MAE as a general and transferable representation learning framework for plasma spectroscopic diagnostics.

</details>


### [35] [The Power Watershed as a Differentiable Segmentation Layer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38516)
*Galia Akl,Laurent Najman,Hugues Talbot*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 将分水岭变换（Watershed）作为可微的末端层：以有限 p 的种子随机游走（RW）近似 Power Watershed（PW），通过一次伴随求解获得精确梯度，并在 PanNuke 上验证其可训练性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典形态学分割工具 Watershed 能否置于深度网络末端并端到端训练尚未解决；PW 是 RW 在 p→∞ 时的极限，但极限处不可直接求导。

Method: 把种子 RW（稀疏正定线性系统）作为 WS 层的有限温度实现，逐标签求解右端项；用隐函数定理+一次伴随求解得到对边权与 unary 的精确梯度，并与 unrolling 对比校验；研究求解、梯度与到极限距离随 p 的演化。

Result: 合成数据上可把软预测转为精确边界；PanNuke 二元 WS 层与阈值化 U-Net 持平；以实例为标签时实例 F1 从 0.656 提升至 0.795，与调参的 marker watershed 持平；十分之一数据下领先 0.015–0.020 F1。

Conclusion: 有限温度求解使分割可"对冲"：抑制弱 marker、共享争议像素；标签数由 marker 而非输出布局决定；代价是推理需部署有限 p 求解而非精确极限。

Abstract: Can a Watershed transform, the classical tool of morphological segmentation, be placed at the end of a deep network and trained through? The Power Watershed (PW) is the limit of the seeded Random Walker (RW) as p grows to infinity with edge weights raised to the power p. At every finite p the RW solves a sparse positive-definite linear system and is exactly differentiable with respect to the edge weights and the unaries through one adjoint solve; its multi-label form costs one right-hand side per label, and its limit is the PW. We study this family as the last layer of a segmentation network, the watershed layer (WS layer). A conditioning study measures how the solve, the gradient and the distance to the limit evolve with p, and the implicit gradient is checked against unrolling. On synthetic data with correct edge costs the WS layer transforms a soft prediction into an exact boundary. On nuclei segmentation (PanNuke), a binary WS layer is level with a thresholded U-Net. With the instances as labels, the WS layer turns the U-Net into an instance segmenter whose number of labels is set per image by the markers rather than by the output layout, and the network is trained through that partition: instance F1 score rises from 0.656 to 0.795 over a U-Net with connected components, level with the same network followed by a tuned marker watershed. At the training temperature the partition is a watershed of the learned costs, and the finite temperature lets the solve hedge, discounting weak markers and sharing contested pixels. The hedging puts the WS layer 0.015--0.020 F1 ahead of the baseline when trained on a tenth of the data, at the price of having to deploy the finite-p solve rather than its exact limit at inference. Code and the full experimental record are released.

</details>


### [36] [Geometry-Aware Trajectory State Modeling for Few-Shot Action Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38482)
*Zhiqi Miao,Marko Haralović,Stanislav Levendeev,Sarvesh Angadi,Jannatul Ferdous,Dan-Cristian Ploesteanu,Jiapan Guo,Estefanía Talavera*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出GeoTRAM，将动作视为2.5D轨迹状态的有序演化及其局部几何交互，用于少样本动作识别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有轨迹方法仅把轨迹当作采样视觉特征的载体，或用紧凑的2D位移描述子概括运动，未充分刻画轨迹状态演化与几何交互的判别性运动信息。

Method: GeoTRAM将稀疏点轨迹提升为2.5D轨迹；StateMotion建模轨迹内有序状态演化，RelMotion通过时变相对几何与运动刻画状态条件下的局部交互；采用质量过滤的谱采样获得更可靠轨迹初始化；分别精炼并保留语义、运动、深度互补线索进行联合时空建模；引入动作引导重加权与top-ρ轨迹选择，支持帧级与轨迹级互补匹配。

Result: 在五个FSAR基准上，于以运动为核心的Something-Something系列上取得显著提升，在更偏外观驱动的基准上保持竞争力，并获得良好的精度—效率权衡。

Conclusion: 以2.5D轨迹状态的几何演化建模可有效增强少样本动作识别的判别性表征，兼具性能与效率优势。

Abstract: Few-shot action recognition (FSAR) requires representations that expose discriminative motion dynamics from only a few labeled videos. Recent trajectory-based methods leverage long-term point tracks for explicit temporal correspondence, but often treat trajectories as carriers of sampled visual features or summarize their motion with compact 2D displacement-based descriptors. We instead view an action as the ordered evolution of 2.5D trajectory states and their local geometric interactions. Based on this view, we introduce GeoTRAM, a geometry-aware trajectory state modeling framework for FSAR. GeoTRAM lifts sparse tracks into 2.5D trajectories, where StateMotion models ordered intra-trajectory state evolution and RelMotion captures state-conditioned local interactions through time-varying relative geometry and motion. Quality-filtered spectral sampling provides more reliable trajectory initialization; complementary semantic, motion, and depth cues are separately refined and preserved for joint spatio-temporal modeling; action-guided reweighting and top-$ρ$ trajectory selection support complementary frame- and trajectory-level matching. Experiments on five FSAR benchmarks demonstrate strong gains on the motion-centric Something-Something benchmarks while maintaining competitive performance on more appearance-driven benchmarks and a favorable accuracy--efficiency trade-off.

</details>


### [37] [Visually Irrelevant Hallucinations in Medical Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38389)
*Ke Zou,Nan Zhou,Tao Yang,Meng Liu,Linchao He,Zehui Liao,Ling Huang,Guangren Huang,Yidi Chen,Yi Zhang,Hu Chen,Huazhu Fu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出CLEAR，一个模型无关的事后框架，在短语级别估计医疗视觉语言模型（VLM）中“视觉无关幻觉”的风险，通过局部反事实扰动与双审计线索实现检测，在四个数据集上优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医疗VLM在放射报告生成和医学VQA中表现良好，但会生成缺乏视觉证据或与图像内容矛盾的临床陈述（即“视觉无关幻觉”），这类错误在临床上具有误导性，却缺乏细粒度、模型无关的检测方法。

Method: CLEAR将生成回答分解为可视觉评估的临床短语；对每个短语进行短语条件定位（phrase-conditioned grounding）确定候选视觉区域，并施加局部反事实扰动；随后用两类互补审计线索刻画扰动效果——响应线索（语义与临床含义变化）和一致性线索（图文兼容性变化）；将两类线索归一化后联合建模，输出短语级幻觉风险。

Result: 在覆盖RRG与Med-VQA的四个数据集、多个医疗及通用VLM上，CLEAR均优于SOTA幻觉检测基线；在MIMIC-CXR上将AUPRC从85.10%提升至90.23%；并在基于GT构建的受控VIH基准上进一步验证有效性。

Conclusion: 本文将视觉无关幻觉确立为医疗VLM的重要细粒度可靠性失效模式，并证明模型无关的视觉支撑审计对提升多模态临床生成的可信度具有价值。

Abstract: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) show strong performance in radiology report generation (RRG) and medical visual question answering (Med-VQA), producing free-form clinical descriptions and answers from medical images. However, they may generate clinically meaningful statements that lack visual evidence or contradict image content. We refer to these errors as visually irrelevant hallucinations and investigate them at the phrase level. We propose CLEAR (Counterfactual Localized Evaluation of Alignment and Response), a model-agnostic post-hoc framework for phrase-level hallucination risk estimation. CLEAR decomposes generated responses into visually assessable clinical phrases. For each phrase, phrase-conditioned grounding identifies a candidate visual region, which is selectively perturbed by a localized counterfactual intervention. CLEAR characterizes the intervention using two complementary auditing cues: response cues, capturing semantic and clinically meaningful changes in the generated response, and alignment cues, measuring changes in image-phrase compatibility. These cues are normalized and jointly modeled to estimate phrase-level hallucination risk. Across four datasets spanning RRG and Med-VQA, CLEAR outperforms state-of-the-art hallucination detection baselines across multiple medical and general-purpose VLMs. On MIMIC-CXR, CLEAR improves AUPRC from 85.10% to 90.23%. Its effectiveness is further validated on a GT-derived controlled VIH benchmark. These results establish visually irrelevant hallucination as an important fine-grained reliability failure mode in medical VLMs and demonstrate the value of model-agnostic visual-support auditing for more trustworthy multimodal clinical generation.

</details>


### [38] [Volley3D: Unified 3D Full-Sequence Reconstruction from Monocular Broadcasts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38358)
*Noâm Boussouf,Adrien Maglo,Mohamed Chaouch,Hideo Saito*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出面向单目排球转播的物理约束三维重建流程，无需3D训练监督，通过跳跃检测与牛顿插值校正地面投影漂移，并用子轨迹分割与碰撞匹配将2D球检测提升为时空一致3D轨迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单视图体育转播3D重建对自动分析与沉浸式AR/VR回放至关重要，但因移动相机难以标定与深度歧义而病态。排球等团队运动存在不可预测的多次触球序列与高空跳跃，从根本上使现有方法依赖的平面投影假设失效，且缺乏3D训练监督。

Method: 构建完整的物理驱动流程：1）针对地面平面投影引起的透视漂移，引入校正模块，将时序跳跃检测与牛顿力学插值耦合用于3D球员定位；2）针对3D球轨迹估计，设计专用子轨迹分割架构与碰撞匹配算法；3）将物理方程锚定于重建的3D手部顶点，把含噪2D球检测提升为时空连贯的3D场景。

Result: 在多相机基准上评估，相比2D重投影基线显著降低3D空间漂移。

Conclusion: 面向单目排球转播的物理约束、无3D监督流程可有效缓解透视漂移与深度歧义，实现更精确的3D球员与球轨迹重建，验证了物理先验在复杂团队运动重建中的有效性。

Abstract: 3D reconstruction from single-view sports broadcast is a pivotal capability for automated analytics and immersive AR/VR replays, yet notoriously ill-posed due to difficult-to-calibrate moving cameras and depth ambiguity. Unlike widely studied racket sports, team sports such as volleyball feature unpredictable multi-contact sequences and high altitude jumps. These dynamics categorically invalidate the standard planar projection assumptions relied upon by existing methods. To resolve these limitations without 3D training supervision, we propose a complete, physics-grounded pipeline tailored to monocular broadcast volleyball. First, we include a correction module to the perspective drift induced by ground-plane projection by coupling temporal jump spotting with Newtonian interpolation for 3D player placement. Second, for 3D ball trajectory estimation, we design a dedicated sub-trajectory segmentation architecture alongside a collision-matching algorithm. By anchoring physical equations to reconstructed 3D hand vertices, we lift noisy ball 2D detections into a spatiotemporally coherent 3D scene. Evaluations on multi-camera benchmarks demonstrate our approach significantly reduces 3D spatial drift compared to 2D-reprojection baselines.

</details>


### [39] [WeVisCut: The Whole Editing Room in One Agent From Narration to Long-Form Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38352)
*Chenyu Mu,Wenming Weng,Qinrui Wang,Xingsong Ye,Hao Yu,Jun He,Chong Sun,Chen Li,Jing Lyu,Erkun Yang,Cheng Deng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: WeVisCut：将工具执行与策略学习结合的长视频脚本到视频系统，通过编辑逆向+可验证回放构建130K训练样本，训练单一9B策略，在自建100任务基准上以近33倍更少token达到与Claude Opus 5相当的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从旁白生成长视频需要跨镜头保持一致的相互依赖决策；现有多阶段通用模型工作流未厘清紧凑、任务适配策略在质量-成本上的权衡。

Method: 智能体框架维护共享制作状态使工具反馈驱动后续决策与修复；四阶段数据管线结合编辑逆向与可验证回放，将恢复的编辑意图转为可执行监督（3,750个成品视频→13万+训练样本）；用该监督训练单一9B策略，在同一框架内协调制作并从中恢复失败；提出100任务基准与5项指标。

Result: 共享工具环境下显著优于基座模型，性能与Claude Opus 5相当，每成功产出一分钟生成token数少近33倍；在自建指标上优于任务匹配的原生编辑器。

Conclusion: 紧凑的任务适配策略可在大幅降低推理成本的同时保持长视频编辑质量与交付可靠性，为脚本到长视频生成提供了低成本高效范式。

Abstract: Producing long-form videos from narration requires interdependent decisions that remain coherent across shots. Existing agentic editors often use multi-stage workflows driven by general models, leaving the quality-cost trade-off of compact, task-adapted policies unclear. We address this gap with WeVisCut, a long-form script-to-video system that connects tool execution with policy learning. Its agent harness maintains shared production state so that tool feedback informs subsequent decisions and repairs. Because finished videos do not expose these decisions, our four-stage data pipeline combines editing inversion with verified replay to turn recovered editing intent into executable supervision. Applied to 3,750 finished videos, this pipeline yields over 130K training examples. We use this supervision to train a single 9B policy that coordinates production and recovers from failures within the same harness. Moreover, we introduce a 100-task benchmark and five metrics assessing editing quality and delivery reliability. Under a shared tool environment, WeVisCut substantially outperforms its base model and achieves comparable performance to Claude Opus 5 while using nearly 33x fewer generated tokens per successful output minute.   <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 发展中国家快速城市化与交通基础设施不足导致拥堵加剧，且交通流高度异质、混乱，摄像头视角下车辆严重遮挡与重叠，使基于视觉的交通状态估计受限。
