Abstract: Traffic congestion is becoming a critical challenge in rapidly growing urban centers, particularly in developing nations where rapid urbanization and inadequate transport infrastructure place increasing strain on transport networks. In highly heterogeneous and chaotic traffic flows, camera-based traffic-state estimation is limited by severe vehicle occlusion and overlap. In this paper, we propose a framework to optimize traffic flow directly from stochastic visual observations. The architecture is structurally decoupled into three primary components: (a) vehicle density estimation, (b) predictive dynamics modeling, and (c) policy optimization. The proposed methodology introduces a convolutional neural network (CNN) that learns the mapping from camera feeds to spatial density maps, utilizing an adaptive k-nearest-neighbor (k-NN) Gaussian kernel to handle varying congestion levels. This feeds into an ST3DNet predictive module for spatiotemporal forecasting, followed by a hierarchical Graph-Transformer Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) algorithm to optimize signal phases. The density estimation stage was evaluated on 40 annotated intersection images from Rambagh 4, Jaipur, India, with a reported five-fold validation mean absolute error (MAE) of $3.32 \pm 0.95$ vehicles and a mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) of 14.5%. These results pertain to the perception component; empirical training and evaluation of the forecasting and control stages remain future work.

</details>


### [41] [You Don't Need Aligned Representations: Knowledge Distillation via Random Prototype Spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37937)
*Hamza Etcibasi,Ramazan Gokberk Cinbis*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RPKD 放弃师生特征空间需兼容或显式对齐的假设，改用一组随机初始化、冻结的原型向量作为共享外部参考空间进行知识蒸馏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主流知识蒸馏假设教师与学生的表示必须处于兼容或显式对齐的特征空间，这限制了跨架构迁移；同时基于 logit 的方法在类别数很少时监督信号会塌缩。

Method: 构建随机初始化且冻结的原型库；教师侧通过无参数的固定随机映射投影，仅学生可训练；含 logit 分支（对齐全局原型相似度分布）与 feature 分支（匹配空间分辨的原型激活图），二者共享同一固定原型空间；原型库与蒸馏目标跨师生对保持不变，仅输入投影按架构实例化。

Result: 相对 OFA 最大提升：CIFAR-100 +7.98%，ImageNet-100 +12.44%，ImageNet-1K +1.28%。

Conclusion: 将原型词表与任务标签空间解耦，在低类别场景下提供比标签空间更丰富的监督，克服 logit 方法的信号塌缩问题；同时原型空间可视为近似保持样本间相似结构的随机特征嵌入，实现架构无关的外部对齐。

Abstract: A widely held assumption in knowledge distillation is that teacher and student representations must occupy a compatible or explicitly aligned feature space. We propose RPKD (Random Prototype Knowledge Distillation), which discards this assumption by comparing both networks against a shared bank of randomly initialized, frozen prototype vectors. Alignment is therefore carried out in an external reference space rather than in the teacher's native feature coordinates: the teacher side is projected by fixed random maps that carry no trainable parameters, and only the student adapts. Two branches handle the transfer: a logit branch aligning global prototype similarity distributions and a feature branch matching spatially-resolved prototype activation maps. Both operate within the same fixed prototype space, which can be interpreted as a random feature embedding that approximately preserves inter-sample similarity structure, so the prototype bank and the distillation objective stay unchanged across teacher-student pairs while only the input projections are instantiated per architecture. In low-category settings, decoupling the prototype vocabulary from the task label space yields richer supervision than the label space alone, an advantage absent from logit-based methods, whose supervisory signal collapses as class count shrinks. This advantage is especially relevant in real-world scenarios where the label space is typically constrained. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of RPKD, achieving a maximum gain of +7.98% over OFA on CIFAR-100, +12.44% on ImageNet-100, and +1.28% on ImageNet-1K. Source code is available at https://github.com/HamzaEtcibasi/RPKD

</details>


### [42] [inkGround: Benchmarking Fine-grained Visual Grounding Capabilities of Vision-Language Models for Cursive Handwriting in the Wild](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38720)
*Sidra Hanif*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 inkGround 基准，用于从完整页面、相机拍摄的手写图像中恢复笔画轨迹，并将任务形式化为"文本条件的点定位"，对 4 个开源与 3 个前沿闭源 VLM 进行系统评测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线手写图像仅保留最终墨迹，丢失笔序与抬/落笔信息；已有图文-轨迹配对数据均由数字化板在受控条件下采集，书写者覆盖与风格多样性受限，且缺乏衡量通用 VLM 在笔画轨迹恢复上视觉定位能力的基准。

Method: 构建 inkGround：537 张整页图像（约 18.7k 词、163k 笔画），其参考轨迹由预训练 offline-to-online 模型生成，经 OCR 一致性过滤并人工核验；因参考为伪标签（仅代表一种合理笔迹），额外在含真实录制轨迹的 IAM-OnDB 上评测。任务设为文本条件点定位：给定页面图像与目标词，定位该词并输出有序笔画点。评价指标包括轨迹保真度（DTW、Chamfer 距离）、渲染笔画可读性（Accurate Rate、Correct Rate）与风格相似度。所有 VLM 使用统一 in-context 提示。

Result: 闭源模型（尤以 Gemini-3.1-Pro 为代表）生成的轨迹清晰可读且接近参考轨迹；该排名在 IAM-OnDB 上同样成立。

Conclusion: inkGround 提供了面向整页自然拍摄手写的笔画轨迹恢复基准，揭示闭源前沿 VLM 在该任务上明显优于开源模型，且结论具备跨数据集稳健性。

Abstract: Human handwriting is produced as an ordered sequence of pen movements, but an offline image keeps only the final ink. Handwriting trajectory recovery aims to restore the ordered stroke points and their pen-up/pen-down transitions. Existing image-trajectory pair datasets are recorded with digitizing tablets under controlled conditions, which limits writer coverage and stylistic diversity. Moreover, there is no benchmark that measures the visual grounding capabilities of general-purpose Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for the stroke trajectory recovery task. In this work, we introduce inkGround, a benchmark for stroke trajectory recovery from full-page, camera-captured handwriting. inkGround pairs 537 page images (~18.7k words, ~163k strokes) with reference trajectories produced by a pretrained offline-to-online model, filtered by OCR agreement, and verified by human raters. Because these references are pseudo-labels that represent one plausible pen trajectory, we also evaluate VLMs on the IAM-OnDB dataset, which provides recorded pen trajectories. We cast the task as text-conditioned point grounding: given a page image and a target word, the model must locate the word and output its ordered stroke points. Outputs are scored by trajectory fidelity (DTW, Chamfer distance), readability of the rendered strokes (Accurate Rate, Correct Rate), and style similarity. We benchmark four open-source and three frontier closed-source VLMs with a shared in-context prompt. Closed-source models, notably Gemini-3.1-Pro, produce legible trajectories close to the reference, and this ranking also holds on IAM-OnDB.

</details>


### [43] [AskStream: When and What to Ask Proactively under Uncertainty in Streaming Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38678)
*Lu Wang,Zhuoran Jin,Longxiang Wang,Junhong Chen,Yupu Hao,Yao Xu,Daojian Zeng,Yubo Chen,Kang Liu,Guang Liu,Jun Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文指出主动式视频交互现有范式默认信息完备，只能"等待"或"回答"，面对视频/用户不确定性会导致无限等待或高幻觉回答；因此提出第三种动作"提问"，并构建首个覆盖视频与用户不确定性的多轮流式视频理解基准 AskStream（438 视频、2714 帧级时间窗、四类任务八子任务），最强模型在 Ask-F1 上仅 52.18%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大模型推动视频理解从离线走向流式与主动交互，但现有主动范式假设回答查询所需信息是完整的，模型只能在"等待"与"回答"之间二选一。现实中视频本身或用户意图常带不确定性，信息不完整，此时模型要么无限等待、要么产生严重幻觉。故需重新定义主动交互，引入"提问"作为第三动作，主动索取缺失信息。

Method: 提出 AskStream，首个面向流式视频理解、同时涵盖视频不确定性与用户不确定性的多轮基准；设四类任务、八个子任务；包含 438 段视频、2714 个人工标注的帧级时间窗，标注分为 wait、ask、answer 三类；在多项选择与开放式两种设定下评测，并提出 Ask-F1 指标衡量"何时问、问什么"的主动信息寻求能力。

Result: 在多项选择与开放式设定下，即使最强模型在 Ask-F1 上也只有 52.18%，说明模型在不确定性下主动信息寻求能力存在显著不足。

Conclusion: 主动式视频交互应从"等待/回答"二元范式扩展为含"提问"的三元范式；AskStream 揭示了现有模型在不确定性下主动提问决策上的重大局限，为流式视频理解的主动信息寻求研究提供了评测基础。

Abstract: Recent advances in multimodal large language models have increased interest in interaction paradigms for video understanding. The evolution from offline to streaming and proactive interaction has gradually shifted models from passive responders toward more proactive agents that can decide when to answer. However, existing proactive paradigms typically assume that the information required to answer a query is complete, leaving models to only wait or answer. In the real world, however, information is often incomplete due to uncertainty from either the video or the user. In proactive paradigms, such uncertainty can cause the model to wait forever or generate highly hallucinatory responses. We therefore argue that proactive interaction should be redefined with a third action: ask, allowing models to actively ask for missing information. To study when and what models should ask before answering, we introduce AskStream, the first multi-turn benchmark spanning video and user uncertainty for streaming video understanding, with four task categories and eight subtasks. It contains 438 videos with 2,714 manually annotated frame-level time windows across three types: wait, ask, and answer. Across both multiple-choice and open-ended settings, even the strongest model attains only 52.18% on our proposed Ask-F1 metric, highlighting substantial limitations in proactive information seeking under uncertainty.

</details>


### [44] [TRIM: Temporal Run-Time Monitoring of 3D Object Detection via Activation Statistics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38613)
*Hakan Yekta Yatbaz,Konstantinos Koufos,Mehrdad Dianati*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TRIM：一种轻量级时序运行时监控器，仅利用检测器中间激活的通道级统计量序列，在不修改、不重训检测器的前提下检测3D目标检测中的漏检失效，在NuScenes上优于单帧监控。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可靠感知对智能交通系统至关重要，但深度神经网络可能在输出看似合理的结果时静默漏检安全关键目标。现有3D检测运行时监控器普遍逐帧独立评估，无法利用遮挡、点稀疏性与场景复杂度的时间演化信息。

Method: 提出TRIM轻量时序监控器：用紧凑的通道级统计量概括检测器中间激活，并以时序卷积网络（TCN）处理这些摘要构成的短序列；无需修改或重训练底层检测器。同时分析不同backbone层级特征的监控信号强度与推理开销。

Result: 在NuScenes上，相比单帧监控，AUROC从0.686提升至0.704，95%召回下的误报率由0.818降至0.759；骨干网络早期与中间层特征提供最强监控信号；时序推理头在CPU上仅需0.159 ms。

Conclusion: 时序建模可有效提升漏检失效监控的判别能力并降低误报，且早期/中层特征更适合作为监控信号；TRIM以极低计算开销实现检测器无关的运行时安全监控，具备实际部署可行性。

Abstract: Reliable perception is essential to intelligent transportation systems, yet deep neural networks can silently miss safety-critical objects while continuing to produce apparently plausible outputs. Existing run-time monitors for 3D object detection generally assess each frame independently and therefore cannot exploit the temporal evolution of occlusion, point sparsity, and scene complexity. We present TRIM, a lightweight temporal monitor that detects missed-object failures without modifying or retraining the underlying detector. TRIM summarises intermediate activations using compact channel-wise statistics and processes short sequences of these summaries with a temporal convolutional network. Experiments on NuScenes show that temporal monitoring improves AUROC from 0.686 to 0.704 and reduces the false alarm rate at 95% recall from 0.818 to 0.759 compared with single-frame monitoring. Early and intermediate backbone features provide the strongest monitoring signal, while the temporal inference head requires only 0.159 ms on a CPU.

</details>


### [45] [Data Scaling Laws in Stereo Matching: From In-domain Fitting to Cross-domain Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38600)
*Tong Zhao,Di Liang,Yiming Zeng,Bo Xu,Yingzhi Tang,Chen Bai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文初步研究了立体匹配中的域内与跨域数据规模定律，构建了含20万样本的真实感合成数据集 XStereo，发现域内性能随数据量呈两阶段缩放（幂律→饱和），而跨域性能对源域数据规模依赖较弱，分布与覆盖多样性更能缩小域间差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型时代立体匹配正向基于百万级合成图像训练的通用基础模型发展，但模型性能如何随合成数据规模扩展仍缺乏探索，缺乏对数据缩放规律的系统认识。

Method: 构建真实感合成数据集 XStereo（约20万样本）作为高质量数据缩放研究基准；在五个大规模数据集上进行域内训练与跨域评估，分析性能随数据规模的变化规律，并考察数据分布与覆盖多样性对域间差距的影响。

Result: 域内训练表现出随数据量的两阶段缩放行为：从标准幂律过渡到饱和，且在固定模型下临界转折点近似不变；跨域性能对源域数据规模的依赖显著更弱且更难以预测；分布与覆盖多样性对缩小域间差距更有效。

Conclusion: 研究对语言与视觉领域既有缩放定律构成了重要验证与扩展，并为高效数据构建与训练提供指导性建议，为实现高效且更强的立体匹配奠定基础；数据集已公开。

Abstract: In the era of large models, stereo matching is developing towards generalizable foundation models trained on million-scale synthetic images. However, how model performance scales up with synthetic data is still underexplored. In this work, we preliminarily investigate the in-domain and cross-domain data scaling laws in stereo matching. A realistic synthetic dataset, named XStereo, containing 200 thousand samples is first built to serve as a high-quality benchmark for data scaling research. In-domain training on five large-scale datasets demonstrate a two-regime scaling behavior with data, transitioning from the standard power law to saturation, where the critical transition point is approximately invariant under a fixed model. Cross-domain performance exhibits a substantially weaker and less predictable dependence on the source-domain data scale. The distribution and coverage diversity are more effective for diminishing domain gaps. More instructive suggestions are provided for high-efficiency data construction and training. The insightful findings are significant verification and extension of the existing scaling laws in both language and vision, paving the way to efficient and stronger stereo matching. The XStereo dataset is public at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Tong-Zhao/XStereo.

</details>


### [46] [RoSAMDepth: Robust Self-supervised Depth Estimation Leveraging Segment Anything Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38587)
*Xuanang Gao,Zhiwei Ning,Gengming Zhang,Jiaxi Cao,Runze Yang,Zhonglong Zheng,Jie Yang,Rong Xiao,Wei Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出RoSAMDepth框架，利用SAM的物体级先验增强自监督鲁棒深度估计，通过三方面引入物体级信息，在多数据集与恶劣天气下取得更锐利、更准确的深度预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有鲁棒深度估计方法未考虑物体级信息，导致预测深度在物体内部易发生偏移，且在恶劣条件下变得模糊。

Method: 从SAM提取丰富多样的物体级先验，并从三个关键方面融合：(1) 分割引导的表征对比方法，将物体级感知注入特征表征空间；(2) 自适应区域离群值掩蔽策略，结合区域高斯似然损失以强化区域深度平滑；(3) 物体级可靠性估计策略，以减轻不可靠监督的影响。

Result: 在多个数据集及多种天气条件下的广泛实验表明，该方法产生更锐利、更准确的深度预测，持续优于现有最先进方法。

Conclusion: 引入SAM物体级先验可有效提升自监督深度估计的鲁棒性与区域一致性，代码已开源。

Abstract: Robust depth estimation aims to maintain high-quality depths across diverse conditions. However, most existing methods estimate depth without taking into account the object-level information. As a result, the predicted depth may easily deviate within objects and become blurred under adverse conditions. To overcome this weakness, we propose RoSAMDepth, a novel framework that can assist robust self-supervised depth estimation in leveraging rich and diverse object-level priors from the Segment Anything Model (SAM). We focus on incorporating object-level information across three key aspects: a segment-guided representation contrasting method that injects object-level awareness into the feature representation space; an adaptive regional outlier masking strategy combined with a regional Gaussian likelihood loss that enforces regional depth smoothness; and an object-level reliability estimation strategy that mitigates the influence of unreliable supervision. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets and diverse weather conditions demonstrate that our method produces sharper, more accurate depth predictions, consistently outperforming state-of-the-art methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/xagao/RoSAMDepth.

</details>


### [47] [Self-Consistency Geometry Injection for Multi-view Consistent Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38518)
*Yupeng Xiao,Yankai Wu,Jianjie Luo,Jiajie Lin,Yi Yu,Zhenguo Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出RGMV，通过参数免训练的自一致性几何门（SCG）与可靠性感知几何注入（RGI），在稳定区域增强、在不稳定区域衰减几何引导，提升单图多视图生成的几何质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有单图到多视图扩散方法将几何推断与纹理合成显式或隐式耦合，易受不准确几何预测影响；已有解耦方法虽将几何作为独立条件，却将其视为固定条件，未显式建模几何可靠性。

Method: 由几何提议生成器在不同随机采样配置下对同一参考图与目标视角生成多个几何预测；SCG通过度量这些预测的空间一致性得到可靠性图；RGI据此调制RGB合成模型中几何条件残差的注入强度。方法可适配不同几何提议生成器，且SCG无参数。

Abstract: Recent diffusion models have achieved impressive progress in single image to multi-view generation by synthesizing consistent novel views efficiently. Existing methods usually explicitly or implicitly couple geometry inference and texture synthesis, making generation vulnerable to inaccurate geometry prediction. Although several geometry-guided methods have explored decoupling, they usually treat predicted geometry as a fixed condition and do not explicitly model whether the geometry is reliable. We therefore propose Reliability-Guided Multi-View Generation (RGMV), which comprises a parameter-free Self-Consistency Geometry Gate (SCG) and a Reliability-aware Geometry Injection (RGI) module. Specifically, a geometry proposal generator produces multiple geometry predictions for the same reference image and target viewpoints under different stochastic sampling configurations. SCG measures their spatial agreement to derive a reliability map, which RGI uses to modulate the injection strength of geometry-conditioned residuals in the RGB synthesis model. Moreover, RGMV can adapt to different geometry proposal generators. As a result, RGMV preserves stronger geometric guidance in stable regions while attenuating unreliable geometry cues before they propagate into multi-view RGB generation. Extensive experiments show that reliability-aware geometry injection improves the geometric quality of multi-view generation. Code: https://github.com/WISLab-GDUT/RGMV.

</details>


### [48] [Frequency-Adaptive Gaussian Grids for Efficient Image Representation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38007)
*Anatolii Evdokimov,Stavros Diolatzis,Bingxuan Li,Akshay Jindal,Patsorn Sangkloy,Qi Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Gaussian-Grid 混合神经表示，依据局部频率内容在 2D 高斯（无结构）与多分辨率特征网格（有结构）之间动态分配计算，自动适配信号复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高分辨率图像需求增长，需要高效神经表示；但有结构表示（特征网格，具空间一致性）与无结构表示（2D 高斯，能自适应捕捉局部方差）之间存在根本性权衡，单一选择难以最优刻画图像。

Method: 构建结构化与无结构化基元混合的表示：2D 高斯分布附带多分辨率特征网格，按局部频率内容动态在两类基元间划分计算量，从而自动优化表示架构以匹配目标信号的复杂度；在高分辨率自然图像上评估，并用作 GPU 原生数据集存储。

Result: 相比 JPEG+ZIP 归档，解码速度提升 1.24–2.14×，PCIe 数据传输量降低 23–176×；在多种数据集上保持小内存占用并实现高重建保真度。

Conclusion: 混合结构—无结构基元并按频率自适应分配是兼顾内存效率与重建质量的有效途径，且适合作为 GPU 原生的数据存储格式。

Abstract: Neural representation has emerged as a powerful tool to mitigate the demand for increasingly higher-resolution images. However, a fundamental trade-off remains between structured (e.g., feature grids, which offer spatial consistency) and unstructured (e.g., 2D Gaussians, which adaptively capture local variances) representations. This choice significantly affects how well an algorithm represents an image. Here, we present Gaussian-Grid, a hybrid neural representation that adaptively integrates structured and unstructured primitives. By dynamically partitioning computation between 2D Gaussian distributions and their attached multi-resolution feature grids based on the local frequency content, Gaussian-Grid automatically optimizes its architecture to match the underlying complexity of the target signal. We evaluate our approach using high-resolution natural images and demonstrate its applications as GPU-native dataset storage, showing $1.24$-$2.14\times$ decoding speed improvement and PCIe data traffic reduction of $23\times$-$176\times$ over JPEG + ZIP data archiving. The results show that Gaussian-Grid maintains small memory footprints while achieving high reconstruction fidelity across a variety of datasets.

</details>

*Qiming He,Jing Li,Zihan Wang,Tian Guan,Yifei Ma,Zimo Zhao,Yanxia Wang,Hongjing Chen,Yexing Zhang,Yizhi Wang,Xinrui Chen,Xitong Ling,Minxi Ouyang,Yujie Xie,Lianghui Zhu,Yiqing Liu,Qingxia Hou,Shuyan Zhao,Xiaoqin Wang,Lili Ma,Qiang Huang,Zhiyuan Shen,Junru Cheng,Siqi Zeng,Chao He,Yonghong He,Zhe Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GloSAGE：用预训练视觉教师模型预测的病灶谱构建结构化病理文本，实现无需人工图文对的语义自蒸馏，为肾小球视觉基础模型提供概念级监督。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉基础模型虽学到丰富的病理形态表征，但缺乏显式的概念级监督；视觉-语言预训练可提供此类监督，却依赖昂贵的图文配对数据。

Method: 构建语义自蒸馏框架：以预训练视觉教师给出的病灶谱生成结构化病理描述；用可靠性引导筛选图像-文本锚点；提出知识结构化病理文本合成（Knowledge-Structured Pathology Text Synthesis）与证据引导负样本构建（Evidence-Guided Negative-pair Construction）以处理部分可观察病灶；仅训练投影层并冻结视觉编码器进行图文对齐；引入中间语义迁移层为下游任务供特征。在 GloMillion 上开发，于 7 个肾小球级与病例级队列评估。

Result: 支持零样本病灶识别、图文检索、难负样本判别与概念干预分析；在多数病灶识别任务上优于源视觉模型并提升病灶分级，病例级疾病分类、损伤分级及基线肾功能估计具竞争力。消融验证知识结构化文本与证据引导负样本的联合贡献；中间迁移层较完整投影输出提升了平均病灶识别 ROC-AUC；以 GloSAGE 特征为条件的冻结语言模型可生成肾小球描述。

Conclusion: 教师模型衍生的病灶谱可作为标注高效的语义监督，用于扩展肾小球视觉基础模型；该范式可推广至其他缺乏图文配对的医学影像场景。

Abstract: Visual foundation models learn rich pathological morphology but lack explicit concept-level supervision. Vision--language pretraining can provide this supervision but requires costly image--text pairs. Here, we introduce GloSAGE, a semantic self-distillation framework that uses lesion profiles predicted by a pretrained visual teacher to construct structured pathology descriptions. Reliability-guided selection identifies image--text anchors, while Knowledge-Structured Pathology Text Synthesis and Evidence-Guided Negative-pair Construction account for partially observed lesions. Image--text alignment trains projection layers while retaining the frozen visual encoder; an intermediate Semantic Transfer Layer supplies features for downstream tasks. Developed on GloMillion and evaluated across seven glomerulus- and case-level cohorts, GloSAGE supported zero-shot lesion recognition, image--text retrieval, hard-negative discrimination and concept-intervention analyses. It outperformed its source visual model in most lesion-recognition tasks and improved lesion grading, while supporting competitive case-level disease classification, injury grading and baseline renal function estimation. Ablations supported the combined contributions of knowledge-structured text and evidence-guided negatives, and the intermediate transfer layer improved mean lesion-recognition ROC-AUC relative to the complete projection output. A frozen language model conditioned on GloSAGE features generated glomerular descriptions. These findings suggest that teacher-derived lesion profiles can provide annotation-efficient semantic supervision for extending a glomerular visual foundation model.

</details>


### [50] [SSQA: Sibling-Selective Quadtree Attention for Hierarchical Modeling in Perception Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38320)
*Yufan Chen,Arnav Bali,Angela Liu,Laura Zheng,Ming C. Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Sibling-Selective Quadtree Attention (SSQA)，将图像token组织为完整四叉树结构进行层次化建模，实现线性复杂度特征建模，在多个导航/感知任务上以更低计算成本取得不逊甚至更优的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人导航感知任务（无人机、自动驾驶）的数据具有轴对齐结构先验：无人机图像呈天空—中景障碍—地面的层次分布，驾驶数据含规整的道路布局、车道线等。这类结构性强于通用图像任务，且原生Attention为二次复杂度、开销高，故有动机利用四叉树式层次化处理兼顾建模效果与线性效率。

Method: SSQA将图像token按层级组织成结构化、完整的四叉树，在兄弟节点间进行选择性注意力计算（sibling-selective），从而以层次化方式建模特征；并给出复杂度分析证明其线性时间复杂度，同时与Mamba 2、Quadtree Attention等流行方法对比推理速度。

Result: 理论分析表明SSQA保证线性时间特征建模；实测推理速度相较Mamba 2与Quadtree Attention等更快，且在多任务基准上性能至少相当、部分显著更优，而计算成本仅为其中一小部分。

Conclusion: 利用轴对齐结构先验的四叉树层次化注意力是替代二次复杂度注意力的高效方案，可在保证或提升性能的同时大幅降低计算开销，适用于机器人导航与自动驾驶等结构化感知任务。

Abstract: Perception tasks for navigation in robotics, including aerial platforms such as drones and autonomous driving systems, are inherently structured. Drone-mounted cameras typically capture sky above, terrain below, and obstacles or man-made structures in between, while driving data often contains organized road layouts, lane markings, and surrounding agents. Motivated by these axis-aligned structural priors, we note that such information is typically more structured than in generic image tasks. We hypothesize that processing information in a quadtree-esque manner can not only model features effectively in a hierarchical manner, but also offers an efficient linear-time alternative to vanilla attention mechanisms, which run in quadratic time. In this paper, we propose Sibling-Selective Quadtree Attention (SSQA), which models image tokens hierarchically as a structured, full quadtree. We show analytical complexity analysis that guarantees linear-time feature modeling, in addition to empirical experiments comparing inference speeds with other popular modeling approaches, such as Mamba 2 and Quadtree Attention. Our results, benchmarked across several tasks, show that we achieve results at least as good, if not notably better, as others at a fraction of the computational costs.

</details>


### [51] [Extremely Sparse-View Computed Tomography from 2D Projections via Pose-Aware Diffusion Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38319)
*Linrui Dai,Jinxiu Liang,Chu Zhou,Mae Yamaguchi,Ryuya Takahashi,Imari Sato*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出“训练稀疏/推理稀疏”设定下用单张投影学习位姿感知扩散先验的xSV-CT重建方法


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 极端稀疏视角CT中扫描限制同时导致无法获得稠密扫描重建的3D体数据，优化法缺先验、学习法需稠密监督，存在方法空白。

Method: 从每个训练样本的一张2D投影学习位姿感知扩散先验，并以测量视角保真、共享体重投影与投影物理一致性引导扩散采样。

Result: 在两个公开CT数据集的1/4/8视图下取得最佳新视角合成分数，重建质量优于或可比于使用稠密体监督的基线。

Conclusion: 无需稠密训练体即可实现高质量极端稀疏视角CT重建，验证了稀疏监督扩散先验的有效性。

Abstract: Extremely sparse-view computed tomography (xSV-CT) is critical when scanning time, motion, or radiation tolerance limits each scan to only a few projections. In many such scenarios, the same acquisition limits also constrain dataset construction, making pre-reconstructed 3D volumes from dense scans unavailable. This exposes a gap in current sparse-view approaches: Optimization-based methods, which use the sparse measurements directly but lack data-driven priors to suppress artifacts, and learning-based methods, which use strong priors but usually require densely scanned training volumes acquired outside the xSV-CT regime. We study this train-sparse / infer-sparse setting by learning a pose-aware diffusion prior from one 2D projection per training sample, then guiding diffusion sampling with measured-view fidelity, shared-volume reprojection, and projection-physics consistency for tomographic reconstruction. On two public CT datasets across 1-, 4-, and 8-view settings, the proposed method achieves the best novel-view synthesis scores and best or competitive reconstruction quality compared with baselines that use dense-volume supervision.

</details>


### [52] [Does 3D Pose Improve Action Valuation in Football? An Empirical Study of Pose Representations and Learning Objectives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38308)
*Rikuhei Umemoto,Kenjiro Ide,Soham Majumder,Ulf Brefeld,Keisuke Fujii*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 在SARSA框架下加入3D姿态对足球动作价值估计的收益有限：50项对比中仅3项稳健改善回报预测，而训练设置（去除动作预测损失）的影响远大于姿态特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有足球多智能体深度强化学习（MADRL）模型仅使用2D位置与速度，忽略了与即将发生动作相关的姿态信息，因此需要检验3D姿态能否提升观测动作价值对进攻回报（进球、失球、最终EPV）的估计精度。

Method: 基于UEFA欧冠2022/23的赛事事件、跟踪与3D姿态数据，构建SARSA价值估计模型；比较六种表征（无姿态、原始关节、躯干与头部朝向、ST-GCN嵌入等），跨5种学习设置与3个随机种子；设置中变化TD目标与动作预测损失，并以蒙特卡洛回报回归作为参照基准。共进行50组有球/无球对比。

Result: 仅3组（均为躯干+头部朝向）姿态稳健提升回报预测，12组变差（多为ST-GCN）。训练设置影响更大：移除动作预测损失使仅位置价值的有球技能值由0.003升至0.040，与xG相关性由0.23升至0.60，且在匹配训练时长下仍保持。姿态可改善0.2s后动作预测（macro AUC 0.914→0.934，原始关节）及传球执行姿态对传球成功率预测（AUC 0.844→0.856）。

Conclusion: 在该训练协议下，姿态信息有助于刻画即将发生的动作，但很少提升观测动作价值估计；动作价值估计的性能瓶颈更多来自训练目标设计而非输入表征。

Abstract: Football action valuation estimates players' contributions to future scoring. Existing multi-agent deep reinforcement learning (MADRL) models use 2D positions and velocities, omitting posture information relevant to imminent actions. We investigate whether adding 3D pose to a SARSA-based model improves observed-action values relative to attack returns: goals, conceded goals or final expected possession value. Using UEFA Champions League 2022/23 event, tracking and 3D pose data, we compare six representations (no pose, raw joints, torso and head orientation, and spatial-temporal graph convolutional network (ST-GCN) embeddings) across five learning settings and three seeds. The settings vary temporal-difference targets and action-prediction loss, with Monte Carlo return regression as a reference. Across 50 on-ball and off-ball comparisons, pose robustly improved return prediction in only three, all using torso and head orientation, while worsening it in twelve, mostly with ST-GCN. Training choices had greater effects: removing the action-prediction loss raised on-ball skill of position-only values from 0.003 to 0.040 and their correlation with expected goals from 0.23 to 0.60; the improvement in return prediction persisted at matched training length. Separately, pose improved prediction of the on-ball action 0.2 s ahead (macro AUC 0.914 to 0.934 with raw joints), while the passer's pose during execution improved pass-success prediction (AUC 0.844 to 0.856). Within this training protocol, pose informed imminent actions but rarely improved observed-action values.

</details>


### [53] [Silhouette-Based Gaitomics for Frailty Assessment in Older Adults](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38223)
*Laura McDaniel,Ryan Roemmich,Crystal Szczesny,Peter Abadir,Rama Chellappa,Basudha Pal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出基于轮廓的"步态组学"(gaitomics),用90个可解释的步态描述符将视频步态分析与Fried衰弱表型预测联系起来,并通过嵌套交叉验证与SHAP分析揭示任务依赖的特征优先级及prefrail/nonfrail区分困难。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 步态为可解释的视频化衰弱评估提供了窗口,但需要把模型预测与可测量的身体构型与运动模式显式关联,提升可解释性。

Method: 66名老年人,Fried衰弱表型评估;标准化轮廓与步态能量图提取形状、时间变化、运动、纹理共90个描述符;采用mRMR(互信息差准则)做特征选择;分类器评估采用参与者级别的嵌套分层交叉验证(5外折3内折),特征排序与数量选择仅限训练集;用SHAP解释留出预测的贡献。

Result: 双侧轮廓差异在三分类及两项涉及frail的比较中位列特征排序首位;归因谱随任务差异,纹理与相邻帧轮廓差在三分类中突出。CatBoost三分类微AUC最高,为0.647±0.085;成对比较frail vs nonfrail为0.833±0.249,frail vs prefrail为0.765±0.168,prefrail vs nonfrail仅0.554±0.129。

Conclusion: 框架将预测与显式步态特征关联,揭示任务依赖的特征优先级与prefrail–nonfrail区分受限;为可解释研究提供基础,但样本量小,需更大独立研究验证可靠性与临床价值。

Abstract: Walking offers a window into physical function that may support interpretable video-based frailty assessment. We developed silhouette-based "gaitomics" to connect frailty predictions with measurable patterns of body configuration and movement. In 66 older adults assessed using the Fried Frailty Phenotype, standardized silhouettes and gait energy images yielded 90 descriptors of shape, temporal variation, motion, and texture. Minimum redundancy maximum relevance selection using the mutual information difference criterion prioritized informative features while limiting redundancy. Each classifier was evaluated using nested stratified cross-validation with five outer and three inner folds at the participant level, with feature ranking and feature-count selection confined to training partitions. Shapley additive explanations examined contributions to held-out predictions. Bilateral silhouette difference led the aggregate feature-selection rankings for three-class classification and both comparisons involving frail participants. Attribution profiles differed across tasks, with texture and consecutive-frame silhouette differences prominent in three-class classification. Among classifier-specific evaluations, CatBoost achieved the highest mean three-class micro-AUC of 0.647 \pm 0.085. Leading pairwise mean micro-AUCs were 0.833 \pm 0.249 for frail versus nonfrail, 0.765 \pm 0.168 for frail versus prefrail, and 0.554 \pm 0.129 for prefrail versus nonfrail classification. These findings connect model predictions to explicit gait characteristics while revealing task-dependent feature priorities and limited separation of prefrail and nonfrail participants. The framework provides an interpretable basis for further investigation, with larger independent studies needed to establish reliability and clinical relevance.

</details>


### [54] [Complementing Text Based Moderation with Multimodal Grounding: Detecting Fraudulent Inducement Behaviors on Short Video Platforms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38185)
*Xiaoyong Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文针对短视频平台互联网金融黑灰产诱导内容的审核需求，提出OCR+MLLM流水线，在保留OCR文本召回信号的同时，用多模态大模型联合完成判别与时序定位，并设计召回加权F2定位奖励与类别均衡重采样，在自建数据集上显著优于关键帧OCR+LLM基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 短视频成互联网金融黑灰产主要渠道，诱导信息常通过点赞、关注、私聊、外链等引导用户至诈骗；此类视频短小、动态，意图多由瞬时视觉线索而非稳定文本承载。现有OCR+LLM逐帧转录再分类，仅利用文本信息，漏检OCR不可见的视觉诱导，且关键帧定位无法给出精确时间边界；同时审核系统需保证召回并最小化人工复核片段。

Method: 构建含2,419条互联网金融短视频（66.49小时）、3,194个标注事件（四类）的数据集；对比OCR+LLM、OCR+MLLM、大规模零样本MLLM三条路线在检测、时延、token消耗与部署复杂度上的表现。OCR保留保证召回的文本信号，MLLM联合执行OCR接地的判别与时序定位（grounding）。研究类别不平衡下RL定位的奖励设计，发现辅助奖励项被reward hacking利用、更强定位奖励会损害类别均衡检测，遂提出召回加权F2定位奖励＋类别均衡重采样。

Result: OCR+MLLM定位优于关键帧OCR+LLM基线（mIoU 26.52 vs 14.49），并能检出纯文本流水线漏检的非文本诱导，同时保持67.0%宏召回。

Conclusion: 在文本流水线上引入MLLM可在维持召回的前提下同时提升文本与非文本诱导的时序定位能力；奖励设计需警惕reward hacking与检测-定位权衡，召回加权F2奖励配合类别均衡重采样是有效方案。

Abstract: Short video platforms have become a primary channel for black and gray industry operations in internet finance, where inducements such as prompts to like, follow, join private chat groups, or click external links frequently steer users toward fraud. Because such videos are short, dynamic, and often convey intent through fleeting visual cues rather than stable text, a moderation system must guarantee detection recall and localize the offending segment so reviewers inspect only the relevant clip. Existing OCR+LLM pipelines transcribe on-screen text frame by frame and classify the transcript, but exploit only textual information. Many inducements are conveyed through visual cues OCR cannot observe, and keyframe-based localization cannot recover precise temporal boundaries. We explore OCR+MLLM, which augments the text pipeline with a Multimodal Large Language Model, and compare three routes: OCR+LLM, OCR+MLLM, and a large zero-shot MLLM, along detection, latency, token consumption, and deployment complexity. OCR preserves the text signal that guarantees recall, while the MLLM jointly performs OCR-grounded discrimination and temporal grounding, localizing both textual and non-textual inducements. We construct a dataset of 2,419 internet finance short videos (66.49 hours) with 3,194 annotated events across four categories, and study reward design for RL-based grounding under class imbalance. We report two findings: auxiliary reward terms are exploited through reward hacking, and stronger localization rewards degrade class-balanced detection. We therefore design a recall-weighted F2 localization reward with class-balanced resampling. Experiments show OCR+MLLM localizes better than the keyframe OCR+LLM baseline (mIoU 26.52 vs. 14.49) and detects non-textual inducements that text-only pipelines miss, while maintaining 67.0 percent macro recall.

</details>


### [55] [From Next Day Wildfire to Next Days Wildfire: A New Multi-Continent Dataset of Active-Fire Spread for Sequence-to-Sequence Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38086)
*Jose Guillen,Renzo Zanca,Valentin Barriere*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出多模态野火数据集AFSeq（1,194起2023–2026年、8国三区域的火情，聚焦短小火灾）与自回归模型UTAE-AR（U-Net+时序自编码器+解码器前循环模块），支持逐日序列预测，次日精度优于SOTA且参数量仅21.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准（如WildfireSpreadTS）受规模限制只能覆盖燃烧数周的大火，且环境同质化，严重低估了短时小规模火灾；同时单步模型无法给出逐日预报，长时程预测能力不足。

Method: 构建AFSeq多模态数据集（1,194个近期火事件，8国三区域，以短时小火为主）；提出UTAE-AR，在经典U-Net+时序自编码器（UTAE）基础上于解码器前引入循环模块，实现整段序列的自回归预测，并将自身预测的火mask逐日反馈作为输入。

Result: 在WSTS、WSTS+与AFSeq上，UTAE-AR的次日预测精度均超过SOTA，参数量仅为对比模型的21.5%，且能在更长预测时程上保持高置信度。

Conclusion: AFSeq提供了迄今规模最大、多样性最高的时序野火蔓延预测数据集，弥补短小火灾样本缺失；UTAE-AR以极小参数代价实现自回归多步预测，兼具精度与长时程可靠性。

Abstract: Benchmarks such as WildfireSpreadTS (WSTS) have enabled data-driven forecasting of wildfire spread from multimodal satellite time series, but they suffer from limitations: size restricts them to large fires that burn for weeks, and they are from similar environments. We introduce AFSeq, a multimodal dataset of 1,194 recent fire events (2023 to 2026) from 8 different countries across three regions, dominated by the short, small fires that existing benchmarks underrepresent. Our dataset is the largest and most diverse to date for time-series-based wildfire spread prediction. We also introduce UTAE-AR, an extension of a classical U-Net with Temporal Auto Encoder, enhanced with recurrent modules before the decoder. This allows the model to not only predict the next day but the whole sequence in an autoregressive way. Moreover, our model can feed its own predicted fire mask back one day at a time, producing the day-by-day forecasts that single-step models cannot. Our results show that UTAE-AR surpasses state-of-the-art on both WSTS, WSTS+ and AFSeq for next-day accuracy while having 21.5% of their parameters, and being able to predict confidently at a longer horizon.

</details>


### [56] [Convex Potential Learning for Optimal Transport Between Medical Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37844)
*Hongyu Kan,Ivan Medri,Natasha Ironside,Kristofor Pas,Richard Corp,Shinjini Kundu,Gustavo Kunde Rohde*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出通过对凸势函数进行参数化来估计最优传输映射的方法，构造上保证传输映射无旋（符合Brenier定理），在2D/3D医学影像上取得更低传输误差与更高质量重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学图像间的形态学分析依赖最优传输映射，但现有方法难以扩展到大规模3D医学图像，或依赖正则化形式仅给出近似传输映射，限制了下游分析精度。

Method: 以凸势函数为参数化对象来求解最优传输映射；由于映射为凸势的梯度，构造上天然无旋，与Brenier定理一致，从而避免仅近似传输。

Result: 在2D与3D医学影像数据集上的实验表明，传输估计误差低于现有方法，图像重建质量更高。

Conclusion: 参数化凸势是获取精确最优传输映射的有效途径，可提升医学图像形态学分析的下游精度。

Abstract: Computing optimal transport maps between medical images plays a fundamental role in morphological analysis. However, existing methods are either difficult to scale to large 3D medical images or rely on regularized formulations that provide only approximate transport maps. To improve the accuracy of downstream medical image analysis, we propose a novel approach for estimating optimal transport maps by parameterizing the convex potential function. By construction, the resulting transport map is guaranteed to be curl-free, consistent with Brenier's theorem. We evaluate the proposed method on both 2D and 3D medical imaging datasets. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach achieves lower transport estimation errors and produces higher-quality image reconstructions than existing methods.

</details>


### [57] [Sparse tensor networks for individual tree diameter estimation in mixed forests](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37784)
*Clara Lößl,Fabian Ewald Fassnacht,Viacheslav Barkov*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出轻量级稀疏张量网络TreeNext，直接从体素化ULS点云回归单木胸径，构建从实例分割到DBH估计的全自动森林调查流程，R²达0.8355（自动分割）与0.9380（真值分割），优于随机森林与XGBoost。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人工实测胸径（DBH）难以覆盖整片林分或区域；ULS可扩展自动化调查，但冠层遮挡导致树干点云稀疏，QSMs与圆拟合等依赖树干重建的方法受限，而基于预定义点云指标的机器学习方法不够本质。稀疏张量网络已在树种分类等任务中展现潜力，作者探究其能否推广至单木DBH估计。

Method: 在德国四块混交温带森林样地采集ULS数据；对现有多数稀疏张量网络进行改进，提出轻量架构TreeNext，直接由体素化LiDAR点云回归单木参数；搭建从单木实例分割到DBH回归的全自动流程，并对比自动分割实例与真值实例以量化分割误差影响；与Random Forest、XGBoost等表格基线比较。

Result: TreeNext在自动分割树上R²=0.8355，在真值分割上R²=0.9380，优于强表格基线（RF、XGBoost）；分割质量是自动化流程中的主导误差源；模型数据效率高，小样本场景下仍表现良好。

Conclusion: 稀疏张量网络可作为ULS单木DBH自动估计的实用基础；误差瓶颈主要在于实例分割而非回归模型，未来应优先提升分割精度。

Abstract: Measurements of tree diameter at breast height (DBH) are fundamental to forest inventories, but manual surveys across entire stands or regions are impractical. UAV-borne laser scanning (ULS) enables scalable automated forest surveys, yet canopy occlusion makes accurate DBH estimation from ULS point clouds non-trivial. Limited stem-level point density of ULS data constrains approaches relying on detailed stem reconstruction, such as Quantitative Structure Models (QSMs) and circle fitting. Empirical machine learning methods based on predefined point cloud metrics are an alternative. New deep learning approaches offer an even more principled solution, allowing models to learn directly from point clouds. Sparse tensor networks have shown particular promise, transforming forestry tasks such as tree species classification. We investigate whether these strengths can be extended to estimate individual tree DBH from ULS data across four mixed-species temperate forest plots in Germany. We further advance existing sparse tensor networks by introducing TreeNext, a lightweight deep learning architecture for direct individual tree parameter estimation from voxelized LiDAR point clouds. We present a fully automated forest inventory pipeline from individual tree instance segmentation to DBH regression, and quantify the impact of segmentation errors by comparing performance on automatically segmented and ground truth instances. TreeNext achieves an $R^2$ of 0.8355 on automatically segmented trees and 0.9380 on ground truth segments, outperforming strong tabular baselines including Random Forest and XGBoost. Segmentation quality emerges as the dominant error source in the automated pipeline. TreeNext proves highly data-efficient, performing well even in small data scenarios. Our findings establish sparse tensor networks as a practical foundation for automated individual tree DBH estimation from ULS.

</details>


### [58] [What do MLLMs know about 'Waldo'? Evaluating Visual Reasoning under Multi-Instance Multi-Object Challenges](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38957)
*Saumya Mundra,Ajoy Mondal,Vineeth N Balasubramanian,C. V. Jawahar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 MIMO-Bench，一个面向"多物体类别、每类多实例"（MIMO）场景的多模态大模型视觉推理基准，包含 3,802 个图文问答对，覆盖属性绑定与计数任务；实验表明现有先进模型在该基准上性能显著下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉推理基准的图像-问题对通常针对实例数量很少的物体类别，导致目标指代过于简单、视觉歧义不足，无法真实检验模型的细粒度视觉推理能力。

Method: 构建 MIMO-Bench 基准：图像-问题对中的目标属于拥有多个实例的物体类别，引入相似特征干扰项，迫使指代表达需由多个视觉子任务组合才能唯一、无歧义地定位目标；基准共含 3,802 个图文问答对，涵盖属性绑定（attribute binding）与数值计数（numerical counting）两类任务。

Result: 在现有基准上表现优异的开源模型（InternVL、QwenVL）与闭源模型（Gemini、GPT-5）在 MIMO-Bench 上性能均大幅下降，暴露其在多实例场景下的局限。

Conclusion: MIMO 场景构成对当前 MLLM 的实质性挑战，MIMO-Bench 可作为评估和推动细粒度视觉指代与推理能力的新基准，并将公开发布。

Abstract: Recent advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have led to significant progress in visual reasoning capabilities. However, existing benchmarks curate image-question pairs pertaining to object categories with few instances, enabling trivial object referencing and limited visual ambiguity. In this work, we introduce MIMO-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating MLLMs in a Multi-Instance per Multi-Object categories (MIMO) setting. Each image-question pair in our benchmark pertains to instances belonging to object categories with multiple instances. The presence of such similar feature distractors causes hindrance in basic visual reasoning tasks, necessitating the referring expression to be composed of multiple visual subtasks to uniquely and unambiguously identify the target object. MIMO-Bench comprises 3,802 image-question pairs across attribute binding and numerical counting tasks. Despite impressive performances on existing benchmarks, both SOTA open-source (InternVL, QwenVL) and proprietary (Gemini, GPT-5) models exhibit substantially lower performance on MIMO-Bench, highlighting their limitations in the MIMO setting. The benchmark will be made publicly available.

</details>


### [59] [GradSplat: Gradients Inside the Forward Pass for Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38951)
*Jingong Chen,Linlian Jiang,Guangyuan Li,Xinxin Zuo,Yang Wang,Chulwoo Pack,Kyle Gao,Kwanghee Won*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GradSplat 在前向推理中通过可学习的梯度步骤自我精修 Gaussian 形状（尺度与旋转），无需目标视图，在 RealEstate10K、DL3DV、ScanNet++ 上取得最优重建精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前馈 3D Gaussian Splatting 从少量图像预测场景，但精度不及对该场景逐场景优化的 Gaussians。作者发现这一差距主要来自 Gaussian 的形状（尺度与旋转），而非不透明度与颜色，因此希望在前向过程中直接修正形状。

Method: 提出 GradSplat：一个前馈模型，在前向推理内部用可学习的梯度步骤精修自身 Gaussians，且不需要目标视图。具体包括：(1) log-anisotropy 校正，在等体积条件下于对数空间改变每个高斯椭球的轴比；(2) 前向梯度精修，将 Gaussians 渲染到输入视图上，计算光度损失梯度，并用学习到的循环更新依次作用于不透明度与颜色、再作用于形状。

Result: 在两个完整的六视图 RealEstate10K 协议下，九种方法中 PSNR 与 SSIM 最优；在 6 至 42 个输入视图范围内保持精度。无需微调即在 DL3DV 上精度最高，在 ScanNet++ 上 PSNR 与 SSIM 最优。

Conclusion: 前馈 Gaussian 预测的精度差距可通过输入视图上的梯度精修主要补偿形状误差来解决；将学习式梯度更新嵌入前向推理，可显著提升跨数据集、跨视图数的泛化精度。

Abstract: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting predicts a scene from a few images, but our predictor is less accurate than its own Gaussians optimized per scene on those images. This gap lies mostly in the shape of the Gaussians, their scale and rotation, since optimizing the shape alone recovers almost all of it and opacity and color recover less. Gradient steps on the input views correct this shape, and the model holds these views at inference. Log-anisotropy correction changes the axis ratios of each Gaussian in log space at constant volume, and in-forward gradient refinement renders the Gaussians into the input views and applies the gradient of the photometric loss with a learned recurrent update, first to opacity and color and then to the shape. GradSplat is a feed-forward model that refines its own Gaussians by learned gradient steps inside its forward pass, with no target view. On both complete six-view RealEstate10K protocols, it has the best PSNR and SSIM among nine methods and keeps its accuracy from $6$ to $42$ input views. Without fine-tuning, it is the most accurate on DL3DV and has the best PSNR and SSIM on ScanNet++. The code will be released at https://github.com/Jingong-Chen/GradSplat/.

</details>


### [60] [OneScene-Bench: Do Vision-Language Models Integrate Evidence Across Views?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38926)
*Swathi Suhas,Anurag Das,Bernt Schiele,Jonas Fischer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 OneScene-Bench 基准，显式区分"多图处理"与"跨视角整合"，发现现有 VLM 在互补视角计数与跨视角一致性上存在显著能力缺口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM 越来越多地处理同一场景的多视角输入，但是否能将多视角观察整合为统一的场景级表征尚不清楚。现有多图评测无法隔离该能力，因为许多任务可通过独立的单视角处理得到正确答案，并不真正需要跨视角对应关系。

Method: 构建受控基准 OneScene-Bench，在真实多视角场景上评测三项互补能力：(1) 唯一目标计数——通过控制跨视角目标重叠度，区分可由单视角简单聚合解决的情形与需要实例级对应的情形；(2) 跨视角一致性——在共享区域与视角特有区域引入局部编辑，检验模型能否区分真实场景矛盾与由视角、可见性差异造成的变化；(3) 空间推理——构造需跨视角融合空间证据来判断物理接近度的目标关系。评测 12 个开源与闭源 SOTA VLM。

Result: 在互补视角下计数准确率大幅下降至 4.5%–50.0%，而完全重叠样例为 45.5%–81.5%；跨视角一致性在各模型上均维持在约 50%，包括最新的闭源 VLM，尽管其空间推理表现明显更强。

Conclusion: 结果揭示了"处理多张图像"与"跨图像整合证据"之间的显著鸿沟，说明需要显式检验场景级多视角理解的评测方法。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly process multiple views of the same scene, but it remains unclear whether they integrate these observations into a coherent scene-level representation. Existing multi-image evaluations do not isolate this capability, as tasks may admit correct solutions through independent per-view processing without requiring cross-view correspondence. We introduce OneScene-Bench, a controlled benchmark designed to explicitly distinguish when cross-view integration is necessary. Our benchmark evaluates three complementary capabilities on real-world multi-view scenes: unique object counting, cross-view consistency, and spatial reasoning. For counting, we control object overlap across views to separate cases solvable by simple per-view aggregation from those requiring instance-level correspondence. For consistency, we introduce localized edits in shared and view-specific regions, testing whether models distinguish genuine scene contradictions from differences caused by viewpoint and visibility. For spatial reasoning, we construct object relations that require combining spatial evidence across viewpoints to compare physical proximity. We evaluate twelve state-of-the-art open-weight and proprietary VLMs and find that counting accuracy drops substantially on complementary views, ranging from 4.5-50.0%, compared with 45.5-81.5% on complete-overlap examples. Moreover, cross-view consistency remains around 50% across models, including recent proprietary VLMs, despite substantially stronger performance on spatial reasoning. Our results reveal a substantial gap between processing multiple images and integrating evidence across them, highlighting the need for evaluations that explicitly test scene-level multi-view understanding. Code and data are available at https://github.com/swathisuhas/OneScene-Bench.

</details>


### [61] [COGS: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Attribute-Aware Object-Level 3D Gaussian Splatting Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39201)
*Zheng Xiao,Yifan Liu,Weijian Deng,Jiashu Li,Ziqin Liu,Zhenjun Han,Jianbin Jiao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出规模达15,675个对象、40类的大规模3DGS数据集COGS及基准COGS-Bench，揭示高斯属性并非全部有益（子集可优于全集），并提出保持属性角色分离的参考模型HALO。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3DGS作为3D感知输入表示被广泛探索，但现有架构如何利用异质高斯属性（外观、不透明度、协方差等）尚不清楚，导致精度难以解释、架构设计缺乏原则；而现有对象级3DGS数据集缺乏外观多样性与伪影控制，无法进行系统的属性级分析。

Method: 构建含15,675个经伪影过滤、外观丰富对象（40类）的3DGS数据集COGS；基于其建立面向目标分类与属性使用诊断的基准COGS-Bench，并辅以外部验证；提出参考模型HALO，在层次化聚合前保留属性特定证据（角色保持的属性组织）。

Result: 基准显示高斯属性收益不一致：部分属性子集可超过完整属性集；外观、不透明度及协方差相关属性组合的影响随架构差异显著。COGS-Bench与外部3DGS数据集实验表明COGS支持系统性诊断，HALO体现角色保持属性组织的价值。

Conclusion: COGS与COGS-Bench为3DGS感知提供了可控、可诊断的属性级分析平台，说明应按属性角色有原则地组织输入，而非默认使用全属性；HALO验证了角色保持聚合的有效性。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is increasingly explored as an input representation for 3D perception. Yet it remains unclear how current 3D architectures exploit heterogeneous Gaussian attributes. This ambiguity makes accuracy hard to interpret and limits principled architecture design for 3DGS perception. However, existing object-level 3DGS datasets lack the appearance variation or artifact control needed for systematic attribute-level analysis. We introduce COGS, a large-scale 3DGS dataset with 15,675 artifact-filtered and appearance-rich objects across 40 categories. Built on COGS, we establish COGS-Bench for object classification and attribute-usage diagnosis, complemented by external validation. Our benchmark shows that Gaussian attributes are not uniformly beneficial: selected subsets can outperform the full attribute set, and the effects of appearance, opacity, and covariance-related attribute combinations vary substantially across architectures. We further study this finding with HALO, a reference model that preserves attribute-specific evidence before hierarchical aggregation. Experiments on COGS-Bench and external 3DGS datasets demonstrate that COGS supports systematic diagnosis of 3DGS attribute usage, while HALO highlights the value of role-preserving attribute organization. Our dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/XiaoZhengCV/COGS.

</details>


### [62] [CLaW: Codec-Guided Adaptive Latent Watermarking for Traceable Diffusion Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39160)
*Huangchao Song,Lingyun Yu,Cong Li,Peiqi Jiang,Mingqi Fang,Hongtao Xie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CLaW：基于预训练水印编解码器将水印消息映射为潜空间残差，在晚去噪窗口注入，并以解码置信度自适应校准强度，实现冻结主干、免反演的鲁棒高效扩散图像水印，用于用户级溯源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型生成图像逼真，带来滥用与版权侵权风险，需用户级可溯源水印；现有方法依赖昂贵的模型重训或检测，效果-保真度权衡差，且对图像变换鲁棒性不足，难以规模化部署。

Method: 1) 用预训练水印codec将每条水印消息编码为潜空间残差，实现低成本的采样期注入；2) 在晚去噪时间窗内注入残差，此时图像语义已基本确定、后续去噪扰动小，兼顾有效性与保真度；3) 提出解码器引导的自适应注入机制，以解码置信度作为反馈动态校准水印强度，增强弱信号并提升变换鲁棒性；扩散主干冻结、检测无需反演。

Result: 大量实验表明：CLaW保持高视觉保真度，在多种图像变换下取得SOTA鲁棒性，并支持可靠的用户级溯源。

Conclusion: CLaW以冻结主干+免反演的方式兼顾保真度、鲁棒性与部署效率，为可溯源扩散图像生成提供了实用可扩展的水印方案。

Abstract: With the rapid advancement of text-to-image diffusion models, increasingly realistic AI-generated content has raised serious concerns about misuse and copyright infringement. Digital watermarking offers a promising solution by enabling user-level traceability, yet existing methods remain difficult to deploy at scale, hindered by costly model retraining or detection, poor effectiveness-fidelity trade-offs, and limited robustness to image transformations. To address these challenges, we propose CLaW (Codec-guided Latent Watermarking), a robust and efficient watermarking framework for traceable diffusion image generation with frozen diffusion backbones and inversion-free detection. Specifically, CLaW first uses a pretrained watermark codec to map each watermark message to a latent residual, enabling low-cost sampling-time injection. Then, the residual is injected within a late denoising window, where image semantics are better preserved and the watermark signal is less perturbed by subsequent denoising updates, yielding a better balance between watermark effectiveness and image fidelity. Furthermore, we introduce a decoder-guided adaptive injection mechanism that uses decoding confidence as feedback to dynamically calibrate watermark strength, reinforcing weak watermark signals and improving robustness under image transformations. Extensive experiments show that CLaW preserves high visual fidelity and achieves state-of-the-art robustness under image transformations, enabling reliable user-level traceability.

</details>


### [63] [Kinematic Causal Attribution: Black-Box Explanations of Motion versus Geometry for 4D Point-Cloud Video Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39147)
*Zerui Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Kinematic Causal Attribution（KCA），一种黑盒、干预式的4D点云视频归因方法，通过"冻结运动"与"去形状代理"算子构建运动×几何立方体，实现运动与形状重要性的可分离度量，并需帧间点对应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 4D感知模型（对3D点云视频分类）即将部署于机器人、辅助监控与AR，但从业者无法检验模型依赖哪种线索：是身体部位的运动方式还是其形状。现有方法各有局限：3D归因局限于单帧，视频归因限于RGB像素，梯度图需白盒访问，状态空间骨干缺乏注意力机制，点级扰动则假设帧间点对应，而真实深度与LiDAR数据并不具备该对应关系。

Method: KCA只查询模型输出，属黑盒干预式归因。其"冻结算子"去除区域运动而保留形状，"去形状代理"去除形状而保留运动；二者为每个跟踪区域张成运动×几何立方体，采用阶对称Shapley分解（完备且显式度量交互项而非忽略），并配合上下文平均估计器处理跨多区域的结构。算子直接重写逐帧点集，无需点对应。

Result: 在MSR-Action3D上训练的官方PSTNet、P4Transformer与Mamba4D上验证。审计实验：用真实片段构建两个二分类任务，其类别仅在同一手臂的运动或形状上不同；手臂重要性的运动占比随定义线索变化——P4Transformer为0.83 vs 0.60，PSTNet为0.86 vs 0.30，Mamba4D为0.92 vs 0.61，这是单一归因图无法做出的区分。分解不损失忠实性：必要性图在P4Transformer与PSTNet上删除AUC最低，在Mamba4D上与最佳基线持平，且权重随机化后与训练模型的相关性消失。另以骨架真值、重采样稳定性与计算开销完成验证。

Conclusion: KCA提供了一种黑盒、无对应依赖、可分离运动与形状贡献的4D点云视频归因方案，兼具高忠实性与可解释的线索区分能力，可作为4D感知模型部署前的实用审计工具。

Abstract: 4D perception models, which classify 3D point-cloud videos, are being built into robots, assistive monitoring and AR, yet before deploying one a practitioner cannot check which cue it relies on: how a body part moves, or what shape it has. 3D attribution is single-frame, video attribution is confined to RGB pixels, gradient maps need white-box access, attention is absent from state-space backbones, and point-level perturbations assume a point correspondence across frames that real depth and LiDAR data lack. We present Kinematic Causal Attribution (KCA), a black-box, interventional attribution method that queries only the model's outputs. Its freeze operator removes a region's motion while keeping its shape, and a shape-free proxy removes the shape while keeping the motion. Together they span a motion$\times$geometry cube for every tracked region, whose order-symmetric Shapley decomposition is complete and whose interaction is measured rather than assumed away. The operators rewrite per-frame point sets, so they need no correspondences, and a context-averaged estimator handles structures that span several regions. We validate KCA on the official PSTNet, P4Transformer and Mamba4D trained on MSR-Action3D. The decisive test is an audit: two binary tasks are built from real clips whose classes differ only in the motion or only in the shape of the same arm, and the motion share of the arm's importance follows the defining cue on all three backbones (0.83 vs. 0.60 on P4Transformer, 0.86 vs. 0.30 on PSTNet, 0.92 vs. 0.61 on Mamba4D), a distinction no single attribution map can make. The split costs no faithfulness: the necessity maps have the lowest deletion AUC on P4Transformer and PSTNet, tie with the best baseline on Mamba4D, and lose their correlation with the trained model's once the weights are randomised. Skeleton ground truth, re-sampling stability and cost complete the validation.

</details>


### [64] [PicturePerfect: Diffusion-based Same-identity Facial Replacement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39344)
*Manik Dhingra,Yashesh Savani,Mahesh Reddy,Antoine Mercier,Jiahe Liu,Guillaume Berger*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种基于预训练文本到图像扩散模型的同身份人脸替换方法：以肖像图与同一人的参考图为输入，在保持背景不变的前提下无缝替换人脸；并构建大规模同人像对数据集，效果优于现有人脸重演模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型在视觉领域成果显著，但"给定同一身份参考图、在不同表情与姿态条件下进行人脸替换并保持背景不变"这一具明确实用价值的任务，尚无近期工作直接研究，且缺乏对应数据支持。

Method: 在预训练文本到图像扩散模型基础上构建替换框架；输入为人像图与同一人的第二张参考图（采集条件可能不同）；通过扩散生成实现参考人脸对输入人脸的替换，同时保持背景完整；为此构建了包含同一人在不同表情与姿态下的大量图像对数据集。

Result: 实验表明，该方法生成的结果在真实感与身份一致性上均优于现有人脸重演（face reenactment）模型。

Conclusion: 验证了扩散模型在同身份人脸替换任务上的可行性，并指出该特定设定此前缺乏直接研究，所提数据集与方法为后续工作提供了基准与基础。

Abstract: With the growing success of diffusion models in computer vision, we explore their potential for same-identity facial replacement in photographs. Specifically, we propose a diffusion-based method, built on top of a pre-trained text-to-image model, that takes as input a portrait image of a person and a second reference image of the same individual, potentially captured under different conditions. The goal is to seamlessly replace the input face with the reference face, while keeping the background intact. Surprisingly, despite the clear real-world utility of this task, no recently published work has directly addressed face replacement in this specific setting. To support this goal, we construct a large dataset of image pairs depicting the same person under varying facial expressions and poses. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach produces more realistic and identity-consistent results than existing face reenactment models.

</details>


### [65] [Can Image Agents Complete Visual Commissions? A Benchmark and Modular Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39330)
*Tong Li,Lishuai Gao,Qi Zeng,Yifan Li,Cong Wei,Zhuoliang Kang,Xiaoming Wei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 Visual Commission Bench (VCB) 基准与 V-Protocol 参考智能体，用于评估端到端"视觉委托"任务的完成度，V-Protocol 在 VCB 上取得 69.0% 严格任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉委托任务要求图像智能体整合异构源材料、在多个依赖阶段间保持需求一致并产出协调的交付物。现有评测只考察单一能力或特定执行环境，对端到端委托完成情况缺乏理解。

Method: 构建 VCB，含 12 类共 600 个任务、三个互补层级（从能力导向任务到完整委托），使用 5,039 条需求检查与独立的视觉质量评分，评估内容正确性、视觉实现、约束保持与交付完整性，且不规定内部工作流。提出 V-Protocol：推理时动态组合可复用的任务模块（组织交付）、认知模块（推导内容）、表达模块（引导视觉实现）；模块间交换结构化中间产物，由共享执行框架追踪产物修订与依赖、管理工具执行并校验完成度。

Result: 在与基线智能体相同的控制器与图像生成器条件下，V-Protocol 在 VCB 上严格任务成功率达 69.0%，SCOPE 为 42.0%；在 Mind-Bench 上严格准确率由 39.2% 提升至 45.4%。

Conclusion: 模块化、可组合且不约束内部流程的智能体架构能显著提升复杂视觉委托的端到端完成质量，VCB 为多阶段视觉任务提供了更系统的评测框架。

Abstract: Visual commissions require image agents to integrate heterogeneous source materials, preserve requirements across dependent stages, and produce coordinated deliverables. Existing evaluations examine specific capabilities and execution settings, leaving end-to-end commission completion less understood. We introduce Visual Commission Bench (VCB), comprising 600 tasks across 12 categories and three complementary tiers, from capability-focused tasks to complete commissions. VCB uses 5,039 requirement checks and separate visual quality ratings to assess content correctness, visual realization, constraint preservation, and delivery completeness without prescribing an internal workflow. We present V-Protocol, a reference agent that dynamically composes reusable task, cognitive, and expression modules at inference time. Task modules organize delivery, cognitive modules derive content, and expression modules guide visual realization. The modules exchange structured intermediate artifacts, while a shared execution harness tracks artifact revisions and dependencies, manages tool execution, and checks completion. With the same controller and image generator as the agent baselines, V-Protocol achieves 69.0\% strict task success on VCB, compared with 42.0\% for SCOPE. On Mind-Bench, strict accuracy increases from 39.2\% to 45.4\%.

</details>


### [66] [FYC: FPR-Disparity Weight Perturbation and Youden Calibration for Fair Deepfake Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37882)
*Uzoamaka Ezeakunne,Taiwo Olabamipe,Deevesh Jain,Xiuwen Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出两阶段后处理方法FYC：以FPR差异为准则扰动预训练检测器权重，再对每个族群单独校准决策阈值；无需重训练与人口统计标注，在AI-Face v2六个交叉性别×肤色组上于21项公平性与效用指标中18项优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度伪造检测器总体准确率虽高，但存在显著族群差异（性别、肤色间假阳性率相差两位数）。现有补救方案要么需带公平目标的完整重训练，要么需人口统计标注数据，仅有预训练检查点时均不可行；而无需标签的事后校准器不改变检测器权重，公平性改进受限。

Method: FYC为两阶段事后方法：(1) 在FPR差异准则（即将人口统计均等目标条件化于真实图像上）下对检测器权重进行扰动；(2) 为每个族群分别校准独立决策阈值。无需改动架构、无需完整重训练。并在四种架构上对比原先验工作中基于人口统计均等（DP）的加权扰动目标。

Result: 在AI-Face v2全部基准检测器、六个交叉性别×肤色组上评估，FYC在21项公平性与效用指标中的18项领先（含专门设计的公平性架构），训练成本仅为其一小部分。分析显示原DP目标具架构依赖性且不可预测：四种架构中两种改善、一种基本不变、第四种（PG-FDD）显著退化，且无法事先预判；改用仅条件化于真实图像的FPR差异准则后，四种架构公平性与准确率均无一例外地同时提升。

Conclusion: 公平性准则的选择至关重要：以真实图像为条件的FPR差异准则消除了DP目标的架构依赖性不确定性，实现公平性与准确率的稳定协同提升；FYC提供了在仅有检查点、无标注条件下的高效后处理去偏方案。

Abstract: Deepfake detectors routinely achieve high aggregate accuracy while exhibiting substantial demographic disparities in their errors: false-positive rates differ by double digits across gender and skin tone. Most existing remedies require either full retraining with a fairness-aware objective or demographic-annotated training data, both impractical when only a pretrained checkpoint is available, while label-free post-hoc calibrators leave the detector's weights unchanged. We introduce FYC (FPR-disparity Weight Perturbation and Youden Calibration), a two-stage post-hoc method that perturbs a detector's weights under an FPR-disparity criterion, then calibrates a separate decision threshold for each demographic group - requiring no architectural changes and no full retraining. Evaluated against every detector benchmarked on AI-Face v2 across six intersectional gender x skin-tone groups, FYC outperforms the field on 18 of 21 reported fairness and utility metrics, including purpose-built fairness architectures, at a fraction of the training cost. We further identify why the choice of fairness criterion is critical: the original Demographic Parity objective used in prior weight-perturbation work is architecture-dependent and unpredictable, improving two of four evaluated architectures, leaving a third largely unchanged, and substantially degrading the fourth (PG-FDD), with no way to anticipate the outcome for a given checkpoint in advance. Conditioning the same objective on real images only - our FPR-disparity criterion - eliminates this unpredictability, improving fairness and accuracy jointly across all four architectures with no exceptions.

</details>


### [67] [Geometry Matters in Packed 3D Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38694)
*Amil Khan,Anantajit Subrahmanya,B. S. Manjunath*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PACK3D 将 3D 体数据打包为 token 序列后，以真实 token 网格坐标上的轴向 RoPE 解耦"内存布局"与"注意力几何"，避免模型学到序列排布而非物体结构，并在合成任务与 Allen WTC-11 真实数据上验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D 体数据打包成序列后，序列顺序不再编码样本几何；以序列位置索引的位置编码会学到内存布局而非物体本身，这是打包几何数据上注意力的通用失效模式。作者旨在直接暴露并度量该失效模式。

Method: 提出局部-全局注意力算子 PACK3D：局部邻域注意力保持精确（不压缩）；仅将远距离上下文压缩为连续的 3D 块摘要；所有 query-key 交互用基于真实 token 网格坐标的轴向 RoPE 索引，而非打包位置。由于旋转在块摘要之前施加，query-to-summary logit 仍是 query 相对 3D 位移的加权和，压缩后的全局上下文在打包后依然空间可解释。另提供融合 Triton 实现。

Result: 受控合成任务：训练一种打包，仅改变 token 内存顺序、物理标注规则不变——学习式位置嵌入与打包序列 RoPE 在训练布局上完美求解，但在 Morton、块连续、随机重打包下崩溃；轴向网格坐标 RoPE 全程保持精确。真实数据：Allen WTC-11 hiPSC 显微图像 15 结构联合任务上优于参数匹配 3D U-Net 及匹配的学习式位置局部-全局基线，对照实验隔离出增益源于坐标系而非编码器容量。Triton 实现在 65k token 时与窗口注意力延迟持平，并提供窗口注意力无法具备的长程上下文。

Conclusion: 打包几何数据上的位置机制应按真实坐标而非序列位置索引；PACK3D 通过轴向 RoPE 与块摘要保持了压缩全局上下文的空间可解释性，兼顾正确性与大规模可训练性。

Abstract: Packing a 3D volume into a token sequence is not merely long-sequence modeling. Once the volume is packed, sequence order no longer encodes the geometry of the sample---so a positional mechanism indexed by sequence position can learn the memory layout rather than the object. This is a general failure mode for attention over packed geometric data. We introduce PACK3D, a local-global attention operator that separates memory layout from attention geometry. PACK3D keeps local neighborhood attention exact, compresses only distant context into contiguous 3D block summaries, and indexes every query-key interaction with axial RoPE on true token-grid coordinates rather than packed positions. Because the rotation is applied before a block is summarized, the query-to-summary logit remains a weighted sum of query-relative 3D displacements; compressed global context therefore stays spatially interpretable after packing, instead of collapsing to anonymous pooled content. We measure the failure mode directly. On a controlled synthetic task---train on one packing, change only the memory order of the tokens, hold the physical labeling rule fixed---learned positional embeddings and packed-sequence RoPE solve the training layout perfectly yet collapse under Morton, block-contiguous, and random repacking, while axial grid-coordinate RoPE stays exact throughout. The same coordinate system carries to real data: on Allen WTC-11 hiPSC microscopy, PACK3D improves over a parameter-matched 3D U-Net on the 15-structure joint task and over a matched learned-position local-global baseline, with controls isolating the coordinate system, not encoder capacity, as the source of the gain. A fused Triton implementation matches windowed-attention latency at 65k tokens while supplying the long-range context windowing cannot---so the operator is not only correct but trainable at scale.

</details>


### [68] [Neighbourhood shortcuts in building damage assessment from very-high-resolution satellite imagery: diagnosis and a building-evidence plug-in](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38162)
*JianChong Guo,YuTing Wan,Kefan Li,AiLong Ma,YanFei Zhong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文揭示建筑损毁评估（BDA）模型存在"邻域捷径"：整体高分掩盖了对邻域上下文而非建筑自身证据的依赖，并提出无需重训的building-evidence插件予以缓解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 损毁在空间上聚集，多数建筑与邻居损毁等级一致，导致整体指标被此类建筑主导；孤立受损建筑稀少且易被忽视。因此高分无法判断模型是依据建筑本身还是依赖邻域捷径。作者旨在诊断主流BDA范式是否依赖邻域，并低成本纠正。

Method: 采用欺骗性/反事实诊断：按建筑与邻居的一致性分层，并在像素不变前提下把建筑移入新邻域，测试9个覆盖主要BDA范式的模型。提出building-evidence插件，在冻结原模型下新增两个专家——一个只看建筑本身，另一个看周边但用无缝替换的邻域训练以学会不信任上下文。

Result: 所有模型漏检1/3至1/2的孤立受损建筑；在非洪涝事件中，完好建筑移入受损邻域后73–87%被判为受损。插件对9个模型均保持或提升整体精度，与邻居不一致建筑的错误降低8–18%，邻域诱导的误判减少40–69%，合成孤立损毁检测率从1–6%提升到13–39%，并可迁移到光学–SAR数据与未见地震场景。

Conclusion: BDA模型整体高精度指标掩盖了对邻域的系统性依赖；building-level证据可在低计算成本下显著削弱该捷径，提升对稀有孤立损毁的鲁棒性与泛化性。

Abstract: Building damage assessment (BDA) from very-high-resolution imagery supports disaster response, and deep models now achieve high overall accuracy on public benchmarks. Because damage is spatially clustered, most buildings share the damage level of their neighbours, so overall scores are dominated by such buildings, whereas damaged buildings among intact ones are rare and easily overlooked. A high overall score therefore cannot tell whether a model judges the building itself or relies on its neighbourhood as a shortcut, and this study tests which of the two current models do. We stratify buildings by their agreement with their neighbours, move buildings into new neighbourhoods with their pixels unchanged, and diagnose nine models covering the main paradigms of BDA. All models miss a third to half of the isolated damaged buildings, and in non-flood events they call 73--87% of intact buildings damaged once these are moved into a damaged neighbourhood. We propose a building-evidence plug-in that adds two experts to an existing model without retraining it. One expert sees only the building, and the other sees its surroundings but is trained with seamlessly swapped neighbourhoods so that it learns not to trust them. With each of the nine models, the plug-in maintains or improves overall accuracy, reduces errors on buildings that disagree with their neighbours by 8--18%, and cuts by 40--69% the intact buildings that a damaged neighbourhood turns into damaged ones. It also raises the detection of synthetic isolated damage from 1--6% to 13--39% and carries over to optical--SAR data and to an unseen earthquake. High overall scores thus conceal a systematic reliance on the neighbourhood, which building-level evidence reduces at low cost.

</details>


### [69] [What Does LOL Measure? Hidden Label Shifts in Low-Light Enhancement Benchmarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38121)
*Adityan Thirumani Srinivasan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文审计LOL-v1与LOLv2-Real两个低光照增强基准，用8种方法的18个公开checkpoint在统一指标实现下复现所有已发表结果（误差≤0.09 dB），发现测试标签与训练标签存在系统性分布偏移：LOL-v1测试标签饱和度低1.48倍，LOLv2-Real测试标签暗14%，且LOL-v1测试输入在LOLv2-Real中全部重现；论文认为已发布的测试期手调参数实际上在补偿这些偏移，并给出报告规范建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LOL-v1与LOLv2-Real是监督式低光照图像增强的标准基准，但多个领先方法在评测脚本中附带人工设定的测试期调整（test-time settings）。若测试集与训练集分布不一致，这些调整与基于测试集的checkpoint选择可能掩盖真实泛化能力，导致排行榜失真。作者希望量化这种标签偏移、判定其来源，并厘清哪些收益来自可校准部分、哪些仅来自测试集调参。

Method: 统一指标实现下复现18个公开checkpoint（8种方法）的已发表数值，验证复现一致性；对训练/测试标签做光度统计对比（亮度、饱和度），用Cliff's delta与显著性检验量化偏移；通过输入统计对比与"无标签训练方法"的train/test性能差验证偏移来源；追踪LOL-v1测试输入在LOLv2-Real中的重复情况；将测试期收益分解为"可在训练数据上校准的部分"与"仅测试集调参可得的残差"，并在无偏移的LOLv2-Syn上作对照；评估测试集checkpoint选择对从头训练模型的虚高幅度及去除发布设置后的方法排名变化。

Result: (i) LOL-v1的15个测试标签渲染不同：同一批采集图像在LOLv2中标签亮度相同但饱和度低1.48倍，且LOL-v1自身训练标签与LOLv2渲染一致，已在官方发布版确认。(ii) LOLv2-Real测试集为连续图像690–789，其标签比训练标签暗14%（Cliff's delta=-0.45, p<1e-12），而所考察的输入统计无相应偏移；无标签训练方法在测试集上反而高出最多5.5 dB。(iii) LOL-v1全部15个测试输入在LOLv2-Real中重现，其中12个位于其训练集。测试期残差中位数在无偏移的LOLv2-Syn上为0.00 dB，LOL-v1为0.37 dB，LOLv2-Real为0.92 dB（最高3.9 dB）。偏移条件下测试集checkpoint选择使从头训练模型虚高0.9–2.0 dB；移除发布设置后第一名方法发生变化。

Conclusion: LOL-v1与LOLv2-Real的测试标签与训练标签存在系统性渲染/统计偏移，且测试样本与训练数据高度重叠，已发布的测试期设置与这些偏移相吻合。该基准上的部分性能提升来自测试集调参与checkpoint选择而非泛化能力；作者提出具体的报告建议（如固定并公开指标实现、区分可校准收益与测试集调参收益、报告训练/测试标签统计一致性、避免测试集checkpoint选择）。

Abstract: LOL-v1 and LOLv2-Real are the standard benchmarks for supervised low-light image enhancement, and several leading methods ship hand-set test-time adjustments with their evaluation scripts. We audit both benchmarks with 18 public checkpoints of eight methods under one metric implementation that reproduces every published number to within 0.09 dB, and find that their test labels differ from their training labels. (i) The 15 LOL-v1 test labels are rendered differently: the same captures appear in LOLv2 with labels of identical luminance but 1.48x lower saturation, and LOL-v1's own training labels match the LOLv2 rendering; we confirm this on the official release. (ii) The LOLv2-Real test set is the contiguous block of images 690-789, whose labels are 14% darker than the training labels (Cliff's delta = -0.45, p < 1e-12) with no comparable shift in the input statistics we examined; methods trained without any labels score up to 5.5 dB higher on test than on train. (iii) All 15 LOL-v1 test inputs reappear in LOLv2-Real, 12 in its training set. The released test-time settings are consistent with compensating for these shifts. Separating what can be calibrated on training data from what only test-set tuning finds, the test-only residual has median 0.00 dB on LOLv2-Syn, which has no shift, but 0.37 dB on LOL-v1 and 0.92 dB on LOLv2-Real (up to 3.9 dB). Under the shift, test-set checkpoint selection inflates a from-scratch model by 0.9-2.0 dB, and removing the released settings changes which method ranks first. We give concrete reporting recommendations.

</details>


### [70] [The Prestige: Benchmarking Cognitive Visual Reasoning using Magic Tricks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38103)
*Shuo Wen,Beixi Du,Edwin Meriaux,Junming Shi,Chloe Si,David Meger,Doina Precup,Gregory Dudek*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出视频理解基准 The Prestige，以专业魔术表演作为测试场景，通过刻意的误导来考察视觉语言模型的认知视觉推理能力，涵盖时序与因果理解、对抗性问题鲁棒性等开放式问答。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频理解基准难以有效探测模型的认知层面视觉推理能力，缺少能够施加系统性误导、要求模型追踪事件并解释反常结果的评测场景；同时当前 VLM 的推理能力与评测方法本身均存在可靠性问题。

Method: 构建基于专业魔术表演的视频理解基准 The Prestige，设计从时序理解、因果理解到对抗性问题鲁棒性的开放式问答；评测主流开源与闭源 VLM，并与人类表现对比；同时比较人工评分与自动评分的一致性，分析模型反复出现的失败模式，并进行问题格式（如多项选择与开放式生成）的消融实验。

Result: 即使最强的 VLM 与人类表现之间仍存在显著差距；人工评分与自动评分之间存在系统性差异；模型呈现出反复出现的失败模式；消融显示模型在无法独立生成正确解释的情况下仍能选中正确的多项选择答案。

Conclusion: 研究结果同时揭示了 VLM 推理能力的局限与现有评测方式的不足，表明需要更可靠的视频理解模型以及更严格的基准设计，并提示应进一步研究问题格式对评测结果的影响。

Abstract: We introduce The Prestige, a video understanding benchmark that probes cognitive visual reasoning through professional magic performances, where deliberate misdirection challenges models to track events and explain unexpected outcomes. The benchmark comprises open-ended questions ranging from temporal and causal understanding to robustness against adversarial questions. Evaluation of leading open-source and proprietary VLMs reveals a substantial gap between even the strongest model and human performance. We also find systematic discrepancies between human and automated grading and identify recurring model failure modes. Ablations further show that models can select correct multiple-choice answers even when they fail to generate correct explanations independently, motivating further investigations into question formats. Together, these findings highlight limitations in both VLM reasoning and its evaluation, underscoring the need for more reliable video understanding models and more rigorous benchmarks.

</details>


### [71] [Semantic Mismapping in Generalized Category Discovery: Evaluation and Mitigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39356)
*Zitai Wang,Qianqian Xu,Cong Hua,Xi Chen,Zhiyong Yang,Xiaochun Cao,Qingming Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文指出广义类别发现（GCD）中常用的全局匈牙利匹配会导致"语义错配"（semantic mismapping），可使新类准确率虚高最多25.63个点；为此提出语义保持评估（SPE）与新指标下的错配缓解优化（MMO）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期GCD方法采用可训练参数化分类头，旧类索引由监督语义锚定、新类索引仍可交换，输出空间变为"部分可交换"。但评估时仍沿用全局匈牙利匹配，会把已锚定的旧类索引重新分配给其他类别，从而掩盖预测错误并高估新类精度（最高25.63点）。作者希望修正评估方式并缓解引发错配的预测错误。

Method: 1) 定义"语义错配"现象，并推导置换环（permutation-cycle）条件，刻画语义错配何时能提升全局匹配得分；2) 提出SPE：保留旧类索引的监督语义，将匈牙利匹配限制在新类区域；3) 提出MMO：包含区域平衡损失（RBL，用于旧/新路由）与新颖多样性损失（NDL，鼓励新类原型间正交），以减轻导致错配的预测错误；4) 理论证明最小化这两个损失可收紧语义错配所致虚假精度增益的上界，且残差项可控。

Result: 实验观察到全局匹配下新类准确率高估可达25.63点；在GH与SPE两种评估协议下，所提方法均表现有效。

Conclusion: GCD评估中的全局匹配与部分可交换输出空间不匹配，会系统性地掩盖错误；应在评估阶段保持旧类语义、仅对新类做匹配，并通过RBL与NDL等优化手段抑制错配，从而获得更可靠且更优的性能。

Abstract: Generalized Category Discovery (GCD) aims to perform old-category recognition and novel-category discovery in the same unlabeled set. Early methods address both objectives through clustering and evaluate the exchangeable predicted indices with global Hungarian (GH) matching. Recent methods adopt trainable parametric heads, using supervision for old-category recognition and discovery-oriented objectives for new categories. In this way, the output space becomes partially exchangeable: old indices are semantically anchored, while new indices remain exchangeable. However, these methods still apply global matching, which can reassign anchored old indices to other categories and hide some prediction errors. Empirically, we are surprised to observe that this reassignment can induce an overestimation of new-category accuracy by up to 25.63 points. We term this phenomenon semantic mismapping and further derive a permutation-cycle condition that characterizes when semantic mismapping can increase the global matching score. To fix this issue, we propose Semantics-Preserving Evaluation (SPE), which preserves the supervised semantics of old indices and restricts Hungarian matching to the new region. Furthermore, we propose Mismapping-Mitigating Optimization (MMO) to alleviate the prediction errors that can give rise to semantic mismapping, combining a region-balance loss (RBL) for old/new routing with a novel-diversity loss (NDL) that encourages orthogonality among new prototypes. Theoretically, we show that minimizing the two losses can tighten an upper bound on spurious accuracy gains from semantic mismapping, with controllable residual terms. Empirical results under both GH and SPE demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed method.

</details>


### [72] [WorldFlow: Joint Video and 3D Motion Prediction via Large-Scale Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39278)
*Yuhao Lu,Jiongxu Chen,Hexiang Wei,Jiajin Wu,Juelin Li,Mingjian Liang,Fan Yang,Zhuowei Liang,Zihao Liu,Zhennan Wang,Sheng Wang,Lin Shao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: WorldFlow：联合预测未来视频与查询式3D轨迹的生成式世界模型，用MoT骨干联合去噪，在WorldFlowBench上取得最低ADE/FDE。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频世界模型把3D动态隐式化；基于动作的建模绑定特定机器人构型；3D运动预测模型仅有光流监督，对物理动态的学习信号有限。

Method: 将3D运动参数化为与视频网格对齐的连续位移token，用统一的Mixture-of-Transformers骨干在rectified-flow目标下同时去噪视频与3D轨迹两种模态；在144万条对象级模拟与真实样本上训练，并提出WorldFlowBench（1678样本、11个数据源）。

Result: 三个评测集上平均位移误差(ADE)与末端位移误差(FDE)最低；SpatialCog集ADE为0.060 m，较最强外部基线降低54.2%；相比纯flow变体，ADE与FDE分别降低55.9%和68.5%。

Conclusion: 显式几何动态与视觉演化的耦合可激活预训练视频模型中的物理常识，统一架构在模拟与真实域上具备良好可扩展性与泛化性。

Abstract: Predicting future physical states stands as a central challenge in embodied intelligence. Existing video world models leave 3D dynamics implicit, action-based formulations remain tied to specific robot configurations, and 3D motion prediction models use flow-only supervision, providing a limited learning signal for physical dynamics. To circumvent these limitations, we introduce \method{}, a generative world model that jointly predicts future video and query-based 3D trajectories. By parameterizing 3D motion as continuous displacement tokens aligned with the video grid, a unified Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) backbone jointly denoises both modalities under a rectified-flow objective. This formulation couples explicit geometric dynamics with visual evolution, effectively unlocking the physical commonsense embedded within pretrained video models. To empirically scale and validate this unified architecture, we train \method{} on a heterogeneous mixture of 1.44 million object-level samples spanning simulated and real-world domains. We further introduce WorldFlowBench, comprising 1,678 evaluation samples from 11 data sources across simulated and real-world interactions, including spatial reasoning tasks. Across all three evaluation sets, WorldFlow achieves the lowest average displacement error (ADE) and final displacement error (FDE) among the evaluated learning-based methods. Notably, on the challenging SpatialCog set, WorldFlow achieves an ADE of 0.060 m, a 54.2\% reduction compared with the strongest external baseline. It also reduces ADE and FDE by 55.9\% and 68.5\%, respectively, compared with its flow-only variant. Project page: https://worldflow-rbs.github.io/.

</details>


### [73] [DeCoRL: Decomposed Consistency Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Image Composition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39265)
*Zhiqiang Wu,Shuang Sun,Jiale Zhang,Jing Li,Yibo Chen,Xu Tang,Yao Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DeCoRL强化学习框架，通过将整体多图组合一致性分解为对象级一致性，并构建2-6张参考图的DeCo-Bench基准，提升图像编辑模型的多图组合一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多图组合（MICo）是大型图像编辑模型的关键能力，但随着参考图数量增加一致性迅速下降。现有监督微调（SFT）只对合成图像提供隐式监督，难以学到可靠的多参考图间对象级对应关系。

Method: DeCoRL将整体MICo一致性分解为对象级一致性：(1) 在参考图间建立与指令相关的对象对应关系，并定位其在生成图中的对应区域；(2) 使用基于单对象一致性标注训练的VLM奖励模型给出细粒度、逐对象的反馈；(3) 将对象级反馈聚合为多对象一致性奖励，用于指导RL后训练。同时构建DeCo-Bench基准。

Result: 在DeCo-Bench（2至6张参考图）和公开的MICo-Bench上均取得一致的MICo一致性提升。

Conclusion: 对象级一致性分解结合VLM奖励的强化学习方法，能有效克服SFT隐式监督的局限，为多图组合任务提供更可靠的一致性优化路径。

Abstract: Multi-image composition (MICo) is a critical yet challenging capability for large-scale image editing models, where consistency degrades rapidly as the number of reference images increases. While supervised fine-tuning (SFT) can equip models with basic MICo ability, it provides only implicit supervision on the composed image and often fails to learn reliable object-level correspondence across multiple references. We propose DeCoRL, a reinforcement-learning (RL) framework that improves MICo consistency by decomposing holistic MICo consistency into object-level consistency. DeCoRL first establishes instruction-relevant object correspondences across reference images and localizes the corresponding regions in the generated image. It then uses a VLM-based reward model trained on single-object consistency annotations to produce fine-grained, object-wise feedback, which is aggregated into a multi-object consistency reward to guide RL post-training. We further introduce DeCo-Bench, a benchmark covering compositions from 2 to 6 reference images. Experiments on DeCo-Bench and the public MICo-Bench demonstrate consistent improvements in MICo consistency.

</details>


### [74] [Don't Ask the LLM: Visual Token Pruning with Spectral Structure and Semantic Relevance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38303)
*Intaek Shin,Geuntaek Lim,Sungjune Park,Yukyung Choi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练的 ST-Pruner 框架，在进入 LLM 之前完成结构连贯且查询感知的视觉 token 选择，仅用 ≤11.1% 视觉 token 保留 >95% 性能，并在 LLaVA-NeXT 上实现 3.2× 端到端加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LVLM 将图像/视频表示为长视觉 token 序列，推理成本高。现有 token 剪枝的瓶颈在于"选什么信号"与"信号何时可用"：视觉侧 [CLS] 注意力在激进压缩下选择分散、偏向背景；更强的查询条件信号则要等 LLM 内部大量计算后才出现。由此提出核心问题：能否在咨询 LLM 之前实现结构连贯、查询感知的 token 选择。

Method: ST-Pruner（Spectral-Textual Pruner）：无训练、LLM 前阶段的视觉 token 选择框架。融合两类互补信号——(1) 与注意力无关的谱显著性（spectral saliency），(2) 反转的 patch–文本相似度（inverted patch-text similarity）；两者通过无参数乘性融合组合。

Result: 在多类 LVLM 上，仅使用最多 11.1% 的视觉 token 即保留超过 95% 的全 token 性能；在 LLaVA-NeXT 上获得 3.2× 端到端加速。代码已开源。

Conclusion: 查询感知、结构连贯的视觉 token 选择可在 LLM 之前高效完成，无需训练或额外参数，为 LVLM 推理加速提供了低成本且可迁移的剪枝范式。

Abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) represent images and videos as long visual-token sequences, substantially increasing inference costs. These costs motivate visual-token pruning, whose effectiveness depends on both what signal is used for selection and when that signal becomes available.
