Our analysis reveals complementary limitations: visual-side [CLS] attention produces scattered, background-biased selections under aggressive compression, while stronger query-conditioned signals become available after substantial computation within the large language model (LLM). This raises a natural question: can structurally coherent, query-aware token selection be performed before consulting the LLM? We therefore propose ST-Pruner (Spectral-Textual Pruner), a training-free framework for pre-LLM visual-token selection. It combines attention-independent spectral saliency with inverted patch-text similarity through parameter-free multiplicative fusion. Across diverse LVLMs, ST-Pruner retains over 95% of full-token performance using at most 11.1% of visual tokens and achieves a 3.2x end-to-end speedup on LLaVA-NeXT. Code is available at https://github.com/sejong-rcv/ST-Pruner.

</details>


### [75] [Hidden Commitment: When Language Models Silently Pick a Side and How Steering Can Surface It](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38296)
*Samuel Dawit Assefa,Jae Won Cho*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文检验"语言模型答案是否忠实反映内部决策"这一假设，发现模型在冲突上下文问答中即便处理了分歧仍会给出单边答案，其隐藏的"来源承诺"可由残差流中的来源选择方向读出，并可与冲突披露行为分离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人们常把模型输出当作内部决策的可见记录。但当事先提供的两个文档给出互不兼容的答案时，模型能否察觉分歧并如实披露，还是仍只选一边作答，尚未得到验证。作者希望弄清：模型内部的来源选择是否可从表征中读出、由哪些组件写入、能否被干预，以及这与"披露冲突"是否是同一机制。

Method: 构建"冲突上下文问答"设定（两份文档支持互斥答案）。在Qwen 0.8B上，用残差流中的"来源选择方向"（sign指示答案采用哪份文档）作为探针指标，定位写入该坐标的稀疏中层MLP写入器；通过对该坐标加steering验证因果性；并在Gemma 3 1B上以LLM审核标签做迁移验证；对"冲突披露"行为单独做层位与可干预性分析。

Result: Qwen 0.8B中，来源选择可由单个残差方向线性读出，中层稀疏MLP写入器向同一坐标写入；steering该坐标可切换模型实际采用的来源；迁移到Gemma 3 1B后，来源选择读数与稀疏写入桥接仍然保持。相比之下，冲突披露更弱、出现在更靠后的层，且只能被部分操纵，与来源选择不是同一机制。

Conclusion: 模型输出并非内部决策的可靠可见记录，存在"沉默的来源承诺"。据此提出面向检索系统的监控策略：用残差读出示踪隐含来源选择，并在模型已选边时，将"提示暴露冲突"的prompt与"披露steering"配合使用。

Abstract: Language-model answers are often treated as a visible record of the internal decision that produced them. We test this assumption in conflicting-context question answering, where two supplied documents support incompatible answers. A model can process the disagreement and still return a one-sided answer, even under prompts that ask it to disclose conflict. In Qwen 0.8B, hidden source commitment is captured by a residual source-choice direction whose sign tracks which document the answer uses. Sparse middle-layer MLP writers feed the same coordinate, and steering the coordinate changes the chosen source. A transfer run on Gemma 3 1B preserves the source-choice readout and sparse-write bridge under LLM-audited labels. Conflict disclosure follows a different pattern, appearing weaker, later-layer, and only partially steerable. These results support a practical monitoring strategy for retrieval systems that detects silent source commitment with residual readouts and pairs conflict-surfacing prompts with disclosure steering when the model has selected a side under disagreement.

</details>


### [76] [BudSplat: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting under a Rendering Budget](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38278)
*Muyu Xu,Fangneng Zhan,Yu Wei,Ling Shao,Shijian Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 BudSplat，一个紧凑的前馈 3DGS 框架，在有限高斯基元数量下学习保留最有价值的基元，通过细节感知重要性评分与质量感知剪枝提升渲染效率与质量权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前馈 3D Gaussian Splatting 从稀疏到密集多视角输入扩展时遇到渲染效率瓶颈：更多视角提供更强几何约束，但产生快速增长的候选高斯基元。现有方法无法可靠区分冗余基元，反复观测区域产生大量冗余基元，导致渲染开销上升而视觉质量收益甚微。

Method: 两项核心设计：(1) 细节感知重要性评分，从多层级视觉 token 中提取，显式指示剪枝可能损害感知质量的区域，并可注入体素融合过程，在多视角聚合时保留高价值局部贡献者；(2) 质量感知高斯剪枝，联合考虑渲染贡献与细节重要性来选取紧凑基元集合，并支持局部配额再分配，避免向大面积冗余区域过度分配基元。

Result: 在 RE10K、DL3DV 与 ACID 数据集上的实验表明，BudSplat 在渲染质量与效率之间取得了有利的权衡。

Conclusion: 通过显式建模细节重要性并据此进行质量感知剪枝与配额再分配，可在受限基元预算下构建紧凑的前馈 3DGS 表示，有效缓解多视角输入带来的冗余问题。

Abstract: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting has recently emerged as a promising alternative to per-scene optimization, enabling fast novel view synthesis by predicting Gaussian primitives directly from input images. However, it quickly faces a bottleneck of rendering efficiency while scaling from sparse to dense multi-view inputs, which offer more geometric constraints but produce a rapidly growing set of candidate Gaussians. Existing solutions cannot reliably distinguish redundant primitives, leading to many redundant primitives from repeatedly observed regions and increased rendering cost without much gain in visual quality. We propose BudSplat, a compact feed-forward 3DGS framework that learns to keep the most valuable Gaussians under a limited primitive count. BudSplat has two novel designs. The first is a detail-aware importance score that is extracted from multi-level visual tokens, providing an explicit cue for regions where pruning is likely to harm perceptual quality. The score can be injected into voxel fusion to preserve high-value local contributors during multi-view aggregation. The second is quality-aware Gaussian pruning that selects a compact set of primitives by jointly considering rendering contribution and detail importance. The quality-aware pruning enables local quota redistribution that helps avoid over-allocating primitives to large redundant regions. Experiments on RE10K, DL3DV, and ACID show that BudSplat achieves a favorable trade-off among rendering quality and efficiency.

</details>


### [77] [TreemapMix: Dirichlet-Controlled Multi-Image Augmentation for Probability and Ordinal Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38265)
*Ejafa Bassam,Konstantin Garbers,Yingsheng Geng,Dalton Jens,Jiaxu Qian,Guyue Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 TreemapMix，一种分布可控的多图混合增强：从 Dirichlet 分布采样源权重，并用 treemap 划分将其映射为面积比例区域，从而精确控制来源数量、可见面积与监督信号；配合 SCE 或 Plackett-Luce 目标分别实现概率匹配与排序匹配监督。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有混合样本增强多限于两图配对或固定小布局，难以控制混合源数量、各源可见面积比例及由此产生的监督形式，缺乏对混合结构的细粒度调控。

Method: TreemapMix 先从 Dirichlet 分布采样各源图像权重，再用 treemap 分区把权重映射为面积成比例的区域，得到已知面积的混合图；在此基础上给出两种目标：以面积为软类别概率目标的 soft cross-entropy（SCE），以及将面积转为序数监督的 Plackett-Luce（PL）目标。

Result: ImageNet-1K 同等训练配方下，TreemapMix-SCE 的校准误差显著低于所对比的混合样本基线，TreemapMix-PL 取得最高 Top-1 准确率；目标检测与实例分割的迁移实验表明其预训练特征在分类之外仍有价值。

Conclusion: 受控的多图组合可将同一区域面积信息分别暴露为概率匹配或排序匹配监督，两种实例化在精度与校准上各有优势，且特征具备良好迁移性。

Abstract: Data augmentation improves visual recognition by exposing models to synthetic training examples that encourage generalization beyond the observed data. Mixed-sample methods extend this idea by combining multiple images. However, many common approaches either mix only pairs of images or rely on fixed small layouts, limiting control over source count, visible area proportions, and induced supervision. We propose TreemapMix, a distribution-controlled multi-image augmentation that samples source weights from a Dirichlet distribution and assigns them to area-proportional regions using a treemap partition. The resulting known region areas support two complementary objectives. TreemapMix with soft cross-entropy (SCE) treats areas as soft class-probability targets, while TreemapMix with a Plackett-Luce (PL) objective converts areas into ordinal supervision. On ImageNet-1K under matched training recipes, TreemapMix-SCE achieves substantially lower calibration error than evaluated mixed-sample baselines, while TreemapMix-PL achieves the strongest Top-1 accuracy. Transfer experiments on object detection and instance segmentation suggest that TreemapMix-pretrained features remain useful beyond classification. These results show that controlled multi-image composition can expose the same region-area information as either probability-matching or rank-matching supervision. Code is available at https://github.com/Ejafa/treemapmix.

</details>


### [78] [Similar Scores, Opposite Failures: Human Correction as an Instrument for Video Caption Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38511)
*Ankit Khedia,Astitva Jaiswal,Chaitanya Prasad,Anisha Raju,Aangeeras*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文检验单句图像描述指标能否反映人类对密集多窗口视频描述的判断，结论是不能。BLEU-4与CIDEr类余弦的AUC仅为0.510与0.528，限定参考为审阅者修订后BLEU-4为0.479，与随机无异；审阅粒度影响检测结果（镜头类错误2.7% vs 12.8%）；15组模型两两差距中仅4组经Bonferroni校正显著。作者主张描述评测应记录"错在哪"而非仅"错多少"，并公开分类体系与代码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频描述能力的提升使模型输出从单句扩展为密集、多窗口的长描述，但评测仍沿用为单句图像描述设计的参考重叠类指标。作者要验证这类指标是否仍能复现人类判断，若不成立则暴露现有视频描述评测范式的有效性缺口。

Method: 6个前沿模型为196个短片生成描述；受训标注员依据预先固定的失败分类体系对每条描述做后编辑，分别以整片概览与逐窗口两种粒度进行，并由质检复核，共得到1,144条概览判定与4,672条窗口判定。以AUC衡量参考重叠指标（BLEU-4、CIDEr式tf-idf余弦）对"接受/拒绝"的区分力，并做参考限定、bootstrap置信区间、Bonferroni多重比较校正及审阅者/片段效应校正等稳健性检验，同时比较不同粒度的错误检出率与模型排序一致性。

Result: 参考重叠指标无法区分被接受与被拒绝的描述：BLEU-4 AUC=0.510，CIDEr式余弦0.528；将参考限定为审阅者修订后BLEU-4降至0.479（95% CI 0.431–0.529），与随机不可区分。审阅粒度改变检出内容：同样的标注员在概览模式下于2.7%的描述中记录镜头/机位错误，逐窗口模式下为12.8%，4.7倍差距在所有稳健性检验中稳定。正确概览率区间为54.1%–72.7%，但15组两两差距仅4组（校正审阅者与片段效应后5组）通过Bonferroni校正；准确率与衍生严重度给出不同的模型排序。准确率在统计上不可区分的模型，其失败画像差异显著，任何单一标量均无法体现。

Conclusion: 单句图像描述的参考重叠指标不能作为密集多窗口视频描述的有效代理，评测存在效度缺口；粒度设计会系统性改变错误统计，模型比较的显著性需多重校正，且准确率与严重度指标排序不一致。作者主张视频描述评测应从"错多少"转向"错在哪"，记录结构化失败类型；论文给出失败分类体系、各模型失败画像、预测难度的语料属性及可复现全部数值的代码。

Abstract: Video captioning models are increasingly evaluated with metrics designed for single-sentence image captions. We test whether those metrics recover human judgement on dense, multi-window video description, and find that they do not. Six frontier models captioned 196 short clips. Trained annotators post-edited every caption against a failure taxonomy fixed before annotation, once as a whole-clip overview and once window by window, and a quality-control reviewer checked each annotation, yielding 1,144 overview verdicts and 4,672 window verdicts. Reference-overlap metrics do not separate the captions reviewers accepted from those they rejected: BLEU-4 reaches an AUC of 0.510 and a CIDEr-style tf-idf cosine 0.528, and restricting references to reviewer corrections leaves BLEU-4 at 0.479 (95% CI 0.431-0.529), indistinguishable from chance. Review granularity changes what is detected. The same annotators record camera and shot errors on 2.7% of captions when reading the overview and on 12.8% when reading window by window, a 4.7x gap that holds across every robustness check we ran, on the mode most likely to need a near-total rewrite. Correct-overview rates span 54.1-72.7%, but only 4 of 15 pairwise gaps survive Bonferroni correction (5 after adjusting for reviewer and clip effects), and accuracy and derived severity order the models differently. Models with statistically indistinguishable accuracy have sharply different failure profiles, which no single scalar shows. We argue that caption evaluation should record what was wrong rather than only how often, and we report the taxonomy, the per-model profiles, the corpus properties that predict difficulty, and the code that regenerates every number in the paper.

</details>


### [79] [UnMixMamba: Unmixing Guided State Space Subpixel Mapping of Crops from MODIS Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38507)
*Motasem Alkayid,Yimin Zhu,Naser El-Sheimy,Lincoln Linlin Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: UnMixMamba将250 m MODIS时序作物亚像元制图重构为"解混+丰度超分+自适应Mamba精化"，在阿尔伯塔2015数据上以OA 0.8397、mIoU 0.6640、AA 0.7837、Kappa 0.7715优于ST-DRes、ESPCN、FineCrop、AgriFM及经典SPM基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 需将250 m MODIS时序映射到田块尺度AAFC标签以支撑面积估算与农情监测，但存在三重困难：(i) 光谱-时相耦合与混合像元使粗到细直接分类失效；(ii) 类内端元变异大，单一作物光谱无法刻画；(iii) 在高分网格上均匀精化，易像素与难像素同等对待，少数类误差残留。

Method: 提出UnMixMamba：时相-光谱-空间解耦(TSSD)分解估计单纯形分数，并由同一混合场驱动AAFC分类，避免LR→HR logits直接映射；引入×8丰度超分与可学习的按作物端元变体库，在线性混合模型下重建LR与HR的MODIS数据立方；用预测的作物丰度分配固定Mamba token预算，使HR精化聚焦少数类而非全网格。

Result: 在阿尔伯塔2015、固定空间块划分协议下，UnMixMamba取得OA 0.8397、mIoU 0.6640、AA 0.7837、Kappa 0.7715，均优于ST-DRes、ESPCN、FineCrop、AgriFM及经典SPM基线。

Conclusion: 解混驱动的丰度域建模配合预算受限的自适应精化，可有效缓解混合像元、端元变异与少数类欠拟合问题；方法限定为已知农业掩膜内的闭集四作物制图，泛化至更多作物类别与其他区域尚待验证。

Abstract: Subpixel mapping (SPM) of crop types from \SI{250}{m} Moderate Resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer (MODIS) time series to field-scale Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada (AAFC) labels supports acreage estimation and agricultural monitoring. Three difficulties remain: (i)~spectral-temporal coupling and mixed pixels that break direct coarse-to-fine classifiers; (ii)~intra-class endmember variability that a single spectrum per crop cannot capture; and (iii)~uniform refinement on the high-resolution (HR) grid, which treats every subpixel the same, so most of the effort goes to easy pixels while errors remain in the minority class. UnMixMamba addresses them as follows. For~(i), a temporal-spectral-spatial decoupled (TSSD) factorization estimates simplex fractions and drives AAFC classification from the same mixture field, instead of mapping low-resolution (LR) observations directly to HR logits. For~(ii), \(\times 8\) abundance super-resolution and a learnable per-crop variant endmember bank reconstruct the MODIS cube at LR and HR under a linear mixing model. For~(iii), the predicted crop fractions decide where a fixed Mamba token budget is spent, so HR refinement focuses on the minority class instead of the full grid. On Alberta 2015 under a fixed spatial-block protocol, UnMixMamba reaches OA 0.8397, mIoU 0.6640, AA 0.7837, and Kappa 0.7715, ahead of ST-DRes, ESPCN, FineCrop, AgriFM, and classical SPM baselines. The task is closed-set four-crop mapping inside a known agricultural mask.

</details>


### [80] [Residual Motion Splatting for Continuous Space-Time Video Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38499)
*Vincent Herfeld,Eva Coupet{é},Julien Mairal,Jean Ponce*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种学习式的连续时空视频超分方法，直接在隐空间中将低分辨率特征按预测的亚像素轨迹与可见性权重splat到高分辨率网格上再融合解码，实现时间插值与多帧超分的统一操作，性能优于SOTA且快一个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典多帧超分表明可通过对齐亚像素互补观测并累积到更细网格恢复单帧采样极限外的细节。但现有学习式连续时空超分方法在融合前先重采样（要么仅在低分辨率对齐融合后回归连续高分辨率表示，要么将每帧插值到输出分辨率再splat），导致帧间合并前丢失亚像素位置信息。要在学习式连续模型中恢复该原理存在两大挑战：未观测时刻的亚像素运动估计，以及粗网格splat到细网格时的空洞与遮挡处理。

Method: 1) 预测逐像素连续轨迹，以平滑残差运动精化线性光流路径，特征在整段视频序列上积分获得；2) 在学习的隐空间中，将连续低分辨率特征按预测的亚像素位置与预测可见性权重直接splat到高分辨率网格，再由解码器消除残余歧义；时间插值与多帧超分被统一为单一操作。

Result: 在多个标准基准上，重建保真度与感知质量均优于现有SOTA，运行速度最高提升约一个数量级。

Conclusion: 回归经典亚像素对齐-累积原理，通过在隐空间中以亚像素精度直接splat实现融合前不丢失亚像素信息，可将时空超分统一为单次操作，兼顾质量与效率。

Abstract: Continuous space-time video super-resolution produces a high-resolution, highframe-rate video from a low-resolution, low-frame-rate one at arbitrary spatial scales and temporal instants. Classical spatial multi-frame super-resolution has shown that detail beyond a single frame's sampling limit can be recovered by aligning complementary observations with sub-pixel precision and accumulating them on a finer grid. Existing learning-based methods largely depart from this principle: some align and fuse frames only at low resolution before regressing a continuous high-resolution representation, while others interpolate each frame to the output resolution before splatting. In both cases, the per-frame samples are resampled before fusion, so their sub-pixel positions are lost before frames are combined. Restoring this principle in a learned continuous model raises two challenges: estimating sub-pixel motion at unobserved times, and handling holes and occlusions when splatting a coarse grid onto a finer one. We address the first by predicting per-pixel continuous trajectories that refine linear optical-flow paths with smooth residual motion, using features integrated over the full video sequence. We address the second by directly splatting consecutive low-resolution features in a learned latent space onto a high-resolution grid at their predicted sub-pixel positions with predicted visibility weights, before a decoder resolves remaining ambiguities. This makes temporal interpolation and multi-frame superresolution a single operation. Our method improves both reconstruction fidelity and perceptual quality on multiple standard benchmarks over the state of the art, while running up to an order of magnitude faster.

</details>


### [81] [IntReal: A Real-World Dataset and Benchmark for Multimodal Interleaved Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38425)
*Shaohan Yu,Jie Qin,Wende Tan,Haiwen Diao,Limeng Qiao,Yueming Lyu,Chenyang Si*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 IntReal，包含真实世界交错多模态数据集 IntReal-100K 与覆盖七个维度、借助专家模型实现由粗到细诊断的评测套件 IntReal Evaluation Suite，系统填补了交错多模态生成任务定义、数据与细粒度评测的空白。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 统一多模态模型（UMMs）虽能联合生成文本与图像，但"交错多模态生成"研究不足，主要受限于两点：(1) 缺乏任务定义清晰、配套训练数据的交错生成基准；(2) 缺乏可跨能力维度可靠诊断模型表现的细粒度评测协议。

Method: 构建两部分：IntReal-100K，即涵盖四大类别的真实世界交错多模态样本数据集；IntReal Evaluation Suite，使用专门专家模型在七个互补维度上评测，实现粗到细的诊断。并对四个模型族进行基准测试，开展后训练实验。

Result: 评测套件有效性得到验证：指标间冗余低（最大两两绝对 Spearman ρ ≤ 0.42）、与人工判断一致性高（83.3% 准确率）、不同专家评测器间一致性高（ρ > 0.9）；基准测试揭示各模型族在能力维度上优劣分明；后训练实验表明 IntReal-100K 可提升交错生成，且单模态生成训练亦能增益交错生成。

Conclusion: 交错生成可从模态特定优化中获益，而非必须在每个阶段进行文本-图像联合训练；IntReal 为交错多模态生成提供了数据与评测基础。

Abstract: Humans routinely consume multimodal content, where textual and visual information is naturally interleaved. Although Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) can jointly generate text and images, multimodal interleaved generation remains largely underexplored. Progress in this area is hindered by two key limitations: (1) the lack of well-defined interleaved generation tasks and corresponding training data, and (2) the absence of fine-grained evaluation protocols that can reliably diagnose model performance across different capability dimensions. To this end, we present IntReal, comprising two complementary components: IntReal-100K, a real-world dataset of multimodal interleaved samples spanning four major categories, and the IntReal Evaluation Suite, which evaluates model performance across seven complementary dimensions using specialized expert models, enabling coarse-to-fine diagnosis. Extensive experiments validate our evaluation suite through low inter-metric redundancy (max pairwise absolute Spearman's $ρ\leq 0.42$ ), high agreement with human judgments (83.3% accuracy), and strong consistency across different expert evaluators (Spearman's $ρ> 0.9$ ), supporting the complementarity and reliability of our metrics. By benchmarking four families of UMMs, we show that IntReal Evaluation Suite reveals distinct strengths and weaknesses across models. Post-training experiments demonstrate the utility of IntReal-100K for improving interleaved generation and further show that training unimodal generation can also benefit interleaved generation. These findings suggest that interleaved generation can benefit from modality-specific optimization, rather than requiring joint text-image training at every stage.

</details>


### [82] [SparseTokenGS: Gaussian-based Sparse-View CBCT Reconstruction via Reusable Token Pool](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38360)
*Zihan Deng,Zhenzhen Gong,Yujie Liu,Jiaxin Gong,Dingkun Liu,Kexian Xie,Yixing Huang,Peng Jin,Tianye Niu,Zhisheng Wang,Fenglin Liu,Hongming Shan,Lequan Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 SparseTokenGS，用可复用 token 池为前馈高斯重建提供扫描全局上下文，实现稀疏视角 CBCT 单次前向重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏视角锥束CT（CBCT）存在严重伪影；前馈高斯方法把重建成本转移到训练阶段，但全局扫描信息仅在构建场时写入，坐标解码阶段无法检索，只能依赖局部特征，导致同一扫描内体数据不一致、重建质量明显下降。

Method: 引入可复用 token 池：Anchor Token Fusion 在锚点处、Point-Token Attention 在查询坐标处分别对共享池进行检索，保留局部高斯先验；无需逐扫描优化与投影域损失，一次前向完成重建。

Result: 在三个公开胸部与牙科数据集上取得对比方法中最优重建性能；临床牙科扫描仅用6个投影即达 PSNR 29.51 dB、SSIM 0.842（对照全视角参考），且现成牙髓分割仍可保持结构可分；在火山岩与鸡肉数据上验证了同物体自适应后的性能。

Conclusion: 可复用 token 池使前馈重建在解码过程中持续保有扫描级上下文，有望服务快速临床病灶定位与分析。

Abstract: Sparse-view cone-beam computed tomography is widely used for fast, low-dose volumetric imaging and lesion localization in dentistry and image-guided interventions, but it introduces severe artifacts. Feed-forward Gaussian methods transfer the reconstruction cost to training and decode each coordinate from projection-aligned features and neighboring anchors. However, information from the whole scan is written only when the field is constructed and cannot be retrieved during coordinate decoding, leaving the volume inconsistent within the scan. This is a common limitation of such methods: once the field is fixed, decoding uses only local features and reconstruction quality drops substantially. We propose SparseTokenGS, a Gaussian-based method for sparse-view cone-beam computed tomography reconstruction via a reusable token pool. Anchor Token Fusion and Point-Token Attention query this shared pool at the anchors and at the query coordinates, respectively. The local Gaussian prior is retained, and the volume is reconstructed in one forward pass, without per-scan optimization or a projection-domain loss. On three public chest and dental datasets, SparseTokenGS achieves the highest reconstruction performance among the compared methods. On clinical dental scans, reconstruction from only six projections reaches 29.51 decibels in peak signal-to-noise ratio and a structural similarity of 0.842 against the full-view reference, and off-the-shelf tooth-and-pulp segmentation keeps these structures separable for root-canal localization. Experiments on volcanic rock and chicken show performance after same-object adaptation. A reusable token pool gives feed-forward reconstruction a mechanism that keeps scan-wide context available through decoding and can benefit future rapid clinical lesion localization and analysis. The code is available at: https://github.com/FrankDengAI/SparseTokenGS.

</details>


### [83] [VEvo-Harness: Causally-Guarded Self-Evolving Harness for Agentic Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39158)
*Yuan Wang,Yuhang Yu,Mengting Chen,Tianrun Xu,Zihao Pan,Xuetao Feng,Wei Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VEvo-Harness：面向智能体式视觉生成的因果守卫持续自演化脚手架系统，将浅层“生成-验证-重写”循环升级为可治理、可记忆、可路由的闭环自演化系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉生成与编辑的核心瓶颈已从像素级保真度转向满足密集约束的用户规格，且工作流日趋智能体化。现有智能体生成流水线仍是浅层的“生成-验证-重写”循环，把VLM判断当作粗粒度视觉反馈，要么丢弃修复经验，要么进行无门控更新从而污染技能库；由于缺少记忆与治理环节，它们退化为无治理的反复试错迭代器，无法成为持续自演化的脚手架。

Method: 提出四项耦合创新：(1) 视觉回溯（visual traceback）：借助分层验证树将稀疏判断稠密化为根因归因；(2) 视觉持续治理（visual continual governance）：通过反事实双臂图像生成重放，仅接纳因果有效的技能补丁；(3) 生命周期管理的脚手架状态：按工作层、经验层、模式层三级层次蒸馏以根因锚定的episode，形成可路由、经因果验证的持久技能库；(4) 异构沙盒策略：编排多样化修复原语动作空间，依据根因动态路由成本感知的干预以选择最优策略。

Result: VEvo-Harness 超越当前最先进的智能体方法，并可媲美专有生成器（如 GPT-Image、Nano-Pro），同时保持脚手架的持续演化与泛化能力。

Conclusion: 该工作首次将因果守卫的持续自演化机制引入智能体式视觉生成，通过“回溯-治理-记忆-策略”的闭环，使系统从无治理的试错迭代转变为可持续积累与泛化的技能演化系统。

Abstract: The central bottleneck in visual generation and editing has migrated from achieving pixel-level fidelity to satisfying densely constrained user specifications through increasingly agentic workflows. Prevailing agentic generation pipelines remain shallow generate-verify-rewrite loops treating VLM judgments as coarse visual feedback, either discarding repair experience or admitting ungated updates that poison skill library. With memorize and govern periods left open, they degrade into ungoverned iterators of repeated trial-and-error rather than continual self-evolving harness. Towards this issue, we present \textbf{VEvo-Harness}, the first causally-guarded continual self-evolving harness system for agentic visual generation. VEvo-Harness introduces four coupled innovations: (1) \textit{a visual traceback} that densifies sparse judgments into root-cause attributions with a hierarchical verification tree; (2) \textit{a visual continual governance} that admits only causally valid skill patches through counterfactual dual-arm image generation replay; (3) \textit{a lifecycle-managed harness state} that hierarchically distills root-cause-anchored episodes across working, experience, and pattern tiers into a persistent skill library of routable and causally verified capabilities; (4) \textit{a heterogeneous sandbox policy} that orchestrates a diverse action space of repair primitives, dynamically routing cost-aware interventions based on root causes to select the most effective strategy. VEvo-Harness surpasses state-of-the-art agentic methods and rivals proprietary generators (\textit{e.g.}, GPT-Image, Nano-Pro) while maintaining the continual harness evolution and generalization.

</details>


### [84] [AlbumVSR: Identity-Preserving Face Video Super-Resolution from a Personal Photo Album](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39001)
*Nianyao Du,Xijun Wang,Stanley H. Chan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AlbumVSR：以个人相册为外部身份先验，通过集合Token注入冻结的单步流式扩散Transformer，实现重度退化下的视频人脸复原。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 严重模糊、下采样、噪声与压缩会抹除忠实复原人脸所需身份线索，需引入同一人物的照片作为外部身份来源。

Method: 将冻结的单步流式扩散Transformer以个人相册为条件：用4个MagFace/CLIP集合Token编码相册，另用64个纹理Token，取自按当前窗口估计人脸姿态渲染的融合UV图集；两类Token附加到Transformer缓存的交叉注意力上下文中。

Result: 在身份不重叠、含重度合成退化的VoxCeleb2基准上，ArcFace与真值相似度由0.586升至0.670，人脸PSNR由24.98升至26.71 dB；91个测试身份的平均身份相似度高于全部14个基线。

Conclusion: 相册级身份先验与姿态对齐的纹理Token经交叉注意力缓存注入，可在不微调主干的前提下显著提升退化视频人脸的保真度与身份一致性。

Abstract: Severe blur, downsampling, noise, and compression can erase the identity cues needed to faithfully restore a person's face. We therefore use photographs of the same person as an external source of identity. AlbumVSR conditions a frozen, one-step streaming diffusion transformer on a personal album. We use four MagFace/CLIP set tokens to encode the album, and 64 texture tokens which come from a fused UV atlas rendered at the current window's estimated face pose. These tokens are appended to the transformer's cached cross-attention context. On an identity-disjoint VoxCeleb2 benchmark with heavy synthetic degradation, AlbumVSR raises ArcFace similarity to the ground truth from 0.586 to 0.670 and face PSNR from 24.98 to 26.71 dB. On the 91 test identities, its mean identity similarity is higher than that of all 14 baselines.

</details>


### [85] [PairCLIP-SWA: Similarity-Guided Balancing and Stochastic Weight Averaging for Generalized Deepfake Image Detection with OpenCLIP](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37874)
*Md. Nakib,Sudipto Sarkar,A. J. A. Jubayer Talukder,Mohammad Ariful Haque*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文衡量深度伪造检测器“以验证集最优单点checkpoint部署”这一做法的可靠性，提出单backbone检测器PairCLIP-SWA：通过渐进式解冻OpenCLIP ViT-L/14并对微调轨迹做权重平均，在DF-Wild-Cup上以单模型超过已发表的三backbone集成，并揭示验证集选点会导致误排与严重漏检。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度伪造检测器几乎总是以验证集上得分最好的单一checkpoint部署，但这一选择的可靠性很少被量化；同时已有最强结果依赖多backbone集成，成本高。

Method: 提出PairCLIP-SWA：单backbone，基于OpenCLIP ViT-L/14视觉塔做渐进式block解冻微调；用CLIP相似度引导的一对一子采样构建类别平衡语料；在权重空间对微调轨迹做平均（SWA）。在与三backbone集成相同的协议下于IEEE SP Cup 2025（DF-Wild-Cup）训练，并在OpenForensics衍生基准上验证选点问题，另做22组内部配置的消融（含预处理）。

Result: DF-Wild-Cup上达97.04%准确率、98.64% AU-ROC、4.07% EER，对比集成基线94.46%、97.60%、5.00%。训练日志显示未平均checkpoint的验证准确率波动达5.34个点、验证损失翻倍以上，而权重平均从不更差且最多优5.99个点。OpenForensics衍生基准上，验证准确率最高的checkpoint（98.43%）在10,905张不相交测试集上仅88.85%，拒真21.1%，而终末平均（验证排名末位）达94.76%。消融表明CLIP预训练而非集成为准确率主因，二次人脸裁剪损失约34个点，频域输入迁移性差。

Conclusion: 单backbone加权重平均即可超越多backbone集成，且验证集选点不可靠；建议采用在早停划分上测得的按类选择准则（per-class selection criteria）替代单一总体验证准确率。

Abstract: Deepfake detectors are almost always deployed as the single checkpoint that scored best on a validation split, yet the reliability of that choice is rarely measured. We measure it with PairCLIP-SWA, a single-backbone detector that adapts an OpenCLIP ViT-L/14 visual tower by progressive block unfreezing on a class-balanced corpus built by CLIP-similarity-guided one-to-one subsampling, and averages the fine-tuning trajectory in weight space. Trained in-domain on the IEEE SP Cup 2025 (DF-Wild-Cup) benchmark under the same protocol as the strongest published three-backbone ensemble, the weight-averaged detector reaches 97.04% accuracy, 98.64% AU-ROC and a 4.07% equal error rate, against 94.46%, 97.60% and 5.00%. Its training log shows why averaging matters: over the averaged epochs the non-averaged checkpoint swings across 5.34 points of validation accuracy while its validation loss more than doubles, whereas the average is never worse and is up to 5.99 points better. On an OpenForensics-derived benchmark the same instability becomes a misranking: the checkpoint that validation accuracy selects (98.43%) scores 88.85% on a disjoint 10,905-image test partition, rejecting 21.1% of genuine photographs, while the terminal average, ranked last on validation, scores 94.76%. A study of twenty-two in-house configurations on the identical DF-Wild-Cup split, including preprocessing ablations, shows that CLIP pre-training rather than ensembling drives accuracy, that secondary face cropping costs about 34 points, and that frequency-domain inputs transfer poorly. We recommend per-class selection criteria measured off the early-stopping split.

</details>


### [86] [Structure-retained low-rank adapters for weather synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38413)
*Shunxin Wang,Alexandros Stergiou,Luuk Spreeuwers,Estefania Talavera,Nicola Strisciuglio*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出基于结构保持LoRA的天气合成框架，利用SDXL中处理结构信息的注意力块学习结构LoRA矩阵，实现无需ControlNet等外部条件的高保真天气合成，为户外视觉模型提供训练与评测数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 户外视觉模型在恶劣天气下鲁棒性不足，而现有数据集难以分离天气引起的分布偏移：同一场景的动态元素（行人、车辆）与相机视角会变化，导致无法将天气因素从场景变化中解耦，且高质量、仅含单一天气影响的数据难以获取。

Method: 分析SDXL在图像到图像翻译过程中各注意力块对结构信息的处理位置，据此在相应模块上学习结构LoRA矩阵（structure-retaining LoRA），并将其用于天气合成，摆脱对外部条件控制（如ControlNet）的依赖。

Result: 实验表明该方法优于现有天气合成方法，在保持场景结构的同时获得更高的真实感。

Conclusion: 该框架可为户外计算机视觉应用生成高保真的训练与评测数据，形成稳健的数据生成流水线。

Abstract: Real-world deployment of computer vision models, particularly in outdoor scenarios, is often limited by environmental interferences, such as adverse weather. Improving model robustness across weather conditions is thus critical for reliability. However, sourcing high-quality data relevant to isolated weather effects is a significant challenge. Most datasets include changes in dynamic elements across observations of the same scene: subjects such as pedestrians and vehicles change between shots, while camera viewpoints vary. These aspects make it difficult to decouple solely weather-induced distribution shifts from the scene. In this work, we address this with a novel weather synthesis framework that utilizes structure-retaining Low-Rank Adapters (LoRA). We analyze the attention blocks in Stable Diffusion XL (SDXL) and identify where relevant structural information is mostly processed during image-to-image translation. Through an architectural analysis of SDXL, we learn structural LoRA matrices for the corresponding blocks and then leverage them for weather synthesis, eliminating the need for external conditioning such as ControlNet. Experimental results demonstrate that our method improves upon existing synthesis approaches, achieving greater realism while preserving structure. This provides a robust pipeline for generating high-fidelity training and evaluation data for outdoor computer vision applications.

</details>


### [87] [ETA-Motion: Efficient Topology-Agnostic Motion Diffusion via Sparse Joint Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38259)
*Seoyoung Hwang,Tae-Kyun Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ETA-Motion 提出基于稀疏关节学习的拓扑无关动作生成框架，以少量关键关节代替全关节建模，在降低计算冗余的同时提升跨骨架的可迁移性与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统动作生成假设固定骨骼模板，而拓扑无关设定需应对关节数量与语义不一致的多样角色。现有方法采用密集全关节建模，计算开销大，且难以学习跨拓扑的可迁移动作模式。

Method: 从全关节中选取紧凑关节子集构建稀疏骨架并训练生成器；引入融合文本与视觉线索的语义关节嵌入以建立跨拓扑对应关系；设计保持骨骼结构的拓扑感知训练目标。推理阶段虽仅在稀疏观测上训练，仍支持全骨架动作生成。

Result: 实验表明 ETA-Motion 优于现有拓扑无关基线，并在效率、对未见动作与未见拓扑的泛化能力上显著提升。

Conclusion: 稀疏关节建模可有效替代密集全关节建模，在保证甚至提升生成质量的同时显著降低计算成本，为拓扑无关动作生成提供高效且可泛化的方案。

Abstract: Topology-agnostic motion generation aims to synthesize motions for diverse characters with arbitrary skeletons. Unlike conventional motion generation, which assumes a fixed skeletal template, this setting must handle diverse joint configurations and inconsistent joint semantics across characters. Existing methods address this challenge through dense full-joint modeling, which incurs substantial computational cost and hinders learning transferable motion patterns across diverse skeletal topologies. We present ETA-Motion, a topology-agnostic motion generation framework based on sparse joint learning. Instead of learning motion from all joints, our method uses a compact subset of joints to reduce redundancy and trains the motion generator on the resulting sparse skeleton. To facilitate correspondence across diverse topologies, we introduce semantic joint embeddings that combine textual and visual cues, together with topology-aware training objectives for preserving skeletal structure. Although ETA-Motion is trained only on sparse skeletal observations, it supports full-skeleton motion generation during inference. Experimental results demonstrate that ETA-Motion outperforms existing topology-agnostic baselines while significantly improving efficiency and generalization to unseen motions and unseen topologies.

</details>


### [88] [Vision Tomography: Towards Portable 3D Bidirectional Face-Skull Inference from Visual Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38065)
*Zidu Wang,Meng Xu,Miao Xu,Hengyuan Ma,Jiankuo Zhao,Xutao Li,Zhen Lei,Xiangyu Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Vision Tomography（VT）框架，可从图像/素描等多模态视觉输入重建配对3D人脸-颅骨几何，并支持面部与颅骨的联合编辑；核心为密集射线匹配配准与3D双向面-颅骨可变形模型BFSM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统CT虽能同时获取3D人脸与颅骨的配对几何，但成本高、位置固定且存在辐射暴露。远程诊断、数字医疗、法医鉴定、失踪人员调查与考古分析等场景亟需便携、安全、易获取的3D颅骨几何捕获方案。

Method: 1) 构建200+样本数据集，每例含CT颅骨、CT人脸与高保真带纹理人脸扫描；2) 提出密集射线匹配配准方法，保证人脸、颅骨及其软组织对应关系的拓扑一致性；3) 在此基础上构建3D双向人脸-颅骨可变形模型BFSM，通过共享系数空间实现面-颅形状双向推断，并对软组织厚度变化建模以支持同一颅骨的一对多面部重建（如年龄、体脂变化）。

Result: 在法医与医疗多个任务上验证了VT的有效性，包括从图像或素描重建配对3D人脸-颅骨、以及通过面-颅联合编辑预测手术效果；大量实验证实方法的鲁棒性与准确性。代码已开源。

Conclusion: VT为无需CT的便携式、安全3D颅骨-人脸联合几何获取提供了可行路径，BFSM的共享系数空间与软组织厚度建模使双向形状推断和一对多重建成为可能，具有法医鉴定、数字医疗与手术规划等应用价值。

Abstract: Traditional computed tomography (CT) can capture paired 3D face and skull geometry, but it remains costly, fixed in location, and exposes patients to radiation. For applications such as remote diagnostics, digital healthcare, forensic identification, missing-person investigation, and archaeological analysis, there is an urgent need for a portable, safe, and accessible solution to capture 3D skull geometry. In this work, we introduce Vision Tomography (VT), a concept and framework capable of reconstructing paired 3D face-skull geometry from various visual modalities, and also enabling joint manipulation of 3D facial and skull geometry. To achieve this, we first construct a dataset of over 200 samples, where each case includes a CT-based skull, a CT-based face, and a high-fidelity textured face scan. Secondly, we propose a novel dense ray matching registration method that ensures topological consistency across face, skull, and their tissue correspondences. Building on this registration, we introduce the 3D Bidirectional Face-Skull Morphable Model (BFSM) as the foundation of Vision Tomography, which enables shape inference between the face and skull through a shared coefficient space, while also modeling tissue thickness variation to support one-to-many facial reconstructions from the same skull, reflecting individual facial changes such as age or body fat. Finally, we demonstrate the effectiveness of Vision Tomography across various forensic and medical applications, including paired 3D face-skull reconstruction from images or sketches and predicting surgical outcomes with joint face-skull editing. Extensive experiments confirm the robustness and accuracy of our method. Vision Tomography is available at https://github.com/wang-zidu/BFSM

</details>


### [89] [Beyond Region Memory: Local Point Tracking for Vocal Cord Localization in Video Laryngoscopy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38830)
*Huayu Wang,Gyungmin Ko,Jung Heon Kim,Jia-Xian Jian,Dae Kon Kim,Dong Keon Lee,Hsiang-Wei Huang,Pau-Choo Chung,Linda Shapiro,Richard B. Utarnachitt,Jenq-Neng Hwang,Nathan J. White*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出局部点跟踪框架LPT，用"先定位、后贴合"的两阶段解耦方式实现鲁棒的声带定位/跟踪。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 急救视频喉镜中的声带定位面临组织快速形变、镜面高光与器械遮挡，逐帧视觉定位困难；同时有状态掩码或整区域表示会把掩码误差累积进时序记忆。

Method: LPT将时序状态存储在局部点坐标而非有状态掩码中：先用单帧语义检测器产生稀疏锚点并初始化局部查询点（默认SAM支持，回退为规则网格）；再用点传播模块跨检测漏检帧跟踪这些点，由点几何恢复时序边界框；最后用box-snap步骤将所选框精化到目标边界，单帧空间精化不回写时序记忆。

Result: 在两个不同数据集上整体优于现有基线，两项数据集均取得最佳mAP_50、success AUC与最低missing rate；消融显示点跟踪主要提升时序跟踪鲁棒性，box-snap主要提升边界紧致度。

Conclusion: 将时序跟踪与单帧边界精化解耦的LPT在遮挡、形变、高光条件下有效，点级状态表示与框贴合精化各自贡献互补优势。

Abstract: Reliable vocal-cord localization in emergency video laryngoscopy remains visually challenging due to rapid tissue deformation, specular highlights, and instrument occlusions. We propose Local Point Tracking (LPT), a robust framework that combines a single-frame detector, local point propagation, and stateless mask refinement. LPT follows a localize first, snap second pipeline. First, a single-frame semantic detector generates sparse anchors, within which LPT initializes local query points (SAM-supported by default, with a regular grid as fallback). A point-propagation module tracks these points through detector-missed frames and recovers temporal bounding boxes from their geometry. Second, because point-derived boxes can be loose around the visible boundary, a box-snap step refines the selected box to the target boundary. This decomposition keeps temporal state in local point coordinates rather than a stateful mask or whole-region representation, while the spatial refinement module handles single-frame boundary precision without feeding mask errors back into temporal memory. Extensive evaluations on two distinct datasets demonstrate that our proposed LPT method achieves strong overall performance against existing baselines, with the best mAP_50, success AUC, and missing rate on both datasets. Furthermore, ablation studies confirm that point tracking primarily enhances temporal tracking robustness, while box-snap refinement effectively improves boundary tightness.

</details>


### [90] [RuleForge: Inferring and Instantiating Latent Visual Rules as Executable Programs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38737)
*Weifeng Xu,Yaxiong Wang,Zhedong Zheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Bongard-Forge100k基准与RuleForge框架，联合学习视觉规则理解与规则条件下的可执行生成，显著提升多模态模型的规则理解与场景级规则满足率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究要么仅从视觉样例推断规则但只评测分类或语言化表达，要么以规则作为输入来监督可执行生成，导致"视觉规则理解"与"可靠规则实例化"之间的关系缺乏充分探索，缺乏可控的联合评测基准。

Method: 构建Bongard-Forge100k受控基准（共108,797题：86,000训练、19,297熟悉规则测试、3,500留出规则组合测试）；提出backbone-agnostic的RuleForge框架，分三阶段训练：规则理解训练→理解与场景程序联合监督→基于执行反馈的强化学习精调（含Understanding Replay）。通过多随机种子执行生成程序，获得可执行性、规则满足度、多样性与鲁棒性的可验证反馈。

Result: 以UniLIP为主干，熟悉规则多选题准确率提升20.93个百分点，留出规则组合提升28.42个百分点，场景级规则满足率由2.91%提升至70.99%；在InternVL3.5、Qwen3-VL、Show-o2上验证训练数据与框架的跨架构有效性。

Conclusion: 视觉规则理解与可执行规则实例化可以相互促进；联合训练配合执行驱动的强化学习能显著提升规则理解与生成可靠性，且方法具有主干无关的通用性。

Abstract: Visual rule reasoning asks whether multimodal models can recover an abstract concept from a few examples. Existing studies either infer rules from visual examples but evaluate only classification or verbalization, or supervise executable generation with rules provided as input. Consequently, the relationship between visual rule understanding and reliable rule instantiation remains insufficiently explored. We present Bongard-Forge100k, a controlled benchmark, together with RuleForge, a backbone-agnostic framework that jointly learns visual rule understanding and rule-conditioned executable generation. The benchmark contains 108,797 problems: 86,000 for training, 19,297 for testing familiar rules, and 3,500 for testing held-out rule compositions. The framework progresses through rule-understanding training, joint understanding and scene-program supervision, and refinement via execution-grounded reinforcement learning with Understanding Replay. Executing generated programs under multiple random seeds provides verifiable feedback on executability, rule satisfaction, diversity, and robustness. With UniLIP as the primary backbone, RuleForge improves multiple-choice accuracy over the base model by 20.93 percentage points on familiar rules and 28.42 percentage points on held-out rule compositions, while increasing scene-level rule satisfaction on familiar rules from 2.91% to 70.99%. Additional experiments on InternVL3.5, Qwen3-VL, and Show-o2 demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed training data and framework across diverse multimodal architectures.

</details>


### [91] [Cross-Primitive Consistency in Jev](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38623)
*Xu Liu,Guikun Chen,Kanzhi Wu,Wenguan Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出四轴跨原语一致性基准PrimaCons，系统评估Jev在语义等价查询原语下的决策不一致，并给出跨原语残差校准器CPRC以缓解该问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Jev通过类型化查询原语让LLM高效决策，同一语义状态可用二值或多选等不同格式表达；但跨原语决策一致性此前未被系统评估，语义等价表述下的输出是否稳定尚不清楚。

Method: 构建PrimaCons四轴基准，在保持查询语义不变的前提下考察跨原语一致性；在三种Jev规模上评测并分析不一致的模式及其与决策失败的关联（以ROC-AUC衡量预测力）；提出CPRC，在冻结主干上附加轻量残差网络，联合优化预测精度与跨原语一致性，并采用留一领域出协议评估。

Result: 四个轴上均观察到一致性违背；违背呈系统性模式，跨原语差异可用ROC-AUC 0.91预测决策失败；CPRC在留一领域出协议下使跨原语不一致降低58.57%、精度提升2.97%，域内与域外均有效。

Conclusion: 跨原语一致性应成为评估Jev的关键维度；CPRC为使决策可靠性提升提供了可行方案，并公开代码与基准。

Abstract: Jev enables efficient decision-making with large language models (LLMs) through typed querying primitives, allowing the same semantic state to be expressed in different formats, such as binary and multiple-choice queries. However, the consistency of decisions across primitives has not been systematically evaluated. This work introduces PrimaCons, a four-axis benchmark for assessing cross-primitive consistency while preserving the semantics of the query. Evaluations across three Jev sizes reveal consistency violations across all four axes. Our analysis shows that these violations follow systematic patterns and that cross-primitive discrepancies predict decision failure with a ROC-AUC of 0.91. To mitigate these inconsistencies, we propose the Cross-Primitive Residual Calibrator (CPRC), which attaches a lightweight residual network to a frozen backbone and jointly optimizes predictive accuracy and cross-primitive consistency. Under a leave-one-domain-out protocol, CPRC reduces cross-primitive inconsistency by 58.57% and improves accuracy by +2.97%., demonstrating its effectiveness in both in-domain and out-of-domain settings. Our findings establish cross-primitive consistency as a key dimension for evaluating Jev and provide a practical approach to improving the reliability of its decisions. Code and benchmark is available at https://github.com/67L1/PrimaCons-CRPR.

</details>


### [92] [Venus-DefakerOne2: A Vision-Forensics Foundation Model with Broader Coverage](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37918)
*Chenfan Qu,Yachao Liang,Mingqi Fang,Jiangwei Xie,Zhenming Wang,Baoyue Zhang,Changjiang Jiang,Zheng Chang,Fanli Jin,Xuekang Zhu,Kaiwen Feng,Junchi Li,Weihong Zhang,Haoyue Wang,Chenfeng Zhang,Yinan Xia,Fangming Cui,Dong Fan,Jingjing Liu,Tianyi Zhang,Luobin Chen,Ji-Zhe Zhou,Sheng Li,Wei Wang,Bin Li,Ran He,Xinpeng Zhang,Linna Zhou,Jian Liu,Weiqiang Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出统一反伪造基座模型 Venus-DefakerOne2，沿"伪造形式"与"媒体类型"两个维度扩展取证能力，在六类基准上取得SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实伪造具有异构性：既有数字篡改也有物理欺骗，既有图像也有视频。现有工作取得进展，但仍缺乏覆盖如此广泛威胁谱系的统一反伪造基座模型。

Method: 基于数千万开源与自建样本训练，采用两项关键设计：(1) Tide-Style-Tuning，交替使用 LoRA 与全参数微调，在计算效率、泛化性与难样本拟合之间取得平衡，并缓解灾难性遗忘；(2) 基于熵的测试自适应（Entropy-based Test Adaptation），通过分析预测熵确定最优预测模态。

Result: 在一整套综合基准上达到新的SOTA：DeepFake 人脸 96.7%、AI生成图像 93.3%、篡改文档 87.6%、操纵自然图像 89.6%、物理欺骗 93.1%、AI生成视频 96.0%；显著优于专用专家模型及前代 DefakerOne。

Conclusion: Venus-DefakerOne2 可作为面向二分类取证任务的强大且通用的基座模型。

Abstract: Real-world forgery is inherently heterogeneous: it manifests not only as digital manipulation but also as physical spoofing, and is carried not only by images but also by videos. Despite substantial progress, a unified anti-forgery foundation model covering such a broad threat spectrum remains absent. In this paper, we present Venus-DefakerOne2, which substantially extends the forensic capability boundary along both the forgery-form and media-type dimensions. Trained on tens of millions of open-source and in-house samples, it incorporates two key designs. Tide-Style-Tuning alternates LoRA and full-parameter fine-tuning to balance computational efficiency, generalization, and hard-sample fitting while mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Entropy-based Test Adaptation determines the optimal prediction modality by analyzing prediction entropy. Venus-DefakerOne2 achieves new state-of-the-art performance across a comprehensive suite of benchmarks, including DeepFake faces (96.7%), AI-generated images (93.3%), tampered documents (87.6%), manipulated natural images (89.6%), physical spoofs (93.1%), and AI-generated videos (96.0%). It significantly outperforms both specialized expert models and its predecessor, DefakerOne, establishing itself as a powerful and versatile foundation model for binary-decision forensic tasks.

</details>


### [93] [Where Can We Fool the Model's Mind? Response-Guided Semantic Probing and Adaptive Routing for Transferable Attacks on Black-Box MLLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38013)
*Ahmed Abdelnaby,Mohamed Elmahallawy*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出VISTA黑盒对抗攻击框架，从MLLM的应答（而非梯度）中识别语义脆弱区域，以熵自适应Sinkhorn路由与代理集成聚焦扰动，在GPT-5、Gemini-3.5-Flash、Claude Sonnet 4.6上最高达到97%攻击成功率且PSNR>30dB，纯迁移设置下无需查询目标模型即可达93% ASR。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态大模型对抗攻击依赖代理模型的显著性来分配扰动，但代理显著性未必反映未知MLLM的语义解释与区域依赖，导致迁移性受限。作者希望在不访问梯度、logits、参数或内部表征的严格黑盒条件下，直接利用应答层面的语义脆弱性来提升攻击有效性。

Method: VISTA框架构建基于不确定性的多模态行为（UBMB）图，综合应答漂移、冲突、误导与语义偏移来定位语义脆弱区域；随后采用熵自适应Sinkhorn路由与代理模型集成将扰动集中到这些区域。框架提供两种设置：VISTA-Proxy（纯迁移，仅探测开源模型后迁移至未见商业模型）与VISTA-Victim（查询辅助，探测目标模型以捕获模型特定脆弱性）。

Result: 在GPT-5、Gemini-3.5-Flash与Claude Sonnet 4.6上，VISTA最高实现97%的攻击成功率，同时维持PSNR高于30dB；VISTA-Proxy在完全不查询最终受害者的情况下仍达到最高93% ASR。

Conclusion: 由应答推导的语义脆弱性可作为跨异构MLLM迁移的有效信号，表明语义层面的脆弱区域定位比传统代理显著性更能提升黑盒攻击的迁移性与隐蔽性。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) ground language in visual evidence, yet their semantic reasoning can be exploited through transferable black-box adversarial attacks. Existing attacks typically allocate perturbations using surrogate-model saliency, which may not reflect how an unseen MLLM semantically interprets or relies on different image regions. We introduce VISTA (Vulnerability-Informed Semantic Transfer Attacks), a black-box framework that identifies semantically vulnerable visual regions from an MLLM's responses without access to gradients, logits, parameters, or internal representations. VISTA supports two attack settings: (i) VISTA-Proxy, a pure-transfer setting that probes an open-source MLLM and transfers the resulting adversarial examples to unseen commercial MLLMs without querying them; and (ii) VISTA-Victim, a query-assisted setting that probes the target MLLM to capture model-specific semantic vulnerabilities. VISTA builds an Uncertainty-Based Multimodal Behavior (UBMB) map from response drift, conflict, misleading, and semantic shifts, then uses entropy-adaptive Sinkhorn routing and a surrogate ensemble to focus perturbations on vulnerable regions. Across GPT-5, Gemini-3.5-Flash, and Claude Sonnet 4.6, VISTA achieves up to 97 % attack success rate (ASR) while maintaining a Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) above 30 dB. Notably, VISTA-Proxy achieves up to 93 % ASR without querying the final victim, demonstrating that response-derived semantic vulnerability can enable effective transfer across heterogeneous MLLMs.

</details>


### [94] [Meta-Initialization of Implicit Neural Representations to Accelerate Deformable Medical Image Registration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37965)
*Marat O. Zinovev,Dmitry V. Sorokin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究用元初始化加速INR可变形医学图像配准的早期适应，比较Reptile与STRAINER两种方案，在小迭代预算下均优于随机初始化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: INR配准方法需为每对新图像重新优化网络参数，适应速度慢是实际瓶颈；作者希望借助在历史配准任务上学习的初始化来加速早期适应。

Method: 以KAN-IDIR为基座INR位移场模型，比较两种初始化方案：Reptile元初始化与STRAINER迁移坐标网络的共享成分。在OASIS-1上实验，364个连续图像对用于训练，49对用于测试时适应；以平均Dice、HD95及第1500次迭代时负雅可比行列式体素比例评价配准质量。

Result: 在所研究配置下，两种方案在早期迭代的Dice均高于随机初始化、HD95更低；小迭代预算下Reptile数值上优于STRAINER，但二者预训练预算未对齐；随迭代增加方案间差异缩小。STRAINER预训练耗时39–40分钟，Reptile为44.98小时。

Conclusion: 学习式初始化可加速INR配准的早期适应；Reptile与STRAINER各有取舍，前者早期收敛更优但预训练代价极高，后者计算高效，且差距随迭代增多而收敛。

Abstract: Implicit neural representation (INR) methods for deformable medical image registration require the network parameters to be optimized for each new image pair, making adaptation speed a practical limitation. This work investigates whether early adaptation can be accelerated using an initialization learned from a collection of previously solved registration tasks. We examine two schemes: Reptile meta-initialization and STRAINER transfer of the shared component of a coordinate network. KAN-IDIR is used as the base INR displacement-field model. Experiments are conducted on OASIS-1, with 364 consecutive pairs used for training and 49 pairs for test-time adaptation. Registration quality is evaluated using mean Dice and HD95, together with the fraction of voxels with a negative Jacobian determinant at iteration 1500. In the configurations studied, both schemes yield higher Dice and lower HD95 at early iterations than random initialization. Reptile numerically outperforms STRAINER under a small iteration budget, although their pretraining budgets are not matched. As the number of iterations increases, the differences between the schemes shrink. STRAINER pretraining takes 39-40 minutes, compared with 44.98 hours for Reptile.

</details>


### [95] [LightGenBench: A Benchmark for 3D Emission Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39038)
*Dongchen Yang,Xingguang Yan,Manolis Savva*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出新任务"发光生成"(emission generation)：仅凭几何、非发光材质与一张渲染视图，预测3D资产表面的空间变化RGB发光；并发布LightGenBench基准，含37k艺术家制作的发光资产数据集、四类方法族基线与评估协议。稀疏体素方法TRELLIS.2-Emission表现最佳（IoU 0.271），但任务远未解决。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D生成方法虽能产出精细几何与丰富纹理，但生成的资产均为非发光体：只反射光而不发光。缺乏对"发光"这一材质属性的生成能力，且此前无相应数据集与评测标准，故需将其定义为可基准化的问题。

Method: 构建LightGenBench：(1) 数据集——37k件艺术家创作的发光资产，提供UV、体素、多视图三种表示；(2) 基线——覆盖四个方法族：UV域生成、稀疏体素生成、多视图生成、基于分割的生成；(3) 评估协议——度量"何处发光"与"如何发光"，并在不同发光强度渲染下辅以用户研究比较。

Result: 四类基线中，稀疏体素方法TRELLIS.2-Emission最优，因其在3D原生空间生成发光，规避了UV空间的碎裂伪影与多视图生成中不可见的遮挡发光体等失效模式；但其IoU仅达0.271，表明任务远未解决。用户研究提供了不同发光强度渲染下的主观比较作为补充。

Conclusion: 3D原生（稀疏体素）生成是发光生成任务的较优范式，但当前性能仍低（IoU 0.271），存在显著提升空间。作者希望LightGenBench将发光生成确立为3D生成领域中一个可基准化的研究问题。

Abstract: Recent generation methods produce 3D assets with detailed geometry and rich textures. However, these assets are non-emissive: they reflect light but emit none. We study a new task, emission generation: predicting spatially varying RGB emission over a 3D asset's surface from its geometry, non-emissive materials, and a rendered view.
  To support this task, we introduce LightGenBench. Our benchmark makes three contributions. First, we curate a dataset of 37k artist-authored emissive assets in UV, voxel, and multi-view form. Second, we establish baselines across four method families: UV-domain, sparse-voxel, multi-view, and segmentation-based generation. Third, we design an evaluation protocol that measures where an asset emits and how, complemented by user-study comparisons on renderings with varying emission strength.
  Across the four families, the sparse-voxel baseline TRELLIS.2-Emission performs best because generating emission natively in 3D avoids the failure modes of the other representations, such as the fracturing artifacts of UV space and the occluded emitters that multi-view generation cannot see. However, TRELLIS.2-Emission only reaches an IoU of 0.271, leaving the task far from solved. We hope LightGenBench establishes emission generation as a benchmarkable problem for 3D generation.

</details>


### [96] [MRC-MMAgent: Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Role Collaboration in Multimodal Tool-Using Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39324)
*Shengqin Wang,Jie Jin,Xiaofan Li,Wentao Yan,Yu Cheng,Qingsong HuYihang Chen,Weilin Luo,Jingyu Gong,Xin Tan,Yuan Xie,Zhizhong Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MRC-MMAgent多角色协同强化学习框架，将轨迹评估与续接内嵌进智能体执行循环，通过求解—检查—续接三角色与角色耦合的全轨迹优化目标，提升多模态工具智能体的自我纠错能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态工具智能体强化学习流水线多为单角色训练，仅以终端奖励驱动检索与作答，忽略了人类检索中检查证据、改写查询、修正结论的自我纠错过程，因而无法在完整交互轨迹上优化该过程。

Method: 构建融合求解、检查与续接的多角色协同循环：智能体调用工具获取证据后可评估前序轨迹，并在答案支撑不足时恢复作答；同时设计角色耦合学习目标，联合任务成功、交互有效性、成功纠错三类信号，对所有角色产生的决策进行全轨迹策略优化。

Result: 仅使用原始基线训练集、不额外构建数据，方法在各基准上稳定优于对应基座模型，并取得领先或极具竞争力的性能。

Conclusion: 将轨迹评估与续接显式纳入可执行智能体循环，并以多角色耦合奖励进行全轨迹优化，可有效训练多模态工具智能体的自我纠错过程，且无需额外数据即可获得泛化收益。

Abstract: Multimodal tool-using agents augment vision-language models with access to external information and capabilities, enabling them to solve knowledge-intensive and visually complex tasks that cannot be addressed using visual context alone. However, existing reinforcement learning pipelines largely train single-role agents to search and answer using terminal rewards, overlooking how humans inspect retrieved evidence, reformulate queries, and revise conclusions during search. Consequently, they fail to optimize this self-corrective process over complete interaction trajectories. We propose MRC-MMAgent, a multi-role collaborative reinforcement learning framework that incorporates trajectory assessment and continuation directly into the executable agent loop. First, the framework establishes a multi-role collaborative loop that integrates solving, inspection, and continuation, enabling the agent to acquire evidence through tools, evaluate the preceding trajectory, and resume problem solving when the current answer is insufficiently supported. Second, we introduce a role-coupled learning objective that combines task success, interaction validity, and successful correction with full-trajectory policy optimization across the decisions generated by all roles. Extensive experiments show that, using only the original baseline training set without constructing additional datasets, our method consistently outperforms the corresponding base models and achieves leading or highly competitive performance across benchmarks.

</details>


### [97] [CAD-WAM: Anticipating Geometry for Text-to-CAD Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39306)
*Zhengyang Li,Weijie Zheng,Yuxin Cui,Sijie Wang,Wenjie Feng,Qiyu Kang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CAD-WAM，将CAD建模操作视为动作，结合几何条件动作生成与下一状态预测，从文本生成可编辑CAD模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的方法仅学习预测命令，缺乏对命令应产生的几何状态的显式监督，单步操作错误会累积影响后续步骤，导致多步生成不可靠。

Method: 受world-action model启发，将完整建模操作定义为CAD DSL中的动作；用预训练VAE将中间实体的表面点云编码为紧凑隐状态；LLM主干根据目标描述与当前几何状态生成下一动作，同一主干上的辅助头预测下一状态以提供几何监督；从DeepCAD参数化模型构建逐步轨迹并配以专家级文本描述；推理时由CAD kernel执行生成动作并将结果重编码反馈。

Result: 在DeepCAD测试集上，几何精度与输出有效性优于任务特定基线，在需要更多操作的模型上增益更大；几何精度优于以相同DSL提示的通用LLM；消融显示下一状态监督相较仅预测动作的相同模型将平均Chamfer距离降低13.2%。

Conclusion: 将下一状态预测作为几何监督信号可有效提升多步CAD生成的可靠性与几何精度，验证了world-action范式在文本到CAD任务中的价值。

Abstract: Generating editable computer-aided design (CAD) models from text requires selecting operations that produce the intended changes to the geometry constructed so far. An incorrect operation can compromise subsequent steps, making reliable multi-step generation challenging. Existing methods based on large language models (LLMs) primarily learn to predict commands, without explicit supervision of the geometric states those commands should produce. Inspired by world-action models, we introduce CAD-WAM, which couples geometry-conditioned action generation with next-state prediction. We define complete modeling operations as actions in a CAD domain-specific language (DSL) and encode surface point clouds of intermediate solids into compact latent states using a pretrained variational autoencoder. An LLM backbone generates the next action from the target description and current geometric state, while an auxiliary head on the same backbone predicts the next state to provide geometric supervision during training. We construct step-wise training trajectories from parametric CAD models in the DeepCAD dataset, pairing each trajectory with an expert-level textual description. At inference, each generated action is executed by a CAD kernel, and the resulting solid is re-encoded to inform the next decision. On the DeepCAD test set, CAD-WAM outperforms the task-specific baselines in geometric accuracy and output validity, with larger gains on models requiring more operations, and produces more accurate geometry than general-purpose LLMs prompted with the same DSL. Ablations further show that next-state supervision reduces mean Chamfer distance by 13.2\% relative to an otherwise identical model trained only to predict actions. Code is available at https://github.com/Lzy-1037/CAD-WAM.

</details>


### [98] [Unlocking Any-Order Generation in Pretrained Autoregressive Image Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39293)
*Rishav Pramanik,Marco Pedersoli,Zhaozheng Yin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种低成本后训练配方，将预训练的栅格扫描自回归图像生成器转化为任意顺序生成器，无需从零训练即可解锁图像修补、外扩与编辑能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准AR图像生成器以固定栅格扫描顺序训练，将图像分布硬编码为单一因子分解，推理时无法支持inpaint、outpaint或编辑。现有方案（如离散扩散、按token顺序混合从零训练）需约3倍算力，且离散扩散牺牲了与KV缓存、vLLM等AR推理生态的兼容性。作者认为该代价不必要：预训练模型已学到联合分布，缺的只是通过非顺序条件路径表达该知识的能力。

Method: 两组件适配配方：(1) future-aware positional embeddings，以极小开销解决目标位置可识别性问题；(2) ordering curriculum，从预训练解出发引导稳定优化至良好的任意顺序解盆地。在LlamaGen-L/XL、RAR-L/XL四个基模型（两种架构、两种规模）上验证。

Result: ImageNet修补FID 6.21显著优于MaskGIT的10.44，外扩同样占优；与MAR-L相当；为换取灵活性付出1.2-1.9的类条件FID增幅；额外算力仅为预训练的13-33%，且不改动标准AR推理栈。

Conclusion: 修补、外扩与编辑能力无需在AR图像模型上另行添加，而可从已有预训练模型中被"解锁"；适配成本远低于从零训练，并保持AR推理生态兼容。

Abstract: Autoregressive (AR) image generators are powerful in principle but inflexible in practice: training with a fixed raster-scan order hardcodes a single factorization of the image distribution into the model, leaving it unable to inpaint, outpaint, or edit at inference time. Existing solutions, including the modern discrete-diffusion family, train from scratch on a mixture of token orderings, paying roughly 3x the compute of standard raster-scan training; discrete diffusion further sacrifices compatibility with the AR inference ecosystem (KV caching, vLLM) by construction. We argue that this cost is unnecessary. A pretrained raster-scan AR model has already learned the joint distribution over image tokens; what it lacks is not knowledge but the ability to express that knowledge through non-sequential conditional pathways. We propose a recipe for adapting pretrained raster-scan models into any-order generators using two components: future-aware positional embeddings that resolve a target-position identifiability problem at negligible overhead, and an ordering curriculum that traces a stable optimization path from the pretrained solution to a good any-order basin. Applied to four base models across two architectures and two scales (LlamaGen-L/XL, RAR-L/XL), the recipe substantially outperforms MaskGIT on ImageNet inpainting (FID 6.21 vs. 10.44) and outpainting, is competitive with MAR-L, trades a 1.2-1.9 increase in class-conditional FID for this flexibility, and costs 13-33% additional compute beyond pretraining, while leaving the standard AR inference stack untouched. Inpainting, outpainting, and editing, our results suggest, need not be added to autoregressive image models. They can be unlocked from the ones that exist. Code is available at https://github.com/Ordered-AR/unlockedadaptation.

</details>


### [99] [PriorMaskMap: Robust Online Vectorized Map Construction with Biased Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39283)
*Haoming Xu,Wei Li,Yu Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PriorMaskMap，一种鲁棒的先验引导矢量化地图构建框架，通过置信度评估先验可靠性并据此引导查询初始化与BEV特征融合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线矢量化地图构建需实时语义与几何理解，引入先验地图可提升精度，但先验常因信息过时或临时道路变化而存在偏差；现有方法将先验视为完全可靠或仅考虑有限噪声模式，在先验不完美时性能严重下降。

Method: 1) Prior-Aware Confidence Estimator (PACE)：将输入栅格化地图与当前视觉观测比对，对可靠、错误、空白区域分配置信度分数，生成基础掩码指导两个分支；2) Dual-Prior Query Generator (DPQG)：选择性过滤并嵌入栅格化与矢量化先验，从可信地图结构初始化信息丰富的查询；3) Confidence-Guided Prior Fusion (CGPF)：对掩码进行空间传播与细化，用细化后的掩码控制BEV特征与先验地图的融合，为地图解码器提供丰富上下文表示。

Result: 在nuScenes数据集上，PriorMaskMap的建图精度优于现有方法，且在先验存在明显错误时表现出显著鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 通过显式评估先验置信度并分级利用先验信息，可有效缓解不完美先验带来的负面影响，实现更精确且鲁棒的先验引导矢量化地图构建。

Abstract: Online vectorized map construction provides autonomous vehicles with essential, real-time semantic and geometric scene understanding. While leveraging prior maps presents an opportunity to improve accuracy, they are often biased due to outdated information or temporary road changes. Existing methods, which typically treat priors as fully reliable or only consider limited noise patterns, suffer severe performance degradation when these priors are imperfect. To address this, we propose PriorMaskMap, a robust framework for prior-guided vectorized map construction. Its first innovation is a Prior-Aware Confidence Estimator (PACE) that evaluates the input rasterized map against current visual observations. It assigns confidence scores to regions classified as reliable, erroneous, or blank, creating a foundational mask that guides two subsequent branches. In one branch, the Dual-Prior Query Generator (DPQG) selectively filters and embeds both rasterized and vectorized priors to initialize informative queries from trustworthy map structures. In the other, the Confidence-Guided Prior Fusion (CGPF) module spatially propagates and refines the mask, using the refined version to govern the fusion of BEV features with the prior map, thereby providing rich contextual representations for the map decoder. Evaluation on the nuScenes dataset shows that PriorMaskMap achieves superior mapping precision over existing approaches and exhibits marked robustness when provided with priors containing apparent errors. Our code is released at https://github.com/healenrens/PriorMaskMap.

</details>


### [100] [Aligning Misaligned Benchmarks for Single-View Novel View Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38349)
*Yang-Che Tseng,Erqun Dong,Jeong-gi Kwak,Gopal Sharma,Shakiba Kheradmand,Stephan Garbin,Hossam Isack,Kwang Moo Yi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文指出单视图新视角合成（NVS）评测缺乏标准化，核心问题在于各方法自身参考系与"真值位姿"的对齐方式；作者提出用传统2D-to-2D与2D-to-3D图像匹配来对齐3D重建，并仅在视图间共视区域评测。结果显示，坐标对齐正确后，显式3D高斯方法达到SOTA；同时给出一个直接调用现成视频生成器与前馈几何估计器的简单基线，无需任务特定训练即可与专用方法相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有单视图NVS评测未标准化。多数方法通过测试时优化目标位姿来实现参考系对齐，但相机位姿与渲染精度构成的优化景观复杂，该问题本质上是病态的（ill-posed），导致方法被在任意局部最优处评估；部分工作改用训练+测试视图做全场景3D重建来对齐位姿，但可能不可行。因此需要一个可行且可定义"正确"真值的评测协议。

Method: 1）用传统2D-to-2D与2D-to-3D图像匹配技术对齐3D重建，从而确定方法参考系与真值位姿的坐标变换；2）评测仅在视图间共视（co-visible）区域内进行，因为这是"正确"真值唯一可定义之处。

Result: 在恰当坐标对齐与共视区域评测下，使用显式3D高斯的新视角合成方法取得SOTA，与此前文献中"被纯图像2D方法超越"的结论相反；此外，直接利用现成视频生成器与馈前几何估计器的简单基线，在无任何任务特定训练下已与专门训练的SOTA方法相当。

Conclusion: NVS性能量化高度依赖参考系对齐与评测区域定义，此前部分排序结论源于评测协议缺陷；应采用基于图像匹配的3D重对齐与共视区域评测，以建立标准化、可复现的评测范式。

Abstract: While single-view novel view synthesis methods have been dramatically enhanced recently, how to quantify their performance has yet to be standardized. In this work, we demonstrate that an important factor lies in how each method's own reference frame is aligned with the so-called ground-truth pose. Existing methods often rely on test-time optimization of target poses for this alignment, which inherently is ill-posed due to the complexity of the optimization landscape of camera poses vs render accuracy, leading to methods being evaluated at an arbitrary local optimum. Some recognize this limitation and thus rely on 3D reconstructions of entire scenes using training and test views to align poses, which may be infeasible. In this work, instead, we propose to use traditional 2D-to-2D and 2D-to-3D image matching techniques to align 3D reconstructions. We also evaluate only within co-visible regions, between different views, which is the only place where a `correct' ground truth can be defined. Our evaluations show that with proper coordinate alignment, novel-view synthesis methods that use explicit 3D Gaussians achieve the state of the art, despite being previously reported in the literature to be outperformed by pure image-based 2D methods. We further provide a simple baseline that directly utilizes an off-the-shelf video generator and a feed-forward geometry estimator. Our simple baseline is already comparable to state-of-the-art methods specifically trained for novel-view synthesis, without any task-specific training.

</details>


### [101] [Wizard: Manipulate Any World in Real Time via Agentic Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40339)
*Yuzhe Wu,Zijun Lin,Yeying Jin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Wizard，一个agentic游戏世界模型，通过骨架/几何结构化代理条件化视频生成、自适应掩码对齐与显式游戏状态维护，实现实时、精确的角色动作控制，并零样本泛化到新场景、角色与动作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频世界模型与agentic框架虽可定制化游戏生成，但仅支持简单游戏设定与预定义动作模式，对未见环境与角色泛化差，实时交互性有限。作者希望实现玩家可自由配置虚拟世界、细粒度操控角色动作，同时保持实时性、视觉质量与玩法一致性。

Method: (1) 构建覆盖750个场景、178个角色的多样化数据集，引入骨架与几何信息作为结构化表示；(2) 将这些表示作为中间代理对视频生成模型进行条件化；(3) 设计自适应掩码机制，提升条件信号与生成视频rollout的对齐；(4) 构建agentic框架，显式维护并更新游戏状态，将agentic控制与结构化代理生成相结合。

Result: 实现对新场景、新角色、新动作的零样本泛化；支持实时、精确的角色动作控制；在玩家自由配置虚拟世界的前提下保持视觉质量与玩法（机制）一致性。

Conclusion: 将agentic控制与结构化代理（骨架/几何）驱动的视频生成相结合，可解锁玩家驱动的游戏创作新范式，实现实时、可泛化且机制一致的世界模拟。

Abstract: Recent advances in video world models have enabled the generation of increasingly realistic and interactive virtual environments, opening new possibilities for player-customizable gameplay. Agentic frameworks further advance this direction by decoupling explicit game logic and controllable world representations from visual generation. However, existing approaches support only simple game settings and predefined motion patterns, generalize poorly to unseen environments and characters, and offer limited real-time interactivity. In this paper, we introduce Wizard, an agentic game world model that enables real-time, precise control over character motions while generalizing zero-shot across novel scenes, characters, and actions. To achieve this, we construct a diverse dataset spanning 750 scenes and 178 characters, incorporating skeleton and geometry information as structured representations. We leverage these representations as intermediate proxies to condition a video generation model, together with an adaptive masking mechanism that improves alignment between the conditioning signals and generated video rollouts. Furthermore, we introduce an agentic framework that explicitly maintains and updates game states, allowing players to freely configure their virtual worlds and exercise fine-grained control over character motions while preserving visual quality and gameplay consistency. By combining agentic control with structured proxy-based generation, our framework unlocks new possibilities for player-driven game creation with real-time, generalizable, and mechanically consistent world simulation.

</details>


### [102] [Uncertainty-aware Coarse-to-Fine Main Pancreatic Duct Segmentation for Width Measurement in 3D MRCP](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40073)
*Zipei Zhang,Jaakko Sahlsten,Mikko Saukkoriipi,Johanna Ronkainen,Mona Lehto,Akseli Aittoniemi,Irina Rinta-Kiikka,Kimmo Kaski*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种自动且具不确定性感知的深度学习流程，用于MRCP图像中主胰管(MPD)的分割与最大宽度分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MPD评估对胰管扩张诊断和胰腺癌分析至关重要，但人工评估存在阅片者间差异，而全自动且不确定性感知的MPD分析研究尚不充分。

Method: 采用两阶段级联架构：粗定位模型先确定胰管感兴趣区域，再由精细模型在该区域内分割MPD；使用69名患者共256例已标注MRCP扫描（其中14名患者55例作为随机留出测试集），并采用五模型交叉验证集成以提升性能并估计不确定性。

Result: 最佳分割性能为DSC 0.634、精确率0.744、召回率0.593；最大MPD宽度预测平均绝对误差为0.355 mm；扩张MPD(≥5 mm)检测灵敏度75.0%、特异度74.4%。

Conclusion: 结果表明自动化MPD分割可辅助基于MRCP的胰管测量。

Abstract: Assessment of the main pancreatic duct (MPD) from volumetric magnetic resonance cholangiopancreatography (MRCP) scans is an essential task for ductal dilatation diagnosis and pancreatic cancer analysis. However, manual assessment is affected by reader variability in which automated analysis may assist. Nevertheless, fully automated and uncertainty-aware MPD analysis from volumetric MRCP remains underexplored area of research. In this study, we propose an automatic and uncertainty-aware deep learning-based pipeline for MPD segmentation and maximum-width analysis from MRCP scans. A coarse localisation model first identifies the ductal region-of-interest, followed by a fine model that segments the MPD within the region. The dataset consists of 256 MPD-segmented MRCP scans from 69 patients. A randomly selected holdout test subset of 14 patients with 55 MRCP volumes was used for evaluation. We employed a five-model cross-validation ensemble for improved performance and uncertainty estimation. The best MPD segmentation performance was 0.634 DSC, 0.744 precision, and 0.593 recall. The mean absolute error for maximum MPD width prediction was 0.355~mm and dilated MPD ($\geq 5$~mm) was detected with 75.0\% sensitivity and 74.4\% specificity. These novel results suggest that automated MPD segmentation can be used to aid MRCP-based duct measurements.

</details>


### [103] [BRACHIO: Broad Representations Across Centres for Head-and-neck Imaging Oncology (HECKTOR 2026)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40068)
*Roxanne De Maeyer,Ine Dirks,Yannick Brackenier,Simon DeKeyser,Jef Vandemeulebroucke,Vicky De Ridder*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 团队 nucli 参加 HECKTOR 2026 挑战赛，针对头颈癌的肿瘤分割、TN 分期与无复发生存预测三项任务，采用自监督预训练编码器与集成/多模态融合策略；分割 Dice 0.5409，T/N 分期平衡准确率 0.3962/0.6432，RFS 测试 C-index 0.6577（加权总分 0.5802），预后表现接近上届最佳，但分割偏弱并制约了分期结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: HECKTOR 2026 的三项任务分别依赖多中心 PET/CT 的稠密（体素级）与全局（病例级）信息，单一架构难以兼顾；作者希望借助自监督预训练编码器统一处理分割与全局特征提取，并复用分割几何特征服务分期与预后。

Method: ①自监督：在 HECKTOR 2026 PET 扫描上训练 2D DINOv2 编码器（PET-DINOv2-MIPs）。②分割：测试集集成 DynUNet（从头训练）与 SwinUNETR（Swin trunk 由 SimMIM 预训练权重初始化）。③TN 分期：以分割掩膜提取 GTVp/GTVn 几何特征经逻辑回归得分期概率，与 PET-DINOv2-MIPs 深度特征（PCA+LR）由二级 LR 融合。④RFS：微调 PET-DINOv2-MIPs ViT-S 最后两个 block 与 MLP 头，CoxPH 损失，临床协变量与影像特征拼接。

Result: 分割平均 Dice 0.5409；TN 分期平衡准确率 T-stage 0.3962、N-stage 0.6432；RFS 测试 Harrell C-index 0.6577，加权挑战分数 0.5802。预后结果与上届最佳参赛相当，且与内部交叉验证一致。

Conclusion: 自监督预训练编码器在多中心 PET/CT 的全局任务（预后）上表现稳健，可媲美上届最佳；但分割性能明显低于上届水平，并因分期依赖分割掩膜而拖累 TN 分期结果，分割模块是该方案的主要瓶颈。

Abstract: The HECKTOR 2026 challenge benchmarks machine learning for head and neck cancer, where teams delineate primary and nodal tumour volumes, perform TN staging, and predict recurrence-free survival (RFS). This report describes the submissions for the HECKTOR challenge of team nucli. As the three tasks span both dense and global information from multicentric PET/CT scans, we utilise self-supervised pre-trained encoders, training a 2D DINOv2 encoder (PET-DINOv2-MIPs) on HECKTOR 2026's PET scans. Our final test submission ensembles a DynUNet trained from scratch with a SwinUNETR whose Swin trunk was initialised from a SimMIM-pre-trained checkpoint for segmentation, reaching a mean Dice of 0.5409. For TN staging, GTVp/GTVn geometric features from the segmentation masks are fit to stage probabilities by logistic regression (LR) and fused with PET-DINOv2-MIPs deep features (PCA + LR) via a second-level LR, reaching balanced accuracies of 0.3962 (T-stage) and 0.6432 (N-stage). For the RFS prognosis task, we fine-tune the last two blocks of the PET-DINOv2-MIPs ViT-S encoder jointly with an MLP head under a CoxPH loss, concatenating clinical covariates with the imaging features, reaching a test Harrell's C-index of 0.6577 and a weighted challenge score of 0.5802. The prognosis result is comparable to the best entry of the previous edition and consistent with our internal cross-validation, while our segmentation result is well below it and limits the staging results that depend on it.

</details>


### [104] [EPC-RawDC: Equivariant Physics Constrained 3D Diffusion with Raw Data Consistency for CBCT to CT Image Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40046)
*Alzahra Altalib,Chunhui Li,Alessandro Perelli*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出EPC-RawDC，一种条件3D潜扩散框架，将体素生成建模与源于扫描器特定CBCT前向模型的两种互补物理约束结合，实现定量CBCT到CT合成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CBCT广泛用于图像引导与自适应放疗，但散射、噪声、重建伪影及HU不准确限制了其定量应用。现有基于扩散的CBCT-to-CT合成方法多为纯图像驱动，对采集物理的利用有限。

Method: 条件3D潜扩散框架，引入两项源自同一扫描器特定CBCT前向模型的约束：(1) 几何等变投影约束，利用CBCT前向算子的旋转等变性，通过相应变换后的参考投影监督合成CT；(2) 原始数据一致性，将单次采集的含噪投影测量作为扫描特定监督用于训练。

Result: 在两个独立临床队列（不同扫描器几何与投影来源）评估。JUST使用Elekta系统实测临床原始投影；SynthRAD2025使用Varian几何并按泊松光子统计由参考CT仿真投影。EPC-RawDC在两队列SSIM均达0.97；相对DDPM，PSNR在SynthRAD2025提升2.66 dB、JUST提升2.10 dB，平均MAE分别降低20.3%与19.0%；SynthRAD2025上投影一致性与等变误差相对DDPM分别降低55.0%与41.4%。

Conclusion: 将体素扩散先验与扫描器几何及扫描特定投影测量相结合，可在仿真与实测投影域上同时改善定量CBCT-to-CT合成；代码将公开。

Abstract: Cone beam computed tomography (CBCT) is widely used for image guided and adaptive radiotherapy, but scatter, noise, reconstruction artifacts, and inaccurate Hounsfield units limit its quantitative use. Recent diffusion approaches for CBCT to CT synthesis remain largely image driven, with limited use of the underlying acquisition physics. We propose EPC-RawDC, a conditional 3D latent diffusion framework that combines volumetric generative modeling with two complementary constraints derived from the same scanner specific CBCT forward model. First, geometry equivariant projection constraint exploits the rotational equivariance of the CBCT forward operator by supervising the synthesized CT through correspondingly transformed reference projections. Second, raw data consistency uses noisy projection measurements of the individual acquisition as scan specific supervision during training. The framework was evaluated on two independent clinical cohorts with distinct scanner geometries and projection sources. For JUST, the physics constraints used measured clinical raw CBCT projections acquired with an Elekta system, whereas for SynthRAD2025 the projection data were simulated from the reference CT using a Varian geometry with Poisson photon statistics. EPC-RawDC achieved an SSIM of 0.97 in both cohorts and improved PSNR over DDPM by 2.66 dB on SynthRAD2025 and 2.10 dB on JUST, while reducing mean MAE by 20.3% and 19.0%, respectively. On SynthRAD2025, projection consistency and equivariant errors were reduced by 55.0% and 41.4% relative to DDPM. These results demonstrate that combining a volumetric diffusion prior with scanner geometry and scan specific projection measurements improves quantitative CBCT to CT synthesis across both simulated and measured projection domains. Code available after publication at https://github.com/ALZAHRAALTALIB/EPC-RawDC.

</details>


### [105] [Difficulty Calibration Across Time for Membership Inference in Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40616)
*Michael Joseph,Yedid Hoshen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出沿“训练时间”与“扩散时间”两个维度进行难度校准的扩散模型成员推理方法：RMC利用早期检查点对比隔离新记忆数据，TSC仅用单一模型比较目标时间步与邻近时间步损失，二者大幅超越SOTA且可跨x-/v-/ε-参数化泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代扩散模型在海量含版权或私密图像的数据上训练，成员推理攻击（MIA）用于判断某图像是否在训练集中。标准做法以重建损失打分、将低损失判为成员，但图像本身的重建难易程度不同，简单未见图可能比复杂训练图损失更低，导致误判。因此需要把“记忆”与“图像固有难度”分离。

Method: 沿两条时间轴做难度校准：(1) 训练时间维度提出Reference-Model Calibration (RMC)，将微调模型的损失与更早检查点对比，干净地隔离新记忆的数据，且在无文本描述时仍近乎完美的审计效果；(2) 因早期检查点不总可得，提出Temporal Self-Calibration (TSC)，仅用单一模型在扩散时间上校准。核心观察是图像难度跨噪声水平持续存在，而记忆是局部存在于时间上的；通过将目标时间步的损失与同一模型邻近时间步的损失比较，用模型自身轨迹衰减图像难度。

Result: 实验中方法以较大优势击败现有SOTA；与多数现有攻击不同，可泛化到不同模型参数化形式，如 x-、v-、ε-预测模型。代码已开源。

Conclusion: 难度校准是提升扩散模型成员推理可靠性的关键：RMC在可获取检查点时提供近乎完美的审计能力，TSC在仅有单一模型时仍具强性能，且具备跨参数化的通用性。

Abstract: Modern diffusion models are trained on massive datasets that often include copyrighted or private images. Membership inference attacks (MIAs) address this by testing whether a given image was in a model's training set. The standard approach scores an image by its reconstruction loss and flags low-loss images as members. This often fails because some images are simply easier to reconstruct than others, so a simple unseen image can score a lower loss than a complex training image. Difficulty calibration separates memorization from how difficult an image is to begin with. We show how to calibrate along two axes of time: training time and diffusion time. First, across training time, we introduce Reference-Model Calibration (RMC), which compares a fine-tuned model's loss against an earlier checkpoint. This cleanly isolates newly memorized data and gives near-perfect auditing, even without text captions. Since earlier checkpoints are not always available, we next present Temporal Self-Calibration (TSC), which calibrates across diffusion time using only a single model. Our key observation is that an image's difficulty persists across noise levels, whereas memorization is localized in time. By comparing the loss at a target timestep against neighboring timesteps from the same model, TSC attenuates image difficulty using the model's own trajectory. Empirically, our methods beat the state of the art by a wide margin, and unlike most existing attacks, generalize across different model parameterizations such as $x$-, $v$-, and $ε$-prediction models. Code is available at https://github.com/MichaelJoseph777/TSC.

</details>


### [106] [L3G-World: Real-Time Infinite World Generation with Latent 3D Gaussian Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40614)
*Jinhyeok Choi,JoungBin Lee,Jongmin Lee,Minkyeong Jeon,Jiyoung Kim,Kaeun Han,Yoonjin Yoon,Seungryong Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出潜空间3D高斯记忆(L3G)，与视频DiT自回归交替生成，实现实时、长时程空间一致的交互式世界模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互式世界模型需在长时程探索中保持空间一致且实时生成；现有方法依赖时序上下文或显式3D记忆，前者内存随流长度增长，后者需重编码RGB渲染，二者均难以扩展且阻碍实时性。

Method: 构建Latent 3D Gaussian Memory：每个高斯存储VAE潜特征并可直接渲染进DiT潜空间，免去VAE重编码；记忆更新器在新观测区域生成高斯并精炼已有高斯，使记忆随场景范围而非流长度增长；更新器与视频扩散Transformer自回归交替生成。

Result: 达到SOTA生成质量与长时程空间一致性；相比最优3D记忆基线，3D基元最多少38.6×，记忆更新快3.2×，记忆渲染快359×，实现9 FPS实时世界生成。

Conclusion: 以潜空间3D高斯作为紧凑可渲染记忆，解耦记忆规模与视频长度，兼顾实时性与长时程一致性，为交互式世界生成提供可扩展范式。

Abstract: Interactive world models generate visual content conditioned on user actions, yet maintaining spatial consistency over long-horizon exploration in real time remains challenging. Existing approaches rely on either temporal context or explicit 3D memory, both of which scale poorly because memory grows with the length of the generated stream. Moreover, explicit 3D memories condition latent video generators by re-encoding RGB renderings, which precludes real-time generation. In this paper, we introduce a Latent 3D Gaussian Memory (L3G) that combines the efficiency of feed-forward reconstruction with a compact, rapidly renderable scene representation. Building on this memory, we propose L3G-World, in which a memory updater and a video diffusion transformer (DiT) alternate autoregressively to generate spatially consistent worlds. The memory updater spawns Gaussians in newly observed regions and refines existing ones, so that the memory grows with scene extent rather than stream length. Each Gaussian further stores a VAE latent feature, allowing the memory to be rendered directly into the DiT's latent space without VAE re-encoding. Experiments show that L3G-World achieves state-of-the-art generation quality and long-horizon spatial consistency, with up to $38.6\times$ fewer 3D primitives, $3.2\times$ faster memory updates, and $359\times$ faster memory rendering relative to the most efficient prior 3D-memory baseline for each metric, enabling real-time world generation at 9 FPS.

</details>


### [107] [InfantNet: A Large Scale Dataset for Infant Body Pose and Shape Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40467)
*Zhipeng Hui,Jiahao Wang,Xun Dong,Guofeng Zhang,Xingrui Wang,Jiawei Peng,Qihao Liu,Xiaoding Yuan,Yi Zhang,Junjie Oscar Yin,Wufei Ma,Qinfan Lyu,Sara N. Lupolt,Keeve Edward Nachman,Adam Kortylewski,Alan Yuille*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出InfantNet——目前最大的真实婴儿图像数据集（108,902张6-18月龄RGB图像，其中11,642张含SMIL参数级3D姿态与形状标注），并建立婴儿2D关键点检测与3D姿态形状恢复基准，证明成人模型迁移性差而微调后显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 婴儿姿态与形状估计在育儿、发育监测与医学诊断中至关重要，但现有方法与数据集主要面向成人；由于婴儿在身体比例、关节活动范围及频繁自遮挡等方面差异巨大，直接将成人模型迁移到婴儿会失效，因此缺乏大规模、高质量的真实婴儿数据与基准。

Method: 构建InfantNet数据集：108,902张6-18月龄婴儿RGB图像，全部标注2D关键点，11,642张子集额外标注完整SMIL参数的3D姿态与形状，并经多视角渲染与重投影误差过滤校验；采用迭代式标注流程保证2D/3D标签高保真度；以此建立2D关键点检测与3D姿态形状恢复的基准，并进行基线实验（成人SOTA模型直接测试 vs. 在InfantNet上微调）。

Result: 基线实验表明，现有SOTA成人姿态估计器对婴儿泛化性差；在InfantNet上微调后性能一致提升；3D姿态与形状估计提升更显著，基于SMIL的估计表现稳健，精度与SMPL类模型已报道结果相当。

Conclusion: InfantNet提供了一个大规模、全面的婴儿姿态分析基准与数据资源，可推动婴儿姿态估计及相关健康应用研究；同时表明面向婴儿的专用数据与模型适配是必要的。

Abstract: Infant pose and shape estimation is essential for applications in childcare, developmental monitoring, and medical diagnosis. However, existing methods and datasets are largely designed for adults, and direct transfer to infants fails due to substantial differences in body proportions, articulation limits, and frequent self-occlusion.
