To address this gap, we introduce InfantNet, the largest real-image infant dataset to date, comprising 108,902 RGB images of infants aged 6-18 months. Each image is annotated with 2D keypoints, and a curated subset of 11,642 images additionally includes 3D pose and shape annotations with full SMIL parameters, verified through multi-view rendering and reprojection-error filtering. We use an iterative annotation pipeline to ensure high fidelity across both 2D and 3D labels. InfantNet establishes a large-scale, comprehensive benchmark for infant 2D keypoint detection and 3D pose-and-shape recovery. Baseline experiments demonstrate that state-of-the-art adult pose estimators do not generalize well to infants, whereas fine-tuning on InfantNet yields a consistent improvement. The gains are even more pronounced for 3D pose and shape estimation, where SMIL-based estimation demonstrates robust performance with accuracy comparable to results reported for SMPL-based models. By releasing the InfantNet dataset and benchmark, we provide a vital resource for advancing infant pose analysis and related healthcare applications.

</details>


### [108] [A Unified Benchmark for Aerial-Enhanced Autonomous Driving: The KITScenes Aerial Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40455)
*Daniel Lengerer,Richard Schwarzkopf,Jonas Merkert,Fabian Immel,Rupert Polley,Frank Bieder,Jan-Hendrik Pauls,J. Marius Zöllner,Klaus Bogenberger,Christoph Stiller,Carsten Markgraf*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 KITScenes Aerial 数据集，将航拍影像与车载同步传感器数据、位姿及 Lanelet2 标注在空间上关联，统一支撑建图、航拍辅助在线 HD 建图与跨视角定位研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 航拍影像可提供超出车载传感器感知范围的道路结构信息，但地图构建、航拍辅助在线 HD 建图与跨视角定位长期在各自独立的数据与基准上研究，缺乏统一的评测基础。

Method: 在 KITScenes Multimodal 基础上扩展：将同步车载传感器数据、车辆位姿与丰富的 Lanelet2 地图标注与航拍影像进行空间关联，并提供更高分辨率的神经表示。建图评测覆盖全部 53 类地图类别，考察不同模型设计、空间范围与航拍分辨率，同时兼容常用的三类设置。

Result: 在更大建图范围下，航拍上下文使 53 类 mAP 提升一倍以上；更高分辨率航拍影像再带来 4.3 mAP（+24%）提升，收益延伸至红绿灯等困难要素。在地理完全不相交条件下进行跨视角定位评测，适配的细粒度特征匹配基线取得 5.13 m 平均平移误差。

Conclusion: KITScenes Aerial 为航拍与地面信息的统一研究提供了共同基础，支撑互补的建图与定位任务，并显示航拍上下文对细粒度、远距离建图尤为有利。

Abstract: Aerial imagery provides complementary spatial context for autonomous driving by exposing road structure beyond the immediate perception range of onboard sensors. Yet map construction from aerial imagery, aerial-assisted online HD mapping, and cross-view localization are typically studied on separate data and benchmarks. We introduce KITScenes Aerial, an extension of the KITScenes Multimodal dataset that augments synchronized onboard sensor data, vehicle poses, and rich Lanelet2 map annotations with spatially associated aerial imagery and higher-resolution neural representations, providing a common basis for a variety of research tasks. Our mapping evaluation focuses on all 53 KITScenes map classes across different model designs, spatial ranges, and aerial resolutions, while retaining compatibility with the widely used three-class setting. Representative baselines show that aerial context is particularly beneficial for fine-grained and extended-range mapping, more than doubling 53-class mAP at the larger mapping extent. Higher-resolution aerial imagery yields a further 4.3 mAP (+24 %) improvement, with gains extending to challenging map elements such as traffic lights. We additionally evaluate cross-view localization under geographically disjoint conditions, where an adapted fine-grained feature-matching baseline achieves a mean translation error of 5.13 m. KITScenes Aerial thus enables unified study of aerial and ground-level information across complementary mapping and localization tasks. Project page: https://kitscenes.com/aerial

</details>


### [109] [Soil Moisture Estimation in Precision Agriculture: A Knowledge Distillation Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40432)
*Mohammed Rakib,Vrinda Nagula,Arunkumar Bagavathi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Soil Moisture Distillation (SMD)，一种基于知识蒸馏的多模态学习框架，用单模态教师模型提升多模态土壤湿度估计精度，并在土壤斑块与作物图像上验证作物图像提供更优视觉线索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 精准农业中土壤湿度估计对灌溉、施肥与收获策略至关重要。传统方法依赖气象与土壤属性数据，近期引入航空/地理空间影像等视觉模态，但高分辨率图像获取成本高、计算开销大，需要一种更高效利用多模态信息的方式。

Method: 提出SMD（Soil Moisture Distillation）框架：以单模态教师模型通过知识蒸馏指导多模态学生模型学习，融合气象数据与视觉数据；并与MIS-ME等传统多模态融合方法及单模态模型进行对比，同时比较土壤斑块图像与作物图像两种视觉输入的效果。

Result: SMD优于传统多模态融合方法（如MIS-ME）及单模态模型，体现引导式单模态知识迁移的收益；对比分析显示作物图像比土壤斑块图像提供更强的视觉线索、预测更准确。相比SOTA基线，MAPE在土壤斑块上提升2%、在作物图像上提升1.2%。

Conclusion: 知识蒸馏能有效整合气象与视觉数据以增强土壤湿度预测；单模态教师的引导式迁移优于常规多模态融合，且视觉模态的选择（作物图像优于土壤斑块）对精度有显著影响。

Abstract: Accurate soil moisture estimation is critical for precision agriculture, influencing irrigation, fertilization, and harvesting strategies. Traditional methods primarily rely on meteorological and soil property data, while recent approaches incorporate visual modalities such as aerial and geospatial imagery. However, these high-resolution images are expensive and computationally demanding to analyze. In this work, we propose Soil Moisture Distillation (SMD), a Knowledge Distillation (KD)-based multimodal learning framework that leverages unimodal teachers to enhance multimodal soil moisture estimation. SMD surpasses not only traditional multimodal fusion techniques, including MIS-ME, but also outperforms unimodal models, demonstrating the benefits of guided unimodal knowledge transfer. Additionally, we conduct a comparative analysis of soil patches and crop images, showing that crop images provide superior visual cues, leading to improved prediction accuracy. SMD achieves a 2% improvement in MAPE for soil patches and 1.2% for crops over state-of-the-art baselines, highlighting the effectiveness of leveraging both meteorological and visual data through knowledge distillation for enhanced soil moisture forecasting.

</details>


### [110] [Confidence Filtering in Video-Based Gait Assessment: Measurement Error versus Selection Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39704)
*David Regev,Eran Beeri Bamani*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 在高置信度姿态筛选与预算匹配随机筛选的对比中，置信度筛选会带来小而一致的观测运动摘要偏移（+0.05 SD），临床误差不变不足以证明质量筛选保留了所评估的运动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频步态评估常只保留高置信度姿态观测，虽可降低测量误差，但可能改变所评估的运动本身；作者希望厘清"误差降低"与"选择偏移"两种效应，并检验临床误差不变能否作为筛选无害的证据。

Method: 在帕金森相关队列（n=96）与NF2相关复制队列（n=18）中，对比置信度筛选与预算匹配的随机筛选；采用保留运动组比例的筛选策略；并在队列的窗口结构上对选择偏移与测量误差进行分解与模拟。

Result: 帕金森队列中置信度筛选造成观测运动摘要小幅一致偏移（+0.05 SD，95% CI 0.03–0.07），而留出Mini-BESTest误差基本不变（-0.04分，-0.13–0.05）；保留运动组比例的策略减小了该偏移；NF2队列无偏移，其预测器未超过常数基线。该队列中置信度与运动仅弱相关（rho=0.14）；若系统误差仅在个体内重分配，筛选可引入至多0.58度的偏差。

Conclusion: 筛选在误差依赖置信度时可降低局部误差，但一旦置信度更多反映运动而非误差，就会使终点估计产生偏差；因此小队列预测器上临床误差不变不能证明质量筛选保留了所评估的运动。

Abstract: Video-based gait assessment often keeps only high-confidence pose observations, which can lower measurement error but change the movement assessed. We compared confidence selection with budget-matched random selection in a Parkinson-related cohort (n = 96) and an NF2-related replication cohort (n = 18). In the Parkinson-related cohort, confidence selection produced a small but consistent shift in the observed movement summary (+0.05 SD, 95% CI 0.03 to 0.07), while held-out Mini-BESTest error stayed flat (-0.04 points, -0.13 to 0.05); a policy preserving motion-group proportions reduced the shift, while NF2 showed no shift and its predictor did not beat a constant baseline. Because this shift mixes measurement error with selection shift, we decompose and simulate both on the cohort's window structure. Filtering lowers local error when error depends on confidence, but biases the endpoint once confidence tracks movement more than error. In the Parkinson-related data, confidence was only weakly tied to movement (rho = 0.14). There, filtering is harmless if well-tracked windows are unbiased. If instead systematic error only redistributes within participants, filtering can add up to 0.58 degrees. Unchanged clinical error from such small-cohort predictors therefore cannot show that quality filtering preserves the assessed movement.

</details>


### [111] [Look at Where You Think: Localization-Head Alignment for Fine-Grained Perception in Thinking VLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39649)
*Yuan Wang,Wei Wu,Hongning Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: The bottleneck of long-chain vision-language reasoning is visual evidence selection, not perception; aligning a few "localization heads" via attention supervision improves accuracy and shortens reasoning.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM reasoning chains are long yet still miss small details in high-resolution images. Existing remedies (multi-pass zooming) cost extra inference, and outcome-only rewards give no credit assignment on where to look. The authors hypothesize the failure is selection rather than seeing, and seek a diagnostic plus a cheap fix.

Method: Identification of "localization heads" via ablations (4 heads vs. 4 random heads on Qwen3.5-4B), then Localization-Head Alignment (LHA): when the reasoning text states a visual fact, an auxiliary loss makes these heads attend to the focal region instead of background, applied during both SFT and RL.

Result: Ablating four localization heads costs 13.2 points more than four random heads; their focus decays as reasoning lengthens. LHA raises Qwen3.5-4B from 74.1% to 76.6% on V*, HR-Bench 4K and TreeBench — best single-pass 4B result reported, beating multi-pass zooming and released 7B models. Alignment alone yields +1.8 points over identical training and 20% shorter reasoning; gains transfer to Qwen2.5-VL-3B.

Conclusion: Attention can serve as a dense, token-level training signal. Supervising a small set of localization heads is a parameter-free-at-inference, single-pass alternative to zooming, improving both accuracy and reasoning efficiency, and appears model-agnostic.

Abstract: Thinking vision-language models reason for thousands of tokens, yet still miss small details in high-resolution images. Zooming methods pay for extra inference passes, and outcome rewards never tell the model where to look at. In Qwen3.5-4B, we find that the bottleneck is selection, not seeing: a few attention heads, which we call localization heads, pick the evidence out of thousands of visual tokens; ablating four of them costs 13.2 points more than ablating four random heads, and their focus fades as the reasoning grows. We therefore propose Localization-Head Alignment (LHA), which makes attention a training signal: whenever the reasoning states a visual fact, these heads learn to look at the focal region rather than the background, as an auxiliary loss in both SFT and RL training. On benchmarks of V*, HR-Bench 4K and TreeBench, LHA lifts Qwen3.5-4B from 74.1% to 76.6% accuracy, the best single-pass 4B result we evaluate, ahead of multi-pass zooming and released 7B models. Alignment alone adds 1.8 points over otherwise identical training while shortening reasoning by 20%, and the gains carry over to Qwen2.5-VL-3B.

</details>


### [112] [TokenRepel: Generating Diverse Image Sets Without Compromising Quality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39913)
*Qingtao Yu,Zhen Wang,Ning Lai,Boyang Hu,Hongdong Li,Dylan Campbell*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种推理时方法，利用预训练模型的隐表示几何结构，在不损失平均图像质量的前提下提升文本到图像模型在同一提示下生成图像集的视觉多样性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本到图像模型对同一提示生成的图像缺少视觉多样性，而现有提升多样性的手段往往牺牲单图质量。

Method: 利用隐空间表示的几何特性：1）token 排斥机制，在单位超球面上对 token 的 von Mises-Fisher 混合分布取负黎曼梯度步，增大跨样本特征 token 间夹角；2）token 密度保持机制，将排斥引起的预测变化投影到与模型 score 方向对齐的半空间，使更新停留在生成模型的高密度区域；并将该机制扩展到各中间层输出，实现更细粒度的迭代引导。

Result: 在三种预训练文本到图像模型上评测，同一提示下的视觉多样性显著提升，同时图像保真度保持相当水平。

Conclusion: 通过流形上的几何引导可在推理阶段解耦多样性与质量，为文本到图像生成提供无需重训练的多样性增强方案。

Abstract: We present an inference-time approach that enhances the visual diversity of image sets generated by text-to-image models, without compromising the average image quality. Our method leverages the intrinsic geometry of hidden representations in pretrained models to diversify images generated from the same prompt. First, we introduce a token repulsion mechanism that increases the angle between feature tokens across samples. It takes a negative Riemannian gradient step on a von Mises-Fisher mixture distribution of tokens on the unit hypersphere. Second, to preserve the quality of each output image, we propose a token density preservation mechanism that projects the repulsion-induced prediction change onto a half-space aligned with the model's score direction. This encourages the updates to remain within the high-density regions learned by the generative model. We further extend this mechanism to the output of each intermediate layer, enabling finer-grained iterative guidance. We evaluate our method on three types of pretrained text-to-image models. Experiments show substantial gains in visual diversity under identical prompts, while maintaining a comparable level of image fidelity.

</details>


### [113] [Open-set multi-view seahorse re-identification from underwater photograph sequences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39857)
*Tristan Fauvel,Sylvie Louisy,Patrick Louisy,Thomas Fauvel*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出基于图像序列的海马分类学分类、性别判定与开放集重识别方法，在35,914张、474只野生海马的数据集上验证，多图信息融合取得最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动化动物重识别可支撑大规模、微创的捕获-标记-重捕获（CMR）研究；但单次观测中的照片质量差异大，单幅图像常不足以提供可靠重识别所需的判别信息。

Method: 面向图像序列，分别构建分类学分类、性别判定和开放集重识别三类新方法；将同一观测会话内多张照片的信息进行融合，而非依赖单幅图像。

Result: 在含35,914张照片、474只野生个体的海马数据集上训练与评测，多图融合方案在各项任务上达到state-of-the-art性能。

Conclusion: 聚合序列内多张照片的信息可有效缓解图像质量波动对重识别的影响，为可扩展的微创CMR研究提供可行技术路径。

Abstract: Automated animal re-identification from photograph sequences can facilitate minimally invasive Capture-Mark-Recapture studies at scale. Yet, photographs taken during an observation session can vary greatly in quality, not always providing the necessary information for accurate re-identification. In this paper, we present new methods for taxonomic classification, sex determination, and open-set re-identification from image sequences. We train and evaluate our models on a dataset of 35,914 photographs of 474 individual seahorses observed in the wild. We demonstrate that our approach, by combining information from multiple photographs, yields state-of-the-art performance.

</details>


### [114] [CrossWeave: Cross-Modal Scene and Instance Retrieval from Sparse 2D-3D Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40525)
*Aadith Warrier,Gnana Prakash Punnavajhala,Siddharth Tourani,Muhammad Haris Khan,Avinash Sharma,Madhava Krishna*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CrossWeave框架，仅用稀疏2D-3D patch-point对应监督，训练单一模型同时完成场景级与实例级跨模态检索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有跨模态场景/实例检索仅在整场景或整物体层面学习对齐，缺少对内部细粒度局部结构的监督，需为两类任务分别训练模型，效率与灵活性受限。

Method: 以稀疏2D-3D对应关系作为监督，学习patch与3D点之间的稀疏对齐，不使用场景级或实例级对比目标；在对齐特征上引入基于最优传输的聚合器，对结构冗余区域进行聚类，从而把描述子容量释放给语义上不同的局部特征。

Result: 在ScanNet与3RScan上，场景级和实例级检索均取得SOTA，且由单一模型完成；仅靠稀疏对齐即已超越现有方法，聚合器进一步提升性能。

Conclusion: 整场景编码对跨模态检索并非必要，稀疏局部对应监督是更有效、更灵活的替代方案，可用统一模型覆盖多层级检索任务。

Abstract: Cross-modal scene and instance retrieval aims to retrieve a corresponding 3D environment or object given query 2D images, serving as a foundational mechanism for spatial reasoning in robotics and AR/VR. Existing methods achieve this by learning alignment only at the level of whole scenes or objects, which provides no supervision for the fine-grained local structure within them. In this work, we show that supervision on a set of sparse 2D-3D correspondences, without scene- or instance-level contrastive objectives, is sufficient to train a single model for both scene- and instance-level retrieval. Specifically, we propose $\textbf{CrossWeave}$, a novel framework for cross-modal retrieval that learns sparse patch-point alignment, which alone outperforms existing methods. An optimal transport-based aggregator over the aligned features gives further gains by clustering structurally redundant regions, freeing descriptor capacity for semantically distinct local features. CrossWeave achieves state-of-the-art performance on both scene- and instance-level retrieval on ScanNet and 3RScan with a $\textit{single model}$, whereas existing methods require separate models for each task. Our results suggest that whole-scene encoding is unnecessary for cross-modal retrieval and that sparse local correspondence supervision is a more effective and flexible alternative.

</details>


### [115] [Annotation-Free Representation Learning for Polyp Retrieval in Colonoscopy Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39648)
*Luca Parolari,Lamberto Ballan,Carlo Biffi,Loic Le Folgoc*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出无需标注的结肠镜轨迹片段表示学习框架，直接从原始视频构建轨迹视图，在轨迹检索与重识别上达到SOTA，并引入更贴近临床的少样本息肉检索任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结肠镜诊断本质上是比较性的：可靠地评估息肉需要不同视角与成像条件下的互补视图，因此需要有息肉轨迹（tracklet）表示来检索这些视图。现有的对比学习方法虽利用时序线索，但仍依赖人工标注的边界框，成本高且限制规模。

Method: 提出无标注框架，直接从原始结肠镜视频自动构建tracklet视图，实现覆盖完整检查视频（包括无可见息肉的帧）的时序自监督学习；在REAL-Colon数据集上进行验证，并进一步定义少样本息肉检索任务——给定目标息肉少量观测来检索其其余tracklet。

Result: 在REAL-Colon上，tracklet检索与重识别任务均取得SOTA，优于自监督与监督基线；少样本检索中仅用2个样本即超过多数使用10个样本的竞争方法；少量未标注检查视频即可获得有竞争力的性能。

Conclusion: 无标注的时序自监督表示学习可替代边界框标注需求，并支持现场（on-site）模型开发，使临床部署更可行。

Abstract: Colonoscopy is inherently comparative: reliable visual assessment of polyps often depends on complementary views acquired under different viewpoints and imaging conditions. Retrieving such views requires polyp tracklet representations, which recent contrastive methods learn from temporal cues but still build from manually annotated bounding boxes. We propose an annotation-free framework that constructs tracklet views directly from raw colonoscopy videos, enabling temporal self-supervised learning on full-procedure videos, including frames without visible polyps. On REAL-Colon, our method achieves state-of-the-art results on tracklet retrieval and re-identification, outperforming both self-supervised and supervised baselines. We then introduce few-shot polyp retrieval, a task closer to clinical use, where a few observations of a target polyp are used to retrieve its remaining tracklets: with only two examples, our method surpasses most competing methods given ten. Finally, we show that a modest number of unlabeled procedures suffices for competitive performance, making on-site model development more practical. Code is available at https://github.com/lparolari/freerep.

</details>


### [116] [M-PFT: Angular Margin for Calibrated Prompt-Tuning of Fine-Tuned Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39861)
*Shihab Aaqil Ahamed,Mohamed Ansaff,Nang Khin Myat Lay Phyu,Udaya Sampath K. Perera Miriya Thanthrige,Chamira U. S. Edussooriya,Ranga Rodrigo,Muhammad Haris Khan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 M-PFT，一种基于角度间隔的 prompt tuning 方法，通过最小化类嵌入间最大余弦相似度与保持与零样本嵌入的角度一致性来扩大角度间隔，缓解 base-to-novel 双重校准失调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: prompt-tuned VLM 存在 base 类欠自信、novel 类过自信的双重校准失调问题；现有校准方法或单独或联合处理该问题，但缺乏对超球嵌入空间的几何理解，未能利用角度判别性来修正畸变的决策边界。

Method: M-PFT 引入两个互补目标以增大角度间隔：(1) 最小化可学习类嵌入之间的最大余弦相似度，抑制嵌入坍缩；(2) 最小化各可学习嵌入与其对应零样本嵌入之间的角度距离，保持语义几何结构。

Result: 在 15 个数据集、多种 backbone、9 种 prompt-tuning 方法上进行大量实验，所提方法降低了 novel 类的平均校准误差，在 base 类上保持竞争力，同时维持相当的准确率。

Conclusion: 进一步分析表明，M-PFT 能有效调整 prompt tuning 导致的畸变决策边界，同时保留预训练嵌入空间，在可忽略的计算开销下提升校准性能。

Abstract: Prompt-tuning has emerged as a parameter-efficient technique for adapting large-scale vision-language models (VLMs) to downstream tasks while keeping the pre-trained weights frozen. However, prompt-tuned VLMs often suffer from a base-to-novel dual miscalibration problem, where models typically show underconfidence on base classes and overconfidence on novel classes. Current VLM calibration approaches address this dual miscalibration either separately or jointly, but lack a geometric understanding of the hyperspherical embedding space and thus fail to exploit angular discriminative properties to adjust distorted decision boundaries. To address this, we propose M-PFT, a novel angular-margin approach for prompt tuning that introduces two complementary objectives to promote class discriminability and semantic anchoring. This enlarges the angular margin by 1) minimizing the maximum cosine similarity between tunable class embeddings to reduce embedding collapse and 2) minimizing the angular distance between each tunable embedding and its corresponding zero-shot embedding to preserve semantic geometry. Extensive experiments across 9 prompt-tuning methods with various backbones on 15 diverse datasets show that our approach reduces the average calibration error on novel classes, while remaining competitive on base classes and maintaining comparable accuracy. Further analyses reveal that M-PFT effectively adjusts distorted decision boundaries induced by prompt tuning while preserving the pre-trained embedding space, improving calibration with negligible computational overhead.

</details>


### [117] [Segment Anything Model Based Context Guided Mamba Unet for Medical Image Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40029)
*Chenchen Wang,You Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SAMBA-UNet，将SAM的上下文知识与Mamba的层次特征学习结合，通过HCEM模块与LoRA/Adapter微调实现医学图像分割，在Synapse、ISIC17、ISIC18上取得SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学图像分割需兼顾全局上下文理解与细粒度结构精度。SAM泛化性强但缺乏医学领域适应性；基于SSM（如Mamba）的方法能高效建模长程依赖，却难以保留细微解剖细节。

Method: 构建SAM+Mamba的U-Net式框架：引入分层上下文增强模块（HCEM），基于注意力深度融合SAM与Mamba的多层级特征以提升细节感知与分割精度；并采用LoRA与Adapter微调使SAM适配医学影像，增强领域特定能力与鲁棒性。

Result: 在Synapse、ISIC17、ISIC18等多个数据集上多指标评估，SAMBA-UNet达到SOTA，在泛化性、分割精度与计算效率间取得良好平衡。

Conclusion: 融合SAM上下文知识与Mamba层次特征学习并以参数高效微调适配，是提升医学图像分割性能的有效路径；代码将在录用后开源。

Abstract: Medical image segmentation is crucial for clinical diagnosis and treatment planning, requiring both global contextual understanding and fine-grained structural precision. While the Segment Anything Model (SAM) demonstrates strong generalization capabilities, its direct application to medical images often lacks domain-specific adaptability. Meanwhile, State Space Models (SSMs)-based methods, such as Mamba, efficiently capture long-range dependencies but may struggle with preserving fine anatomical details. To address these challenges, we propose a segment anything model based context guided mamba unet, SAMBA-UNet, a novel framework that integrates SAM's context knowledge with Mamba's hierarchical feature learning to enhance both global representation and local detail refinement. Specifically, we introduce the Hierarchical Context Enhancement Module (HCEM), an attention-based fusion module that deeply incorporates the multi-level features of SAM and Mamba to improve detail perception and segmentation precision. Additionally, we employ LoRA and Adapter-based fine-tuning to adapt SAM to medical imaging tasks, further enhancing its domain-specific segmentation capability and robustness. We conducted a comprehensive study on several medical segmentation datasets, including Synapse, ISIC17, and ISIC18, evaluating our method across multiple metrics. Experimental results demonstrate that SAMBA-UNet achieves state-of-the-art performance, effectively balancing generalization, segmentation accuracy, and computational efficiency. Our code will be released upon acceptance.

</details>


### [118] [Mind The Gap (MTG-AD): Dataset and Fine-grained Evaluation for End-to-End Inline Audio Descriptions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39955)
*Subhashini Venugopalan,Jenny Tan,Taylor Roper,Jimmy Tobin,Anton Kast,Alicia Martin,Sam Sepah,Amy Pavel*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MTG-AD数据集与MTG-AD-Eval无参考评估框架，系统研究MLLM生成"内嵌式"音频描述的表现，发现模型能准确描述视觉事件并减少语音重叠，但叙事节奏与流畅性仍有差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 音频描述对盲人与低视力用户获取视觉媒体至关重要，MLLM可按需生成，但在需嵌入视频原有静音间隙的"内嵌式"AD场景下（尤其面向多样化用户生成内容UGC）性能缺乏研究。

Method: 构建MTG-AD数据集（36小时视频、约5分钟/条、8k+描述，由盲人与明眼AD专业人员配对共创）；提出基于AD专家指南的MTG-AD-Eval无参考、细粒度、可执行评估框架，并进行端到端评估：将生成脚本渲染为音轨以检验其在自然静音中的适配度与重叠干扰。

Result: 前沿MLLM能准确描述视觉事件并显著降低语音重叠，但在叙事节奏与流畅性上存在差距；自动化无参考指标与明眼评分者及7名BLV参与者的人工质量评分显著相关；用户略偏好人工撰写AD，但认为MLLM生成AD对理解高度有益。

Conclusion: 为内嵌式AD任务提供基准与评估工具，给出可执行的系统设计指导，并开源MTG-AD数据集与MTG-AD-Eval评估代码。

Abstract: Audio descriptions (AD) are essential for making visual media accessible to blind and low-vision (BLV) users. While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) offer a scalable solution for generating audio descriptions on-demand, their performance on ``inline'' audio descriptions -- which must fit within existing silences in a video -- remains under-explored, particularly for diverse user-generated content (UGC). We present a comprehensive investigation into MLLM-generated inline audio descriptions. First, we introduce MTG-AD, a professionally annotated dataset of 36 hours of videos, each averaging $\sim$5 mins. and 8k+ descriptions in total, co-created by paired blind and sighted AD professionals to provide a high-quality benchmark for this task. Second, we propose MTG-AD-Eval, an evaluation framework based on audio description expert guidelines that provides fine-grained, reference-free actionable metrics for model improvement. Crucially, our framework evaluates the end-to-end task: it renders the generated scripts into audio tracks to assess their fit within the original video's natural silences, minimizing disruptive overlaps. Our analysis across frontier MLLMs reveals that while models accurately describe visual events and substantially reduce speech overlaps, gaps persist in narrative pacing and flow. Finally, we empirically validate that our automated and reference-free metrics correlate significantly with human quality ratings from sighted raters and 7 BLV participants, finding that while users narrowly prefer human-authored audio descriptions, they find MLLM-generated audio descriptions highly beneficial for comprehension. We provide actionable system design guidance and release MTG-AD at https://hf.co/datasets/google/mind-the-gap-inline-ad and MTG-AD-Eval at https://github.com/google/mtg-ad.

</details>


### [119] [ElasticFormer: Detecting Objects in HRW Shots via Elastic Computing Vision Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39946)
*Wenxi Li,Jingchen Huang,Chenyang Lyu,Moran Liu,Haozhe Lin,Guiguang Ding,Yuchen Guo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对gigapixel级宽幅图像前景稀疏、分辨率极高且目标数量多变的问题，提出动态稀疏骨干网络ElasticFormer，依据前景占比自适应分配算力，在PANDA基准上减少骨干FLOPs约80%同时提升AP50。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超高分辨率宽幅图像存在前景极度稀疏、gigapixel级分辨率、目标数量差异大等挑战，传统近景检测器被海量背景淹没而变得不准确且缓慢；已有稀疏骨干采用固定稀疏模式，无法适应多变的目标数量。

Method: 提出ElasticFormer，一种根据前景比例动态分配计算资源的稀疏骨干。其ElasticSelector模块先基于方差对窗口打分，再预测各窗口前景占比并据此进行top-k选择，从而将资源导向含目标区域及目标聚集区域；同时设计新损失函数与三阶段训练策略，使ElasticSelector在缺乏边界框标注时仍能正常工作。另在PASCAL VOC 2007上进行WSOD研究以评估可扩展性，并构建ElasticNet验证与骨干无关的特性。

Result: 在PANDA gigapixel基准实验中，相比固定比例稀疏方法，ElasticFormer将骨干FLOPs降低80%，同时AP50显著提升。

Conclusion: 动态、按前景占比自适应的稀疏计算优于固定稀疏模式，可在大幅降低计算开销的同时提升检测精度，且方法具有可扩展性与骨干无关性。

Abstract: Recent advances in gigapixel-level imaging have brought High-Resolution Wide shots to the forefront of research. However, these images present significant challenges: extreme sparsity of foreground, gigapixel-level resolutions and diverse target counts. This makes traditional close-up detectors inaccurate and slow as they are overwhelmed by the background. Although previous research has explored sparse backbones, their fixed sparsity patterns lack the adaptability required to handle diverse target numbers. To address this, we introduce ElasticFormer, a sparse backbone that dynamically allocates computational resources based on foreground proportion. After scoring windows based on variance, proposed ElasticSelector module will predict the foreground proportion for top-k selection. The mechanism guides the model to select target-containing windows, scaling resources in areas where objects are clustered. We introduce a novel loss function combined with the 3-phase training strategy for ElasticSelector, allowing it to function properly when bounding box annotations are missing. A WSOD study is carried on PASCAL VOC 2007 to evaluate its extensibility. Further, ElasticNet is created to verify its backbone-agnostic nature. In experiments on the PANDA gigapixel benchmark, ElasticFormer reduces backbone FLOPs by 80% while achieving a significant improvement in AP50 when compared to fixed-ratio sparse methods.

</details>


### [120] [GROME: GROunding Factorized MEmory into Video World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39812)
*Fang Yu,Xiaoxue Wu,Haiyu Zhang,Yangfu Li,Botong Zhao,Yu Qiao,Tianfan Xue,Yue Lu,Xinyuan Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GROME：一种免训练、因子化记忆框架，将历史解耦为静态场景与动态实体，经局部检索与原生条件通路注入视频世界模型，实现长时程一致性与可插拔外部记忆。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频世界模型在观测内容超出上下文窗口后难以维持长时程一致性。隐式上下文检索受上下文容量限制且混合静态/动态信息；显式全局表示难以刻画演化的动态并累积几何误差。

Method: 提出GROME因子化记忆框架，含三部分：1）静态-动态因子化，将历史证据解耦为静态场景几何与动态实体状态；2）局部记忆检索，选取空间对齐的静态历史以消除几何漂移，并取最新动态实体状态保证时序连续；3）免训练记忆注入，通过模型原生条件通路将因子化记忆注入视频世界模型。无需额外训练，主干保持冻结。

Result: 在长时程重访场景实验中，相比现有方法显著提升场景持续性与动态实体保真度，同时保持冻结主干的视觉质量与可控性。此外可将外部观测作为即插即用记忆，支持可控视频延展与场景探索。

Conclusion: 因子化记忆与免训练注入是提升视频世界模型长时程一致性的有效途径，并具备良好的可扩展性与外部观测兼容性。

Abstract: Long-horizon consistency is essential for video world models, yet it becomes difficult to maintain once observed content falls outside the context window. Existing memory mechanisms either retrieve history as implicit context, which remains constrained by context capacity and entangles static and dynamic information or consolidate history into explicit global representations, which struggle to model evolving dynamics and accumulate geometric errors. To overcome these limitations, we introduce \textbf{GROME}, a novel factorized memory framework that augments video world models for long-horizon coherence across both static scenes and dynamic entities. GROME operates via three synergistic components: 1)~\emph{Static-Dynamic Factorization} decouples historical evidence into static and dynamic components, preserving static scene geometry and dynamic entity states separately; 2)~\emph{Local Memory Retrieval} selects spatially aligned static history to eliminate geometric drift alongside the latest dynamic entity states to ensure temporal continuity; 3)~\emph{Training-Free Memory Injection} seamlessly grounds the factorized memory into video world models via their native conditioning pathways. Experiments on long-horizon revisit scenarios demonstrate that GROME substantially enhances scene persistence and dynamic entity fidelity over existing methods, all while preserving the visual quality and controllability of the frozen backbone without additional training. Beyond self-rollouts, GROME readily accommodates external observations as plug-and-play memory, unlocking flexible and controllable video continuation and scene exploration.

</details>


### [121] [FFAI: Flow Matching with Feedback Training and Adaptive Initialization for CT Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39517)
*Jigang Duan,Heran Wang,Genwei Ma,Xing Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出统一条件流匹配方法，处理低剂量、稀疏视角、有限角度三类CT重建


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 三类CT退化的机制不同，但本质都是测量信息受限导致的重建不适定问题，可统一建模；同时现有基于流匹配的迭代图像复原存在两个缺陷：预测误差会使推理状态偏离训练轨迹，固定的初始化不适合退化程度差异大的输入。

Method: 统一条件流匹配框架，以初始重建结果为条件；训练端采用反馈感知训练，由教师网络模拟推理更新生成偏移状态，学生网络学习从中恢复高质量参考图像；推理端采用退化自适应初始化，依据噪声水平或投影数据缺失程度选择起始时刻，并相应调整初始状态所加噪声。

Result: 在公开基准数据集上，三类重建任务的定量指标均优于对比方法，有效抑制噪声与伪影，同时保持解剖结构与细节。

Conclusion: 将低剂量、稀疏视角、有限角度CT重建纳入统一的条件流匹配框架可行且有效，反馈感知训练与退化自适应初始化分别缓解了误差累积和初始化不匹配问题。

Abstract: Although low-dose, sparse-view, and limited-angle CT involve distinct degradation mechanisms, all three pose reconstruction challenges due to limited measurement information and can therefore be addressed within a unified framework. In iterative image restoration with flow matching, prediction errors may cause inference states to deviate from the prescribed training path, while a fixed initialization may be unsuitable for inputs with varying degradation severity. We propose a unified conditional flow matching method that conditions on the initial reconstruction and combines feedback-aware training with degradation-adaptive initialization. During training, a teacher network simulates inference updates to generate shifted states, from which a student network learns to recover high-quality reference images, improving its ability to handle prediction errors. During inference, the starting time is selected based on the noise level or extent of missing projection data, and the noise added to the initial state is adjusted accordingly to adapt the starting point to the input. Experiments on public benchmark datasets show that the proposed method achieves better quantitative results than the compared methods across all three reconstruction tasks, effectively suppressing noise and artifacts while preserving anatomical structures and details.

</details>


### [122] [DiFuse: Fusing Native Diffusion Representations for Spatial Reasoning in Unified Multimodal Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39609)
*Ruixin Fan,Weining Wang,Jiahui Sun,Tailai Chen,Jing Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DiFuse，将UMM中扩散分支的中间表征选择性注入理解通路，以提升空间推理且不损害通用理解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 统一多模态模型中，理解表征常用于条件化生成，而生成表征极少被复用于推理，信息流呈明显不对称，生成侧的空间信息未被充分利用。

Method: 系统性的逐层分析以定位最具信息量、且对语义处理干扰最小的扩散表征与注入位置；据此将扩散特征与视觉token空间对齐，并通过残差融合注入选定的多模态解码层。

Result: 在UniWorld-V1上，DiFuse相对匹配的SFT基线持续提升空间推理，同时在通用多模态基准上保持大致可比的表现；在OmniGen2上验证了跨架构可迁移性，且性能增益关键依赖于扩散表征选取、注入位置及扩散特征与视觉token间空间对应关系的保持。

Conclusion: 以结构保持的方式选择性集成原生扩散表征，可为多模态推理提供互补的空间线索。

Abstract: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) jointly support visual understanding and image generation, yet information flow between these two capabilities remains largely asymmetric: understanding representations routinely condition generation, whereas generative representations are rarely reused for multimodal reasoning. In this work, we investigate whether intermediate representations from a UMM's native diffusion branch can enhance spatial reasoning without compromising general multimodal understanding. We propose DiFuse, which selectively incorporates intermediate diffusion representations into the understanding pathway of UMMs. Through systematic layer-wise analysis, we identify which diffusion representations are most informative and where they can be integrated with minimal interference to semantic processing. Guided by these findings, DiFuse spatially aligns diffusion features with visual tokens and injects them into selected multimodal decoder layers via residual fusion. Extensive experiments on UniWorld-V1 show that, DiFuse consistently improves spatial reasoning over a matched SFT baseline while maintaining broadly comparable performance on general multimodal benchmarks. Further analyses show that these gains depend critically on the choice of diffusion representations, injection positions, and the preservation of spatial correspondence between diffusion features and visual tokens. Results on OmniGen2 further demonstrate the transferability of DiFuse across unified multimodal architectures. Overall, our findings show that native diffusion representations can provide complementary spatial cues for multimodal reasoning when selectively integrated in a structure-preserving manner.

</details>


### [123] [It Takes Two to Probe, Thousands to Retrieve: Putting Vision--Language Probes to the Retrieval Test](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40124)
*Ivana Beňová,Michal Gregor,Marián Šimko*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文比较了"图文匹配探针"与"检索"两种评测方式的关系，发现探针准确率与检索准确率并不可比：负样本来源（benchmark手工构造、随机抽样、其他模型的错误检索）显著改变难度，且基准标注的不完整会严重低估检索性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLMs 的细粒度理解常用图像—文本匹配探针评测（在少量手工负样本中挑出正确项），而实际应用（如检索）需从数千候选中排序。两种评测是否可互相推断尚不清楚，因此作者要测量二者的关系。

Method: 将两个探针基准 \svo{} 和 SugarCrepe 改造成检索任务；选取 6 个 VLM，对 100 个图像/文本查询在全量数据集中取 top-10 检索结果，用人工标注者与 LLM 评估器（o3）判定正确性；随后在相同查询下只改变负样本来源（基准手工负样本、随机抽样、其他模型被判定为错误的检索结果），比较排序表现，并分析标注完整性与探针通过/检索成功的关联。

Result: \svo{} 上，在手工负样本中选出正例的准确率显著高于在检索结果中选出正例（85% vs. 77%）；10 个检索负样本构成的候选池即可达到 200–430 个随机负样本的同等难度。SugarCrepe 上结论相反，其手工负样本比检索负样本更难。标注不完整可解释 \svo{} 上的低检索分：人工标签下 top-1 正确率为 54–90%，而按基准标签仅 6–21%。探针是否通过与该查询能否检索出正确首项之间无关联。LLM 评估器 o3 与单个标注者的一致性（κ 0.57–0.61）略低于标注者之间的一致性（0.64–0.68）。

Conclusion: 探针准确率不能可靠代表检索性能：难度高度依赖负样本来源，基准自身负样本的难度方向在两个数据集间不一致，且基准标签不完整会大幅低估检索能力。评测 VLM 细粒度能力时需明确负样本分布并改进标注完整性；LLM 作为评估器在一致性上接近人类标注者但略逊。

Abstract: Vision--language models (VLMs) are tested for fine-grained understanding with image--text matching probes, a model must prefer the correct image or caption over handcrafted negative. In retrieval, the correct item must beat thousands of alternatives. We measure how these two evaluation methods relate by using two probing benchmarks, \svo{} and SugarCrepe, for retrieval tasks. For 100 image and caption queries we judge the top-10 retrievals from full dataset of six VLMs, with human annotators and an LLM assessor. We than compare how well models rank pool of items on the same queries, while changing only where the negatives comes from: the benchmark, a random draw, or the judged-incorrect retrievals of other models. On \svo{} the accuracy of retrieving a positive over handcrafted negatives is significantly higher than for retrieved ones (the correct item is preferred in 85\% against 77\% of the time). Using pool of ten retrieved negatives leads to same accuracy as when one uses pool of 200 to 430 random negatives. On SugarCrepe the order is reversed: its handcrafted negatives are harder than the retrieved ones. Incomplete relevance labels explain most of the low retrieval scores on \svo{}, where the top-ranked item is correct for 54--90\% of the queries under human labels against 6--21\% under the benchmark's labels. However, we detect no association between passing the probe for a query and retrieving a correct item first. The LLM assessor o3 agrees with individual annotators ($κ$ 0.57--0.61) slightly less than they agree with each other (0.64--0.68).

</details>


### [124] [RepConTUR: A Report-Conditioned Volumetric Multimodal Model for Abdominal Tumor Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40094)
*Seunghwan Lee,Sangjoon Park,Jongmin Lee,Yoon Jo Kim,Wonyoung Cho,Jin Sung Kim,Han Joo Chae*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出RepConTUR——首个原生3D早期融合的多模态模型，以完整放射报告为条件进行腹部肿瘤体积分割，并将AbdomenAtlas 3.0扩展为亚器官级提示分割数据集，联合训练RES、GSEG、RRG、VQA四项任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 放疗计划需要肿瘤勾画，但自动分割以假阳性为主的错误会扭曲剂量并增加医生编辑时间；放射报告已对病变进行亚器官级定位，但现有文本可提示模型仅以短指代短语为条件且多为2D架构，无法利用叙述性报告的空间与语义信息。

Method: 构建原生3D早期融合模型RepConTUR，由3D CT编码器、早期融合语言模型与原生3D分割模块组成；将AbdomenAtlas 3.0扩展为亚器官级可提示分割数据集并生成基于报告的VQA对，在同一标注上派生RES、GSEG、RRG、VQA四个任务进行联合训练。

Result: 在肝、肾、胰腺上，DSC、实例级精确率与检测F1均优于文本可提示基线；加入报告在召回相当的情况下提升平均精确率；对比nnU-Net与R-Super，在肝、胰腺全部域内指标最优，并在四个域外公开队列上取得最高平均DSC、召回、精确率与检测F1。消融显示：报告条件化使检测F1由0.499升至0.528，联合GSEG训练使RES F1由0.450升至0.482，原生3D分割模块使GSEG F1由2D的0.139升至0.528。

Conclusion: 完整叙述性报告可作为有效的亚器官级空间先验，结合原生3D架构与多任务联合训练，可显著提升腹部肿瘤分割的精确率与检测性能，并具备较好的域外泛化能力。

Abstract: Tumor delineation is required for radiotherapy planning, yet automatic segmentation is limited by errors, predominantly false positives, that distort dose and increase editing time. The radiology report accompanies the scan and localizes disease at the suborgan level, but existing text-promptable models condition on short referring phrases, and most operate in 2D. We present RepConTUR, a single native-3D early-fusion multimodal model that conditions volumetric abdominal tumor segmentation on the narrative report. We extend AbdomenAtlas 3.0 to a suborgan-level promptable segmentation dataset and generate report-based VQA pairs, yielding four report-derived tasks on the same annotations: referring segmentation (RES), report-grounded segmentation (GSEG), report generation (RRG), and visual question answering (VQA). We train RepConTUR, comprising a 3D CT encoder, an early-fusion language model, and a native-3D segmentation module, jointly on the four tasks. Across liver, kidney and pancreas, RepConTUR attains the highest Dice similarity coefficient (DSC), instance-wise precision, and detection F1 among the text-promptable baselines, and adding the report raises mean precision while leaving recall comparable. Against two vision-only specialists, nnU-Net and the report-supervised R-Super, RepConTUR attains the highest value on every in-domain metric for liver and pancreas and the highest mean DSC, recall, precision, and detection F1 over the four out-of-distribution public cohorts. Ablations indicate that conditioning on the narrative report raises detection F1 from 0.499 to 0.528 within the same model, that joint GSEG training raises RES F1 from 0.450 to 0.482, and that the native-3D segmentation module raises GSEG F1 from 0.139 to 0.528 over its 2D counterpart. Code is available at https://github.com/Oncosoft-Research/RepConTUR.

</details>


### [125] [Probing Spatial State Representations in Visual Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40636)
*Baiqiao Yin,Zhongang Cai,Ruisi Wang,Qiwei Liang,Lei Yang,Ziwei Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文系统评估视觉基础模型的表征是否支持\"持久空间状态\"，在四个空间能力层级（空间结构、物体持续性、预测性空间更新、可行动性）上用冻结特征探针测试十种表征，发现各层能力在不同任务/层/前缀长度间不一致，强读出能力不保证持久性或可行动性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 观察者只能看到世界的一部分，必须追踪视野之外的信息，因此空间感知需要一种在自我运动下更新并指导动作的持久空间状态。作者追问：视觉基础模型是否提供了支持这种状态的表征，而非仅能识别单张图像。

Method: 在静态室内环境的流式自我中心观测下，对十种表征（含原生未来预测特征）进行冻结特征探针分析，按四个层级评测：空间结构、物体持续性、预测性空间更新、可行动性；并设置匹配对照，将读出精度与对视觉历史及运动的依赖区分开来；另测试真实特征上训练的空间读出器能否迁移到预测特征，以及目标依赖的候选选择能否带来连续动作效用。

Result: 能力画像随任务、网络层和前缀长度而变化：可见场景的强读出并不能保证准确的对象持续性或未来特征检索。原生未来预测保留了可恢复的空间结构，但在真实特征上训练的空间读出器无法原样迁移到预测特征。目标变化会引发预测动作的响应，但提供正确目标并不能可靠提升进展，表明目标依赖的候选选择未确立可靠的连续动作效用。相关性上，物体持续性与可行动性依赖相机位姿读出，而特征预测依赖可见场景读出。

Conclusion: 评估空间表征不应只看\"能从中解码出什么\"，还应看信息是否在观测之外被维持、是否被预测性地更新、以及是否用于目标导向动作。未来工作应据此建立面向持久空间状态的多层级评测范式。

Abstract: An observer sees only part of the surrounding world, yet must keep track of what lies beyond the current view. Spatial perception therefore involves more than recognizing individual images: it calls for a persistent spatial state that is updated under self-motion and used to guide action. Do visual foundation models provide representations that support such a state? We study this question through four levels of spatial capability---spatial structure, object persistence, predictive spatial update, and actionability---using frozen-feature probes on ten representations under streaming egocentric observations of static indoor environments. The resulting capability profiles vary across tasks, network layers, and prefix lengths: strong readout of the visible scene does not ensure accurate object persistence or future-feature retrieval. Matched controls separate readout accuracy from reliance on visual history and motion. Native future prediction retains recoverable spatial structure, but a spatial reader trained on real features does not transfer to predicted features unchanged. Finally, goal-dependent candidate selection does not establish reliable continuous action utility: predicted actions respond to goal changes, yet supplying the correct goal does not reliably improve progress. Across the four levels, object persistence and actionability build on camera-pose readout, whereas feature prediction builds on visible-scene readout. Together, these findings motivate evaluating spatial representations not only by what can be decoded from them, but by whether that information is maintained beyond observation, updated predictively, and used for goal-directed action.

</details>


### [126] [Fight World Model: Customizable Combat through Visual Interaction Proxies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40607)
*Jiahua Li,Zixu John,Tom Zhong,Fuping Wu,Tianhao Xu,Ruicheng Zhang,Jun Zhou,Zunnan Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FWM 将规则驱动的战斗执行与视频渲染解耦，通过可执行引擎+确定性编译器生成时空对齐的交互代理，实现可编程、可变规则的格斗游戏世界模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频世界模型虽能生成看似合理的战斗画面，但难以保证受击反应与血量更新符合游戏规则，缺乏持久状态、可执行规则与可扩展玩法机制，无法成为"可玩的、可编程的"游戏世界。

Method: 提出 Fight World Model（FWM）：(1) 可执行引擎维护状态并解算交互；(2) 确定性编译器将结果与尝试动作编码为时空对齐的交互代理（interaction proxy），按角色身份与时间戳对齐动作/技能窗口、短促受击反应与持久血量；(3) 这些线索可分别控制，以在修改规则下渲染交互；(4) 身份绑定的参考保持换边后的角色外观一致性。基于 FightWorld Corpus（52 种技能效果、187 种外观变体、15 个竞技场）训练。

Result: 无需重训渲染器即支持伤害缩放、限定次数受击免疫、吸血、多段技能机制等原生游戏之外的规则，并支持角色与场景定制；在动作保真度、受击反应、血量状态一致性、角色外观保持上优于现有游戏世界模型。

Conclusion: 将规则执行与视觉渲染分离是构建可编程、可玩视频世界模型的有效范式，可在不重训渲染器的前提下实现规则级可控与内容可扩展。

Abstract: A playable, programmable game world must maintain persistent state, enforce executable rules, and support extensible gameplay mechanics. Existing video world models can generate plausible combat, yet struggle to keep hit reactions and health updates consistent with game rules. We introduce Fight World Model (FWM), which separates rule-governed combat execution from video rendering. An executable engine maintains state and resolves interactions. A deterministic compiler encodes these outcomes and attempted actions in a spatially and temporally aligned interaction proxy. The proxy aligns action and skill windows, brief hit reactions, and persistent health by fighter identity and timing. These cues can be controlled separately to render interactions under modified rules. Identity-bound references preserve character appearance across side switches. We train FWM on FightWorld Corpus, spanning 52 skill effects, 187 character-appearance variants, and 15 arenas. Without retraining the renderer, FWM supports damage scaling, limited-hit immunity, lifesteal, and multi-stage skill mechanisms beyond the native game. It also allows character and arena customization. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of FWM, which outperforms existing game world models in action fidelity, hit reactions, health-state consistency, and character appearance preservation. Our project is available at https://fight-world-model.github.io.

</details>


### [127] [AdMuse: Skill-Guided Creative Advertising Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40190)
*Minyan Luo,Yuxin Zhang,Meng Zhao,Xincan Wang,Fuzhang Wu,Tong-Yee Lee,Oliver Deussen,Fan Tang,Weiming Dong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AdMuse是一个技能引导的多智能体框架，将高质量广告抽象为可复用的"创意技能"库，通过技能路由、多候选构思与选择、VLM引导的视觉精修三阶段流程生成广告图像，在多样化产品与品牌定位上生成兼具视觉吸引力与定位传达准确性的广告。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 优秀创意广告需同时吸引注意力并传递产品定位，关键在于渲染前选定有说服力的"概念桥梁"（conceptual bridge）。现有方法依赖检索孤立样例，难以在不同产品brief间迁移可复用的创意策略，广告生成中的策略决策缺乏结构化支撑。

Method: 提出AdMuse：(1)将高质量广告抽象为反复出现的桥梁模式，构建可复用技能库，替代孤立样例检索；(2)生成时进行技能路由（skill routing），将新产品brief匹配到合适技能；(3)多候选构思与相对判断（relative judgment）选择最有前景方向；(4)VLM引导的视觉精修，将选定意图落实到最终图像。整体将广告创意视为结构化决策过程而非单步提示写作。

Result: 在多样化产品与品牌定位设置下开展实验，AdMuse能生成视觉上具有吸引力的广告，并忠实传达产品定位。

Conclusion: 以技能库抽象+多智能体协同的结构化决策范式可有效提升跨域广告生成的创意质量与定位保真度，为策略先行的广告图像生成提供可行路径。摘要未给出量化指标与基线对比细节。

Abstract: An outstanding creative advertising image should both attract attention and communicate a product's positioning. How to choose a persuasive conceptual bridge before rendering begins is challenging for advertising generation. We present AdMuse, a skill-guided multi-agent framework that distills high-quality advertisements into reusable creative skills for cross-domain advertising strategy. Rather than retrieving isolated exemplars, AdMuse abstracts recurring bridge patterns into a skill library that can guide new product briefs. At generation time, AdMuse coordinates skill routing, multi-candidate ideation and selection, and VLM-guided visual refinement: diverse skills propose alternative concepts, relative judgment selects the most promising direction, and vision-language feedback helps realize the selected intent in the final image. This design treats advertising creativity as a structured decision process rather than a single prompt-writing step. Experiments across diverse product and brand positionings show that AdMuse produces visually compelling advertisements that faithfully communicate product positioning.

</details>


### [128] [EventSeeColor: Learning to Reconstruct Color from Monochrome Events](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40166)
*Chuanzhi Xu,Langyi Chen,Haoxian Zhou,Zelin Zhang,Haodong Chen,Qiang Qu,Xiaoming Chen,Weidong Cai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EventSeeColor 利用事件重建灰度图与对齐事件联合引导扩散着色器，从单色事件相机数据中重建彩色图像。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事件相机在挑战性光照下能捕捉亮度变化，但现有事件图像重建只生成灰度强度，丢失了区分同亮度不同表面所需的颜色信息；单色事件相机的触发模式隐含反射率、光照与光谱响应线索，可用于颜色推断。

Method: 以事件重建的灰度图与对齐事件作为双重条件，联合引导扩散模型进行着色；引入灰度语义上下文辅助颜色推断，并采用区域平衡的色度监督与局部 RGB 精修以改善色彩分布、亮度与纹理。

Result: 在两个真实事件数据集上的联合评测中，该方法在结构相似度、学习感知指标及彩色区域色差方面均优于外部对比方法。

Conclusion: 灰度语义与事件触发模式可有效支撑事件相机的彩色重建，扩散着色框架结合区域平衡色度监督与局部精修能显著提升颜色还原质量。

Abstract: Event cameras capture visual brightness changes under challenging lighting conditions. However, traditional event-based image reconstruction targets grayscale intensity and produces images without scene color. Color distinguishes surfaces with similar intensity. Reconstructing color from events can reveal appearance differences that reconstructed grayscale images cannot express. Although monochrome event cameras do not directly measure color, their event-triggering patterns depend on surface reflectance, illumination, and the sensor's spectral response. These patterns may contain cues that support color reconstruction. In this paper, we present EventSeeColor, which uses event-reconstructed grayscale and aligned events to jointly guide a diffusion colorizer. Grayscale-derived semantic context supports color inference, while region-balanced chroma supervision and local RGB refinement improve color distribution, brightness, and texture. In the combined evaluation on two real event datasets, EventSeeColor achieves the best structural similarity, learned perceptual scores, and chromatic-region color difference among the external methods.

</details>


### [129] [Regional Anchor Routing for Multi-Object Motion Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39478)
*Yuze Li,Fuchen Long,Xinlong Sun,Cheng Yan,Xinyu Zhang,Xi Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RART 将物体级运动提取、目标区域锚定与帧对齐注入统一到冻结的视频 Diffusion Transformer 中，实现多物体组合式运动迁移，无需逐视频优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 组合式运动迁移需从多个参考视频提取运动并分别施加到目标场景中用户指定的物体。现有方法难以将不同参考运动可靠地分配到正确目标物体，易产生物体间串扰；且部分运动特化微调方法在参考视频变化时需重新优化，重复迁移效率低。

Method: 对每个参考运动，从掩码参考视频中提取时序有序特征，并以目标首帧掩码为条件生成“掩码锚定运动 token”；引入帧对齐运动交叉注意力，使每个生成帧仅读取对应时间槽的运动 token，在单次去噪过程中组合所有物体运动；训练时使用运动注意力路由损失，促使各目标区域关注其对应运动 token 并抑制物体间干扰；整个框架构建于冻结的视频 DiT 之上。

Result: 实验表明 RART 在运动保真度、推理效率和组合泛化能力上均表现良好，并可处理未见过的参考—目标组合而无需逐视频优化。

Conclusion: 通过将运动提取、区域锚定与帧对齐注入统一于冻结视频扩散 Transformer，并结合注意力路由约束，RART 有效缓解了多物体运动串扰与重复优化问题，为高效组合式运动迁移提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Compositional motion transfer requires a model to extract motions from multiple reference videos, and apply each motion to a user-specified object in one target scene. Existing methods normally struggle to reliably assign different reference motions to the correct target objects, thus a motion intended for one object may affect another. Meanwhile, some motion-specific tuning approaches are still facing another issue: they must run a new optimization whenever the reference video changes, making repeated transfers inefficient. To address these limitations, we propose RART, a framework that unifies object-wise motion extraction, target-region anchoring, and frame-aligned injection into a frozen video Diffusion Transformer for multi-object motion transfer. For each reference motion, RART extracts temporally ordered features from the masked reference video, and then conditions them on the target first-frame mask to form mask-anchored motion tokens. Frame-aligned motion cross-attention allows each generated frame to read only the motion tokens at the corresponding time slots, composing all object motions in one denoising process. During training, a motion-attention routing loss encourages each target region to attend to its corresponding motion tokens and reduces interference between objects. Therefore, RART can handle novel reference-target combinations without per-video optimization. Experiments show that RART achieves accurate motion preservation, efficient inference, and strong compositional generalization.

</details>


### [130] [Cross-Encoder Anchor Refinement for Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39727)
*Kaisong Ji,Ziyang Xu,Chang Bian,Yu Zhou,Wenyu Liu,Xinggang Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出跨编码器锚点细化框架CEAR，在原型构建前的锚点阶段融合ViT与工业预训练CNN的互补表征，在13个工业与医学数据集68项评测中57项最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 零样本异常检测需将辅助域学到的判别能力迁移到未见类别并定位细微缺陷，核心难点在于构建同时具备上下文表征与局部证据的判别性参考（原型）。

Method: CEAR在锚点阶段连接两条视觉编码路径：以面向工业产品识别的独立卷积编码器构建图像特异性记忆，并在选定的多个ViT层间共享；从ViT patch特征读取的空间锚点经交叉注意力查询该记忆并进行残差细化；随后由图像条件化的正常/异常查询门控锚点聚合，构建原型用于异常打分。

Result: 在13个工业与医学数据集的68项评测中57项取得最佳；44项像素级比较中41项超越现有SOTA。11个定位数据集上像素级最大F1与平均精度分别平均提升4.45与3.79个百分点。

Conclusion: 在锚点阶段进行跨编码器交互可有效整合互补视觉表征，实现跨域细粒度异常定位，说明原型构建前的表征融合是提升零样本检测性能的关键切入点。

Abstract: Zero-shot anomaly detection aims to transfer anomaly discrimination from auxiliary training domains to unseen categories while localizing subtle defects. A key challenge is to construct discriminative references that combine contextual representations with complementary local evidence. We present Cross-Encoder Anchor Refinement (CEAR), which connects two visual encoding paths for the same image at the anchor stage, before normal and anomalous prototypes are constructed. An independent convolutional encoder pretrained for industrial product recognition builds an image-specific memory shared across selected vision transformer (ViT) layers. Spatial anchors read from ViT patch features query this memory through cross-attention and undergo residual refinement. Image-conditioned normal and anomalous queries then gate anchor aggregation to construct prototypes for anomaly scoring. Across 13 industrial and medical datasets, CEAR achieves the best performance in 57 of 68 evaluations spanning image-level detection and pixel-level localization. Notably, CEAR surpasses all other state-of-the-art methods in 41 of 44 pixel-level comparisons. Across 11 localization datasets, mean gains in pixel-level maximum F1 score and average precision are 4.45 and 3.79 percentage points, respectively. This study shows how cross-encoder interaction at the anchor stage can integrate complementary visual representations for fine-grained anomaly localization across domains.

</details>


### [131] [NIF: Normal-Intersection Fields for Geometrically Consistent Oriented Box Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39715)
*Shaokai Zheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出NIF精炼模块，用边界锚点处的法向交点场与可靠度加权最小二乘拟合替代额外框回归器，以极少参数（0.132M）解析恢复精炼定向框，在多个旋转目标检测数据集上取得SOTA或显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 定向检测要求框贴合目标边界，但标准回归头从池化区域表示直接预测中心、尺寸与角度这三个耦合参数；参数间的微小误差即使分类正确也会使长边发生位移，导致边界偏移误差放大。

Method: NIF不增加额外框回归器，而是在给定粗定向框的20个边界锚点处观测局部特征，预测沿外法向的有符号距离；这些观测在五个几何变量上具有精确仿射表示，通过可微、可靠度加权的最小二乘拟合将预测场投影到该表示并解析恢复精炼矩形。采用切向池化保留法向位置剖面，共享投影使新增网络仅0.132M参数。

Result: DOTA-v1.0上，分别结合Oriented R-CNN、LSKNet-S、Strip R-CNN达到78.00%、79.11%、79.02% mAP，取得表1最高单尺度SOTA；DIOR-R达68.19%，较匹配FAIR1M/DIOR-R基线提升0.30/0.68%；HRSC平均IoU由0.867升至0.888，场误差降低24.5%。在四个冻结检测器框架下，相对AP75提升1.57–4.18%，COCO风格mAP提升0.42–3.74%，无需重训检测器。

Conclusion: 以法向交点场替代直接框回归、结合解析最小二乘拟合的轻量精炼方案，可即插即用地提升多种旋转检测框架的定位精度，参数开销极低且无需检测器重训。

Abstract: Accurate oriented detection requires a box to follow object boundaries, yet a standard regression head predicts its center, size, and angle from a pooled region representation. Small errors in these coupled parameters can displace long boundaries even when the object is correctly classified. We propose NIF, a refinement module that replaces an additional box regressor with normal-intersection fields. Given a coarse oriented box, the module observes local features at 20 boundary anchors and predicts signed distances along their outward normals. These observations admit an exact affine representation in five geometric variables. A differentiable, reliability-weighted least-squares fit projects the predicted field onto this representation and analytically recovers a refined rectangle. Tangential pooling preserves the normal position profile, while shared projection limits the added network to 0.132M parameters. On DOTA-v1.0, NIF reaches 78.00%, 79.11%, and 79.02% mAP with Oriented R-CNN, LSKNet-S, and Strip R-CNN, respectively, achieving the highest single-scale SOTA result in Table 1. It reaches 68.19% on DIOR-R, improves matched FAIR1M/DIOR-R baselines by 0.30/0.68%, and raises HRSC mean IoU from 0.867 to 0.888 while reducing field error by 24.5%. Across four different detector frameworks with the detectors frozen, relative AP75 improves by 1.57-4.18% and COCO-style mAP by 0.42-3.74%, without detector retraining. Code is available at https://github.com/zsk466991125-collab/Normal-Intersection-Fields.

</details>


### [132] [AB-Attention: Accurate Block Attention for Accelerating Video Diffusion Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39663)
*Bin Xu,Mo Zhang,Zhengfeiyang Zhang,Xinfeng Yang,Yixing Ma,Wei Wang,HeXin Wang,Pengfei Zhou,Wangbo Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练AB-Attention，通过块内聚类选择器、包含概率加权采样与精细kernel，在高稀疏度下精确逼近稠密3D注意力，跳过89–92%注意力计算并实现最高2.23倍端到端加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频扩散Transformer中3D全注意力的二次成本主导推理开销。现有动态块稀疏注意力在激进稀疏下有保真度问题：块重要性由粗粒度摘要估计或依赖昂贵的全局聚类获得；被剪枝块从softmax中消失；整块保留/丢弃即使块内仅少数key重要。

Method: 免训练的Accurate Block Attention（AB-Attention）：(1) Intra-Block Clustering Selector（IBCS）仅在每个query块内对query聚类，无需置换token，廉价且准确地估计块重要性；(2) Sampling with Inclusion-Probability Weighting（SIP）按估计比例采样块并以逆包含概率重加权，使单次遍历成为稠密注意力的估计而非截断；(3) kernel将小于tile的key/value块聚合为完整tensor-core tile，在不增加tensor-core成本下细化选择。

Result: 在Wan2.1与HunyuanVideo上，AB-Attention跳过89–92%的注意力计算，而基线计算量为1.8–3.6倍；相对最强基线PSNR最高提升4.4 dB，端到端加速最高2.23倍。

Conclusion: AB-Attention以采样估计取代截断式稀疏，可在高稀疏度下稳健逼近稠密注意力，兼顾保真度与效率，且无需训练即可用于现有视频扩散Transformer。

Abstract: Video diffusion transformers generate high-quality videos, but the quadratic cost of 3D full attention dominates their inference. Dynamic block-sparse attention reduces this cost by computing exact attention only on key/value blocks selected from current activations. However, its fidelity degrades under aggressive sparsity: blocks are scored from coarse summaries or formed by costly global clustering, pruned blocks vanish from the softmax, and whole tiles are kept or dropped even when only a few of their keys matter. To address these limitations, we propose Accurate Block Attention (AB-Attention), a training-free method that accurately approximates dense attention at high sparsity. Its Intra-Block Clustering Selector (IBCS) estimates block importance faithfully yet cheaply by clustering queries only within each query block, without permuting tokens. Sampling with Inclusion-Probability Weighting (SIP) then samples blocks in proportion to these estimates and reweights them by inverse inclusion probability, so that one pass estimates dense attention rather than truncating it. Finally, its kernel gathers key/value blocks much smaller than a tile into full tensor-core tiles, refining selection at no extra tensor-core cost. On Wan2.1 and HunyuanVideo, AB-Attention skips 89--92\% of attention, whereas the baselines compute 1.8--3.6$\times$ as much, yet it still improves PSNR by up to 4.4~dB over the strongest baseline and achieves up to 2.23$\times$ end-to-end speedup. Our code is available at https://github.com/InfRec-Cardinal/AB-Attention.

</details>


### [133] [FlexTry-On: A Time-Efficient Framework for Multi-Scenario Virtual Try-on](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39646)
*Phuong Dam,Quyen Nguyen Duc,Son Hoang Minh,Daeyoung Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 FlexTry-On，一个统一的扩散式虚拟试穿框架，用统一条件表示与双条件 DiT 覆盖 cloth-to-person、person-to-person、跨域与 in-the-wild 场景，并保持快速推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有虚拟试穿方法多为特定场景设计（如 cloth-to-person 或 person-to-person），不同设置需要各自的条件策略与处理流程，缺乏统一且高效的方案。

Method: 采用统一的条件公式化：1）文本感知的条件提取策略，将异构服装源转换为统一表示；2）双条件扩散 Transformer（DiT）联合建模服装外观与人物身份。

Result: 在 cloth-to-person 与 person-to-person 基准上取得有竞争力的性能，同时保持快速推理；同一框架可直接用于未见过的跨域场景，无需单独架构或场景专用处理流程。

Conclusion: 统一且高效的虚拟试穿框架具备可行性，可作为迈向更灵活、更广泛适用试穿系统的实用一步。

Abstract: Virtual try-on has achieved remarkable progress in recent years, yet most existing methods are designed for a specific scenario, such as cloth-to-person or person-to-person try-on, and often require separate conditioning strategies and processing pipelines for different settings. We present FlexTry-On, a unified and time-efficient diffusion-based framework for diverse virtual try-on scenarios, including cloth-to-person, person-to-person, cross-domain, and in-the-wild settings. FlexTry-On adopts a common conditioning formulation, where a text-aware condition extraction strategy converts heterogeneous garment sources into a unified representation, and a dual-conditioning diffusion transformer jointly models garment appearance and person identity. Extensive experiments demonstrate competitive performance on both cloth-to-person and person-to-person benchmarks while maintaining fast inference. Moreover, the same framework can be directly applied to unseen cross-domain scenarios without requiring separate architectures or scenario-specific processing pipelines. These results highlight the potential of unified and efficient virtual try-on frameworks as a practical step toward more flexible and widely applicable virtual try-on systems.

</details>


### [134] [Operator-Aware Posterior Sampling for Multivariate Weather Downscaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39592)
*Carlo Saccardi,Rudolf Saathof,Geethu Joseph,Justin Dauwels*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 将统计降尺度建模为贝叶斯逆问题，在引导环节学习前向算子并按通道归一化梯度，从而提升扩散先验对异构数据源的适应性与跨变量的引导稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于扩散先验的贝叶斯逆问题框架能解耦先验与粗分辨率源，使单一预训练模型适配多种源；但存在两点限制灵活性：(1) 当粗场与目标场来自不同再分析系统时，无固定粗化算子能刻画其关系；(2) 不同变量的引导梯度量级可相差数个数量级，单一引导强度无效。

Method: 在引导循环内处理上述两个问题，保持先验不变：从配对数据中学习前向算子（operator-aware），并对梯度按通道归一化；理论上证明该归一化等价于块最大值范数（block-max norm）下的最速下降，从而支持跨变量使用统一引导强度。

Result: 所提方法在无需修改先验的前提下，缓解了跨再分析系统关系不可用固定算子刻画的问题，并使单一引导强度在变量间均有效；代码已公开。

Conclusion: 通过数据驱动的前向算子学习与基于块最大值范数的最速下降式梯度归一化，可在引导环节内同时解决算子失配与梯度尺度异质性，增强扩散降尺度框架的灵活性，且不改变预训练先验。

Abstract: Statistical downscaling is the task of reconstructing high-resolution meteorological fields from coarse inputs. A principled approach formulates downscaling as a Bayesian inverse problem, using a diffusion prior over high-resolution fields and incorporating the coarse field only at inference through a likelihood. This decouples the prior from the coarse source, allowing one pretrained model to adapt to different sources. However, two challenges limit this flexibility: (1) when coarse and target fields come from different reanalysis systems, no fixed coarsening operator can capture their relationship; and (2) guidance gradients can differ by orders of magnitude across variables, making a single guidance strength ineffective. This paper addresses both challenges within the guidance loop, leaving the prior unchanged. We learn the forward operator from paired data and normalize the gradient per channel. We show that this normalization corresponds to steepest descent under a block-max norm, allowing a single guidance strength across variables. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/CarloSaccardi/operator-aware-weather-downscaling.

</details>


### [135] [Comprehensive empirical evaluation of feature extractors in computer vision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39551)
*Murat Isik*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文对SIFT、SURF、BRIEF、ORB、BRISK、KAZE、AKAZE、FREAK、DAISY、FAST、STAR等传统特征检测与描述子进行系统评测，基于IMC 2020数据集，从架构复杂度、计算效率与多变换鲁棒性角度给出选型建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 特征检测与匹配是计算机视觉的基础环节，传统方法种类繁多且性能差异显著，但缺乏在统一数据集与统一评价流程下对检测器架构复杂度、计算效率与多种几何/光度变换鲁棒性的系统性对比，导致实际应用中方法选型缺乏依据。

Method: 以Image Matching Challenge Photo Tourism 2020（含超150万张图像）为基准数据，对SIFT、SURF、BRIEF、ORB、BRISK、KAZE、AKAZE、FREAK、DAISY、FAST、STAR逐一分析其架构设计与算法复杂度；在旋转、缩放、模糊、亮度增强、仿射变换、透视畸变、鱼眼畸变、椒盐噪声等条件下，搭配BF暴力匹配器进行超过200万次对比实验，统计特征提取/匹配速度与匹配鲁棒性。

Result: FAST检测器配合ORB描述子与Brute-Force匹配器取得最快特征提取与匹配速度，为效率最优组合；ORB在仿射变换与亮度增强图像上表现突出；AKAZE在模糊、鱼眼畸变、图像旋转与透视畸变条件下优势明显。

Conclusion: 传统特征方法不存在普适最优解：效率优先场景宜采用FAST+ORB+BF；几何与退化条件下宜采用AKAZE，光度（亮度）与仿射条件下宜采用ORB。研究为不同应用条件下特征提取器的选择提供了实证依据。

Abstract: Feature detection and matching are fundamental components in computer vision, underpinning a broad spectrum of applications. This study offers a comprehensive evaluation of traditional feature detections and descriptors, analyzing methods such as Scale Invariant Feature Transform (SIFT), Speeded-Up Robust Features (SURF), Binary Robust Independent Elementary Features (BRIEF), Oriented FAST and Rotated BRIEF (ORB), Binary Robust Invariant Scalable Keypoints (BRISK), KAZE, Accelerated KAZE (AKAZE), Fast Retina Keypoint (FREAK), Dense and Accurate Invariant Scalable descriptor for Yale (DAISY), Features from Accelerated Segment Test (FAST), and STAR. Each feature extractor was assessed based on its architectural design and complexity, focusing on how these factors influence computational efficiency and robustness under various transformations. Utilizing the Image Matching Challenge Photo Tourism 2020 dataset, which includes over 1.5 million images, the study identifies the FAST algorithm as the most efficient detector when paired with the ORB descriptor and Brute-Force (BF) matcher, offering the fastest feature extraction and matching process. ORB is notably effective on affine transformed and brightened images, while AKAZE excels in conditions involving blurring, fisheye distortion, image rotation, and perspective distortions. Through more than 2 million comparisons, the study highlights the feature extractors that demonstrate superior resilience across various conditions, including rotation, scaling, blurring, brightening, affine transformations, perspective distortions, fisheye distortion, and salt-and-pepper noise

</details>


### [136] [Robust LIDAR Sensor-to-Sensor Domain Generalization via Accumulated-Point Scene Completion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39516)
*Christoph B Rist,Larissa T Triess,Markus Enzweiler,Dariu M Gavrila*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种仅用源域数据训练的LiDAR语义分割域泛化方法：引入基于源域扫描聚合世界模型的占用预测辅助任务替代单帧分割监督，不改变输入、不增加推理开销，可提升对新传感器的泛化性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实LiDAR数据具有传感器特定的采样模式，导致模型跨数据集（尤其面对完全未见的新传感器）迁移困难；而应用中希望模型在没有目标域数据、标签或传感器先验的情况下直接部署。

Method: 源域-only训练方案：将源域多帧扫描聚合为简单世界模型，用其生成占用预测的辅助监督信号，替代传统单帧分割训练；输入仍为单帧LiDAR，仅监督信号被增强。辅助头可在部署时丢弃（纯分割）或保留（同时输出场景补全与语义分割），源域训练与测试输入保持一致。

Result: 在多个不同LiDAR数据集上的实验表明，监督方式显著影响跨域泛化；某些设置下无需任何显式域适应（无目标扫描、无目标标签、无传感器先验）和预测细化即可提升未见域性能，同时保持有竞争力的源域分割精度且无额外推理成本。

Conclusion: 通过丰富监督信号（占用预测）而非修改输入或做域适应，可有效改善LiDAR语义分割的域泛化，是一种无推理开销、易部署的源域-only方案。

Abstract: We study domain generalization for LIDAR semantic segmentation. Deep neural networks achieve strong performance on 3D point clouds, yet real-world LIDAR exhibits sensor-specific sampling patterns that hinder transfer across datasets. In many applications, performance on completely unseen sensors is crucial. A model should preferably work on a new setup without prior access to its data or labels. To this end, we introduce a source-only training scheme that adds an occupancy prediction auxiliary objective. We aggregate source-domain scans into a simple world model and use it as the supervision signal, replacing single-scan standard segmentation training.
  A key property of our approach is that it does not alter the input scan. During training and testing the network consumes the same single-frame LIDAR input, only the supervision signal is enriched via the occupancy objective. At deployment, there is no runtime overhead as the auxiliary head can be dropped for pure segmentation, or kept to obtain scene completion alongside semantic segmentation. In an experimental evaluation across distinct LIDAR datasets, we demonstrate that a model's generalization to new domains can be significantly affected by how it is supervised. In certain setups, performance on unseen domains improves without any explicit domain adaptation (no target scans, no target labels, no sensor priors) and without prediction refinement. At the same time, our method maintains competitive source-domain segmentation performance and incurs no additional inference cost.

</details>


### [137] [Agent-Wise Test-Time Normalization for Camera-Based Cooperative Perception with Corrupted Collaborators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39505)
*Yu Wang,Shaohua Wang,Yicheng Li,Kecheng Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 AgentNorm：无参数、无梯度、无标签的逐智能体测试时归一化，解决协同感知中仅协作者相机退化时批次统计量混合污染干净 ego 的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 中间融合协同感知依赖协作者共享特征；当仅协作者相机受雾、运动模糊或曝光误差退化时，其特征偏离训练分布，而 ego 输入仍干净。标准免训练补救方案（测试时批归一化）在所有智能体合并批次上估计统计量，用两种分布的混合去归一化干净 ego 与退化协作者，反而损害 ego 自身检测性能（自特征检测下降 3.58–6.68 AP@0.5）。

Method: AgentNorm 采用逐智能体的测试时归一化：(i) 每个协作者仅依据自身当前观测估计归一化统计量；(ii) 将 ego 锚定到其源统计量，使 ego 通路与原模型完全一致。方法不含可学习参数，不需要梯度或标签，与测试帧顺序无关，各智能体本地运行且不改变传输的特征。

Result: 在相机版 OPV2V（四个融合检查点、仅协作者受腐蚀）上，severity-5 雾下 AP@0.5 由 29.42–37.25 提升至 43.32–58.86；雾与运动模糊下较 pooled normalization 高 5.53–12.94 点；每帧额外延迟 2.3 ms。真实数据集 DAIR-V2X-C 上，十种基础设施腐蚀设置全部优于 pooled normalization。未解决的情形：遮挡（移除图像内容而非偏移统计量）以及所有智能体共享同一偏移。

Conclusion: 联合批次统计量是协同感知测试时自适应的关键缺陷，逐智能体归一化并锚定 ego 是简单有效的免训练方案；对内容缺失型退化与全局一致偏移仍存在局限。

Abstract: Intermediate-fusion cooperative perception lets a vehicle detect objects beyond its own field of view by fusing features shared by nearby agents. When only a collaborator's cameras are degraded by fog, motion blur or exposure errors, the features it shares drift away from the training distribution while the ego input stays clean, and cooperation can become worse than not cooperating at all. Test-time batch-normalization adaptation, the standard training-free remedy, estimates statistics over the pooled batch of all agents and therefore normalizes both the clean ego and the corrupted collaborator with a mixture of two distributions. We show that this mixing harms even the clean ego: when the ego shares BN statistics with a corrupted collaborator, its detection from its own features drops by 3.58 to 6.68 AP@0.5 points although its cameras are untouched. We propose AgentNorm, an agent-wise test-time normalization that i) estimates the normalization statistics of every collaborator from its own current observation and ii) anchors the ego to its source statistics, so that the ego path remains exactly the original model. AgentNorm has no learnable parameters, needs no gradients or labels, is independent of the order of test frames, and runs locally on each agent without changing the transmitted features. On camera-based OPV2V with four fusion checkpoints and collaborator-only corruptions, AgentNorm raises AP@0.5 under severity-5 fog from 29.42-37.25 to 43.32-58.86 and outperforms pooled normalization by 5.53-12.94 points under fog and motion blur, at an extra latency of 2.3 ms per frame. On the real-world DAIR-V2X-C dataset, it outperforms pooled normalization in all ten infrastructure-corruption settings. We also report the cases it does not fix: occlusion, which removes image content rather than shifting feature statistics, and the case in which all agents share the same shift.

</details>


### [138] [MLLM-GS: Multimodal Large Language Model Prior-Guided Fast Novel View Synthesis in Extreme Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39936)
*Zhiliang Wu,Xinye Zheng,Kun Li,Fei Wang,Hao Guo,Yanyan Wei,Guanghui Yue,Beier Zhu,Wei Zhou,Xun Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MLLM-GS：利用冻结多模态大模型(MLLM)的视觉先验增强退化视图，并配合轻量校正网络消除像素错位与色偏，再以优化的3DGS实现极端环境下快速、高质量的novel view synthesis。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 退化场景下的新视角合成（NVS）需从受多种退化的多视图观测重建3D场景。现有方法多为退化专用模型，跨极端环境泛化差；生成模型虽有丰富视觉先验，但输出存在像素错位与颜色偏差，会传播进3D重建；且3D重建计算与内存开销大，限制实际应用。

Method: 提出MLLM-GS双分支框架：(1) MLLM先验引导视图增强分支——利用冻结MLLM的丰富视觉先验增强严重退化视图，并引入轻量校正网络减少MLLM输出的像素偏移与颜色失真；仅需少量成对干净视图监督，即可为所有退化观测生成可靠增强视图，作为后续3D重建的伪GT。(2) 快速3D场景重建分支——通过优化光栅化、高斯内存布局与参数更新，减少冗余计算、访存开销与优化成本，提升3DGS效率。

Result: 在多种退化场景上的大量实验表明，MLLM-GS能有效处理各类严重退化，实现高质量NVS，且重建时间与内存消耗显著降低。

Conclusion: 以冻结MLLM先验+轻量校正替代退化专用模型，兼顾跨退化泛化与可靠性；结合高效3DGS优化，使极端环境下的NVS在质量与效率上同时受益，具备较强实用价值。

Abstract: Novel view synthesis (NVS) in degraded scenes aims to reconstruct 3D scenes from multi-view observations affected by various degradations, and to generate clear and photorealistic images at unseen viewpoints. Despite recent advances, existing methods often rely on degradation-specific models, limiting their generalization across diverse extreme environments. Generative models provide rich visual priors, but their outputs often suffer from pixel misalignment and color deviations, which can propagate into the reconstructed 3D scene and compromise reconstruction quality. Furthermore, the high computational and memory costs of 3D reconstruction hinder the practical application of NVS in extreme environments. To this end, we propose MLLM-GS, a multimodal large language model (MLLM) prior-guided framework for fast NVS in extreme environments. MLLM-GS consists of two branches: MLLM prior-guided view enhancement and fast 3D scene reconstruction. The former leverages the rich visual priors of a frozen MLLM to enhance views under different severe degradations and introduces a lightweight correction network to reduce pixel shifts and color distortions in MLLM outputs. With supervision from only a few paired clean views, this branch produces reliable enhanced views for all degraded observations, providing pseudo-GT views for subsequent 3D reconstruction. The latter improves 3DGS efficiency by optimizing rasterization, Gaussian memory layout, and parameter updates, reducing redundant computation, memory-access overhead, and optimization costs. Extensive experiments on multiple degraded scenes demonstrate that MLLM-GS effectively handles various severe degradations and achieves high-quality NVS with significantly lower reconstruction time and memory consumption. Project Page: https://wzlwlm13.github.io/MLLM-GS

</details>


### [139] [PhysAg3D: Bridging 3D Generative and Agentic Models for High-Fidelity and Physically-Interactive Assets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39924)
*Bi'an Du,Fanpeng Meng,Jiemin Fang,Chen Yang,Pufan Li,Daizong Liu,Qi Tian,Wei Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PhysAg3D框架，将3D生成模型与视觉语言智能体的推理和工具调用耦合，从单张图像生成兼具真实外观、保真几何与合理物理交互（刚性关节或柔性形变）的可交互3D资产。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单图生成交互式3D资产需同时满足外观真实、忠于所描绘物体、物理行为合理三点，但精细几何本身并不能决定物体应如何运动或形变，缺乏交互结构与物理先验。

Method: 视觉语言智能体先从图像推断语义部件、候选交互与物理先验；3D生成器从同一图像产出带纹理的整体网格；用分层交互表示把可修正的先验与机构及其控制的表面关联起来；智能体在该表示与网格观测引导下调用几何与物理工具，构建部件、关节、形变区域和表面绑定，并保留生成几何与材质；以渲染交互和执行测量在固定预算内引导定向修正；统一支持刚性铰接与柔顺形变。

Result: 在真实照片与外部基准上的定量与定性评估表明，可生成细节丰富、与图像对齐且交互合理的资产；消融实验验证了有界精修与源表面保持的有效性。

Conclusion: 将生成式3D与智能体式推理/工具使用结合，可在保留生成几何与材质的前提下由单图获得物理可信的可交互资产，分层交互表示与预算约束下的工具化精修是可行且有效的路径。

Abstract: Generating interactive 3D assets from a single image requires realistic appearance, fidelity to the depicted object, and plausible physical behavior. Yet detailed geometry alone does not determine how an object should move or deform. We introduce PhysAg3D, which couples 3D generative models with agentic reasoning and tool use. A vision-language agent first infers semantic parts, candidate interactions, and physical priors from the image; a 3D generator then produces a textured whole-object mesh from the same image. A hierarchical interaction representation links these revisable priors to mechanisms and the generated surfaces they control, organizing interaction construction and refinement. Guided by this representation and observations of the mesh, the agent uses geometric and physical tools to construct parts, joints, deformable regions, and surface bindings while retaining useful generated geometry and materials. Rendered interactions and execution measurements guide targeted revisions within a fixed budget. The framework accommodates both rigid articulation and compliant deformation. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations on real photographs and external benchmarks demonstrate detailed, image-aligned assets with plausible interactions. Ablations support bounded refinement and source-surface preservation. Project Page: supra-3d.github.io/PhysAg3D.

</details>


### [140] [sDMD: Sinkhorn Distribution Matching Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39889)
*Jaihoon Kim,Lingxiao Li,Soshi Shimada,Roshni Cooper,Minhyuk Sung,Yiwei Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文将DMD与Wasserstein梯度流联系，用积分KL（IKL）作为能量泛函推导其梯度；在此基础上引入Sinkhorn散度构成的最优传输项以缓解低密度区teacher score不可靠与模式坍塌，并提出sDMD用判别器输出自适应激活Sinkhorn修正；在FLUX.1-dev等模型上2–4步采样取得更优指标与多样性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DMD通过最小化反向KL将多步扩散模型蒸馏为少步生成器，但其仅依赖局部密度引导采样，存在两处缺陷：(1) 在teacher密度较低区域，teacher score不可靠；(2) 反向KL的模式寻求性会使student坍缩到teacher模式的一个子集。作者希望在不破坏已有准确引导的前提下兼顾离群样本修正与模式覆盖。

Method: 首先建立DMD与Wasserstein梯度流的联系，证明其梯度可由以积分KL（IKL）为能量泛函的不动点形式导出。据此在IKL上增补一个最优传输项，用有限批次估计的Sinkhorn散度实现，以引导离群样本趋向目标分布并促进模式覆盖。针对估计的Sinkhorn速度误差可能扰动IKL引导已准确的域内样本这一问题，提出sDMD，依据判别器输出自适应地激活Sinkhorn修正，仅作用于IKL可能不可靠的离群样本。

Result: 在FLUX.1-dev、Qwen-Image-20B与Wan2.1-14B上以2–4步采样，sDMD在GenEval、DPG、WISE与VBench上均优于蒸馏基线，且相较DMD2提升了样本多样性。

Conclusion: 以Wasserstein梯度流视角理解DMD可自然导出IKL能量泛函，并在其上加注最优传输项；有限批次Sinkhorn估计的噪声可通过基于判别器的自适应门控加以抑制。由此得到的sDMD在少步图像与视频生成中同时改善质量与多样性。

Abstract: Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) distills multi-step diffusion models into few-step generators by minimizing reverse KL divergence. Despite its strong performance, DMD guides samples by local density alone, which introduces two limitations: teacher scores can be unreliable in regions of low teacher density, and the mode-seeking behavior of reverse KL can collapse the student onto a subset of the teacher modes. We first connect DMD to Wasserstein gradient flow, showing that its gradient follows from a fixed-point formulation with integral KL (IKL) as the energy functional. This perspective motivates augmenting IKL with an optimal transport term that addresses these limitations by guiding outlier samples toward the target and promoting mode coverage. We realize this term using Sinkhorn divergence estimated from finite batches. In practice, however, errors in the estimated Sinkhorn velocity can perturb in-domain samples for which IKL guidance is already accurate. To this end, we introduce sDMD, which adaptively activates the Sinkhorn correction based on discriminator outputs, focusing on outlier samples where IKL may be unreliable. With 2--4 sampling steps on FLUX.1-dev, Qwen-Image-20B, and Wan2.1-14B, sDMD outperforms distillation baselines on GenEval, DPG, WISE, and VBench while improving sample diversity over DMD2.

</details>


### [141] [Read, Allocate, Route: Role-Coupled Tokenization for Pixel-Space Generative Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40647)
*Jiongfan Yang,Weichen Fan,Haiwen Diao,Zhongang Cai,Ziwei Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SpecSlot 提出一种像素空间 rectified-flow Transformer，将每个空间锚点扩展为多个 DCT 系数分带的 slot，使低频 slot 参与全局注意力、所有 slot 局部交互，从而在不增加全局注意力序列长度的前提下提升生成细节，并保持像素空间的生成状态、目标与损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 像素空间生成式 Transformer 通常每个图像块用一个 token，捕捉更细细节需增加 token 数，导致全局注意力代价剧增。作者观察到更细的细节并不必然需要更多全局通信：低频结构适合全局交换，高频细节可局部建模。

Method: 将每个空间锚点扩展为多个 slot，每个 slot 分配一组不相交的 DCT 系数频带，从而将锚点密度与频谱细分解耦；仅每个锚点的最低频 slot 参与全局注意力，所有 slot 进行局部交互；额外引入空间头对频谱预测做局部修正；生成状态、目标与损失仍保持在像素空间。

Result: ImageNet-256 上与 FLOPs 匹配的 JiT 对照相比最终 FID 相当但收敛更快；ImageNet-512 上 FID 提升 2.84 且 FLOPs 少 3.9%，与 JiT-B/16 仅差 0.69 FID 而成本低 38.2%；文本到图像任务在 DPG-Bench 上超过 JiT-B/8 达 1.06，前向成本低 40.6%。

Conclusion: 通过频谱分带的 slot 设计解耦细节与全局注意力序列长度，SpecSlot 在保持或提升生成质量的同时显著降低计算成本，验证了"高频局部、低频全局"的建模假设的有效性。

Abstract: Pixel-space generative Transformers typically use one token per image patch, so capturing finer detail requires more tokens and makes global attention increasingly expensive. We observe that finer detail does not necessarily require more global communication: low-frequency structure benefits from global exchange, while high-frequency detail can be modeled locally. Based on this insight, we introduce SpecSlot, a pixel-space rectified-flow Transformer that decouples output detail from the length of the global attention sequence. SpecSlot expands each spatial anchor into multiple slots, each assigned a disjoint band of DCT coefficients; this separates anchor density from spectral subdivision. Only the lowest-frequency slot from each anchor participates in global attention, while all slots interact locally.
