This allows the model to increase spectral detail without enlarging the global sequence. A spatial head further adds a local correction to the spectral prediction, while the generative state, target, and loss remain in pixel space. On ImageNet-256, SpecSlot achieves a comparable final FID to a FLOPs-matched JiT control while converging faster. On ImageNet-512, it improves FID by 2.84 over the control with 3.9% fewer FLOPs, and comes within only 0.69 FID of JiT-B/16 at 38.2% lower cost. On text-to-image generation, SpecSlot surpasses JiT-B/8 on DPG-Bench by 1.06 at 40.6% lower forward cost.

</details>


### [142] [RADIOlogy: A Single-Pass Approach to Training-Free Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40580)
*Joaquín Figueira,Giacomo D'Amicantonio,Egor Bondarau*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练单次前向的零样本异常检测方法RADIOlogy，利用视觉语言模型中多头注意力池化的涌现特性，通过对比正常/异常提示的平均相似度打分实现异常定位，并用RADIO模型的凝聚特征做稠密精细化分割。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有零样本异常检测依赖复杂提示学习或昂贵的滑窗策略来对齐细粒度视觉特征；根源在于标准CLIP的[CLS]注意力与空间patch池化难以捕捉细微局部异常。提示学习方法还需大量辅助数据集的真值分割掩码，在专业领域常不可得。

Method: 发现视觉语言模型多头注意力池化的涌现特性可"开箱即用"实现零样本异常定位与检测；据此设计单次前向（single-pass）检测流程，无需稠密滑窗执行，采用简单对比打分：比较视觉特征与一组正常/异常提示的平均相似度；并借助RADIO模型的凝聚特征（agglomerative features）构建稠密异常精细化流程以提升像素级分割。

Result: 显著优于其他免训练基线；在最小改动下即可将视觉语言免训练零样本异常检测技术族成功应用于医学领域；代码已开源。

Conclusion: 多头注意力池化蕴含着强零样本异常定位能力，可将免训练、单次前向的对比打分范式推广到医学等专业领域，避免依赖掩码标注与滑窗计算。

Abstract: Current zero-shot anomaly detection methods often rely on complex prompt-learning techniques or computationally expensive sliding-window strategies to achieve fine-grained visual alignment to detect small-scale anomalies. This reliance stems from the fundamental limitation of standard CLIP architectures, where [CLS] token attention and spatial patch pooling struggle to capture subtle, localized anomaly features. While prompt-learning approaches aim to bridge this gap, they typically require a large number of ground-truth segmentation masks from auxiliary datasets, which are often unavailable in specialized domains. In this work, we show an emerging property of multi-head attention pooling in vision-language models: remarkable zero-shot anomaly localization and detection right out of the box. We translate this property into a single-pass anomaly detection technique, RADIOlogy, that does not require dense, windowed execution and significantly outperforms other training-free baselines. Instead, the method relies on a simple contrastive scoring approach that compares the average similarity between vision features and a suite of normal and abnormal prompts. Furthermore, we leverage the agglomerative features of RADIO models to enhance pixel-level anomaly segmentation using a dense anomaly refinement pipeline. Finally, we show how the vision-language family of training-free zero-shot anomaly detection techniques can be applied successfully to the medical domain with minimal modifications. Code is available at https://github.com/jacomof/RADIOlogy.

</details>


### [143] [Accurate MRI-free PET Quantification and Reliability Assessment via CT-to-MRI Synthesis and Conformal Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40478)
*Jungwoo Seo,Seung Yun Choi,Kun Ho Lee,Seun Jeon,Byoung Seok Ye,Jiook Cha*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出"CT-to-MRI合成+保形预测"的无MRI淀粉样蛋白PET定量框架，用切片一致的布朗桥扩散模型生成合成MRI用于SUVR定量，并用保形预测给出可靠性区间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SUVR定量通常依赖受试者自身T1加权MRI进行解剖分割，但可用MRI并非总能获得，需要一种在缺失MRI时仍能可靠完成PET定量的方案，并且必须能评估结果可信度。

Method: 采用切片一致的布朗桥扩散模型（Brownian Bridge Diffusion Model）实现CT到MRI合成；通过多数据集训练与数据来源条件化增强解剖先验，并扩展多切片CT上下文以利用CT的层间解剖连续性；合成MRI用于FreeSurfer分割与PET定量；以深度集成不确定性经保形预测校准，估计真实MRI对应SUVR的合理区间。

Result: 在OASIS-3的11C-PiB PET上，合成与分割保真度均为对比方法中最优；平均皮层SUVR与真实MRI参考高度一致（MAE 0.016±0.015，r=0.9987），87例受试者在预设阈值下淀粉样蛋白阳性分类全部一致；保形预测经验覆盖率接近预设水平，90%目标覆盖下85/87例区间可支持明确阳性判定；外部队列零样本评估显示无需重训练即可支持PET定量，但保形校准需目标队列重校准以恢复预期覆盖。

Conclusion: CT-to-MRI合成支持的无MRI PET定量能提供准确SUVR并显式评估其可靠性，是有前景的替代方案；跨队列部署时需进行保形校准的域适应。

Abstract: Standardized uptake value ratio (SUVR) quantification of amyloid PET commonly relies on a subject-specific T1-weighted MRI, yet a usable MRI is not always available. We therefore combined CT-to-MRI synthesis with conformal prediction for MRI-free PET quantification with reliability assessment. A slice-consistent Brownian Bridge Diffusion Model was strengthened with multi-dataset training and data-source conditioning to enrich the anatomical prior learned from MRI, and with expanded multi-slice CT context to exploit the through-plane continuity of subject-specific anatomy in CT. Synthetic MRI was used for FreeSurfer-based anatomical parcellation and PET quantification, while deep-ensemble uncertainty was calibrated with conformal prediction to estimate a plausible range for the corresponding real MRI-based SUVR. On $^{11}$C-PiB PET from OASIS-3, the proposed method achieved the highest synthesis and parcellation fidelity among the compared methods. Mean cortical SUVR from the proposed synthetic MRI agreed closely with the real MRI-based reference (MAE $0.016 \pm 0.015$, Pearson $r = 0.9987$) and yielded the same amyloid-positivity classification as the real MRI in all 87 test subjects at the prespecified cut-off. Conformal prediction achieved empirical coverage close to the prespecified levels, and at 90% target coverage, 85 of 87 subjects had prediction intervals that supported an unambiguous amyloid-positivity decision. Zero-shot evaluation on an independent external cohort showed that the proposed CT-to-MRI model could support PET quantification without retraining, although conformal calibration required target-cohort recalibration to recover the intended coverage. These findings support CT-to-MRI-based MRI-free PET quantification as a promising approach for providing accurate SUVR measurements and an explicit assessment of their reliability.

</details>


### [144] [PhysInsert: Physically Plausible Object Insertion with Geometric Priors and Bidirectional Object-Scene Interactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40453)
*Yue Gong,Le Zhang,Rui Chen,Song Chang,Xiaochao Qu,Luoqi Liu,Ting Liu,Yebin Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PhysInsert框架，联合适配物体与场景实现物理合理的参考图物体插入，配套Insert World数据集与PhysInsert-Bench基准，在保真度、光照融合与位姿合理性上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有参考图物体插入方法依赖掩码输入、生成式配对或视角变化有限的训练对，导致位姿与光照适配、以及物体-场景双向交互的约束不足。

Method: 构建Insert World数据集（Blender渲染、严格对齐的反事实配对与跨视角/光照物体参考）；提出Geometry-Guided Adaptation，将VGGT几何流与图像、文本流在目标场景特征监督下耦合；引入2D Object-Scene Spatial Supervision，联合监督物体占用与环境变化，并通过图文注意力将空间指令绑定到物体区域。

Result: 在PhysInsert-Bench与DreamBooth上图像保真度提升；用户研究表明放置更准确，光照融合、透视与位姿合理性改善。

Conclusion: 通过多模态几何引导与双向物体-场景监督，可实现需光照与位姿适配的物理合理物体插入，超越单纯外观复制的效果。

Abstract: We present PhysInsert, a framework for physically plausible reference-based object insertion that jointly adapts objects and their surrounding scenes. Existing methods often rely on masked inputs, generation-based pairs, or training pairs with limited viewpoint variation, leaving pose and illumination adaptation and bidirectional object-scene interactions insufficiently constrained. We construct the Insert World dataset with strictly aligned Blender-rendered counterfactual pairs and object references across viewpoints and lighting conditions. Building on these data, Geometry-Guided Adaptation couples a VGGT geometry stream with image and text streams under target-scene feature supervision to guide spatially consistent insertion. Complementary 2D Object-Scene Spatial Supervision jointly supervises object occupancy and environmental changes while grounding spatial instructions in object regions through image-text attention. We introduce PhysInsert-Bench with dedicated cross-environment and cross-view cases requiring illumination and pose adaptation beyond appearance copying. Experiments on PhysInsert-Bench and DreamBooth demonstrate improved image fidelity; a user study further shows more accurate placement and improved lighting integration, perspective, and pose plausibility.

</details>


### [145] [SelfThinker: Self-Evolving Reasoning via Reliability-Verified Intrinsic Visual Thoughts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40115)
*Zhangquan Chen,Ruqi Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SelfThinker 是首个自进化框架，利用统一多模态模型自生成的"视觉思考"（辅助图像）来增强其理解能力，无需人工标注辅助图像，且推理时不生成中间图像。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉思维链方法依赖人工标注的辅助图像进行训练，且测试时需要缓慢的图像生成，限制了统一多模态模型将图像合成作为视觉理解监督信号的潜力。

Method: 给定视觉问题，从生成通路采样候选辅助图像，用冻结的理解通路通过条件点互信息（conditional PMI）对每个候选打分；高效用视觉思考通过 flow matching 精炼生成器，并作为特权教师上下文进行 on-policy 自蒸馏；推理时直接从原图进行文本推理，不生成中间图像。

Result: 仅在小型合成视觉搜索与导航数据集上训练，即可广泛迁移到自然图像与空间基准；ThinkMorph-7B 的七基准平均从 52.7 提升至 64.0（+11.3）；在受控图像扰动探针中，细粒度与空间感知任务上分别超过 ThinkMorph-7B 达 40.4 分、超过 BAGEL-7B 主干达 23.2 分。

Conclusion: 自生成的视觉思考可作为有效训练监督，实现统一模型的自进化，提升视觉理解且不增加推理期生成开销。

Abstract: Unified multimodal models can both generate and understand images within a single set of weights, offering an opportunity to use image synthesis as training supervision for visual comprehension. However, existing visual chain-of-thought methods rely on human-annotated helper images during training and require slow image generation at test time. We present SelfThinker, the first self-evolving framework that turns a unified model's self-generated visual thoughts into stronger understanding without human image annotations. Given a visual problem, SelfThinker samples candidate helper images from its generation pathway and uses its frozen understanding pathway to score each candidate via conditional pointwise mutual information. High-utility visual thoughts then refine the generator via flow matching and serve as privileged teacher context for on-policy self-distillation. At inference, SelfThinker reasons directly from the original image in text without generating intermediate images. Although trained only on small synthetic visual-search and navigation datasets, SelfThinker transfers broadly to natural-image and spatial benchmarks, raising the seven-benchmark average of ThinkMorph-7B from 52.7 to 64.0 (+11.3 points). Controlled image-perturbation probes further show that SelfThinker surpasses ThinkMorph-7B by up to 40.4 points and its pretrained BAGEL-7B backbone by up to 23.2 points across fine-grained and spatial perception tasks. Our code is available at https://github.com/zhangquanchen/SelfThinker.

</details>


### [146] [RFW-A: Agentic Procedural Generation of 400K Articulated Assets over 500 Categories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40333)
*Yuanbo Lyu,Changjian Pan,Saining Zhang,Yi Yang,Peishuo Li,Zhiheng Li,Jialu Liu,Junhao Chen,Jiawei Weng,Yupeng Gao,Weiqing Xiao,Wenyi Li,Jiarui Guo,Rui Zhang,Jingrun Du,Weiyi Lin,Zenan Meng,Hu Wei,Lin Qu,Zongzheng Zhang,Hao Zhao,Chaojian Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RFW-A 将智能体式合成与过程化生成结合：智能体一次性构造并验证类别级可复用生成器，随后过程化执行批量产出铰接资产；作者成本约 $10.62，分摊至 200 个资产后为 $0.05/资产（基线 $1.24/资产），并构建了覆盖 500+ 类别、超 40 万资产的 RFW-A-400K 数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高质量铰接资产对具身感知、仿真与操作至关重要，但规模化构建困难：人工标注与过程化建模耗费大量人力；现有智能体系统虽能通过程序合成自动化构建，却需对每个新资产重复昂贵的推理与精化。核心观察是同类资产虽在结构与外观上有差异，但共享构造逻辑，因此智能体合成与过程化生成具有互补性——前者构建可复用程序，后者跨样本复用该逻辑。

Method: 以已有铰接程序为起点，RFW-A 将可复用组件及其依赖组织为类别级生成器；智能体在采样得到的配置与运动状态下对生成器进行测试与迭代精化，验证通过后由过程化执行生成多样资产，无需额外模型调用或 token 开销。

Result: 生成器编写 API 成本平均 $10.62，200 个资产下摊薄至 $0.05/资产，对比采样式逐资产智能体合成的 $1.24。基于该方法构建的 RFW-A-400K 含 500+ 类别、40 万以上可仿真铰接资产；实验显示其结构与运动学有效性高、跨物理仿真器执行稳定；以该数据训练可提升已见与未见类别的部件级铰接估计，且在仿真中用检索与程序编辑资产训练的策略可零样本迁移到真实铰接物体。

Conclusion: 智能体合成与过程化生成的互补结合为铰接资产规模化生成提供了低成本、可复用、可验证的新范式，其产出的数据在资产有效性之外还实证了对感知训练与仿真到真实策略迁移的增益。

Abstract: High-quality articulated assets are essential for embodied perception, simulation, and manipulation, yet constructing them at scale remains difficult. Manual annotation and procedural modeling require substantial human effort. Recent agentic systems automate asset construction through program synthesis, but repeat costly reasoning and refinement for every new asset. Our key observation is that assets within a category can share construction logic despite variations in structure and appearance. Agentic synthesis and procedural generation are therefore complementary: agents can construct reusable programs, while procedural execution reuses the resulting logic across many samples. We therefore present RFW-A, which combines the two in a new articulated-asset generation paradigm. Starting from existing articulated programs, RFW-A organizes reusable components and their dependencies into category-level generators. Agents test and refine these generators across sampled configurations and motion states. Once constructed and validated, the generators produce diverse assets through procedural execution with no further model calls or token charges. The estimated API cost of generator authoring averages $10.62, amortizing to $0.05 per asset over 200 assets, versus $1.24 for the sampled per-asset agentic synthesis baseline. Using RFW-A, we built RFW-A-400K, containing over 400K sim-ready articulated assets across more than 500 categories. Experiments show high structural and kinematic validity and stable execution across physics simulators. Beyond asset validity, training with RFW-A-400K improves part-level articulation estimation on seen and unseen categories, while policies trained in simulation with retrieved and program-edited assets transfer zero-shot to real articulated objects.

</details>


### [147] [Self-training for cross-centre coronary vessel segmentation in X-ray angiography using pre-contrast frame subtraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40302)
*Danial Moafi,Aida Moafi,Mostafa Aryafar,Ashkan Sami,Maryam Aryafar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究在无额外人工标注的情况下，能否通过伪标签自训练提升冠脉血管分割模型的外部数据泛化性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: X 线血管造影冠脉分割模型在未参与训练的中心数据上性能明显下降；且最大公开数据集 ARCADE 的标注不完整（仅标注 SYNTAX 评分定义的分支段）。作者希望在不增加人工标注的前提下，评估自训练+伪标签能否改善外部数据表现。

Method: 伪标签来自两处：ARCADE 训练的 nnU-Net 预测，以及同一序列中造影前帧相减得到的对比度图。将 nnU-Net 预测沿对比度图扩展，仅在减影图中检测到、未被预测覆盖的像素赋予 ignore 标签并从损失中排除。在 ARCADE 及两个外部数据集（XCAD、XACV）上训练并测试 6 个模型，并与基线及同等轮数微调的对照模型比较；另进行第二轮自训练，以及用 50 张全标注图像训练的外部模型生成初始标签的实验。

Result: 以基线预测初始化的第一轮模型均优于基线及对照模型。XCAD 池训练的模型宏平均 Dice 提升 2.7 点（95% CI 2.3–3.2），对照模型下降 0.6 点。第二轮自训练无进一步提升。用 50 张全标注图像训练的外部模型生成初始标签时，未使用任何 XCAD 标签下 XCAD Dice 由 0.623 升至 0.745，但 XACV 因漏检粗大主血管而未改善。

Conclusion: 自训练的收益在很大程度上取决于生成初始伪标签所用模型的敏感度（召回能力）。

Abstract: Deep learning models for coronary vessel segmentation in X-ray angiography often perform poorly on data from centres that were not represented in training. Apart from differences in equipment, the labels of the largest public dataset (ARCADE) are incomplete, as only the segments defined in the SYNTAX score are annotated. In this study, we evaluated whether self-training with pseudo-labels can improve performance on external data without additional manual annotation. Pseudo-labels were generated from two sources, namely the predictions of an nnU-Net model trained on ARCADE and a contrast map obtained by subtracting a pre-contrast frame from the same sequence. The nnU-Net predictions were extended along the contrast map, and pixels detected only in the subtraction image were assigned an ignore label and excluded from the loss. Six models were trained and tested on ARCADE and on two external datasets (XCAD and XACV). All first-round models initialised with the baseline predictions performed better than both the baseline and a control model fine-tuned for the same number of epochs. The model trained on the XCAD pool improved the macro-averaged Dice score by 2.7 points (95% CI 2.3-3.2), while the control decreased it by 0.6 points. A second round of self-training did not lead to further improvement. When an external model trained on 50 fully annotated images was used to generate the initial labels, the XCAD Dice score increased from 0.623 to 0.745 without any XCAD labels, although performance on XACV did not improve because large main vessels were missed. These results suggest that the benefit of self-training depends largely on the sensitivity of the model used to generate the initial pseudo-labels.

</details>


### [148] [Video Generation Meets Agent Harness: Agentic Video Generation, Agentic World Modeling and Recursive Self-Improvement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40191)
*Liaoyuan Fan,Yuhao Zheng,Dongxing Mao,Hangyu Ran,Siyuan Hu,Weijia Mao,Rui Zhao,Weijia Wu,Guian Fang,Yanzhe Chen,Zeyu Zhu,Yuxin Jiang,Yiren Song,Yuchao Gu,Junchao Yi,Qi Hu,Dan Kong,Alex Jinpeng Wang,Kevin Qinghong Lin,Mike Zheng Shou,Wei Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该报告以"agent harness（智能体执行运行时）"为核心视角，系统梳理agentic视频生成、agentic世界建模与视频模型研发中的递归自我改进三条方向的交叉，并分析所需智能体能力与开放挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频生成正从端到端合成转向由规划、工具调用与反馈驱动的智能体式生成；同时视频世界模型可作为智能体的交互环境。二者交汇处缺乏统一框架，亟需以可执行运行时（harness）为纽带加以研究。

Method: 以agent harness为分析单元——它是围绕视频模型构建上下文、暴露工具、维护状态、路由反馈与管理预算的可执行运行时。沿三条方向展开： (1) agentic视频生成中由harness协调脚本、分镜、素材、制作与剪辑； (2) agentic世界建模中由harness中介观测、控制、执行与状态，讨论游戏引擎或智能体编写程序维护世界状态、视频模型渲染观测的混合设计，以及智能体与世界模型互相评估改进； (3) 视频模型研发中的递归自我改进，区分输出修订、harness状态更新、生成器参数更新、评估器更新与改进流程本身的变更。

Result: 归纳出贯穿三方向的关键智能体能力：视听感知、长时程规划、记忆、基于代码的交互、反馈引导控制、技能复用与多智能体协同；并给出系统性分析而非单一实验结论。

Conclusion: 提出未来挑战：自主视频制作、终身记忆、可编程混合控制、自主模型研发、溯源与成本核算，以及将视频质量与任务性能关联到模型与harness持续改进的评估方法。

Abstract: Video generation is shifting from end-to-end synthesis toward agentic generation, where planning, tool use, and feedback enable coherent, controllable multi-shot videos. In parallel, video world models provide action-conditioned observations and predicted futures, serving as interactive environments for agents. We study their intersection through the agent harness: an executable runtime that constructs context, exposes tools, maintains state, routes feedback, and manages budgets around video models. This report examines three directions. First, agentic video generation, where harnesses coordinate scripting, shot planning, asset management, production, and editing, alongside the evaluation challenges of these systems. Second, agentic world modeling, where harnesses mediate observation, control, execution, and state. We discuss hybrid designs in which game engines or agent-written programs maintain world state while video models render observations, and how agents and world models can mutually evaluate and improve one another. Third, recursive self-improvement (RSI) in video model development, distinguishing output revisions, updates to harness state, generator parameters, and evaluators, and changes to the improvement procedure itself. We identify how these improvements feed back into subsequent development. Across these directions, we analyze essential agent capabilities, including audiovisual perception, long-horizon planning, memory, code-based interaction, feedback-guided control, skill reuse, and multi-agent coordination. We conclude with challenges in autonomous video production, lifelong memory, programmable hybrid control, autonomous model development, provenance, cost accounting, and evaluation linking video quality and task performance to sustained improvements in models and harnesses.

</details>


### [149] [Where Do Vision Language Models Fail at 3D Reasoning?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39639)
*Khai Le-Duc,Nguyen Kim Hai Bui,An Ngo,Nam D. Hoang,Yueqi Song,Jiarui Liu,Thai Quoc Hoang,Fang Wu,Chris Ngo,Terry Jingchen Zhang,Mona T. Diab,Ran Xu,Silvio Savarese,Xiao-Ming Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出BedBench基准，揭示视觉语言模型在3D物体精确属性（如逐色计数）上存在"判对却不能一致使用"的缺口，并主张以精确正确性、一致性与图像依赖性评估3D推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型常能对单个判断给出正确答案，却难以恢复并一致地使用3D物体的精确属性。现有评估多以准确率为唯一指标，无法刻画"恢复属性"与"一致使用属性"之间的差距，因此需要一个受控基准来系统量化这一缺口。

Method: 构建BedBench：13个程序化生成的任务，涵盖单项判断与复合答案。评测12个开放权重模型与4个前沿模型；进行针对性微调实验；将逐色计数作为文本输入进行对照；并探测Qwen3.5-27B的语言模型输入端与输出端可恢复性，辅以图像移除控制实验。

Result: 逐色计数暴露显著弱点：人类准确率93.3%，最佳模型仅7.2%。微调可将某模型从3.0%提升至68.6%，但其对最常见颜色的回答仍与自身逐色计数不一致；将计数以文本提供可改善判断。推理、扩展与额外视觉线索均改善单项判断，但无法使精确答案可靠。探测显示Qwen3.5-27B输入端精确计数可恢复（65.0%），而模型回答几乎无法恢复（3.0%）。图像移除控制表明部分"成功"无需视觉证据。

Conclusion: 3D推理评估应超越单一准确率，采用精确正确性、属性的一致使用以及图像依赖性三项指标；恢复属性不等于一致使用属性，且部分表观成功可能并不依赖视觉信息。

Abstract: Vision-language models can get individual judgments right while struggling to recover and consistently use the exact properties of a 3D object. To characterize this gap, we introduce BedBench, a controlled benchmark of thirteen procedurally generated tasks spanning individual judgments and composite answers. Across twelve open-weight and four frontier models, per-color counting exposes a pronounced weakness: humans achieve 93.3% accuracy, compared with 7.2% for the best model. Targeted fine-tuning raises one model's accuracy from 3.0% to 68.6%, but reveals a further difficulty: its answers about the most common colors remain inconsistent with its own per-color counts. Supplying those counts as text improves its judgments, showing that recovering a property does not mean using it consistently. Reasoning, scaling, and added visual cues each improve individual judgments, but none makes exact answers reliable. To locate the difficulty, we probe Qwen3.5-27B: exact per-color counts remain recoverable at the language model's input, yet the model's answers rarely recover them (65.0% for the probe vs. 3.0% for the model). Image-removal controls further show that some apparent successes require no visual evidence. These findings motivate evaluating 3D reasoning by exact correctness, consistent use, and image dependence, rather than accuracy alone. Code and dataset are publicly available: https://github.com/leduckhai/BedBench

</details>


### [150] [NeurEO: dissecting Earth observation embeddings with computational neuroscience](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40137)
*Thijs L van der Plas,Jacob JW Bakermans,Ioannis N Athanasiadis*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文借鉴计算神经科学中解读神经元活动的方法，为AlphaEarth地球嵌入特征赋予语义解释，揭示了其对土地覆盖与高程的相关性、多尺度结构及方向性调谐特性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地球嵌入是地球观测数据的压缩表示，能提升下游地理空间任务性能，但代价是可解释性下降——嵌入的语义含义未知。这阻碍了可信赖的下游应用开发，因此需要为Earth embeddings赋予意义。

Method: 作者借用计算神经科学中解读生物神经元活动的方法，将其适配应用于AlphaEarth嵌入。分析分两类：将嵌入特征作为独立数据（类比自发神经活动），以及将其与土地覆盖和高程等协变量关联（类比刺激-响应神经活动）；并通过剔除土地覆盖组合响应的主要趋势（如水体vs陆地调谐）来考察细粒度表征。

Result: 嵌入特征表现出相关性与多尺度结构；部分特征对土地覆盖和高程呈现高度特异且具方向性的调谐（如"北vs南林地边缘"响应）；去除主要趋势后可发现更细粒度的表征细节，且有效维度增加。

Conclusion: 该系列分析初步揭示了Earth embeddings所表征的内容，对开发可信赖的下游应用至关重要。

Abstract: Earth embeddings are compressed representations of rich Earth observation data that enable downstream models to tackle a wide range of complex geospatial tasks. Yet, this increase in performance comes at the cost of decreased interpretability, as the semantic meaning of Earth embeddings is unknown. To address this challenge, we borrow methods from the field of computational neuroscience, which aim to interpret activity in (biological) neurons. Here, we adapt and apply these methods to assign meaning to AlphaEarth embeddings. We analyse embedding features both as stand-alone data, equivalent to spontaneous neural activity, and in relation to land cover and elevation correlates, equivalent to stimulus-response neural activity. We demonstrate correlational and multi-scale structure in the embedding features. Embedding features can display highly specific and directional tuning to land cover and elevation, such as a `North vs South woodland edge' response. When we remove the main trends of combined land cover responses (like water versus land tuning), we discover fine-grained representational details with increased effective dimensionality. Together, our analyses start to unravel what these Earth embeddings represent, which is critical for developing trustworthy downstream applications.

</details>


### [151] [Calibrating Attention-Based Token Pruning for Efficient Multi-Image Synthesis in UMMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39467)
*Zimeng Wu,Qijian Tian,Penghui Du,Changqian Yu,Jiaxin Chen,Yunhong Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练上下文压缩方法 CATP，针对统一多模态模型多图生成中的长视觉上下文冗余，通过校准注意力token剪枝实现质量-效率更优权衡，取得最高2.09倍注意力核心加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 统一多模态模型（UMM）支持多图合成，但长视觉上下文带来巨大计算开销。现有token剪枝方法多从理解任务迁移，存在三方面缺陷：参考图像探索不足、条件引导混乱、池化引入的歧义，导致生成质量下降。

Method: CATP为面向UMM生成的首个免训练上下文压缩方法。基于去噪过程中各层独立剪枝，引入：1）Guidance-Consistent Pruning（GCP），在条件分支间同步剪枝决策以统一条件引导；2）Taylor-Calibrated Attention Metric（TCAM），基于泰勒展开给出二阶校正，理论上修正池化引起的偏差；3）Fast Scoring Operator（FSO），将校准融合进分块在线Softmax以降低剪枝开销。

Result: 在代表性UMM与基准上广泛实验表明，CATP持续优于最先进的token缩减方法，注意力核心最高加速2.09倍。

Conclusion: 通过校准通用注意力token剪枝的偏差，CATP在免训练前提下有效提升多图生成的效率并保持生成质量，为UMM推理加速提供了新范式。

Abstract: Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) enable powerful multi-image synthesis but incur substantial computation from long visual contexts. While token pruning offers a direct route to accelerating inference, existing methods are primarily adapted from understanding tasks, suffering from insufficient reference image exploration, confused conditional guidance, and pooling-induced ambiguity that degrades generation quality. To address these issues, we propose CATP, the first training-free context-compression method tailored to UMM generation, which \textbf{C}alibrates the discrepancies of general \textbf{A}ttention-based \textbf{T}oken \textbf{P}runing for better quality-efficiency trade-off. Concretely, building on independent layer-wise pruning during denoising, we introduce Guidance-Consistent Pruning (GCP) to synchronize pruning decisions across conditioning branches, and a Taylor-Calibrated Attention Metric (TCAM) that derives a theoretically grounded second-order correction for pooling-induced bias. In addition, a Fast Scoring Operator (FSO) fuses the calibration into tiled online Softmax to reduce pruning cost. Extensive experiments across representative UMMs and benchmarks demonstrate that CATP consistently outperforms state-of-the-art token-reduction methods, achieving up to 2.09$\times$ attention-core speedup.

</details>


### [152] [PathCowork: Learning from real-world pathology practice to build AI copilots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39441)
*Sheng Wang,Jialu Yao,Maria V. Rossi,Shunsuke Koga,Esther Baranov,MacLean P. Nasrallah,Songhao Li,Jonathan Xu,Wei Du,Cindy McGrath,Timothy Chao,Anne Wang,Zhaohai Yang,Daniel Akuma,Selemon M. Walle,Olga Pozdnyakova,Edward B. Lee,Zahra Alipour,Annapurna Saksena,Rashmi Tondon,Nikolina Dioufa,David E. Elder,George J. Netto,Xiaowei Xu,Zhi Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PathCowork将病理学家阅片时的注视、口述与导航同步采集，转化为视觉定位与诊断流程的监督信号，训练出服务器版PathCowork-1T和本地版PathCowork-27B，在五项器官评估中主任务得分分别比Claude Code和Codex高17.9和24.1个百分点，且用时更短、推理成本更低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学AI通常只学习医生记录的最终答案，而忽略了医生解读证据、得出结论的过程，导致监督信号稀疏且缺乏可解释性，也浪费了日常临床实践中大量隐含的专家推理信息。

Method: 构建PathCowork框架，在阅片过程中同步捕获病理学家的注视（gaze）、口述（narration）与切片导航（navigation），将其对齐为视觉定位与诊断流程监督；基于16位病理学家48场会话、共1028分钟的阅片数据，训练服务器端PathCowork-1T与本地端PathCowork-27B；在五个器官任务上评估智能体将视觉定位与记录的诊断流程相结合的表现，并与多实例学习（MIL）方法及通用编码智能体对比，同时用于构建病理AI基准测试。

Result: 五项器官专项评估中，结合视觉定位与诊断流程的智能体主任务得分平均分别高出Claude Code与Codex 17.9与24.1个百分点，处理时间更短、推理成本更低；在有限切片标签下，PathCowork智能体提出的区域在前列腺分级上优于SOTA多实例学习AI；由记录生成的基准题目揭示了在识别观察情境与拒绝不适用前提方面的难点。

Conclusion: PathCowork提出了一种通过诊断会话中的透明推理来规模化采集数据并训练病理AI的新范式，使系统能够直接从常规临床实践中学习，为可解释、可持续迭代的病理智能体开辟了路径。

Abstract: Medical AI learns from the answers doctors record, but rarely from how they interpret the evidence to reach them. Here we introduce PathCowork, a framework that turns pathologists' narrated examinations into supervision for visual grounding and procedures that guide diagnostic AI agents. Synchronized gaze, narration and navigation link visual findings to the process of interpreting them. Across 48 sessions from 16 pathologists, the platform captured 1,028 minutes of slide review. Using these data, we trained PathCowork-1T for server deployment and PathCowork-27B for local deployment, with improved visual grounding. Across five organ-specific evaluations, agents combining this grounding with recorded diagnostic procedures achieved primary task scores averaging 17.9 and 24.1 percentage points higher than Claude Code and Codex, respectively, with shorter processing times and lower inference costs. Compared to the state-of-the-art multiple-instance learning AIs, the PathCowork agent-proposed regions achieved higher prostate-grading scores with limited slide labels. PathCowork can also help construct pathology AI benchmarks where questions derived from the recordings identified difficulties in recognizing viewing context and rejecting inapplicable premises. In summary, PathCowork proposes a new paradigm to scale up the data collection and train pathology AI through transparent reasoning from diagnostic sessions, opening a path towards systems that learn directly from routine clinical practice.

</details>


### [153] [Luggage re-identification: A study of strategies towards a real-world application](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40643)
*Quentin Dhôte,Romaric Audigier*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究面向多路视频流的行李端到端检测与重识别（ReID）流程，评估多种"多镜头/多视角"融合与训练策略，以提升真实复杂场景下的ReID性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有行李ReID方法多在相对干净的条件下做基于外观的裁剪图像匹配，而真实场景存在频繁遮挡、杂乱背景与拥挤人群，性能显著下降；同时，来自不同视频流的多镜头、多视角互补信息尚未被充分利用。

Method: 构建从多路视频流出发的端到端检测+ReID流程，并在真实环境采集的基准数据集上对比不同变体，重点研究同一行李多视角/多镜头的选择与融合策略，以及在不同环境数据集上训练的效果。

Result: 在真实场景基准数据集上对多种流程变体进行了评估，给出关于视角/镜头选择与合并策略、以及跨环境训练对整体ReID性能影响的实验结果。

Conclusion: 利用多镜头多视角的互补信息并结合跨环境数据训练，可改善实际应用中的行李ReID表现，为真实监控场景下的端到端行李重识别提供策略参考。

Abstract: Luggage re-identification (ReID) is a critical task in video surveillance for forensics, security or border management (suspicious or abandoned luggage recognition), as well as luggage management (lost luggage recovery). It enables the association of observations of the same luggage across disjoint camera views in complex environments such as airports, train stations and border crossing. While existing approaches primarily focus on appearance-based cropped image matching under relatively clean conditions, real-world scenarios are characterized by frequent occlusions, cluttered background and crowded scenes which significantly degrade performance. Yet, strategies leveraging the complementarity of multiple shots and views from different video streams is overlooked. In this paper, we study strategies for an end-to-end pipeline that operates from multiple video streams to detect and re-identify luggage. We evaluate different variants on a benchmark dataset acquired in real-world environments to address the questions of selecting and merging different views and shots of the same luggage as well as training on different environment datasets for an overall ReID performance improvement in practical applications.

</details>


### [154] [LucidLyra: Feed-Forward Generative 3D Scene Reconstruction and Joint Understanding via Multi-Task Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40495)
*Oliver Hahn,Rodrigo Marcuzzi,Sangeetha Grama Srinivasan,Alessandro Burzio,Sherwin Bahmani,Jiahui Huang,Stefan Roth,Shengyu Huang,Qunjie Zhou,Laura Leal-Taixé*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LucidLyra 从视频潜变量出发，前馈式地生成可直接查询语义与实例信息的三维场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式三维重建虽能由单张图像合成虚拟环境，但机器人与具身智能等下游任务需要场景语义与物体身份；现有三维理解方法依赖多视角采集、泛化性有限，或需昂贵的逐场景优化。因此需要一个既能生成、又能查询语义/实例、且无需逐场景优化的统一框架。

Method: 方法将从相机可控视频扩散模型中获取的生成先验与冻结的二维视觉基础模型知识蒸馏到一个统一模型中，前馈地联合推断携带几何、外观、开放词汇语义与类别无关实例线索的三维高斯；训练无需人工三维标注与多视角采集数据。

Result: 在构建的合成与真实图像条件基准上，优于"三维高斯分割方法+生成式场景重建"的基线组合，同时保持重建质量；隐式表示可自然扩展到单目视频，重建跨时间的结构化动态三维场景。

Conclusion: LucidLyra 将可渲染但非结构化的输出转化为可查询的三维世界，支持新视角渲染、开放词汇分割与物体分组且无需逐场景优化，可服务于三维场景编辑、三维资产挖掘与机器人仿真等应用。

Abstract: We present LucidLyra, a framework that makes generatively reconstructed 3D scenes directly queryable for semantics and instances in a feed-forward manner from video latents. While generative 3D reconstruction can synthesize virtual environments from a single image, downstream applications in robotics and physical AI require not only visual realism but also access to scene semantics and object identities. Existing 3D understanding approaches, however, require captured multi-view scenes, have limited generalization capabilities, or rely on expensive per-scene processing and optimization. To bridge this gap, our method distills complementary knowledge from a camera-controlled video diffusion model and frozen 2D vision foundation models into a unified model to jointly infer 3D Gaussians encoding geometry, appearance, open-vocabulary semantics, and class-agnostic instance cues. The resulting scenes support novel-view rendering, open-vocabulary segmentation, and object grouping without per-scene optimization, while training requires neither manual 3D annotations nor captured multi-view data. Our method outperforms baselines combining state-of-the-art 3DGS segmentation approaches with generative 3D scene reconstruction on curated synthetic and real-image-conditioned benchmarks, while preserving reconstruction quality. Furthermore, our latent formulation naturally extends to monocular video, reconstructing structured dynamic 3D scenes across time. By turning renderable but unstructured outputs into queryable 3D worlds, LucidLyra enables downstream applications including 3D scene editing, 3D asset mining, and robotic simulation.

</details>


### [155] [MetaRefine: Score Refinement with Multi-Level Features for Image Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40487)
*Chuanzhi Xu,Chengkun Yue,Haolan Guo,Xuanhua Yin,Boyu Wei,Zihan Deng,Qiang Qu,Weidong Cai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 MetaRefine：一种元数据感知的分数精修架构，利用原始图像几何信息与冻结模型的分数/多层视觉特征，通过轻量残差头预测分数修正量，在不改动原有评分流程的前提下显著提升图像质量评估的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图像评估方法为适配不同输入尺寸而采用缩放、裁剪、填充或块采样，这些操作会改变或掩盖原始图像的几何与构图线索；同时现有模型内部已编码丰富但未被充分利用的多级视觉证据。因此希望在不改变原有评分流程的情况下复用这些信息进行分数精修。

Method: MetaRefine 采用元数据感知的分数精修架构：以原始图像几何信息（尺寸、长宽比、构图）、冻结评估模型的多级视觉特征以及其原始分数为输入，由轻量残差头预测分数修正量，实现后处理式的精修叠加。

Result: 在 21 个数据集、100 种配置下，88 种配置 PLCC 提升、85 种 SRCC 提升，平均相对增益 7.55% 与 7.10%；90 种配置 MAE 下降、89 种 RMSE 下降，平均相对降低 23.27% 与 21.93%；中位参数开销仅 1.11%。

Conclusion: MetaRefine 以极小参数量、通用后处理形式稳定提升多种评估模型，并可在多个基准上进一步提升 SOTA 模型性能。

Abstract: An image's original dimensions, aspect ratio, and composition provide important cues that can affect its technical and aesthetic quality. Image assessment methods use resizing, cropping, padding, or patch sampling to accommodate different input sizes. However, these operations can alter or obscure original geometric and compositional cues. Existing assessment models also encode rich multi-level visual evidence that can be further extracted and exploited to improve existing models. This motivates us to combine visual evidence with original-image geometry for score refinement without changing the original scoring pipelines. In this paper, we introduce MetaRefine, a metadata-aware score refinement architecture whose lightweight residual heads predict score corrections from geometry, multi-level visual features, and the frozen model's original score. Across 100 configurations on 21 datasets, MetaRefine improves PLCC in 88 configurations and SRCC in 85, with average relative gains of 7.55% and 7.10%, respectively. It reduces MAE in 90 configurations and RMSE in 89, with average relative reductions of 23.27% and 21.93%, respectively. The median parameter overhead is only 1.11%. MetaRefine can further improve state-of-the-art (SOTA) assessment models on multiple benchmarks.

</details>


### [156] [DEQ-Stereo: Deep Euilibrium Video Stereo Matching via Adaptive Convergence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39701)
*Kiljoon Han,Kyumin Hwang,Wonheok Choi,Jeonghoon Kim,Sunghoom Im*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DEQ-Stereo将立体匹配的迭代细化重构为深度均衡(DEQ)隐式不动点问题，自适应收敛终止，并引入ConvSGU加速帧内收敛、Temporal State Transfer复用跨帧状态，实现更优的精度-延迟权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有迭代细化立体匹配模型采用固定更新次数，计算开销大且速度-精度难以兼顾；在视频流场景中，在线方法常靠削减特征通道或昂贵的时序warping来应对，问题更突出。

Method: 基于DEQ范式，将细化建模为隐式不动点问题，收敛即终止而非展开固定迭代；提出卷积简化门控单元ConvSGU，以门控逐元素求和建模隐状态、去除冗余非线性以加速稳定收敛；提出时序状态传递TST，将已收敛隐状态热启动至下一帧，无需显式位姿或warping先验。

Result: 大量实验表明DEQ-Stereo达到state-of-the-art性能，并在精度与延迟之间取得更优权衡。

Conclusion: 以隐式均衡替代固定迭代、辅以高效单元设计与无先验的跨帧热启动，是提升视频立体匹配效率与精度的有效路径。

Abstract: Iterative refinement models have significantly improved stereo matching accuracy, but their rigid, fixed update schedules incur heavy computational costs and a strict trade-off between speed and accuracy. This challenge is magnified in video streams, where traditional online methods resort to reducing feature channels or relying on expensive temporal warping. To address this, we propose \textbf{DEQ-Stereo}, a novel video stereo matching framework based on the Deep Equilibrium (DEQ) paradigm. Instead of unrolling a fixed number of iterations, DEQ-Stereo reformulates the refinement as an implicit fixed-point problem, adaptively terminating once convergence is met. To ensure fast and stable intra-frame convergence, we introduce the \textbf{Convolutional Simplified Gated Unit (ConvSGU)}, which eliminates unnecessary non-linearities by modeling the latent state as a gated, element-wise sum of inputs. Furthermore, to exploit cross-frame temporal coherence, we propose \textbf{Temporal State Transfer (TST)}, a warm-start strategy that propagates the converged hidden state to the next frame without requiring explicit pose or warping priors. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that DEQ-Stereo delivers state-of-the-art performance with a superior accuracy-to-latency trade-off.

</details>


### [157] [EditAgent: Rethinking Agentic Image Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39664)
*Haiyang Xu,Tianyu Wang,Jialu Li,Jiteng Mu,Yuanjun Xiong,Jianming Zhang,Zhuowen Tu,Mingze Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EditAgent通过扩展智能体图像编辑的动作空间与观测空间，显著提升复杂编辑任务的可用性与评判可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体图像编辑器将复杂请求分解为多步执行，但步骤失败时往往仅用同一狭窄工具集重试，且依赖"肉眼直接打分"的评判器。作者认为这类智能体受限于两个空间：动作空间（能做什么）与观测空间（评判器能看到什么）。在专家标注基准上，通用编辑器超过40%的案例无可用结果，且没有评判器能跨编辑类型都可靠。

Method: 提出EditAgent，同时扩展两个空间：(1) 将每一步路由到通用编辑器与专用方法；(2) 为每个候选结果附加验证记录（verification record）；(3) 候选并行生成，并通过一次listwise调用完成评判。

Result: 借助验证记录，现成VLM评判器优于微调奖励模型；专家在78.5%的已决比较中更偏好该方式而非顺序精修，且评判调用次数不超过其一半；EditAgent在三个基准上改进两个开放权重编辑器，并可作为数据引擎训练更强的编辑器。

Conclusion: 扩展动作空间与观测空间是提升智能体图像编辑可靠性的关键路径；并行生成加listwise验证记录评判在质量与效率上均优于顺序精修，且具备数据引擎价值。

Abstract: Agentic image editors decompose complex requests into steps, but when a step fails, they mostly retry with the same narrow set of tools and a judge that scores each output by eye directly. We argue that such agents are bounded by two spaces: the action space of what the agent can do, and the observation space of what its judge can see. On our expert-annotated benchmark, a general-purpose editor yields no usable result in over 40% of the cases, and no judge is reliable across edit types. We present EditAgent, which expands both spaces. It routes each step to general editors and specialized methods, and attaches to each candidate a verification record. With these records, off-the-shelf VLM judges outperform finetuned reward models. Candidates are generated in parallel and judged in one listwise call: experts prefer this to sequential refinement in 78.5% of decided comparisons, at no more than half the judge calls. EditAgent improves two open-weight editors on three benchmarks and serves as a data engine for training stronger editors.

</details>


### [158] [UniTele: Learning Device-Conditioned Degradations for Unified Smartphone Telephoto Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39617)
*Yuchen Zhang,Aojie Li,Wei Cheng,Xianfang Zeng,Runxing Liu,haixin hao,Gang YU,Xiaoyun Yuan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出将超长焦退化分解为"设备成像特性"与"超长焦附加信息损失/伪影"两个可学习分量，仅用少量真实拍摄对学习设备相关退化，再迁移合成数千对数据训练统一超分模型 UniTele；构建华为/苹果/vivo 三品牌配对基准（519 训练对、60 测试对），显著提升配对保真度与感知相似度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手机超长焦成像退化复杂且强依赖具体设备，传统手工建模流程刻画不足；而跨机型、跨场景采集大规模对齐训练对成本高、难扩展。因此研究能否仅凭少量真实拍摄学到设备相关退化，并迁移以训练统一 SR 模型。

Method: 核心是退化分解学习：分量一建模良好解析条件下的设备成像特性，分量二建模超长焦成像中额外的信息损失与伪影。采集方式为同一内容在两种显示尺寸与变焦设置下拍摄——大尺寸显示图在手机最大光学变焦下拍摄，小尺寸图经手机原生成像流程在最高原生变焦下直接拍摄。基于该基准学习设备退化后，将其施加到外部图像上合成数千对数据，用于训练 UniTele 超分模型。

Result: 构建三品牌配对基准（519 训练对 + 60 留出对）。相对适配前的 Qwen 与 FLUX 预训练骨干，完整 UniTele 训练配方在留出基准上大幅提升配对复原保真度与感知相似度，重建结果更稳定、视觉更忠实。

Conclusion: 少样本真实拍摄即可有效学习设备相关退化并用于数据合成与统一超分训练，为移动端超长焦复原提供可扩展的退化建模与数据增广范式。

Abstract: Super-telephoto imaging on mobile phones suffers from complex, device-dependent degradations that are poorly captured by conventional handcrafted pipelines. Collecting large-scale aligned training pairs across different phones and diverse scenes, however, is both costly and difficult to scale. We therefore study whether device-specific degradations can be learned from only a small number of physical captures and transferred for training a unified super-resolution (SR) model. Our key idea is to factor degradation learning into two learnable components: one captures the device-specific imaging characteristics under well-resolved conditions, while the other captures the additional information loss and artifacts that arise in super-telephoto imaging. We build a paired benchmark across three phone brands (Huawei, Apple, and vivo) by photographing the same content at two display sizes and zoom settings. The larger displayed image is captured at the phone's maximum optical zoom setting, while the smaller image is photographed directly at the phone's highest native zoom setting through the phone's native imaging pipeline. The benchmark contains 519 training and 60 held-out pairs. We use the benchmark to learn device-specific degradation, then apply it to external images to synthesize thousands of additional pairs to train our UniTele SR model. Relative to the pretrained Qwen and FLUX backbones before adaptation, the full UniTele training recipe substantially improves paired restoration fidelity and perceptual similarity on the held-out benchmark and yields markedly more stable and visually faithful restorations.

</details>


### [159] [Evaluating Cultural Knowledge Editing in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39602)
*Malvina Nikandrou,Georgios Pantazopoulos,Ioannis Konstas,Alessandro Suglia*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 CulturalBind 基准（3.2K 图像、1K 概念、6 个领域），用于评估 VLM 的文化感知跨模态知识及概念级知识编辑；发现文图知识解耦、编辑跨模态可迁移性低、顺序编辑下性能快速退化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前视觉-语言模型难以识别文化特定概念，尤其是来自代表性不足地区的长尾概念，而如何将这类知识有效注入现有模型仍是难题。

Method: 构建 CulturalBind 基准，覆盖 6 个领域的 1K 个概念与 3.2K 张图像，用于评估文化感知跨模态知识及概念级知识编辑；先做编辑前评估，再在单次与顺序两种场景下评估现有知识编辑方法。

Result: 编辑前评估显示文本知识与视觉知识相互解耦：模型常具备文化概念的文本知识却无法从图像中识别；编辑方法虽能纠正单条视觉识别错误，但跨模态可迁移性低，未能将编辑整合进模型更广泛的参数化知识；顺序编辑下性能迅速下降。

Conclusion: 现有知识编辑方法不足以向 VLM 有效注入文化长尾知识，亟需能随时间更好整合多模态知识的综合性适配方法。

Abstract: Current Vision-Language Models (VLMs) frequently fail to recognize culture-specific concepts, especially from underrepresented regions. Effectively injecting this long-tail knowledge into existing models remains a challenge. In this work, we investigate knowledge editing as a targeted alternative by introducing CulturalBind, a benchmark comprising 3.2K images of 1K concepts from 6 domains, designed to evaluate culture-aware cross-modal knowledge as well as concept-level knowledge editing in VLMs. Pre-edit evaluation reveals that textual and visual knowledge is decoupled: models often demonstrate text-based knowledge of cultural concepts but fail to identify them from images. We then evaluate editing methods in single and sequential scenarios. Although current methods successfully correct individual visual recognition errors, they exhibit low cross-modal portability, failing to integrate edits into the model's broader parametric knowledge. Furthermore, performance degrades rapidly under sequential editing, highlighting the need for comprehensive adaptation approaches that better consolidate multimodal knowledge over time.

</details>


### [160] [TactoHand: Learning Geometry-Based Dense Hand-Surface Interaction Fields from Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39585)
*Ziheng Xi,Weibo Li,Jiayi Yu,Sipeng Zheng,Wanpeng Zhang,Haiweng Xu,Hao Luo,Chuan Mao,Zongqing Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TactoHand 从单目视频预测手-表面三种稠密交互场（接触、邻近、3D力），无需采集触觉数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究人与世界交互需要手表面物理交互的表示；触觉传感可捕捉此类交互，但大规模采集触觉数据依赖专用硬件，成本高、难以规模化。

Method: 在约5000万源帧的精选数据中，由几何推导接触与邻近标签、由运动推导力标签；模型采用时序 Transformer 聚合跨帧视觉证据，用三个可学习 query 解码对应手-表面场，并以可微物理层借助观测到的物体运动约束力预测。

Result: 在域内与域外基准上，接触与邻近估计优于先前方法；物理监督降低了运动 rollout 的位置与旋转误差；预测的接触与邻近场提升了下游手-物体重建效果。

Conclusion: 结果表明可在不采集触觉测量的情况下，以可扩展、低成本的方式学习手-表面交互场；代码将开源。

Abstract: Understanding how humans interact with the world requires a representation of physical interactions at the hand surface. Tactile sensing captures these interactions, but collecting tactile data at scale requires specialized hardware. We introduce TactoHand, a model that predicts three dense hand-surface interaction fields---contact, proximity, and 3D force---from monocular video. We derive geometry-based contact and proximity labels and motion-derived force labels from eligible training data within a curated collection spanning approximately 50 million source frames. TactoHand uses a temporal transformer to aggregate visual evidence across frames, while three learned queries decode the corresponding hand-surface fields. A differentiable physics layer further constrains force predictions using observed object motion. Across in-domain and out-of-domain benchmarks, TactoHand improves contact and proximity estimation over prior methods. In addition, physics supervision reduces position and rotation errors in motion rollouts, and the predicted contact and proximity fields improve downstream hand-object reconstruction. Together, these results show a scalable, low-cost path to learning hand-surface interaction fields without collecting tactile measurements. Code will be released at https://github.com/zhenqis123/Tactohand.

</details>


### [161] [HiFOR: Hierarchical Foresight with Action-Guided World Grounding for Vision-Language-Action Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40373)
*Rongxing Ding,Hongyu Qu,Kehong Wu,Xudong Wang,Fan Zhang,Xinguang Xiang,Xiangbo Shu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出HiFOR——一个带动作引导世界检索的分层前瞻框架，用于VLA机器人操作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA方法将短期动态与长期任务目标分开建模，且将预测的未来直接注入动作策略，未充分考量其与当前动作需求的相关性，导致未来信息利用不够精准。

Method: 1) 分层前瞻预测（Hierarchical Foresight Prediction）：通过分层依赖掩码（HDM）联合预测短期状态演化、语义里程碑与最终目标状态，建立跨时间尺度的依赖关系；2) 结构感知潜在世界建模（Structure-Aware Latent World Modeling）：沿时间、视角与空间维度组织未来潜在表征以支持细粒度检索；3) 动作引导的因子化世界检索（Action-Guided Factorized World Retrieval）：在去噪过程中依据演化的动作表征自适应检索相关未来信息，为动作生成提供定向引导。

Result: 在两个仿真基准和六项真实世界机器人操作任务上进行了大量实验，验证了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 通过分层前瞻预测联合建模多时间尺度未来，并以动作引导的结构化检索有选择地利用未来信息，可有效提升VLA模型的操作性能。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated promising capabilities in robotic manipulation by integrating visual perception, language understanding, and action generation. Recent advances have further incorporated future prediction to enhance the understanding of environmental dynamics and task progression. However, existing methods often model short-term dynamics and long-term task objectives separately, while directly incorporating predicted futures into action policies without sufficiently considering their relevance to current action requirements. To address these limitations, we propose HiFOR, a hierarchical foresight framework with action-guided world retrieval. Specifically, Hierarchical Foresight Prediction jointly predicts short-term state evolution, semantic milestones, and final goal states through a Hierarchical Dependency Mask (HDM), establishing dependencies across temporal horizons. Building upon these predictions, Structure-Aware Latent World Modeling organizes future latent representations along the horizon, view, and spatial dimensions to facilitate fine-grained retrieval. Furthermore, Action-Guided Factorized World Retrieval adaptively retrieves relevant future information from the structured latent world based on evolving action representations during denoising, providing targeted guidance for action generation. Extensive experiments on two simulation benchmarks and six real-world robotic manipulation tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.

</details>


### [162] [LoRe-MIM: Lost-or-Replaced Masked Image Modeling for Self-Supervised Representation Learning in Whole-Body PET/CT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40284)
*Amartya Bhattacharya,Bashirul Azam Biswas,Biratal Raj Wagle,Michael S. Leapman,Matthew E. Maeder,James B. Yu,Indrani Bhattacharya*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出LoRe-MIM自监督框架，通过"丢失或替换"掩码图像建模学习全身PET/CT多模态表征，在6,531例扫描数据集上于多项下游任务中超越SOTA基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全身PET/CT深度学习在病灶检测、治疗规划与疗效评估中潜力巨大，但专家标注耗时昂贵，成为模型鲁棒性与泛化性的瓶颈。自监督学习虽可缓解标注稀缺，却因大规模数据匮乏及跨模态互补表征学习困难，在全身PET/CT领域探索不足。

Method: 构建异质、多示踪剂、多机构的6,531例全身PET/CT扫描队列；提出LoRe-MIM框架，采用掩码图像重建进行多模态表征学习。其核心掩码策略将图像区域以零值替换（Lost）或以对应互补模态替换（Replaced），迫使模型同时捕获模态特异性特征与跨模态关联。

Result: 在多模态PET/CT图像重建、patch级癌症/非癌症分类、全身病灶分割、标签高效训练及鲁棒性评估等下游任务中，LoRe-MIM均一致优于相应SOTA基线。

Conclusion: LoRe-MIM是一种可扩展、可泛化的全身PET/CT自监督学习框架，具备临床转化潜力。

Abstract: Deep learning models for whole-body positron emission tomography/computed tomography (PET/CT) hold significant clinical potential for disease detection, treatment planning, and response assessment. However, the time and cost associated with expert annotations remain major bottlenecks in developing robust and generalizable models. Although self-supervised learning (SSL) has emerged as a promising approach to mitigating annotation scarcity, its application to whole-body PET/CT remains relatively underexplored due to the limited availability of large-scale datasets and the challenges associated with learning complementary cross-modal representations. To address these limitations, we curate a heterogeneous, multi-tracer, multi-institutional cohort comprising 6,531 whole-body PET/CT scans and propose LoRe-MIM (Lost-Or-Replaced Masked Image Modelling), a novel self-supervised framework designed to learn multimodal representations through masked image reconstruction. Specifically, LoRe-MIM introduces a masking strategy in which image regions are either replaced with zeros (Lost) or substituted with corresponding complementary imaging modality (Replaced), encouraging the model to capture both modality-specific characteristics and cross-modal relationships. We evaluate the learned representations across multiple downstream tasks, including multimodal PET/CT image reconstruction, patch-based classification into cancer vs. non-cancer, whole-body lesion segmentation, label-efficient training, and robustness assessment. Experimental results demonstrate that LoRe-MIM consistently outperforms the corresponding state-of-the-art baselines across these tasks, highlighting its potential as a scalable and generalizable self-supervised learning framework for whole-body PET/CT analysis.

</details>


### [163] [TaskFrame: Connecting Task-Level Planning with Frame-Level Control for Game Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40276)
*Guangzhi Wang,Junfu Pu,Yiran Wang,Xingyilang Yin,Honghao Chen,Cheng Cheng,Lingen Li,Yinan Zhou,Jiarui Wu,Yinuo Jiang,Hongbo Jin,Xiaodong Cun,Ying Shan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TaskFrame 是一个分层"规划器-控制器"框架，将任务级规划与帧级键鼠控制解耦：视觉语言任务规划器把高层目标分解为原子指令序列，其终止标记的隐藏状态作为可复用的连续目标嵌入，由因果 Transformer 控制器结合近期观测逐步输出离散按键与连续视角动作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用游戏智能体同时需要高层任务推理与快速变化视觉环境下的低延迟动作控制，二者对应的计算特性差异很大，难以在单一模型中同时满足，因此需要分层解耦。

Method: 采用分层规划器-控制器架构。规划器为视觉语言模型，通过监督学习与依赖感知 GRPO 优化，将高层目标分解为有序原子指令；每条原子指令末端的特殊 goal token 隐藏状态作为连续目标嵌入，被缓存并在多个控制步中复用。控制器为因果 Transformer，融合当前目标嵌入与近期观测，逐步预测离散键鼠按键与连续相机运动。训练分三阶段：规划器训练、控制器预训练、联合对齐。

Result: 在 Minecraft 实验中，TaskFrame 在指令分解任务上与通用视觉语言模型表现相当；在闭环评测中，智能体的战斗成功率高于所评估的基线方法。

Conclusion: 通过分层设计与目标嵌入复用，可在保持规划能力的同时实现低延迟动作控制，验证了规划与控制分离的框架在复杂游戏环境中的有效性。

Abstract: Building general game agents requires both high-level task reasoning and low-latency action control in rapidly changing visual environments. These capabilities favor models with substantially different computational profiles, making them difficult to realize within a single model. In this work, we present TaskFrame, a hierarchical planner-controller framework that connects task-level planning with frame-level keyboard-and-mouse control. A vision-language task planner decomposes a high-level goal into an ordered sequence of atomic instructions and is optimized through supervised learning and dependency-aware GRPO. The hidden states of special goal tokens that terminate each atomic instruction provide continuous goal embeddings that are cached and reused across control steps. A causal Transformer controller combines the embedding of the active goal with recent observations to predict discrete keyboard and mouse-button actions and continuous camera motion at every game step. We train the system in three stages: planner training, controller pretraining, and joint alignment. Experiments in Minecraft show that TaskFrame is competitive with general-purpose vision-language models on instruction decomposition, and that in closed-loop evaluation the agent achieves a higher combat success rate than the evaluated baselines.

</details>


### [164] [Benchmarking color judgment in multimodal LLMs with CIE-computable ground truth](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40212)
*Shuwei Yue,Kaida Xiao,Zhihua Wang,Qiao Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文构建了基于CIE色度框架的五任务基准，首次用色度学真值检验MLLM的色彩判断能力，发现模型仅在粗粒度任务上可靠。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大模型已被当作零样本图像质量评判者，但其色彩判断鲜有以色度学真值（colorimetric ground truth）验证，存在评测空白。

Method: 提出五任务基准：AWB成对判断、肤色偏色方向、CCT估计、CIE ΔE2000成对排序、变光源下的颜色命名；测试8个MLLM端点（Qwen3-VL四变体、GLM-4.5V、GPT-5.4、Claude-Opus-4.7、Gemini-3.1-Pro），并设置非ColorChecker对照以检验模板依赖。

Result: 模型普遍能完成粗粒度二值AWB判断，但在数值CCT估计与部分精细色差判断上表现薄弱；ColorChecker-24刺激上，三个闭源前沿模型CCT MAE为715–1056 K，五个开源模型为1358–2133 K；非ColorChecker对照显示该优势部分源于模板依赖。

Conclusion: 当前MLLM具备可用的色彩词汇与粗粒度视觉先验，但其色彩判断未能可靠校准到CIE可计算色差，不宜直接充当零样本色彩/质量评判者。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are now used as zero-shot judges of image quality, but their color judgments are rarely tested with colorimetric ground truth. We present a five-task benchmark based on the CIE colorimetric framework: AWB pair judgment, skin-tone bias direction, CCT estimation, CIE Delta E 2000 pair ordering, and color naming under changing illuminants. We test eight MLLM endpoints, including four Qwen3-VL variants, GLM-4.5V, GPT-5.4, Claude-Opus-4.7, and Gemini-3.1-Pro. The models often solve coarse binary AWB judgments, but they remain weak on numeric CCT estimation and on some fine color-difference judgments. On ColorChecker-24 stimuli, the three closed-weight frontier models reach CCT MAE of 715-1056 K, compared with 1358-2133 K for the five open-weight models. A non-ColorChecker control shows that this advantage is partly template-dependent. The results suggest that current MLLMs have useful color words and coarse visual priors, but their color judgments are not reliably calibrated to CIE-computable color differences.

</details>


### [165] [ROAD: Modern Adversarial Training for Simple One-Step Distillation at Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39539)
*Xiaoou Li,Shan You,Tao Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ROAD：单阶段对抗蒸馏框架，用轻量表示空间判别器把文本到图像扩散模型蒸馏为一步生成器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有一步蒸馏效果好但训练机制与算力开销大；纯对抗蒸馏简单却在现代文生图尺度上失效，本文致力于解决这一矛盾。

Method: 三点改进：(1) 用以 token 级文本条件进行控制的 Lipschitz 受控 Transformer 判别头替换经典卷积头，与视觉编码器语义 token 对齐；(2) 发现固定随机特征混合会导致长程退化，归因于生成器—判别器围绕单一实现视图共适应，故周期性重采样混合；(3) 针对稠密向量值 logits 提出 Jacobian R1，惩罚完整输入—logit 雅可比，克服 pooled R1 忽略大部分 logit 敏感性的缺陷。

Result: 仅用单一对抗目标：COCO-10K 上 SDXL 一步达 11.03 FID，SD3.5-M 达 13.73 FID，超越多步教师模型，且训练算力仅为分布匹配方法的一小部分。

Conclusion: 表示空间判别器加单一对抗目标的单阶段蒸馏足以在文生图规模上实现高质量一步生成，兼具简洁性与计算效率。

Abstract: One-step distillation turns pretrained diffusion models into fast generators, but strong results often require substantial training machinery and compute. Pure adversarial distillation offers a simpler route, yet has struggled at modern text-to-image scale. To address this limitation, we propose ROAD (Representation-grounded One-step Adversarial Distillation), a one-stage framework that distills text-to-image models with one adversarial objective and a lightweight representation-space critic. First, we replace the classical convolutional head with a Lipschitz-controlled Transformer head with token-level text conditioning, which matches the semantic tokens of modern visual encoders. Second, we observed a fixed random feature mixing leads to long-horizon degradation. We attribute it to generator-critic co-adaptation around one realization-specific view, and periodically re-draw the mixing to keep the randomization effective. Third, for our dense and vector-valued logits, we introduce Jacobian R1 which penalizes the full input-logit Jacobian, overcoming pooled R1's limitation of neglecting most of logit sensitivities. A single adversarial objective then suffices: in one step, ROAD reaches 11.03 FID on SDXL and 13.73 on SD3.5-M on COCO-10K, surpassing the multi-step teachers at a fraction of distribution matching's training compute.

</details>


### [166] [UniRA: Unified Representation Alignment and Auto-Encoding for Efficient Diffusion Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39948)
*An Lanji,Dawei Liu,Jin Li,Haoran Xu,Mei Chen,Yu Tian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: UniRA将表示对齐（REPA）与表示自编码（RAE）统一为单一目标：学习一个表示空间tokenizer，其输出同时充当扩散目标与对齐锚点，使tokenizer、扩散骨干与外部表示模型联合优化；在ImageNet 256/512上FID持平或超越SD3、REPA、RAE，训练步数最多减少5倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DiT训练收敛慢、计算开销大。REPA通过将中间特征对齐到预训练外部表示模型（如DINOv2）加速训练，但仍依赖像素空间VAE做潜扩散；RAE用自监督特征学习紧凑的表示空间tokenizer替代VAE，却不利用对齐信号。两条路线彼此孤立，未能互补。

Method: 提出统一框架UniRA，把表示对齐与表示自编码耦合进一个目标：表示空间tokenizer的输出既作扩散目标又作对齐锚点，tokenizer、扩散骨干、外部表示模型三者协同优化；给出理论结果说明联合优化在保持外部模型表示质量的同时加速扩散收敛，并推导出平衡重建、对齐、生成三项损失的原则性加权方案。

Result: 在ImageNet类条件生成（256×256与512×512）上，UniRA的FID持平或优于SOTA DiT方法（SD3、REPA、RAE），训练步数最多减少5倍；统一表示空间还支持更好的零样本分类与线性探测，表明生成与理解能从共享的对齐潜空间共同受益。

Conclusion: 表示对齐与表示自编码可在统一目标下互补：共享且对齐的潜空间既加速扩散训练、提升生成质量，又保留语义表示能力，从而统一生成与理解任务。

Abstract: Diffusion transformers (DiTs) have become the dominant architecture for high-fidelity image synthesis, yet they suffer from slow training convergence and high computational cost. Two recent lines of work address this from complementary angles: Representation Alignment (REPA) accelerates DiT training by aligning intermediate features with a pretrained external representation model (e.g., DINOv2), while Representation Auto-Encoders (RAE) replace the pixel-space VAE with a compact representation-space tokenizer learned from self-supervised features. However, these approaches are developed and applied in isolation: REPA still relies on a pixel-space VAE for latent diffusion, and RAE does not exploit the alignment signal that accelerates the diffusion backbone. We present \textbf{UniRA}, a unified framework that couples representation alignment and representation auto-encoding into a single objective. UniRA learns a representation-space tokenizer whose output serves simultaneously as the diffusion target and the alignment anchor, so the tokenizer, the diffusion backbone, and the external representation model are co-optimized. We give a theoretical result showing that this joint optimization preserves the representation quality of the external model while accelerating diffusion convergence, and we derive a principled weighting that balances the reconstruction, alignment, and generation objectives. On ImageNet class-conditional generation at 256*256 and 512*512, UniRA matches or surpasses state-of-the-art DiTs (SD3, REPA, RAE) in FID while reducing training steps by up to 5*. We further show that the unified representation space supports improved zero-shot classification and linear probing, confirming that generation and understanding benefit from a shared, aligned latent space.

</details>


### [167] [BiHashFormer: Hash-Driven Dual-Branch Transformer for Efficient Object Detection in HRW Shots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39937)
*Jingchen Huang,Wenxi Li,Chenyang Lyu,Moran Liu,Haozhe Lin,Yuchen Guo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出BiHashFormer，一种基于哈希的双稀疏分支Transformer，用于十亿像素级高分辨率宽幅图像检测，通过RoI选择、HashAttention压缩分支与HashMiner补偿分支解决前景稀疏问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 十亿像素级宽幅图像存在前景极度稀疏、分辨率极高、前景与背景交错三大挑战，传统检测器与注意力机制被大量背景干扰，导致低效且不准确，需要针对性稀疏化设计。

Method: （1）RoI Selector预测前景占比并做top-k窗口选择；（2）压缩分支处理被选窗口，将注意力细化为HashAttention，丢弃一半key-value对以降低开销；（3）补偿分支用HashMiner在剩余区域进行低成本哈希搜索，恢复漏检目标特征；（4）并行双分支结构避免分支间依赖带来的推理延迟。

Result: 在十亿像素基准PANDA上，BiHashFormer将backbone FLOPs降低37.5%，同时AP50提升至81.0%；并行双分支结构避免推理延迟，且稳定性显著优于单分支模型，在RoI选择率低时尤为明显。实验还验证HashAttention中的选择关系是单向的，并揭示不同query对key的偏好差异。

Conclusion: 基于哈希的双稀疏分支Transformer能有效应对十亿像素图像的前景稀疏与背景干扰问题，在效率、精度与稳定性之间取得良好平衡，为超高清宽幅视觉检测提供了可行范式。

Abstract: Recent advances in gigapixel-level imaging have brought High-Resolution Wide shots to the forefront of research. However, these images present significant challenges: extreme sparsity of foreground, gigapixel-level resolutions and interleaving of foreground and background. This causes traditional detectors and attention mechanisms to be hindered by background, resulting in inefficiency and inaccuracy. To tackle this problem, we propose BiHashFormer, a dual sparsified branch transformer built on hashing. RoI Selector will predict the foreground proportion for top-k selecting target-containing windows. The compression branch processes windows selected and refines attention into HashAttention by discarding half of the key-value pairs, reducing cost and improving efficiency. The compensation branch uses HashMiner to perform low-cost hash searches in the remaining regions, recovering features of missed objects. Experiments confirm that the selection relationship in HashAttention is one-way and reveal the preference of different queries for keys. In experiments on the gigapixel benchmark PANDA, BiHashFormer reduces 37.5% backbone FLOPs while improving AP50 to 81.0%. Moreover, this parallel dual-branch structure allows the model to avoid inference delays caused by inter-branch dependencies, while achieving much greater stability than single-branch models, specially with low rates of RoI selection.

</details>


### [168] [VideoMemBench: How Well Do MLLMs Remember in Video Conversations?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40131)
*Zhengdong Hu,Chao Wang,Kaituo Feng,Huanjin Yao,Mingfei Lu,Hehe Fan,Yi Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 VideoMemBench，用于评测多模态大模型在长视频多轮对话中的"上下文内视频记忆"能力，该能力指跨轮检索并复用此前看到与说过的信息。基准含 326 个视频、2476 轮对话，其中 1387 轮依赖前文；最强模型 Claude Opus 5 仅得 45.7%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频 QA 基准的题目相互独立、互不引用且均可仅凭视频作答，无法衡量跨轮信息携带能力，即"上下文内视频记忆"（对已见内容的记忆与对自身已给答案的记忆）。

Method: 构建 VideoMemBench：每个样本为单视频配长多轮对话，轮次间引入两类带类型的跨轮依赖——Episodic Dependency（回溯先前轮次描述的视频片段）与 Answer Dependency（基于模型自身先前答案），并施加必要性（无前文则不可答）与非泄漏性（不重述前文信息）两项校验；采用 planner、generator、judger 三角色 LLM 构建流水线，并由人类专家逐条审核。

Result: VideoMemBench 含 326 个视频、2476 轮对话，其中 1387 轮依赖前序轮次，包含多父依赖与长距离回指；在 20 余个开源与闭源 MLLM 中，最佳为 Claude Opus 5，总体得分仅 45.7%。

Conclusion: 现有 MLLM 的上下文内视频记忆能力显著不足，该能力构成长视频多轮交互的主要瓶颈；数据集与评测已开源发布。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can now process hour-long videos, making extended multi-turn dialogue over a single video a natural mode of use. Sustaining such a dialogue requires more than answering each question in isolation: the model must retrieve and reuse information established earlier in the conversation, both what it has seen and what it has said, an ability we term in-context video memory. Existing video QA benchmarks leave this ability unmeasured: their questions are mutually independent, never reference one another, and each is answerable from the video alone, so nothing ever requires carrying information across turns. We introduce VideoMemBench, in which each sample pairs a single video with a long multi-turn dialogue, whose turns are connected by typed cross-turn dependencies: an Episodic Dependency refers back to a visual episode described in an earlier turn, probing memory of what the model has seen, while an Answer Dependency builds on the model's own earlier answer, probing memory of what the model has said. Every dependency is verified considering two properties: 1) necessity, meaning the question cannot be answered without its earlier turns, and 2) non-leakage, meaning the question does not restate the information from its earlier turns. To enforce these properties, we design a construction pipeline with three LLM roles: a planner, a generator, and a judger, with each dialogue reviewed by human experts. VideoMemBench comprises 326 videos with 2,476 turns, of which 1,387 depend on earlier turns, including multi-parent dependencies and long-range call-back. Among over 20 evaluated open- and closed-source MLLMs, Claude Opus 5 performs the best with an overall score of only 45.7\%, highlighting the challenge of in-context video memory. Our dataset and evaluation are released.

</details>


### [169] [Learning a Motion Manifold to Constrain Ambiguity in Unsupervised 4D Medical Image Interpolation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40121)
*Haojin Li,Huazhu Fu,Heng Li,Jiang Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出运动流形学习框架（谱基底+Cayley重定向）解决无监督4D医学图像插值中的运动歧义，在ACDC与4D-Lung上达到无中间监督方法的最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从时间稀疏观测中重建中间解剖状态缺乏中间监督，不同运动场可与端点高度吻合却产生不同的中间解剖结构，形成"运动歧义"。当需从端点估计大量独立可调的运动变量时，该歧义难以约束。

Method: 通过学习运动流形限制候选运动场并保留样本特异变化：1）跨样本谱基底学习（Cross-Sample Spectral Basis Learning）从端点导出的稠密估计中提取反复出现的运动结构并编码为共享谱基底；2）样本条件Cayley基底重定向（Sample-Conditioned Cayley Basis Reorientation）用预测的运动坐标旋转每个端点对的有效运动方向，且不增加独立坐标数；二者组合定义跨端点对的非线性完整速度场族。对预测场积分可实现任意中间时刻的双向重建。

Result: 理论分析给出端点观测在所学运动族内可区分邻近运动的充分条件；ACDC与4D-Lung实验中，在无中间体积训练的方法中取得SOTA，并与使用中间监督的方法相当。

Conclusion: 以共享谱基底加样本条件旋转构成受限但富表达的运动流形，可在无中间监督下有效缓解运动歧义，实现高质量4D插值。

Abstract: Unsupervised 4D medical image interpolation reconstructs intermediate anatomical states from temporally sparse observations without intermediate supervision. Distinct motion fields may attain comparable endpoint agreement while producing different intermediate anatomy, giving rise to motion ambiguity. This ambiguity is difficult to constrain when many independently adjustable motion variables must be estimated from the observed endpoints. We develop a framework that learns a motion manifold to restrict candidate motion fields while retaining sample-specific variation. Cross-Sample Spectral Basis Learning extracts recurring motion structure from endpoint-derived dense estimates and encodes it in a shared spectral basis. Sample-Conditioned Cayley Basis Reorientation uses predicted motion coordinates to rotate the effective motion directions for each endpoint pair without increasing the number of independent coordinates. Their composition defines a nonlinear family of complete velocity fields across endpoint pairs, accommodating anatomical and motion-state differences within a restricted representation. Integrating each predicted field supports bidirectional reconstruction at arbitrary intermediate times. Theoretical analysis establishes sufficient conditions under which endpoint observations distinguish nearby motions within the learned family. Experiments on ACDC and 4D-Lung demonstrate state-of-the-art performance among the evaluated methods trained without intermediate volumes and competitive results against methods using intermediate supervision.

</details>


### [170] [SynthFaces: Balanced Large Scale Human Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40119)
*Sergey Karpukhin,Denis Bobkov,Kirill Morozov,Aibek Alanov*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一条可控生成流程，通过在身份嵌入流形上引入 flow matching 生成模型扩展 Arc2Face 扩散模型，构建身份分布均衡的合成人脸数据集 SynthFaces，以缓解真实数据集的偏差与隐私问题，并用于公平模型的训练与微调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实世界数据集存在固有偏差与隐私风险，身份表征不均衡且含敏感个人信息，导致在偏斜数据上训练的生成模型（尤其身份保持生成）表现出不公平性能。作者希望同时获得生成保真度与标签多样性。

Method: 将 Arc2Face 基础扩散模型扩展为在身份嵌入流形上运行的 flow matching 生成模型，实现人脸的可控生成；按设计发布合成图像与合成身份，并使用最近邻非泄漏指标（nearest-neighbor non-leakage metric）实证检验身份分离性。

Result: 构建了高度均衡的以身份为中心的合成数据集 SynthFaces；实证表明其在生成保真度和标签多样性上同时达标，且为真实数据集所不具备；身份分离性经非泄漏指标验证。

Conclusion: SynthFaces 减少了对真实个人图像的直接依赖，可用于各类下游任务的公平模型训练与调优，并在微调现有基于 adapter 的个性化生成方法中得到验证。

Abstract: The pursuit of fair and equitable AI in human-centric tasks is critically hindered by the inherent biases and privacy risks of real-world datasets, which offer imbalanced representations of identity and often contain sensitive personal information. Consequently, state-of-the-art generative models trained on this skewed data exhibit unfair performance, particularly in identity-preserving generation. In this work we propose a pipeline for controllable generation of dataset with diverse faces for generative models training and finetuning. We achieve this by expanding foundational Arc2Face diffusion model with a flow matching generative model in the manifold of identity embeddings. We demonstrate that such approach achieves both goals of generative fidelity and label diversity not present in real human-centric datasets. As a result we collect and further contextualize a highly balanced identity-centric dataset of humans named SynthFaces. By design, our released images and identities are synthetic, reducing direct reliance on real personal images; we empirically check identity separation with a nearest-neighbor non-leakage metric. We purpose it for training and tuning of fair models for various downstream tasks, and showcase its usability in finetuning an existing adapter-based method for personalized generation.

</details>


### [171] [MOSAIC-Flow: Orthogonal-Axis and Status-Conditioned Fusion for Missing-Sequence Completion in Brain Tumor MRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39534)
*Pengli Zhu,Zhihao Peng,Yixuan Yuan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MOSAIC-Flow统一框架，通过模态感知独立编码、正交轴细化、状态条件原型融合与条件流匹配，实现脑肿瘤MRI缺失序列补全。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨模态融合会模糊序列特异对比度并丢失细粒度三维肿瘤细节，而完整序列对脑肿瘤全面表征至关重要。

Method: 模态感知stem独立编码各序列；正交轴细化捕获轴位/冠状位/矢状位依赖并保留3D表示；状态条件原型融合用紧凑的模态与可用性token路由并调制池化查询，实现目标自适应条件化而无需稠密体素级注意力；条件流匹配目标将目标通道噪声输运至单一缺失序列，七个体积固定，并平均四条Heun轨迹。

Result: 在UCSF-PDGM的结构、扩散与增强MRI上，八个单目标补全任务的全脑与肿瘤区域保真度一致良好，结构序列表现最佳。

Conclusion: MOSAIC-Flow以目标条件的流匹配替代跨模态融合，兼顾序列特异性与三维细节，是通用的缺失序列补全方案。

Abstract: Missing-sequence completion is important for comprehensive brain tumor characterization, but cross-modal fusion can obscure sequence-specific contrast and lose fine-grained three-dimensional tumor detail. To address this challenge, we introduce Modality-aware Orthogonal-axis Status-conditioned Attentive Integration for Completion (MOSAIC-Flow), a unified framework for missing-sequence completion that learns a target-conditioned velocity field while keeping the seven acquired volumes fixed throughout the transport. Specifically, modality-aware stems independently encode each sequence, and orthogonal-axis refinement captures axial, coronal, and sagittal dependencies while retaining the three-dimensional representation. Status-conditioned prototype fusion uses compact modality and availability tokens to route and modulate pooled queries from the fused visual representation, enabling target-adaptive conditioning without dense voxel-to-voxel attention. A conditional flow matching objective transports target-channel noise toward the single missing sequence, while four Heun trajectories are averaged to produce the completion. Evaluation across structural, diffusion, and contrast-enhanced MRI in UCSF-PDGM demonstrates consistent whole-brain and tumor-region fidelity across all eight single-target completion tasks, with the strongest performance on structural sequences. Code is available at https://github.com/CUHK-AIM-Group/MOSAIC-FLOW.

</details>


### [172] [MorphSIG: Subject-Driven Image Generation via Decoupled Anchoring and Feature Transport](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39530)
*Hailong Yan,Yongrui Zhang,Xiangtao Zhang,Le Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出无需训练的 MorphSIG 框架，将主体驱动图像生成重构为伪视频特征传输，在保持主体一致性的同时显著提升姿态多样性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有主体驱动图像生成（SIG）方法存在结构锁定问题，导致生成姿态单一；同时现有基准存在风格同质化且缺乏真值标注的问题。

Method: MorphSIG 包含两个核心模块：(1) 渐进解耦锚定（Progressive Decoupled Anchoring），在去噪早期通过频域解耦与结构打乱打破结构锁定，实现从自由构图到身份对齐的渐进过渡；(2) 伪流引导特征传输（Pseudo-flow Guided Feature Transport），在潜空间构建伪流场，模拟图像到视频的时序一致性以精确传输主体语义。此外构建了包含多样风格化主体的新基准。

Result: 大量实验表明，在无需额外训练的情况下，MorphSIG 相比基线在姿态多样性与主体保真度上均有显著提升。

Conclusion: MorphSIG 衔接了静态生成与动态传播，为高保真主体一致性提供了一种低成本范式。

Abstract: We propose MorphSIG, a training-free framework that reformulates subject-driven image generation (SIG) as pseudo-video feature transport. MorphSIG contains two core modules: Progressive Decoupled Anchoring, which uses frequency-domain decoupling and structural scrambling during early denoising to break structural locking and enable a gradual transition from free composition to identity alignment; and Pseudo-flow Guided Feature Transport, which constructs a latent-space pseudo-flow field to mimic Image-to-Video temporal coherence and transport subject semantics precisely. To address stylistic homogeneity and the lack of ground truth in existing benchmarks, we further introduce a benchmark with diverse stylized subjects. Extensive experiments show that MorphSIG significantly improves pose diversity and subject fidelity over baselines without additional training. Overall, MorphSIG bridges static generation and dynamic propagation, providing a cost-effective paradigm for high-fidelity subject consistency.

</details>


### [173] [BRIDGE: Learning Brain-Gut Metabolic Evidence for Alzheimer's Disease Diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39520)
*Pengli Zhu,Ruxi Chang,Tianliang Yao,Yu Jiang,Shengyuan Liu,Yiyang Lin,Xiaoyi Duan,Shuang Wu,Yixuan Yuan,the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: BRIDGE是一个两阶段框架，将脑-肠配对代谢知识迁移到仅用脑PET的阿尔茨海默病诊断中，在CN/MCI与CN/AD任务上较纯脑基线AUC分别提升6.0%和5.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 脑-肠相互作用相关的肠道代谢信息有望辅助AD诊断，但现有模型多仅分析脑葡萄糖代谢；全身FDG-PET虽可提供脑-肠配对观测，常规脑检查却很少包含肠道成像，导致该信息难以直接用于诊断。

Method: 提出BRIDGE两阶段框架：包含条件式脑到肠潜空间传输模块与疾病证据引导的脑通路，以捕捉受试者特异的跨器官对应关系与疾病相关脑表征；脑通路中利用LLM将文献描述整理为经人工认可的语义锚点以指导特征学习；并引入反事实引导的残差融合机制，以匹配/非匹配的虚拟肠道证据监督置信门控，动态调节迁移信息贡献。推理阶段仅需脑PET。

Result: 在公开与私有队列上的大量实验表明，BRIDGE优于仅脑及跨器官基线，相较纯脑版本在CN/MCI和CN/AD诊断上AUC分别提升6.0%与5.2%。

Conclusion: BRIDGE能在推理时仅以脑PET为输入的前提下迁移互补的脑-肠代谢上下文，具备临床实用性潜力。

Abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) diagnosis may benefit from gut metabolic information associated with brain-gut interactions, yet existing models largely analyze cerebral glucose metabolism alone. Although whole-body fluorodeoxyglucose positron emission tomography (FDG-PET) can provide paired brain-gut observations, routine brain examinations rarely include gut imaging, limiting direct use of this information for diagnosis. In this paper, we present BRIDGE (Brain and Gut Representation Integration via Distribution-Guided Enhancement), a two-stage framework for transferring brain-gut metabolic knowledge to brain-only diagnosis. Specifically, BRIDGE integrates a conditional brain-to-gut latent transport module and a disease-evidence-guided cerebral pathway to capture subject-specific cross-organ correspondence and disease-relevant cerebral representations. For the cerebral pathway, a large language model (LLM) helps organize literature-derived descriptors into human-approved semantic anchors that guide feature learning. Additionally, we introduce a counterfactual-guided residual fusion mechanism, which uses matched and non-matched virtual-gut evidence to supervise a confidence gate and dynamically regulate the contribution of transported cross-organ information. At inference, BRIDGE exploits complementary gut-related context using brain PET alone, without measured gut PET. Extensive experiments across public and private cohorts demonstrate that BRIDGE outperforms brain-only and cross-organ baselines, achieving AUC gains of 6.0% and 5.2% over its brain-only counterpart for CN/MCI and CN/AD diagnosis, respectively. Notably, its ability to transfer complementary brain-gut metabolic context while preserving brain PET as the sole inference input highlights its potential for clinically practical diagnosis. Our code is available at https://github.com/CUHK-AIM-Group/BRIDGE.

</details>


### [174] [DINOv2 for PET: A Pre-Training Domain Benchmark Across Classification, Segmentation, and Prognosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40018)
*Roxanne De Maeyer,Yannick Brackenier,Vicky De Ridder,Simon DeKeyser,Maarten Larmuseau,Jef Vandemeulebroucke*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出PET-DINOv2-2D，首个在2D PET影像上预训练的DINOv2模型，并在三个下游PET任务上与DINOv2（自然图像）和OmniRad（CT/MRI/超声）对比，在预训练数据量远少于两者的情况下性能相当或更优，且标签稀缺时优势最明显。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文献表明自然图像DINO特征在放射影像（X-ray、CT、MRI）上迁移良好，但对PET等功能成像迁移较差；而PET专用的DINO模型极少，且缺乏跨多任务、多数据集的验证。因此需要一个PET专用自监督预训练模型并系统评测其迁移性。

Method: 构建PET-DINOv2-2D：以DINOv2自监督框架在2D PET图像上预训练；所有骨干网络（PET-DINOv2-2D、LVD-142M自然图像预训练的原始DINOv2、CT/MRI/超声预训练的OmniRad）统一使用相同的轻量级下游头，以保证公平比较。

Result: 尽管预训练数据量远少于两个基线，PET-DINOv2-2D在正常/异常分类、病灶分割、无复发生存预后三个PET下游任务上匹配或超越DINOv2与OmniRad；标签稀缺条件下优势最大。

Conclusion: PET专用自监督预训练可获得迁移性更强、标签效率更高的特征，验证了模态特异性预训练对功能成像的价值；代码已开源。

Abstract: DINO (self-DIstillation with NO labels) has become a stan- dard for self-supervised pre-training, producing features that generalise across datasets and downstream tasks. In medical imaging it has been adopted mainly for radiology (X-ray, CT and MRI), where even natural- image DINO features transfer well. In the literature, these features have been reported to transfer worse to functional imaging such as PET. Yet PET-specific DINO models have barely been introduced, and even less validated across multiple tasks and datasets. We present PET-DINOv2-2D, the first DINOv2 model pre-trained on 2D PET, and benchmark it against open-source encoders: the origi- nal DINOv2 (pre-trained on the LVD-142M natural-image dataset) and OmniRad (pre-trained on CT, MRI and ultrasound). Using the same lightweight heads for every backbone, and despite far less pre-training data, PET-DINOv2-2D matches or outperforms both on three down- stream PET tasks: normal/abnormal classification, lesion segmentation and recurrence-free survival prognosis. Its advantage is largest when few labels are available, suggesting that PET pre-training gives more transferable, label-efficient features. Code is made available at https://github.com/nuclivision/pet-dinov2-2d/.

</details>


### [175] [Spectral Invariant Fusion and Refinement for Domain Generalized Semantic Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39926)
*Yansong Bai,Yunzhi Zhuge,Xinzhuo Yu,Lu Zhang,Jin Zhan,Pingping Zhang,Huchuan Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SIFR——一种频率感知的双流框架，在融合与解码两个阶段同时抑制域敏感干扰并保留细粒度空间线索，用于域广义语义分割。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 域广义语义分割需在训练时无法访问目标域数据的情况下实现未见域的稠密预测。现有方法（数据多样化、不变学习、直接用基础模型）难以同时抑制域敏感干扰并保留细粒度的空间线索。

Method: 以频谱建模为统一原则，同时规范异构先验交互与稠密解码精化：1）频谱引导的不变融合，不对冻结的CLIP与DINOv2特征做直接融合，而是滤除域敏感响应、保留互补的语义与结构信息；2）频谱解码精化模块，通过基于低频统计的归一化与自适应频率选择稳定多尺度解码特征，减少残余域偏置向稠密预测的传播。

Result: 在多个DGSS基准（合成到真实、真实到真实、恶劣天气设置）上，相较此前SOTA方法取得一致性提升。

Conclusion: 频谱建模可作为统一原则，在融合与解码两个阶段协同提升域鲁棒性与分割精度，在严重分布偏移下仍有效。

Abstract: Domain generalized semantic segmentation is challenging because it requires accurate dense prediction on unseen domains without any access to target-domain data during training. Existing methods improve transferability through data diversification, invariant learning, or direct use of foundation models, but they often struggle to simultaneously suppress domain-sensitive interference and preserve fine-grained spatial cues. In this work, we propose SIFR, a frequency-aware dual-stream framework that tackles domain shift at both the fusion and decoding stages. SIFR uses spectral modeling as a unified principle to regulate both heterogeneous prior interaction and dense decoder refinement. Instead of directly fusing frozen CLIP and DINOv2 features, SIFR performs spectral-guided invariant fusion to filter out domain-sensitive responses while preserving complementary semantic and structural information.
