In addition, SIFR incorporates a spectral decoder refinement module that stabilizes multi-scale decoder features through low-frequency statistics-based normalization and adaptive frequency selection, thereby reducing the propagation of residual domain bias in dense prediction. This design enables SIFR to jointly improve domain robustness and segmentation precision under severe distribution shifts. Extensive experiments on multiple DGSS benchmarks, including synthetic-to-real, real-to-real, and adverse-weather settings, demonstrate consistent improvements over previous state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [176] [What Survives Label Downsampling? Exact Region Survival for Coarse Segmentation Targets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39880)
*Zhiyuan Zhang,Yukun Ou,San Tek Choi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MatchDown，用区域与网格单元的最小代价匹配构建粗粒度分割标签，最大化保留小区域，并引入优先级分层MatchDown-P，证明其丢失区域数达到理论下界，实验中显著优于常规下采样。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分割网络在输出步长下训练时，目标标签由跨步采样、最近邻重采样或多数池化下采样得到；这些方法对每个粗网格单元独立打标签，导致未赢得任何单元的小区域在目标中消失、得不到正标签，从而损害小目标与实例分割性能。

Method: 将粗标签构建建模为区域与其占据网格单元之间的最小代价匹配问题，使保留区域数达到单区域每单元约束下的上限，并可证明不可避免的丢失数；进一步提出带优先级分层的MatchDown-P，保证每个被评估区域至少占有一个单元面积。MatchDown在训练前一次性运行，替代标签下采样步骤。实验在COCO、Cityscapes、BBBC038上以2–16倍下采样因子评估，并与StarDist、nnU-Net、连接组学金字塔的下采样及多数池化、跨步目标、细胞中心采样对比，配合星凸头与亲和头。

Result: MatchDown-P在2–16倍因子下恰好只丢失理论最少数量的区域，而StarDist/nnU-Net式下采样在COCO因子8时丢失量为其4–5倍。理论上证明多数池化丢失的区域无法通过上采样任何粗目标达到IoU>0.5重建；BBBC038上星凸头用MatchDown目标可分割35%被多数池化丢失的核（多数目标15%、跨步目标24%）。两个细胞核数据集上Acc50比跨步目标高2.6–4.2点，比细胞中心采样最多低2.8点，BBBC039计数误差更低；亲和头相对多数目标计数误差降低9.3个/图但Acc50低7.2点。

Conclusion: 标签下采样本身即是不应被忽视的性能瓶颈；通过匹配式构造粗目标可在不改变网络结构的前提下最小化区域丢失，改善小目标与实例分割精度，且与现有训练流程兼容，可一次预处理替代传统下采样步骤。

Abstract: Segmentation networks that predict at an output stride are trained against label maps downsampled by strided sampling, nearest-neighbor resampling or majority pooling. These methods label each coarse grid cell on its own, so a region that wins no cell is absent from the target and receives no positive label. We present MatchDown, which builds the coarse target from a minimum-cost matching between regions and the grid cells they occupy. It keeps as many regions as any one-region-per-cell target can, certifies how many losses are unavoidable, and with priority tiers (MatchDown-P) keeps every evaluated region (a region that a metric scores) of at least one cell's area. On COCO, Cityscapes and BBBC038 at factors 2 to 16, MatchDown-P loses exactly the minimum number of regions, whereas the downsampling used by StarDist, nnU-Net and connectomics pyramids loses four to five times as many on COCO at factor 8. Keeping a region in the target and reconstructing its shape are different problems: we show that no region lost by majority pooling can be reconstructed above IoU 0.5 by upsampling any coarse target, yet on BBBC038 a star-convex head trained on MatchDown targets segments 35% of the nuclei that majority pooling loses above IoU 0.5, against 15% when trained on majority targets and 24% on StarDist's strided target. On two nucleus datasets, with thresholds cross-validated for count error, this head has instance accuracy at IoU 0.5 (Acc50) 2.6 to 4.2 points above the strided target and at most 2.8 points below cell-center sampling, and a lower count error than the strided and cell-center targets on BBBC039. On BBBC039, an affinity head, which outputs one label per cell, lowers count error relative to majority targets by 9.3 nuclei per image at 7.2 points lower Acc50. MatchDown runs once, before training, in place of the label-downsampling step.

</details>


### [177] [Parametric Gaussian Noise Mixer (PGNM): Unified Synthesis of Camera Noise and Film Grain](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39868)
*Mingyang Song*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种显式统计噪声合成模型：用归一化卷积在像素与颜色通道间关联高斯场，再用查找表按干净强度将高斯值映射为残差；两部分可独立拟合，无需复现成像物理过程或训练神经生成器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有噪声合成主要依赖两类方法：基于图像形成过程的物理模型，或训练神经网络生成噪声图像。前者需复现成像物理机理、通用性受限；后者需训练生成器、成本较高。作者寻求折中方案——直接从成对干净/噪声图像拟合的显式统计模型。

Method: 模型由两部分组成：(1) 归一化卷积（normalized convolution），将高斯场跨像素与颜色通道进行相关性建模；(2) 查找表（lookup），在给定干净图像强度条件下，把每个高斯值映射为残差。由于高斯场始终保持标准高斯分布，两个组件可解耦、分别拟合。同一套公式同时用于SIDD的相机噪声与Newson的模拟胶片颗粒。

Result: 在SIDD上，所提方法在评估方法中取得最低的平均分布误差与相关误差；在胶片颗粒数据上保持竞争力。用其合成噪声训练的去噪器，性能最接近用真实噪声训练的去噪器。1080p帧在GPU上渲染耗时10 ms。

Conclusion: 该工作表明，一个简单、可解释、可分离拟合的显式统计模型，即可在噪声分布与空间/通道相关性上逼近真实噪声，并有效支撑去噪器训练，同时具备高渲染效率（10 ms/1080p），为噪声合成提供了介于物理模型与神经生成器之间的实用方案。

Abstract: Noise synthesis is commonly approached through physical models of image formation or neural networks trained to generate noisy images. We explore a middle ground: an explicit statistical model fitted directly from paired clean and noisy images. A normalized convolution correlates a Gaussian field across pixels and color channels, and a lookup maps each Gaussian value to a residual given the clean intensity. Because the field stays standard Gaussian, the two components are fitted separately, without reproducing the physical process or training a neural generator. With one formulation for camera noise from SIDD and simulated film grain from Newson, the model has the lowest average distribution and correlation errors on SIDD among the evaluated methods and remains competitive on film grain. A denoiser trained on its noise comes closest to one trained on real noise, and a 1080p frame renders in 10 ms on GPU.

</details>


### [178] [LiDAR-SHIELD: A Fully Dockerized Adversarial Robustness Assessment Framework for LiDAR-Based 3D Perception Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39848)
*Alexandros Gkillas,Ioulia Kapsali,Christos Anagnostopoulos,Aris S. Lalos*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LIDARSHIELD 是一个统一、完全 Docker 化的对抗攻击框架，通过三个 HTTP 端点（/info、/forward、/gradient）将任意 LiDAR 3D 感知模型解耦接入，支持语义分割与目标检测的统一攻击评测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LiDAR 对抗攻击实现分散于各自仓库，与特定架构或任务绑定，复现需手动重建环境并编写模型专属集成代码，缺乏统一、可复用的安全测评平台。

Method: 采用“反转工作流”的设计：不在工具包内安装目标模型，而是通过 HTTP 服务协议暴露任意模型（/info 获取元信息、/forward 前向推理、/gradient 梯度回传）；接入新模型或数据集仅需一个 loader 函数或适配器。同一引擎-服务协议同时覆盖 3D 语义分割与 3D 目标检测，集成任务感知的攻击套件：分割任务含 PGD 与 Square Attack，检测任务含点扰动、点移除、点注入与 LiDAttack。

Result: 框架可在异构 LiDAR 骨干网络上系统性地暴露 corner case 与脆弱性；模型与攻击解耦，显著降低环境重建与集成成本；分割与检测任务统一在同一协议下评测。

Conclusion: LIDARSHIELD 以 Docker 化、端点评测的方式实现了 LiDAR 3D 感知对抗鲁棒性评估的统一化与可扩展化，代码已开源（https://github.com/alexandrosgk/LiDAR-shield），为部署前的安全压力测试提供了标准化基础设施。

Abstract: LiDAR-based 3D perception underpins autonomous driving and robotics, yet deploying these models safely requires stress-testing them against adversarial inputs before real-world use. Although state-of-the-art adversarial attacks exist, their implementations are often fragmented across individual repositories, each tied to a specific architecture or task and requiring manual environment reconstruction and model-specific integration code. We present LIDARSHIELD, a unified and fully Dockerized framework that reverses this workflow: rather than installing the target model inside the toolkit, LIDARSHIELD exposes any model through three lightweight HTTP endpoints, namely /info, /forward, and /gradient As a result, connecting a new model or dataset requires only a single loader function or adapter. The framework supports both 3D semantic segmentation and 3D object detection through the same engine-service protocol, integrating a task-aware suite of state-of-the-art attacks, including PGD and Square Attack for segmentation, and point perturbation, point removal, point injection, and LiDAttack for detection. This enables systematic exposure of corner cases and vulnerabilities across heterogeneous LiDAR backbones. The LiDAR-Shield codebase is publicly available at https://github.com/alexandrosgk/LiDAR-shield.

</details>


### [179] [Aligning Medical Vision Language Models at the Capability Boundary with Entropy Adaptive Rubric Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39835)
*Hongyu Bai,Jiaqi Zeng,Chunzheng Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MedCBR两阶段对齐框架：先用难度加权边界偏好优化（DBPO）聚焦能力边界的反事实偏好学习，再用熵门控锚定策略优化（EGPO）以临床评分准则做可验证强化学习，六个医学基准达61.2%平均准确率，两阶段增益超可加。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医学视觉语言模型的对齐目标激励了错误行为：统一SFT使简单样本主导更新、关键边界病例过早饱和；仅基于最终答案正确性的稀疏奖励无法评估解剖学 grounding 与临床推理逻辑，易被答案捷径型 reward hacking 利用。

Method: 两阶段框架。阶段一：依据经验通过率在模型能力前沿构造反事实边界偏好对（共享推理前缀、在决定性诊断分支处分叉），用DBPO将学习集中于校准后的边界区域。阶段二：从边界轨迹中蒸馏可复用临床评分准则（rubric），按预测熵门控激活；EGPO同时奖励答案正确性、解剖定位与推理保真度，并在高置信样本上抑制准则噪声。以边界对齐模型作为参考策略，耦合群体级边界先验与实例级不确定性。

Result: 在六个医学基准上一致优于强通用、专科及强化学习基线，平均准确率61.2%，在困难鉴别诊断任务上增益最大；消融显示两阶段组合收益超可加（super-additive）。

Conclusion: 边界加权的偏好优化与准则锚定的可验证强化学习相互增强，使医学诊断推理更准确且具备临床可验证性；难度校准与熵门控是控制学习信号质量的关键设计。

Abstract: Medical diagnostic reasoning requires verifiable links between visual evidence and clinical knowledge, yet current medical vision language models are aligned with objectives that reward the wrong behavior. Uniform supervised fine tuning lets easy cases dominate updates while clinically critical boundary cases saturate prematurely. Sparse rewards based only on final-answer correctness cannot assess anatomical grounding or clinical logic, inviting reward hacking through answer shortcuts. We propose MedCBR, a two-stage alignment framework coupling boundary-aware preference optimization with rubric-grounded reinforcement learning. First, we construct counterfactual boundary preferences at the model's capability frontier using empirical pass rates and preference pairs that share reasoning prefixes but diverge at decisive diagnostic branches. Difficulty Weighted Boundary Preference Optimization (DBPO) concentrates learning on this calibrated boundary region. Second, we distill reusable clinical rubrics from boundary trajectories and activate them according to prediction entropy. Entropy Gated Grounded Policy Optimization (EGPO) rewards answer correctness, anatomical grounding, and reasoning fidelity while suppressing rubric noise on reliable samples. A reference policy anchored to the boundary-aligned model couples population-level boundary priors with instance-level uncertainty, making diagnostic reasoning more accurate and clinically grounded. Experiments on six medical benchmarks show consistent improvements over strong general, specialized, and reinforcement learning baselines, reaching 61.2% average accuracy with the largest gains on challenging differential diagnosis tasks. Ablations show super-additive gains: combining the two stages exceeds the sum of their individual improvements.

</details>


### [180] [Hierarchical Step Decomposition for Training-free Online Video Step Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40153)
*Long Zhou,Luca Zanella,Paolo Rota,Massimiliano Mancini,Elisa Ricci*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练的层次化步骤分解框架HSD，利用大型多模态模型的语义理解能力，实现在线视频步骤定位（VSG）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VSG方法要么离线（需完整视频），要么在线但依赖固定长度片段，导致输出噪声大、过分割严重。在线场景下存在两大挑战：从流式视频构建语义连贯的时间段，以及弥合粗粒度步骤描述与视觉观测间的语义鸿沟。

Method: HSD为免训练框架：1）增量地将流入片段聚合为语义一致的事件，使用一个持续与视觉流校验的锚点字幕（anchor caption）构建基本时间单元；2）在这些事件上做零样本步骤分类，并对不确定预测进行选择性精炼——将候选步骤分解为更细粒度的子步骤以捕捉更细微的视觉证据。

Result: 在HT-Step、Ego4D Goal-Step和CrossTask上大幅超越SOTA，实现更好的步骤识别、更准确的时间定位以及更快的推理速度。

Conclusion: 基于语义连贯事件而非固定长度片段进行在线推理，可减少冗余计算并产生更稳定的预测，验证了层次化分解与免训练LMM方案在在线VSG中的有效性。

Abstract: Given a set of procedural steps, Video Step Grounding (VSG) aims to identify which steps occur in a video and localize when they are performed. Existing methods are either offline, requiring access to the full video before making predictions, or online, but relying on fixed-length video segments producing noisy, over-segmented outputs. In this work, we propose Hierarchical Step Decomposition (HSD), a training-free framework for online VSG that leverages the semantic understanding capabilities of Large Multimodal Models. HSD addresses two central challenges in online grounding: constructing semantically coherent temporal segments from a streaming video, and bridging the semantic gap between coarse procedural step descriptions and visual observations. To construct elementary temporal units, HSD incrementally groups incoming segments into semantically consistent events, using an anchor caption that is continuously validated against the visual stream. Based on these events, we perform zero-shot procedural step classification and selectively refine uncertain predictions by decomposing candidate steps into finegrained substeps that capture more nuanced visual evidence. By operating on semantically coherent events rather than every fixed-length segment, HSD reduces redundant computation and produces more stable predictions. Experiments on HT-Step, Ego4D Goal-Step, and CrossTask show that HSD substantially outperforms state-of-the-art methods, overall achieving better step recognition, more accurate temporal localization, and faster inference.

</details>


### [181] [Neural Blind Deconvolution for Image Scanning Microscopy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40088)
*Eliot Guez,Nathan Buskulic,Lisa Cuneo,Luca Calatroni,Giuseppe Vicidomini*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练的盲DIP框架，利用ISM扫描图像间的差异联合估计样本与探测器相关的PSF，并通过探测器几何参数化减少未知量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ISM通过多图像反卷积融合各探测器元件的扫描图像以获得超分辨结果，但其精度依赖PSF模型，而样本与系统引入的像差常使理论PSF失效。

Method: 基于扫描图像差异编码像差信息的观察，构建免训练盲Deep Image Prior框架，同时估计样本与探测器相关PSF；PSF由探测器几何及共享的激发、发射PSF参数化，保留物理ISM模型并减少未知量；采用高斯预初始化稳定盲优化。

Result: 在实验微管管蛋白数据上，盲DIP相比多图像反卷积及使用固定理论PSF的DIP恢复出更精细的丝状结构，且PSF能自适应测量数据。

Conclusion: 盲DIP可在无需训练与真实PSF标签的条件下提升ISM重建质量，验证了将像差估计嵌入DIP的可行性与有效性。

Abstract: Image scanning microscopy (ISM) acquires one scanned image per detector element, which are then fused into a single image by multi-image deconvolution to obtain a super-resolved image. Its accuracy, however, depends on point spread function (PSF) models that sample- and system-induced aberrations often invalidate. Since differences between the scanned images encode aberration information, we propose a training-free blind Deep Image Prior (DIP) framework that jointly estimates the specimen and the detector-dependent PSFs. The PSFs are parametrised through the detector geometry and shared excitation and emission PSFs, reducing the unknowns while preserving the physical ISM model, and a Gaussian pre-initialisation stabilises the blind optimisation. On experimental tubulin data, blind DIP recovers finer filamentous structures than multi-image deconvolution and DIP with fixed theoretical PSFs, while adapting the PSFs to the measurements.

</details>


### [182] [Morphology-Aware Channel-Decoupled Mamba Network for Medical Image Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40085)
*Chenchen Wang,You Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出形态感知通道解耦Mamba网络MCDNet，在Synapse腹部CT多器官分割上取得81.61%平均Dice。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CT多器官分割对计算机辅助诊断、治疗规划和疾病监测至关重要，但器官形状尺寸差异大、组织对比度低、边界模糊，使得异构解剖结构建模困难。

Method: 设计形态感知通道解耦状态空间（MCSS）模块，将特征通道划分为独立处理组；每组内用形态感知增强模块（MAEM）结合可变形卷积与通道注意力实现自适应局部特征提取；随后进行分组状态空间建模以捕获长程空间依赖，并通过通道门控自适应融合特征。

Result: 在Synapse腹部CT数据集上验证有效性，多器官分割平均Dice相似系数达81.61%。

Conclusion: 将自适应局部结构增强与通道解耦长程建模相结合，可有效应对器官形态多变与边界模糊问题，提升多器官分割精度。

Abstract: Accurate multi-organ segmentation in computed tomography (CT) is essential for computer-aided diagnosis, treatment planning, and disease monitoring. However, substantial variations in organ shape and size, together with low tissue contrast and ambiguous boundaries, complicate the modeling of heterogeneous anatomical structures. To address these challenges, we propose a Morphology-Aware Channel-Decoupled Mamba Network (MCDNet), which integrates adaptive local structural enhancement with channel-decoupled long-range modeling. Specifically, we introduce a Morphology-Aware Channel-Decoupled State-Space (MCSS) block that divides feature channels into separate processing groups, allowing differentiated structural representations to be learned within an efficient state-space framework. Within each group, a Morphology-Aware Enhancement Module (MAEM) combines deformable convolutions with channel attention to adapt local feature extraction to anatomical shape variations. Group-wise state-space modeling then captures long-range spatial dependencies, and channel gating adaptively integrates the resulting features. Experiments on the Synapse abdominal CT dataset demonstrate the effectiveness of MCDNet, achieving an average Dice Similarity Coefficient of 81.61% for multi-organ segmentation.

</details>


### [183] [Localizing Concepts in Visual Autoregressive Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40061)
*Nanxiang Jiang,Yang Liu,Yuanhao Wang,Min Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出LoCo——首个模型无关的框架，用于在下一尺度视觉自回归模型中从Layer、Scale、Position三个维度定位概念涌现的位置与时机，并构建LoCoBench基准，验证定位的可解释性与因果性，进而应用于概念擦除、个性化与对抗概念注入。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型中的概念定位已有广泛研究，但新兴的下一尺度（next-scale）视觉自回归范式中概念内部路由机制仍基本空白；理解概念路由对生成模型的安全可控适配至关重要。

Method: 利用下一尺度生成天然的由粗到细特性，设计模型无关的LoCo框架，沿Layer（层）、Scale（尺度）、Position（位置）三维度映射概念知识；并提出LoCoBench数据集（覆盖10类），在无上下文偏置条件下系统定位与评估概念路由。在Infinity、HunyuanImage-3.0、InfinityStar等图像与视频自回归模型上进行探测。

Result: 探测表明定位到的位置既可解释又与概念涌现存在因果关系；基于此的定向干预在概念擦除、模型个性化、对抗概念注入三项应用中达到SOTA，大幅降低计算开销且保持良性实用性。

Conclusion: 揭示了自回归生成过程中概念知识的路由规律，为更可解释、高效、安全的模型适配提供了实用路径。

Abstract: Understanding the internal routing of visual concepts is crucial for the safe and controllable adaptation of generative models. While concept localization has been widely studied in diffusion models, the emerging paradigm of next-scale visual autoregressive models remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we introduce LoCo, the first model-agnostic framework to localize where and when specific concepts emerge within autoregressive models. Driven by the native coarse-to-fine nature of next-scale generation, our method precisely maps conceptual knowledge across three distinct dimensions: Layer, Scale, and Position. To systematically localize and evaluate concept routing without context bias, we propose LoCoBench, a comprehensive dataset spanning 10 diverse categories. Extensive probing on image and video autoregressive models like Infinity, HunyuanImage-3.0, and InfinityStar shows that the localized positions are both interpretable and causally related to concept emergence. Building on these insights, we apply our localization method to three key applications: concept erasure, model personalization, and adversarial concept injection. Experiments demonstrate that our targeted intervention achieves state-of-the-art performance, substantially reducing computational overhead while preserving benign utility. Overall, our findings offer insights into how conceptual knowledge is routed during autoregressive generation, introducing a practical pathway for more interpretable, efficient, and secure adaptation.

</details>


### [184] [Radiology Guideline-derived Decision Graph for Efficient Clinical Decision Support](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40327)
*Xuewen Zhou,Zhen Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GDGraph将指南编译与病例评估解耦：先由LLM把指南切分为章节块、抽取带定义链接的局部决策子图并聚合成可执行决策图，推理时用快速System One模型回答局部问题、由确定性遍历解析布尔逻辑，实现可追溯决策路径且无需任务特定训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 放射学风险分层与管理规划是医学影像的关键下游任务，但指南标准分散在散文、表格与交叉引用定义中，自动化困难。

Method: 两阶段框架：编译阶段用大模型做章节切块、抽取带链接定义的局部决策子图、聚合成可执行决策图；推理阶段由System One模型回答局部临床问题，确定性遍历解析布尔逻辑，将单次不透明预测转为可追溯决策路径。

Result: 在涵盖肾囊肿、附件包块、甲状腺结节三类指南的347例病例上，System One准确率由57.3%提升至90.8%，优于RAG-GPT-4o（80.1%）与图引导CoT-GPT-4o（82.7%），且延迟与成本显著更低。

Conclusion: 将指南结构化编译与病例评估解耦，可在无需任务特定训练的前提下兼顾准确性、可追溯性与效率；源码将公开。

Abstract: Radiological risk stratification and management planning are essential downstream tasks in medical imaging. Automating these tasks is challenging because clinical guideline criteria are distributed across prose, tables, and cross-referenced definitions. We present Guideline-derived Decision Graph (GDGraph), a framework that decouples guideline compilation from case evaluation. During compilation, a large language model partitions guidelines into section-based chunks, extracts local decision subgraphs with linked definitions, and aggregates related branches into an executable decision graph. During inference, a fast System One model answers localized clinical questions while deterministic traversal resolves Boolean logic, turning opaque single-pass predictions into a traceable decision path without task-specific training. Across 347 cases spanning renal cyst, adnexal mass, and thyroid nodule guidelines, GDGraph improves System One accuracy from 57.3% to 90.8%, outperforming retrieval-augmented GPT-4o (80.1%) and graph-guided GPT-4o with chain-of-thought (82.7%) at substantially lower latency and cost. The source code will be available.

</details>


### [185] [Textual Response-Aware Guidance for Zero-Shot Adversarial Robustness of Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40309)
*Yubo Cui,Xianchao Guan,Zheng Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出文本响应感知引导（TRAG），利用预训练文本编码器对输入嵌入局部变化的响应方向与幅度构造锚点级约束，并按图文相关性聚合为图像自适应约束，从而抑制对抗微调中的视觉表征漂移，在保持零样本能力的同时取得SOTA的干净与鲁棒性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLMs零样本泛化强但易受对抗攻击。现有对抗微调依赖预训练模型引导以保持图文对齐，但两类引导各有缺陷：匹配视觉特征对各方向等权约束、覆盖面广却缺乏语义侧重；匹配预测分布虽聚焦语义相关方向，但受候选文本集与预测概率限制。二者均难以充分保留预训练图文关系，导致零样本性能下降。

Method: 通过分析视觉表征漂移揭示上述两类引导的互补局限，提出TRAG：以预训练文本编码器对输入嵌入局部扰动的响应为信号，在语义锚点周围提取响应的方向与幅度构建锚点级约束，再依据预训练图文相关性对各锚点约束加权聚合，形成图像自适应的漂移约束用于对抗微调。

Result: 在多种架构与任务上的大量实验表明，TRAG在干净精度与对抗鲁棒性上均达到SOTA；进一步分析显示TRAG有助于保留预训练图文关系。

Conclusion: TRAG以文本编码器局部响应替代特征/分布匹配引导，实现兼具语义侧重与覆盖性的自适应约束，是缓解对抗微调中表征漂移、维持零样本泛化的有效方案。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit strong zero-shot generalization but remain vulnerable to adversarial attacks. Existing adversarial fine-tuning methods often use pre-trained model guidance to preserve image--text alignment while improving robustness. Our analysis of visual representation drift reveals complementary limitations of two representative forms of guidance. Matching visual features provides broad coverage by constraining all directions equally, but lacks semantic emphasis. Matching prediction distributions prioritizes semantically relevant directions, but remains limited by the candidate texts and prediction probabilities. These limitations can hinder preservation of pre-trained image--text relationships and degrade zero-shot performance. To address these issues, we propose Textual Response-Aware Guidance (TRAG), which constrains visual representation drift using the pre-trained text encoder's responses to local variations in input embeddings. Specifically, TRAG constructs anchor-level constraints from the response directions and magnitudes around semantic anchors, then aggregates them using pre-trained image--anchor relevance, yielding an image-adaptive constraint. Extensive experiments across architectures and tasks demonstrate state-of-the-art clean and robust performance. Further analysis shows that TRAG helps preserve pre-trained image--text relationships.

</details>


### [186] [Beyond CCT: Multi-channel SPD recovery for per-shot camera color correction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40175)
*Shuwei Yue,Hongke Wei,Qiao Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出用多通道环境光传感器与白点约束下的非负最小二乘反演光源SPD，再逐张拟合3x3 CCM，替代CCT插值管线；合成与实测基准上角度误差与尾部误差均下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统相机用2–3个预标定3x3矩阵按CCT插值做色彩校正，本质是把光源SPD压缩为一个标量。LED、荧光及混合光源偏离黑体轨迹，且存在色度相同但最优CCM不同的同色异谱光源，CCT管线无法区分。

Method: 以相机白点和多通道环境光传感器（ALS）读数为条件，对基字典做非负最小二乘求解，恢复光源光谱功率分布（SPD）；再基于恢复的SPD为每张图像闭式拟合一个3x3 CCM。

Result: 在含300种光源、3100条反射率的合成基准上，平均角度误差由1.89°降至1.20°；在LED类非普朗克组（n=45）上尾部误差降低1.7倍。增益在ALS不完美与观测噪声下依然保持，并在1684条实测SPD上复现同样的非普朗克优势。

Conclusion: 以SPD反演替代CCT标量假设可有效缓解同色异谱歧义，对非普朗克光源色彩校正更鲁棒，且兼容真实传感器缺陷，具备实用可行性。

Abstract: Modern cameras correct color via two or three pre-calibrated 3x3 matrices interpolated by Correlated Color Temperature (CCT). This collapses the illuminant SPD to a scalar. LEDs, fluorescents, and mixed sources sit off the Planckian locus, and metameric illuminants with the same chromaticity demand different optimal CCMs that a CCT pipeline cannot distinguish. We recover the illuminant SPD instead using non-negative least squares against a basis dictionary, conditioned on the camera white point and a multi-channel ambient-light sensor (ALS). A closed-form 3x3 CCM is then fit per shot. On a synthetic benchmark of 300 illuminants and 3,100 reflectances, mean angular error drops from 1.89 to 1.20 degrees, with a 1.7x tail reduction on the LED-like off-Planckian group (n=45) where metameric ambiguity is tangible. The gain holds under realistic ALS imperfections and observation noise, and the same off-Planckian advantage carries over to 1,684 real measured SPDs.

</details>


### [187] [SonoWorld4D: From One Video to a 4D Audio-Visual Scene via Diffusion Synchronization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40640)
*Derong Jin,Xiyi Chen,Ming C. Lin,Ruohan Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出新任务 Video-to-4DAVScene 与框架 SonoWorld4D，将单目视频转化为可探索、随时间变化的 4D 音视场景，支持新视角视觉与空间音频实时渲染。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉场景生成已从静态 3D 扩展到由少量输入生成动态 4D 场景，但声音虽与动态物体和事件本质耦合，却在先前工作中基本未被建模。作者希望把视觉动态与物理一致的空间声场统一到同一 4D 表示中。

Method: 输入单目视频后分三部分：生成 360° 静态背景；重建发声动态前景物体的显式运动轨迹；通过"双空间音频扩散同步"（dual-space audio diffusion synchronization）合成跨多声源一致、物理合理的声场。

Result: 在真实动态场景上的评测与用户研究显示，SonoWorld4D 生成的 4D 音视场景具有感知真实、物理合理且与场景几何和视觉内容一致的空间音频，并支持实时新视角视觉与空间音频渲染。

Conclusion: 该工作将音频纳入 4D 场景生成，提出 Video-to-4DAVScene 任务及 SonoWorld4D 框架，实现视觉与空间音频联合、可实时探索的 4D 音视场景生成。

Abstract: Recent progress in visual scene generation has extended beyond static 3D scenes toward the more challenging problem of generating dynamic 4D scenes from minimal input. However, sound, despite being intrinsically coupled with dynamic objects and events, remains largely unmodeled in prior work. We introduce Video-to-4DAVScene, a new task that turns a video into an explorable, time-varying 4D audio-visual scene, and present the SonoWorld4D framework for this task. Given a monocular video, our method generates a 360 static background, reconstructs explicit motion trajectories of dynamic, sound-emitting foreground objects, and synthesizes a physically-grounded sound field consistent across multiple sources through dual-space audio diffusion synchronization. The resulting 4D scene supports real-time novel-view visual and spatial audio rendering. Evaluation on real-world dynamic scenes and a user study demonstrates SonoWorld4D generates 4D audio-visual scenes with perceptually realistic, physically grounded spatial audio consistent with scene geometry and visual content.

</details>


### [188] [HairDeck: Animation-Ready Stylized Hair Cards from a Single Image](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40599)
*Yuze He,Yixiang Wei,Wang Zhao,Chuhao Chen,Yanning Zhou,Yong-Jin Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HairDeck将风格化发片（hair cards）发型视为无序基元集合，用集合扩散Transformer从单张图像一次性生成全部发片及其弹簧骨骼链，得到可动画资产。相比CHARM，Chamfer距离降44%、发片朝向误差减半、速度快33倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 游戏与虚拟形象中风格化角色的头发由艺术家放置的发片（ribbon）构成，并由弹簧骨骼驱动动画。现有图像方法只生成写实头发或单一融合网格；唯一生成风格化发片的CHARM将发型自回归解码为超长控制点序列，效率低且未利用发片的集合性。

Method: 关键观察：发片发型是艺术家定义的无序基元集合。HairDeck以每张发片为一个token，采用集合扩散Transformer对所有发片联合去噪；输入单张图像，同时输出发片几何与驱动其的弹簧骨骼链，并导出为下游可直接使用的格式。

Result: 在CHARM自带测试集上，Chamfer距离降低44%，发片朝向误差减少一半以上，运行速度提升33倍；在单图输入下优于CHARM、图像到3D流水线及基于发丝（strand）的方法。

Conclusion: 将发型建模为无序发片集合、以集合扩散替代自回归序列解码，可同时获得更高几何精度、更好朝向一致性和显著加速，并能输出可直接动画、导出的完整发片资产。

Abstract: The hair of stylized characters in games and avatars is built from hair cards: artist-placed ribbons whose geometry is the visible hair, animated by spring bones. Existing image-based methods produce realistic hair or a single fused mesh, while CHARM, the only generator of stylized hair cards, decodes a hairstyle autoregressively as a long sequence of control points. Observing that a card hairstyle is an unordered set of artist-defined primitives, we propose HairDeck, which generates it as one: each card is a single token, and a set diffusion transformer denoises all cards together. From a single image, HairDeck generates the cards and the spring-bone chains that drive them, yielding an animatable asset that exports to ready-to-use downstream formats. On CHARM's own test set, it lowers Chamfer distance by 44% and card-orientation error by more than half while running 33 times faster, and from single images it outperforms CHARM, image-to-3D pipelines and strand-based methods. Project page: https://hyzcluster.github.io/HairDeck

</details>


### [189] [Beyond Ground Truth: A Heuristic Unsupervised Quality Assurance Engine for Diagnosing Calibrational Blindness in Dental Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40587)
*Fatematuj Johura Mim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出无真值掩膜的质量检查引擎HUS-QA，利用置信度、边缘锐度、形状连通性与面积惩罚指标评估牙科X光分割质量，与真实Dice相关系数0.4647、ROC-AUC 0.8405，显著优于标准置信度方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床真实场景下，深度学习牙科X光分割存在可靠性问题：分割质量差时模型仍给出高置信度（校准盲区），且医生实际使用时没有真值掩膜可用来验证准确度，亟需无参考的质量评估手段。

Method: 在PRAD根尖片数据集上训练基于SimCLR自监督预训练的ResNet-18 U-Net，生成分割掩膜；构建三阶段HUS-QA质量检查引擎，在无真值掩膜条件下综合预测置信度、边缘锐度、形状连通性与面积尺寸惩罚四项简单指标评估分割质量。

Result: 标准置信度方法失效（r = -0.1394, p = 1.7864e-3, ROC-AUC = 0.4275）；HUS-QA与实际Dice分数呈正相关（r = 0.4647, p = 3.7510e-28），ROC-AUC达0.8405。

Conclusion: HUS-QA可作为临床质量控制中的实用工具，在缺乏真值掩膜的情况下有效识别低质量分割结果。

Abstract: In real-world clinical settings, dental X-ray segmentation using deep learning methods suffers from reliability issues. Even when the segmentation quality is bad, deep learning models show high confidence in their predictions (calibrational blindness). Moreover, in real use, doctors do not have ground-truth masks to check their accuracy. To address this problem, we introduce a simple quality-checking engine called HUS-QA with three stages. We train it on the PRAD (Periapical Dental X-ray) dataset to build our SimCLR self-supervised ResNet-18 U-Net model, which generates the segmentation mask and then evaluates its quality. Our HUS-QA checks the segmentation mask quality without a ground-truth mask. Prediction confidence, edge sharpness, shape connectivity, and area-size penalty are the simple indicators considered in this research. Results show that standard confidence methods fail (r = -0.1394, p = 1.7864e-3, ROC AUC = 0.4275). By contrast, our HUS-QA shows a positive correlation with actual Dice scores (r = 0.4647, p = 3.7510e-28) and achieves a strong ROC-AUC of 0.8405. Therefore, HUS-QA serves as a practical tool for clinical quality control.

</details>


### [190] [PhysCount: Do MLLMs Count Visual Appearances or Physical Entities?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40530)
*Lidong Lu,Jiaxin Lv,Liangrui Dong,Xinyi Mao,Lidong Zou,Zhenquan Li,Tong Lu,Guo Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 PhysCount 基准，用于区分 MLLM 的两类计数能力：统计图像中可见外观（appearances）与推断场景中真实存在的物理实体（entities）。包含 546 张真实图像、4,595 个人工问题、651 个目标分组，四类互补问题族。测试 40 个 MLLM，发现统计可见外观显著易于恢复实体身份，最强模型全组正确率仅 13.36%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉计数基准很少区分"图像中出现了多少次"与"场景中存在多少个物体"。同一实体可通过镜子反射、玻璃等多重外观呈现，逐次检测可见外观并不能决定实体数量。因此需要一个基准来检验 MLLM 能否区分"图像中显现的"与"物理上存在的"。

Method: 构建 PhysCount：546 张真实图像、4,595 个人工撰写问题、651 个目标特定分组。标注者对每组定位相关外观、标注其观察方式（观察模式）、并识别属于同一实体的外观。设计四类互补问题族：外观枚举、物理实体枚举、特定成像方式计数、外观—实体对应关系。评测指标为各族准确率与"整组全对"比例，覆盖 40 个 MLLM。

Result: 统计可见外观明显易于恢复连接它们的实体身份；最强模型仅 13.36% 分组全对。当一个实体产生大量外观或外观跨越不同观察模式时性能下降。提高图像分辨率改善视觉证据获取，但对全组正确率提升有限；而联合回答相关问题带来显著提升。

Conclusion: 结果表明 MLLM 存在"识别可见内容"与"正确恢复其背后物理实体"之间的能力鸿沟，为多模态计数与物理推理评测提供了新的诊断视角。

Abstract: Images reveal appearances, but counting often asks about physical objects. A single entity may be visible directly, in several reflections, or through glass, so detecting every visible occurrence does not determine how many entities are present. Existing visual counting benchmarks rarely separate these two operations. We introduce PhysCount, a benchmark for evaluating whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can distinguish what appears in an image from what physically exists in the scene. PhysCount contains 546 real-world images and 4,595 human-written questions organized into 651 target-specific groups. For each group, annotators locate the relevant appearances, label how each is observed, and identify appearances of the same entity. Four complementary question families test the enumeration of appearances, the enumeration of physical entities, image-formation-specific counting, and appearance--entity correspondence. We measure both accuracy on each family and the proportion of groups answered entirely correctly. Across 40 MLLMs, counting visible appearances is substantially easier than recovering the identities that connect them. Even the strongest model answers every question correctly in only 13.36\% of groups. Performance declines when one entity produces many appearances or when its appearances cross observation modes. Higher image resolution improves access to visual evidence but brings limited gains in complete-group accuracy, whereas answering related questions jointly produces a marked improvement. These results expose a gap between recognizing what is visible and correctly recovering the physical entities behind those observations.

</details>


### [191] [AVPS-360: A Spatial Audio-Visual Benchmark for Instance Segmentation and Tracking of Sound-Producing Persons](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40480)
*Yifu Sun,Parthasaarathy Sudarsanam,Tuomas Virtanen,Archontis Politis*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 AVPS-360，一个将视听实例分割（AVIS）与声事件定位检测（SELD）衔接的空间视听基准：基于 STARSS23，将一阶 Ambisonics 空间音频与同步 360° 视频配对，共 230 段录制、10.5 小时、31,678 个人工校验实例掩码；并给出融合空间音频与视觉特征的基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 AVIS 基准多采用单声道音频，缺乏通道间线索，难以在空间上区分同时发声的多个声源；且真实场景中发声往往是间歇性的，现有方法在长视频中的检测与身份关联能力不足。

Method: 构建 AVPS-360 数据集：以 STARSS23 为基础，配对一阶 Ambisonics 空间音频与同步 360° 视频，平均时长 164.0 秒，标注 31,678 个实例掩码并关联声源身份与声事件标签，声音以语音为主，兼有笑声、拍手、脚步等。同时提出将空间音频特征与视觉特征融合的基线模型，实现帧级分割与跨帧身份关联。

Result: 实验表明，现有 AVIS 方法在含间歇性发声的长录制视频中，目标检测与身份关联表现较差；所提基线在这两方面均取得显著提升。

Conclusion: 引入空间音频（Ambisonics）与 360° 视频可有效弥补单声道 AVIS 在空间声源分离上的不足；AVPS-360 为 AVIS 与 SELD 的交叉研究提供了新基准，并揭示了长时、间歇发声场景下身份关联的关键挑战。

Abstract: Audio-visual instance segmentation (AVIS) segments and tracks individual sound-producing objects in videos. Existing benchmarks predominantly use monaural audio, which lacks inter-channel cues for spatially distinguishing concurrent sound sources. We introduce AVPS-360 (Audio-Visual Person Segmentation 360), a spatial audio-visual benchmark bridging AVIS and sound event localisation and detection (SELD). Built upon STARSS23, it pairs first-order Ambisonics audio with synchronised 360° video across 230 recordings totalling 10.5 hours. Recordings average 164.0 seconds. The dataset captures intermittent sound production in real-world interactions dominated by speech, alongside laughter, clapping, and footsteps. It provides 31,678 manually reviewed instance masks linked to source identities and sound-event labels. We also present a baseline that integrates spatial audio with visual features for frame-level segmentation and identity association across frames. Experiments on AVPS-360 show that existing AVIS methods struggle with detection and identity association in long recordings with intermittent sound production, while our baseline substantially improves performance in both aspects.

</details>


### [192] [WorldProbe: When Video World Models Fall Apart under Long-Horizon Spatial Exploration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39721)
*Minqi Wang,Jie Peng,Hejun Dong,Ruchang Yao,Puyi Wang,Siyuan Huang,Jihai Zhang,Yafu Li,Qi Dou,Xiaoye Qu,Yu Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出WorldProbe诊断基准，用目标条件多模态智能体在生成过程中在线调整相机动作，对视频世界模型进行长时程探索评测，揭示局部稳定与全局世界一致性之间的差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频世界模型基准多只评估短交互，或使用生成前固定的相机轨迹，导致在长时程、大范围相机运动下的表现未被充分探索。

Method: 构建WorldProbe基准，包含4类探针族、164个测试案例；采用目标条件（goal-conditioned）多模态智能体在生成过程中在线自适应输入相机动作；对10个SOTA模型生成超1600条rollout、总计约800分钟、时程最长180秒的视频，并从四个维度评测。

Result: 评测显示局部指标随长时程退化，并出现长程不一致性；近期模型能在更长时间内维持视觉与内容质量，但长程记忆与世界演化能力仍然薄弱。

Conclusion: 现有基准忽略了局部稳定生成与持久世界一致性之间的鸿沟；WorldProbe揭示了这一差距，代码与基准资源已开源。

Abstract: Video world models generate future visual observations from camera or action inputs, with the goal of synthesizing persistent 3D worlds that can be explored across time and space. Existing benchmarks typically evaluate short interactions or rely on camera trajectories fixed before generation. The performance of video world models under long-horizon exploration with extensive camera motion remains under-explored. We introduce WorldProbe, a diagnostic benchmark that uses a goal-conditioned multimodal agent to adapt camera actions online during generation. WorldProbe comprises 164 test cases across four probing families. Across 10 state-of-the-art models, we generate more than 1,600 rollouts totaling approximately 800 minutes, with horizons up to 180 seconds. Our evaluation across four dimensions reveals both the degradation of local measures and the emergence of long-range inconsistencies. We find that recent models sustain visual and content quality for longer, while long-range memory and evolution remain weak. These results expose a gap between locally stable generation and persistent world consistency that is largely missed by existing benchmarks. Code and benchmark resources are available at https://github.com/Untitled-W/WorldProbe.

</details>


### [193] [Intrinsic Distribution Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39633)
*Deyuan Liu,Yansen Han,Kaiwen Zheng,Jun Xie,Jiacheng Liu,Zhenglin Cheng,Peng Sun,Jintao Zhang,Jianguo Li,Tao Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Intrinsic Distribution Matching (IDM)，将反向KL场分解为高斯矩分量与非高斯残差，在保留完整 DMD 校正的同时用生成器 EMA 特征显式匹配一阶矩与逐坐标标准差，在少步文本生图任务上取得最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 一步/少步文生图缺乏反复修正的机会，必须精准还原提示细节。DMD 依赖分数差，作者追问：能否用一个显式的矩约束来强化这种学习到的分数监督。

Method: 对 reverse-KL 场做高斯矩分量 + 非高斯残差的分解，从而识别可显式约束的统计量；沿用内部 velocity 分支估计分数差（无需额外 fake-score 网络）；引入矩损失，用生成器自身的 EMA 副本匹配特征均值与逐坐标标准差，不需要外部特征编码器。在 Z-Image-Turbo 6B、Qwen-Image 20B 上做全参数与 LoRA 微调。

Result: 两次网络评估下，IDM 在中英文 LongText-Bench 上分别达 94.25% 与 90.20%，为该预算下对比方法中最高；消融显示矩损失带来稳定增益；在五项指标上，生成器 EMA 特征与外部 DINOv2 编码器表现相当。

Conclusion: 显式矩约束是对 DMD 分数监督的有效补充，且可完全内生于生成器自身表征，无需外部编码器即可实现高质量少步生成。

Abstract: One-step and few-step text-to-image generation must accurately render the details specified in the prompt despite limited opportunities for refinement. Distribution matching distillation (DMD) uses score differences to bring the generated distribution closer to a reference distribution. Following prior work, we estimate this difference with internal velocity branches, avoiding a separate fake-score network. We ask whether an explicit moment constraint improves this learned score supervision. A decomposition of the reverse-KL field into a Gaussian moment component and a non-Gaussian residual identifies statistics that can be constrained explicitly. We introduce Intrinsic Distribution Matching (IDM), which retains the full DMD correction and matches feature means and per-coordinate standard deviations using the generator's exponential-moving-average (EMA) copy, requiring no external feature encoder. Experiments use full-parameter and low-rank adaptation (LoRA) tuning on Z-Image-Turbo 6B and Qwen-Image 20B. At two network evaluations, IDM reaches 94.25% and 90.20% on Chinese and English LongText-Bench, the highest scores among the compared methods at this budget. Controlled ablations show gains from the added moment loss, while generator EMA features perform competitively with an external DINOv2 encoder across the five reported metrics. Code is available at https://github.com/inclusionAI/IDM.

</details>


### [194] [FutureWorld: A Plug-and-Play Causal Next-State Predictor for Interactive Video World Exploration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39619)
*Guangyuan Li,Kelu Yao,Shuolin Xu,Xinlei Yu,Wei Xing,Lei Zhao,Peng-Tao Jiang,Xiaogang Xu,Xiaobin Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出即插即用的因果下一片段预测器C-NCP，通过从当前潜变量与下一动作预测未来场景状态，为下一视频片段生成提供先验，从而抑制历史潜变量复用导致的误差循环累积。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互式视频世界模型需在长时间交互中保持场景一致性。基于历史的复用方法（重用已生成潜变量）存在三类误差重循环问题：1）每个交互生成的潜变量被直接当作历史，可能含模糊细节、几何畸变或语义漂移；2）检索到的历史内容即便与当前场景匹配，仍会将误差带入下一片段；3）新输出又成为后续历史，反复复用使同一误差被强化。因此需要打破该循环。

Method: 在生成下一交互视频片段之前，先由当前生成的潜变量与下一动作预测未来场景状态，形成“未来状态先验”以指导下一片段生成，减少从历史继承的误差。具体设计为即插即用的Causal Next-Chunk Predictor (C-NCP)，具备跨模型适配能力与预测引导调制（prediction-guided modulation）机制。将C-NCP集成到四个基础生成器中验证。

Result: 在交互式长视频生成与动作条件世界建模的三个基准上评估增强后的模型。大量实验表明，在多种生成设置下误差累积减少、长时程一致性提升。

Conclusion: 以“预测未来状态”替代单纯“复用历史潜变量”作为引导信号，可有效缓解基于历史方法的误差循环问题，且C-NCP作为插件式模块具有良好的跨模型可迁移性，为长时间交互的世界模型提供通用的误差抑制方案。

Abstract: Interactive video world models aim to follow user actions while maintaining scene consistency over extended interactions. History-based methods reuse generated latents to preserve scene content, but three limitations of this reuse contribute to error recirculation. 1) The latent generated at each interaction is retained as history, potentially containing blurred details, geometric distortions, or semantic drift. 2) Although retrieved historical content matches the current scene, it can still contain errors that are carried into the next chunk. 3) New outputs then become history for later interactions, potentially reinforcing the same errors through repeated reuse. To limit this cycle, we aim to predict the future scene state from the current generated latent and the next action before generating the next interaction's video chunk. This future-state prior provides guidance for the next chunk, with the aim of reducing the errors carried forward from history. To this end, we propose a plug-and-play Causal Next-Chunk Predictor (C-NCP) with cross-model adaptability and prediction-guided modulation. We integrate C-NCP into four base generators and evaluate the augmented models across three benchmarks for interactive long-video generation and action-conditioned world modeling. Extensive experiments demonstrate reduced error accumulation and improved long-horizon consistency across diverse generation settings. The project page is at https://GuangYuanKK.github.io/futureworld.

</details>


### [195] [DOSE: Dominance-Guided Ordinal Severity Estimation from Sparse Relative Annotations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39584)
*Tushir Sahu,Hideaki Hayashi,Hajime Nagahara*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DOSE：无需绝对标注，仅用稀疏成对比较学习有序医学严重度，通过全局比较图估计支配分数、设置累积间隔并生成伪对，再用无标签分数校准得到离散等级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学严重度本质是有序的，但现有方法把等级当作独立类别；learning-to-rank只能给出连续排序、无法直接预测离散等级，而绝对等级标注又昂贵。

Method: 构建全局比较图聚合稀疏成对比较，估计每张图像的支配分数（dominance score）；以其差值在嵌入空间设定累积间隔，使严重度差更大的对分离更强；并由支配分数生成伪对，监督标量严重度头；推断时通过无标签分数校准（以tie-anchored分割为主）将连续严重度轴离散化为等级。

Result: 在ACNE04、IDRiD、LIMUC上，不同成对预算下均稳定优于成对排序基线。

Conclusion: 稀疏相对标注足以学出有序严重度表示，并可经无标签校准转成离散等级，为免绝对标注的严重度分级提供可行方案。

Abstract: Medical severity estimation commonly relies on absolute grade annotations, which are fundamentally ordinal, yet existing methods often treat the grades as independent categories. Learning-to-rank methods, which can be trained using relative annotations based on severity comparisons of image pairs, can provide continuous severity rankings but cannot directly predict discrete severity grades. We propose Dominance-guided Ordinal Severity Estimation from Sparse Relative Annotations (DOSE), a framework for learning ordinal medical severity from sparse pairwise comparisons without using absolute annotations. DOSE aggregates the observed comparisons through a global comparison graph to estimate a dominance score for each image. Differences between dominance scores set cumulative margins in the embedding space, so that pairs with larger estimated severity differences are separated more strongly, and also generate pseudo-pairs that supervise a scalar severity head alongside the observed comparisons. The learned continuous severity axis is converted into discrete grades via label-free score calibration, with tie-anchored segmentation as the main calibration method. In the experiment, DOSE consistently outperformed pairwise-ranking baselines on ACNE04, IDRiD, and LIMUC under different pair budgets. Code is available at https://github.com/TushirSahu/DOSE

</details>


### [196] [BEACON: Distilled Begin/End-Aware Structured Decoding for Continuous Sign Language Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39553)
*Guohou Zhang,Kalin Stefanov*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出BEACON分割器，以四类BIOE标注、八种合法转移的约束Viterbi解码与二分类教师蒸馏边界知识，在严格no-cut评测下显著提升segment-F1与下游识别WER，并论证segment-F1比boundary-F1更能反映识别效用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在基于分割的连续手语识别中，分割只是服务于下游识别的手段，但现有分割器多以局部边界检测（boundary-F1）为评价标准，忽略了词法片段质量及其对识别的作用，评价指标与最终目标不一致。

Method: BEACON：1）四类Outside/Begin/Inside/End（BIOE）标注；2）在八种合法转移上进行约束Viterbi解码；3）将二分类教师模型的边界知识蒸馏至共享学生模型。评测采用严格no-cut协议与基于验证集的模型选择；并在五个不同架构族上分析分割指标与WER的相关性。

Result: 相对SOTA，PHOENIX-14/BSL Corpus上segment-F1提升14.58/14.59点，boundary-F1提升2.17/1.22点，下游WER降低9.10/4.15点。相关性分析显示segment-F1与更低WER的一致性优于boundary-F1（Spearman ρ=-1.0/-0.9 对比 -0.9/-0.8）。

Conclusion: 手语分割应以片段质量与下游识别效用为评价依据，而非仅依赖局部边界准确率；segment-F1是更可靠的代理指标，BEACON在严格评测下验证了该观点的有效性。

Abstract: In segmentation-based continuous sign language recognition, an untrimmed video is first partitioned into lexical units; segmentation is therefore a means to an end---downstream recognition. However, segmenters are usually judged by local boundary detection rather than by the quality of the lexical segments and the recognition they enable. We present BEACON, a begin/end-aware segmenter that combines four-class Outside/Begin/Inside/End (BIOE) labeling, constrained Viterbi decoding over eight legal transitions, and boundary knowledge distilled from a binary teacher into a shared student. Under strict no-cut evaluation with validation-based model selection, BEACON improves segment-F1 by 14.58/14.59 points and boundary-F1 by 2.17/1.22 points, and reduces the downstream word error rate (WER) by 9.10/4.15 points relative to the state-of-the-art in the PHOENIX-14/BSL Corpus. To examine which segmentation metric better reflects downstream recognition, we evaluated five distinct architecture families. Segment-F1 aligns more consistently with lower WER than boundary-F1 in both corpora (Spearman $ρ=-1.0/-0.9$ versus $-0.9/-0.8$). These results support evaluating sign language segmentation in terms of segment quality and downstream recognition utility rather than local boundary accuracy alone.

</details>


### [197] [SCOPE: Semantic COdec Pre-Editing for Object-Preserving Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39778)
*Silvia Dani,Leonardo Galteri,Marco Bertini*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 SCOPE，一种在压缩前修改图像的条件式预编辑器，以编解码器族与压缩强度为条件，单一网络适配多种压缩设置，在保护任务相关区域、简化背景以提升可压缩性的同时改善码率-检测精度权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器视觉系统前端广泛使用图像压缩，但标准编解码器主要面向人类感知优化，而非下游任务精度，导致在给定码率下检测性能次优。

Method: 设计条件图像预编辑器 SCOPE：以编解码器族和压缩严重程度作为条件输入，使一个训练好的网络无需重训练或加载特定编解码器权重即可适配多种压缩设置；并非均匀保留整幅图像，而是学习保护任务相关区域、简化不重要的背景内容以提高可压缩性。

Result: 在多种编解码器族与检测器架构上，率-精度曲线均取得一致性增益，并对未见过的学习式与基于小波的压缩族展现出强迁移性。

Conclusion: 压缩前置的语义化预处理可作为改善下游视觉任务码率-精度权衡的有效通用手段，且条件化设计带来跨编解码器的泛化与迁移能力。

Abstract: Image compression is increasingly used before machine vision systems, yet standard codecs are mainly optimized for human perception rather than downstream task accuracy. We propose SCOPE (Semantic COdec Pre-Editing), a conditional image pre-editor that modifies images before compression to improve the bitrate and detection accuracy trade-off. The model is conditioned on the codec family and compression severity, allowing a single trained network to adapt to multiple compression settings without retraining or loading codec-specific weights. Instead of uniformly preserving the whole image, the pre-editor learns to protect task-relevant regions while simplifying less important background content to improve compressibility. The resulting rate-accuracy curves show consistent gains across different codec families and detector architectures, together with strong transferability to unseen learned and wavelet-based compression families.

</details>


<div id='cs.CL'></div>

# cs.CL [[Back]](#toc)

### [198] [3DCodeEdit: Benchmarking Instruction-Guided 3D Program Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38231)
*Binjie Wang,Xinran Zhao,Shoubin Yu,Xiang Li,Silong Yong,Chenyang Yang,Tianyu Chen,Ruofei Du,He He,Chen Zhao,Tongshuang Wu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出3DCodeEdit基准（108个Blender程序、2,592个指令引导的编辑任务），系统评测17个模型的代码级3D编辑能力，发现平均成功率仅37%，并证明多轮渲染反馈可显著补偿模型的"几何预见"缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型日益通过代码生成3D内容，实际工作流更依赖对已有程序的编辑而非重新生成（更快、更可控）。但编辑需理解程序构建了什么、并预见改动的几何后果；现有基准多只评估生成或与参考结果比对的简单编辑，缺乏对复杂编辑与几何预见能力的系统评测。

Method: 构建3DCodeEdit基准：108个完全以代码构建对象的Blender程序，覆盖参数级、结构级编辑、风格重设计与场景组合，共2,592个指令引导任务；通过渲染结果对照经人工审核的检查表进行判定。评测17个模型，并对比多轮反馈（独立审阅模型描述渲染与需求的差异）、最大推理预算、agent harness三种干预方式。

Result: 平均成功率仅37%；最强模型在结构与风格编辑上完成率不足60%。模型能力提升后，失败模式转向几何预见问题——代码可运行但生成的形状错误。干预对比中，来自独立审阅模型的渲染差异反馈效果最佳，优于最大推理effort与agent harness；且可使27B参数模型的单轮成功率超过2.8T参数模型。

Conclusion: 代码级3D编辑是当前模型的能力短板，核心瓶颈在于几何预见而非代码正确性；结构化多轮视觉反馈是比增大推理预算或引入agent框架更有效的补偿手段。

Abstract: Language models increasingly create 3D content through code, with practical workflows often relying on editing existing programs rather than regenerating them, for speed and precise control. Such edits require understanding what a program builds and foreseeing how a change reshapes it, yet prior benchmarks mostly evaluate generation or simple edits against a reference. In this paper, we introduce 3DCodeEdit, a benchmark of 2,592 instruction-guided editing tasks over 108 Blender programs that construct objects entirely in code. Its edits range from parameter to structural changes, style redesign, and scene composition, and are judged from renders against human-reviewed checklists. Across 17 models, the average success rate is only 37%, and even the strongest models complete fewer than 60% of structural and style edits. As models become more capable, their failures shift to geometric foresight, where the code runs but builds the wrong shape. We therefore study whether multi-turn feedback can compensate for this missing foresight. Feedback from a separate reviewer model that describes how the renders differ from the request helps most, more than maximum reasoning effort or an agent harness, and can let a 27B model surpass the single-shot rate of a 2.8T-parameter model.

</details>


### [199] [Tracing the Influence of Retrieved Literature on Scientific Ideation in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39060)
*Zhipin Wang,Koel Dutta Chowdhury,Christoph Leiter,Steffen Eger*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究在统一生成协议下对比五种文献检索策略与无文献基线，用45,000个想法、15个ML主题、10个开源权重模型分离检索策略本身对想法多样性、质量与新意的影响，并用JSD归因追踪单篇论文对各想法四部分的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有"检索+搜索+生成+精炼"流程耦合过紧，难以判断检索策略本身如何塑造生成的想法，需要解耦并单独量化检索的贡献。

Method: 固定生成协议，比较五种检索策略与No Literature基线；规模为15个机器学习主题、十个开放权重模型的45,000个想法；引入基于JSD的归因方法，将每个想法的动机、核心想法、方法、验证四部分归因到具体输入论文。

Result: 相对无文献基线，五种策略在同一组论文内使想法多样性下降5.6%–17.9%，但跨论文集合汇总时多数策略使多样性提升10.2%–18.1%；对质量与新意平均影响有限且存在主题差异。79.3%的想法中仅1–2篇论文在四部分上获得最高归因分数，且这些主导来源常在同一论文集合内重复出现；来源归因更分散的组想法更多样（r=0.70）。

Conclusion: 检索策略主要通过收窄同一文献集内的想法分布、并在集合间引入差异来影响多样性；主导来源的集中与重复是多样性受限的关键，因此应使用多样化文献集合，并以归因指导后续想法的来源选择。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate research ideas from scientific literature. Existing systems combine literature retrieval with search, generation, and refinement, making it difficult to determine how the retrieval strategy itself shapes the ideas generated. We isolate this contribution by comparing five retrieval strategies and a No Literature baseline under a shared generation protocol, using 45,000 ideas across 15 machine learning topics and ten open-weight models. Relative to no literature basline, all five retrieval strategies reduce diversity among ideas generated from the same set of papers by $5.6\%$--$17.9\%$, while most increase diversity by $10.2\%$--$18.1\%$ when ideas from different sets are pooled. Effects on idea quality and novelty are modest on average but vary across topics. We further apply a JSD-based attribution method to trace the influence of individual input papers on each idea's motivation, core idea, approach, and validation. In $79.3\%$ of ideas, only one or two distinct papers receive the highest attribution scores across these four parts. These leading sources often recur across ideas generated from the same set of papers, and groups with more varied source attribution contain more diverse ideas ($r=0.70$). These findings motivate various sets of literature and the use of attribution to guide the choice of sources for subsequent ideas.

</details>


### [200] [Unlimited OCR Works 2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39308)
*Shu Wei,Jingjing Wu,Qunyi Xie,Lingshu Zhang,Xiangcheng Du,Yannian Fu,Mengjie Wang,Zuyi Wang,Zhichao Liu,Yangliu Xu,YY,Yi Yang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Unlimited OCR 2 通过将解码器注意力全部升级为稀疏参考滑窗注意力（SR-SWA），把活跃参考 token 限制在固定容量，从而在任意长文档上保持恒定计算开销，实现百页级文档的一步式解析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程解析虽缓解了随文档变长而增长的工作记忆压力，但当文档扩展到数百页时，视觉上下文显著膨胀，使每步解码的计算成本急剧上升，限制了超长文档解析的可扩展性。

Method: 受人类摘抄书籍时只聚焦当前局部、不回扫前页的启发，提出 Unlimited OCR 2：将 Unlimited OCR 的所有解码器注意力模块替换为 Sparse Reference Sliding Window Attention（SR-SWA），将活跃参考 token 数限定为固定容量；并与 Unlimited-Horizon Decoding Paradigm 结合。

Result: 在百页规模下，每步解码相对 Full Attention 与 R-SWA 分别取得 7.0× 和 5.6× 加速；在 MPDocBench 与新提出的百页文档基准 MarathonDocBench 上均达到 SOTA 端到端性能。

Conclusion: SR-SWA 与 Unlimited-Horizon 解码的结合使解析长度近乎不受限且无过高内存开销；不间断的一次性文档解析标志着进入 OCR 3.0 时代。

Abstract: Unlimited OCR ushers the era of long-horizon parsing, substantially mitigating the growth of working memory as document lengthens. However, as document length scales to hundreds of pages, the visual context grows substantially, sharply increasing the computational cost of each decoding step and limiting the scalability of ultra-long document parsing. Inspired by human book transcription via localized focus without re-scanning preceding pages, we introduce Unlimited OCR 2, a document parsing model that looks only at what it transcribes. Building on Unlimited OCR, we upgrade all the decoder attention modules to Sparse Reference Sliding Window Attention (SR-SWA), bounding active reference tokens to a fixed capacity and thus sustaining constant computational costs across arbitrarily long documents. By combining SR-SWA with Unlimited-Horizon Decoding Paradigm, Unlimited OCR 2 enables document parsing over virtually unlimited lengths without prohibitive memory overhead. At the hundred-page scale, Unlimited OCR 2 achieves 7.0$\times$ and 5.6$\times$ per-step speedups over Full Attention and R-SWA, respectively. Furthermore, it delivers state-of-the-art end-to-end performance on both MPDocBench and MarathonDocBench, our newly proposed benchmark targeting hundred-page document parsing. Ultimately, the capacity for uninterrupted, one-shot document parsing signifies a fundamental paradigm shift into the OCR 3.0 era.

</details>


### [201] [How Architecture, Typology, and Adaptation Strategies Shape ASR for Low-Resource African Languages: A Controlled Empirical Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39004)
*Mercy Muchai,Kevin Chege,Nick Mumero Mwangi,Samuel Chege Maina,Felermino Ali,Elizabeth Ankrah,Ignatius Ezeani*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 系统比较Phi-4-multimodal-instruct、Whisper-large-v3-turbo和MMS-1B-all三种架构在五种低资源非洲语言及斯瓦希里语上的微调表现，考察数据充分性、单/多语适配、领域微调与语种适配器迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低资源语言ASR中，何种架构、微调方式与数据适配策略有效仍不明确，缺乏跨架构的系统性对比证据。

Method: 在5种低资源非洲语言与斯瓦希里语（中等资源对照）上，对三种不同架构模型（Phi-4-multimodal-instruct、Whisper-large-v3-turbo、MMS-1B-all）进行微调；控制变量分析数据量充分性、单语与多语适配、领域微调及语言适配器（language adapter）迁移。

Result: Phi-4整体准确率最佳；MMS的CER相当；Whisper的CER较高，与已知的幻觉与重复循环问题一致。性能在不同数据规模处饱和，给出实用的数据效率目标；类型学复杂度持续影响错误率。领域微调提升Phi-4与Whisper但损害MMS，暴露适配器式适配的局限；代理语言适配器优于从零训练MMS适配器。

Conclusion: 架构选择与适配策略需联合考量：Phi-4综合最优，MMS经代理适配器迁移更具性价比，Whisper需警惕幻觉；数据效率存在饱和点，类型学难度是误差的稳定预测因素。

Abstract: Despite recent advancements in ASR, identifying effective architectures, fine-tuning approaches, and data adaptation strategies for low-resource languages remains challenging. We present a systematic comparison across five low-resource African languages and Swahili as a mid-resource contrast, fine-tuning three models from distinct architectures: Phi-4-multimodal-instruct, Whisper-large-v3-turbo, and MMS-1B-all. We analyze data sufficiency, monolingual versus multilingual adaptation, domain fine-tuning, and language-adapter transfer. Phi-4 achieves the best overall accuracy, MMS shows comparable CER, while Whisper exhibits high CER, consistent with known hallucinations and repetition loops. Performance saturates at different data scales, offering practical data-efficiency targets, while typological complexity consistently shapes error rates. Domain fine-tuning benefits Phi-4 and Whisper but degrades MMS, revealing limitations of adapter-based adaptation. Proxy language adapters outperform training MMS adapters from scratch.

</details>


### [202] [Statutory Article Retrieval from Arabic Judicial Narratives: Family Law and Law of Evidence in Saudi Arabia](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38336)
*Zarah Shibli,Areej Alhothali,Lulwah Alharigy*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出Decompose-and-Refine（DaR）流水线，通过LLM将阿拉伯语司法事实叙述分解为争议法律问题并生成多通道检索查询，显著提升了叙述到法条（尤其证据法）的检索效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 阿拉伯语司法场景中，冗长的事实叙述需映射到表述抽象规则的简洁法条，存在"叙述—法条规则"的抽象鸿沟，导致现有检索系统在跨法律领域（如证据法）表现脆弱。

Method: 构建含200个合成沙特阿拉伯语司法案例与381条家庭法、证据法条文的基准；对比词级与char-4 BM25、零样本稠密编码器、分法律检索、稠密-稀疏RRF融合及所提DaR流水线。DaR使用LLM把每个叙述切分为争议法律问题，并为每个问题生成三种检索通道：法条风格改写、法律关键词、候选分类章节。

Result: 整体语料上，经指令调优的Qwen3-Embedding-8B稠密编码器取得非分解系统中最佳MRR@10=0.849；但分法律评分显示该优势仅来自家庭法，证据法上同一编码器MRR@10降至0.087，融合BM25也仅提升至0.207。DaR将证据法MRR@10提升至0.696、家庭法提升至0.864。

Conclusion: 未分解时两法律偏好不同检索策略，而DaR使同一检索器在两类法律上均取得最佳MRR@10，证明问题分解是弥合叙述—法条抽象鸿沟的关键。

Abstract: Reliable legal information retrieval must ground legal reasoning in authoritative statutory sources. In Arabic judicial settings, long factual narratives must be mapped to concise articles that express abstract legal rules, creating a narrative-to-legal-rule abstraction gap. Using a benchmark of 200 synthetic Saudi Arabic judicial cases and 381 articles from the Family Law and the Law of Evidence, we compare word-level and char-4 BM25, zero-shot dense encoders, per-law retrieval, dense-sparse reciprocal rank fusion (RRF), and a proposed Decompose-and-Refine (DaR) pipeline. In DaR, a large language model splits each narrative into disputed legal issues and generates, for each issue, three retrieval channels: a statute-style paraphrase, legal keywords, and a candidate taxonomy chapter. On the whole corpus, the instructed Qwen3-Embedding-8B dense encoder reaches an MRR@10 of 0.849, the best result of any non-decomposed system. Under per-law scoring, this advantage reflects Family Law only: restricted to Evidence articles, the same encoder drops to an MRR@10 of 0.087, and fusion with BM25 raises it only to 0.207. DaR changes this picture, raising Evidence MRR@10 to 0.696 and Family MRR@10 to 0.864. Without decomposition, the two laws favor different strategies; under DaR, the same retriever achieves the best MRR@10 on both.

</details>


### [203] [Fu-TCM: a multimodal large language model that learns traditional Chinese medicine diagnostic reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38333)
*Jiahang Xie,Tong Jin,Lingfei Wu,Yaping You,Jie Huang,Yuanchang Jin,Weikang Gong,Wei Cheng,Jia You,Pan Sun,Jianfeng Feng,Hongcheng Guo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出中医多模态大模型 Fu-TCM，基于约712万条清洗过滤后的中医数据训练，并提出辨证引导的策略优化方法 BGPO，在六项中医基准上取得宏平均81.01%的准确率，最高领先最强参照模型7.13个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 中医四诊合参是完整推理链条，现有LLM缺少对辨证这一结构化推理过程的显式监督，需探索中医辨证是否可计算学习。

Method: 构建含经典文本、教材、医学图像、临床病例与公开数据集约712万条样本并清洗过滤；训练多模态中医LLM Fu-TCM；采用BGPO（辨证引导策略优化），对回答格式、中医中间推理字段与最终证候预测分别给予奖励。

Result: Fu-TCM-27B在中医推理、文本与视觉共六项基准上均领先，宏平均准确率81.01%，较全部六项基准均有完整结果的最强参照模型高7.13个百分点；在Fu-bianzheng上最大领先达11.90分。案例级分析显示多数模型中中间字段准确率与最终证候选择准确率正相关。

Conclusion: 中医辨证具有可计算学习性，结构化推理监督能提升跨中医任务的性能。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are advancing in multimodal understanding and reasoning, accelerating medical model development. Traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) uses evidence from the four examinations to determine disease location and nature, differentiate syndromes and guide treatment. This diagnostic process constitutes a complete chain of reasoning. We present Fu-TCM, a multimodal TCM LLM trained on data retained after cleaning and filtering an initial collection of approximately 7.12 million examples derived from classical texts, textbooks, medical images, clinical cases and publicly available datasets. The model was further optimized using Bianzheng-Grounded Policy Optimization (BGPO), which explicitly targets syndrome differentiation through rewards for response format, intermediate TCM reasoning fields and final syndrome predictions. Fu-TCM-27B led all six benchmarks spanning TCM reasoning, text and vision, achieving a macro-average accuracy of 81.01% and surpassing the strongest reference model with complete results across all six benchmarks by 7.13 percentage points. Its largest margin was 11.90 points on Fu-bianzheng. Case-level analyses further showed a positive association between intermediate-field accuracy and final syndrome-selection accuracy in most evaluated models. These findings suggest that TCM syndrome differentiation may be computationally learnable and that structured reasoning supervision can improve performance across TCM tasks.

</details>


### [204] [Robust LLM-Generated Text Detection through Matched Conditional-Response Probing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38312)
*Junfeng Hao,Wenxian Wang,Tao Leng,Xingshu Chen,Hao Ren,Haizhou Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: MCRP：利用冻结LLM在语义匹配条件下的响应差异（token损失与注意力）做特征，训练轻量随机森林分类器，实现对保义改写稳健的LLM生成文本检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有检测器依赖词法、句法和局部篇章线索，而LLM输出常被改写、润色、扩写、翻译或轻度编辑，导致这些线索被削弱，检测在保义修订下失效。

Method: 提出匹配条件-响应探测框架：冻结探针LLM先生成候选文本的简短语义条件，在匹配、空（null）与控制条件下比较token级损失及提示-目标注意力；聚合双向条件对齐、反事实敏感性和内部注意力耦合为探针表示，训练轻量监督随机森林分类器。

Result: 在标准检测、保义修订鲁棒性、多语言与多领域评测中表现稳定；改写/润色/扩写下F1达93.97%、ROC-AUC 96.24%，分别超出最强基线19.50和25.77个百分点。消融显示各响应特征组互补；条件控制实验中匹配条件一致优于随机、错配与损坏条件。

Conclusion: 语义匹配条件下的响应特征比表层线索更具鲁棒性，条件语义匹配带来可量化的增益，为保义修订下的LLM文本检测提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Reliable detection of large language model (LLM)-generated text must remain effective under meaning-preserving text revisions, such as rewriting, polishing, and expansion. In practice, LLM outputs are often rewritten, polished, expanded, translated, or lightly edited before publication, weakening the lexical, syntactic, and local discourse cues used by many existing detectors. We introduce \textbf{M}atched \textbf{C}onditional-\textbf{R}esponse \textbf{P}robing (\textbf{MCRP}), a frozen-LLM probing framework that measures how a candidate text responds when a semantically matched condition is introduced, removed, or replaced. For each candidate, the frozen probe LLM first generates a short semantic condition and then compares token-level losses and prompt--target attention measurements under matched, null, and control conditions. It aggregates bidirectional conditioned alignment, counterfactual sensitivity, and internal attention coupling into a probe representation, on which it trains a lightweight supervised random-forest classifier while keeping the probe LLM frozen. Across standard detection, robustness to meaning-preserving text revisions, multilingual, and multidomain evaluations, MCRP achieves consistently strong performance. Under rewriting, polishing, and expansion, it reaches 93.97\% F1 and 96.24\% ROC-AUC, outperforming the strongest evaluated baseline by 19.50 and 25.77 percentage points, respectively. Component ablations show that the response feature groups make complementary contributions to predictive performance. In the condition-control study, matched conditions consistently outperform random, mismatched, and corrupted alternatives, demonstrating a measurable incremental benefit from semantic matching.

</details>


### [205] [Cross Lingual Abstractive Summarization for Marathi](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38267)
*Asang Dani,Shailesh R Sathe*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文针对低资源印度语言（马拉地语）的单语与跨语言摘要，通过从MahaSum构建跨语言训练数据并结合PMIndiaSum微调IndicTrans2，在马拉地语→英语方向上取得优于IndicBART和mBART-50基线的摘要性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 印度语言的单语言摘要（MS）与跨语言摘要（CLS）研究相对不足，尽管抽取式与生成式摘要整体已有进展；Transformer、预训练语言模型（PLM）及新数据集的出现为该空白提供了填补契机。

Method: 从单语马拉地语MahaSum语料构建跨语言训练数据，与规模较小的跨语言PMIndiaSum数据集合并，用于微调印度语言神经机器翻译模型IndicTrans2；以ROUGE、chrF、chrF++为评价指标，受算力限制主要聚焦马拉地语→英语方向，并讨论英语→马拉地语方向的可行性。

Result: 实验表明，利用预训练翻译模型进行微调所得摘要性能显著优于此前跨语言摘要工作中报告的IndicBART与mBART-50基线。

Conclusion: 以预训练翻译模型（IndicTrans2）为基础、辅以单语语料合成的跨语言数据，是提升低资源印度语言跨语言摘要的有效且相对经济的途径，并具备向反向语言对推广的潜力。

Abstract: Text summarization is an important task for advancing natural language processing (NLP) research and applications in Indic languages. Despite progress in extractive and abstractive summarization, both monolingual summarization (MS) and cross-lingual summarization (CLS) remain relatively underexplored for these languages. Recent advances in Transformer architectures, pretrained language models (PLMs), and dataset availability offer new opportunities to address this gap. In this work, we construct cross-lingual training data from the monolingual Marathi MahaSum corpus and combine it with the smaller cross-lingual PMIndiaSum dataset to fine-tune IndicTrans2, an Indic neural machine translation model. We evaluate the resulting models using ROUGE, chrF and chrF++ metrics, focusing primarily on Marathi-to-English summarization due to computational constraints. We also discuss the applicability of our approach to the English-to-Marathi direction. Our experiments demonstrate that leveraging a pretrained translation model yields substantially better summarization performance than the IndicBART and mBART-50 based baselines reported in previous work on cross-lingual summarization.

</details>


### [206] [HEDGE: Gated Hypergraph Memory for Scalable Multi-Agent Debate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38902)
*Amirhossein Abaskohi,Mahdi Mostajabdaveh,Zirui Zhou*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: HEDGE 是一个将多智能体辩论轨迹建模为语义超图的选择性记忆框架，通过超边连接跨智能体的相关论点、超边内关系图保留细粒度论辩结构，并用可学习的记忆选择模块（MSM）将候选记忆路由为 STORE/BACKUP/OMIT，提升辩论推理效果并降低记忆与轮次开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体辩论需跨轮保留并重访论点，但有限的上下文窗口与非结构化记忆使相关信息难以检索；现有扁平记忆与成对图记忆难以刻画多智能体一致、冲突证据与共识演化等高阶关系。

Method: 以语义超图表征辩论轨迹：超边聚合跨智能体的相关主张，超边内关系图保存细粒度论辩结构；引入记忆选择模块 MSM，结合监督学习与强化学习，将每个记忆候选路由至 STORE、BACKUP 或 OMIT，在保留有用信息的同时抑制冗余。

Result: 在七个多样化基准上一致优于单智能体、多智能体与记忆基线；以 GPT-4o-mini 为后端时，相较最强多智能体系统平均提升 5.0 个点，在冲突密集型任务上提升达 8.2 个点；同时记忆使用量降低 48%，辩论轮次减少 34%。

Conclusion: 高阶结构化记忆（超图）结合学习式选择性存储，是缓解辩论系统上下文瓶颈与冗余的有效途径，兼具性能增益与效率优势。

Abstract: Multi-agent debate systems require agents to retain and revisit arguments across multiple rounds, yet limited context windows and unstructured memories make relevant information increasingly difficult to recover. Existing flat and pairwise-graph memories also struggle to capture higher-order relations, including multi-agent agreement, conflicting evidence, and evolving consensus. We introduce HEDGE, a selective memory framework that represents debate trajectories as semantic hypergraphs. Hyperedges connect related claims across agents, while intra-hyperedge relational graphs preserve fine-grained argumentative structure. A learned memory selection module (MSM), trained through supervised learning and reinforcement learning, routes each memory candidate to STORE, BACKUP, or OMIT, retaining useful information while limiting redundancy. Across seven diverse benchmarks, HEDGE consistently outperforms strong single-agent, multi-agent, and memory baselines, improving accuracy by 5.0 points on average over the strongest multi-agent system with GPT-4o-mini. The gains reach 8.2 points on conflict-heavy tasks, while HEDGE reduces memory usage by 48% and the number of debate rounds by 34%.

</details>


### [207] [Integrating Heterogeneous Echocardiography AI Outputs in Language Space: Learnable Late Fusion with a Supervised LLM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39464)
*Ryo Takizawa,Tempei Kabayama,Chiemi Yamazaki,Shun Kitamura,Ryo Matsuoka,Yuta Ando,Satoshi Kodera,Norihiko Takeda*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于有监督大语言模型（LLM）的晚期融合模块，直接在语言空间中聚合视图特异性的预测所见陈述与测量值，学习病例级融合函数，从而整合异构超声心动图AI模型输出，无需模型特定的输出转换或医学特征工程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视图特异性与目标特异性超声心动图AI模型各自捕获有用但互补的信息，单一模型难以达到足够预测性能。虽然学习式集成是自然的融合途径，但异构模型输出通常必须被转换为二值决策、概率、置信度分数或定长特征向量，这一转换过程繁琐且往往依赖医学知识进行特征工程。

Method: 开发了一个有监督的LLM晚期融合模块，直接以自然语言形式接收各视图模型的预测所见陈述与预测测量值，在语言空间中聚合，并通过监督训练学习一个病例级融合函数。在646名患者、859次检查的患者级三折交叉验证中进行评估。

Result: 该方法在单一框架内整合了异构输出，性能与所评估的最佳参考策略相当，并优于未经任务特异性训练的通用LLM。

Conclusion: 有监督LLM能够在无需模型特定输出转换、也无需依赖医学知识的特征工程的情况下，有效融合多个上游模型，为异构医学AI模型的集成提供了新思路。

Abstract: View- and target-specific echocardiography AI models capture useful but complementary information and may not achieve sufficient predictive performance in isolation. A learned ensemble is a natural way to combine these outputs, but heterogeneous models typically require each output to be converted into a binary decision, probability, confidence score, or fixed-length feature vector. We developed a supervised large language model (LLM)-based late-fusion module that directly aggregates view-specific predicted finding statements and predicted measurements in language space and learns a case-level fusion function. In patient-level three-fold cross-validation of 859 examinations from 646 patients, the proposed method integrated heterogeneous outputs within a single framework, performed comparably to the best-performing reference strategy evaluated, and outperformed a general-purpose LLM without task-specific training. These results suggest that a supervised LLM can combine multiple upstream models without model-specific output conversion or feature engineering that requires medical knowledge.

</details>


### [208] [How Specific Do I Need to Be? Effects of User Query Underspecification on Deep Research Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39413)
*Yi Wen,Xiangjue Dong,Bingxuan Li,Hangxiao Zhu,Leo Zhicheng Liu,Yu Zhang,James Caverlee*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 UNDERSPEC-DR 框架，系统评估用户查询欠明确性如何影响深度研究智能体（DRA）的最终答案质量与中间检索行为，并揭示其脆弱性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 DRA 的训练与评测均基于完全明确的用户查询，而真实场景中用户查询常欠明确，二者存在错配，需系统刻画欠明确查询对 DRA 的影响。

Method: 构建 UNDERSPEC-DR 评测框架，在三个 DRA 上对比欠明确查询与明确查询，联合分析最终答案对用户信息需求的满足度（并检验其证据支撑性）与中间检索行为（检索广度、对原始查询的利用程度、对训练先验的依赖）。

Result: 欠明确性显著降低答案对用户信息需求的满足程度，尽管答案仍由引用证据支撑；检索行为上，DRA 倾向于开展更宽泛的搜索，对原始查询信息利用减少、更多依赖训练习得的先验，该先验可能与用户意图不一致。

Conclusion: 当前 DRA 对欠明确用户查询存在明显脆弱性，答案为"有据但不对题"；未来应构建能主动识别何时需要额外用户输入、以便可靠完成深度研究任务的 DRA。

Abstract: Deep research agents (DRAs) conduct long-horizon reasoning, search, and literature synthesis to provide long-form answers to complex, domain-specific questions. These agents are typically trained and evaluated on fully specified user queries. However, real-world user queries can often be underspecified. We introduce UNDERSPEC-DR, a framework for systematically evaluating how underspecified queries affect agents' final answer quality and intermediate search behavior. Across three DRAs we evaluated, underspecification substantially reduces how well DRA's answers fulfill users' information needs, even though they remain grounded in cited evidence. Our analysis of intermediate search behavior suggests a possible explanation: DRAs conduct broader searches that draw less on the original user query but rely more on their learned prior during training, which can be misaligned with users' intent. Our findings reveal the vulnerability of current DRAs to underspecified user queries and inform future efforts to build DRAs that proactively recognize when additional user input is needed to reliably complete deep research tasks.

</details>

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 Nemotron 3.5 Super 与 Lightning 两款基于 MoE 的混合 Mamba-Transformer 开源模型，面向推理、长上下文与智能体任务，在高效部署与能力之间取得平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为同时满足推理、长上下文理解与智能体（agentic）负载需求，并在训练与部署中兼顾能力与效率，尤其是以更少激活参数实现超越更大模型的表现。

Method: 两款模型均采用大规模蒸馏、长上下文训练与原生投机解码；Super 额外加入 Indic 继续预训练与智能体软件工程中期训练。后训练流水线涵盖 SFT 与 RLVR/RLHF，Super 另设专门教师训练与多教师同策略蒸馏（MOPD），使其从纯文本基座转为可处理文本、图像、视频及工具环境的多模态智能体。测试时通过并行智能体执行与自验证进行缩放；此外研究后训练 MTP 提升与 NVFP4 量化。

Result: Indic 继续预训练使印度语基准提升最高 9.82 个百分点；智能体中期训练增强软件工程能力与跨 agent harness 鲁棒性；Super 在 SWE-bench Pro 达 51.78%，以约 4.6 倍更少激活参数超越 Nemotron 3 Ultra；MTP 提升使概率性 draft 采样下投机解码接受长度增加最高 21.8%；NVFP4 量化相对 BF16 达 99.62% 中位精度恢复；推理优化在 GB200 上实现最高 4,856 output tokens/s/GPU 且每用户维持至少 50 tokens/s。

Conclusion: 通过混合架构、蒸馏与后训练流水线及推理侧优化，该系列模型以较小激活参数量达成较强推理与智能体能力，并保持高吞吐、低精度损失的可部署效率。

Abstract: We introduce Nemotron 3.5 Super and Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, open and efficient Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Transformer models designed for reasoning, long-context understanding, and agentic workloads. Super is a 120B-parameter, 12B-active multimodal model, while Lightning is a smaller 30B-parameter, 3B-active text model; both designed for efficient deployment. Both models combine large-scale distillation, long-context training, and native speculative decoding, while Super further incorporates Indic continued pretraining and agentic software-engineering mid-training. We develop a comprehensive post-training pipeline spanning supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning (RLVR and RLHF), complemented in Super by specialized teacher training and multi- teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD). This transforms Super from a text-only base model into a multimodal agent capable of reasoning over text, images, video, and interactive tool environments. We further explore test-time scaling through parallel agent execution and self-verification. Across training and deployment, we jointly optimize capability and efficiency. Indic continued pretraining improves Indian-language benchmarks by up to 9.82 percentage points, while agentic mid-training strengthens software-engineering capabilities and robustness across agent harnesses. The post-trained Super model achieves 51.78% on SWE-bench Pro, surpassing Nemotron 3 Ultra despite using approximately 4.6x fewer active parameters. Post-training MTP boosting improves speculative- decoding acceptance length by up to 21.8% under probabilistic draft sampling, while NVFP4 quantization achieves 99.62% median accuracy recovery relative to BF16. Inference optimizations enable up to 4,856 output tokens/s/GPU on GB200 while sustaining at least 50 tokens/s/user.

</details>


### [210] [Prompt-agnostic Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37683)
*Frederic Sadrieh*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文聚焦训练期提示鲁棒性，发现多复述提示训练中逐复述梯度存在干扰（57%符号冲突、朴素平均丢弃约五分之一幅度），据此提出Prompt-TIES与Prompt-DARE两种梯度合并方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型对提示表述高度敏感。推理期人工提示优化开销大、难扩展，因此转向在指令微调阶段将提示鲁棒性内建于模型；但常用的"混合多个改写提示"策略并未被细致分析其梯度层面的问题。

Method: 分析训练中逐复述（per-paraphrase）梯度在可训练参数上的干扰：统计符号冲突比例与朴素平均造成的幅度损失。借鉴模型/梯度合并中的干扰消解算子，提出Prompt-TIES与Prompt-DARE，将其应用于提示梯度。与三类训练期鲁棒性方法（数据构造、一致性正则、对比对齐）对比，跨两个模型家族、两个规模共四个模型评测。

Result: 提示措辞与具体样本的交互平均解释54%的逐样本方差，在ANLI、WiC等任务上超过70%。梯度合并方法直接提升该局部鲁棒性，在完全微调模型上将逐样本方差近乎减半，且对总体准确率代价很小；其他训练期方法提升原始性能，但未能可靠降低逐样本方差。

Conclusion: 提示敏感性问题可归结为训练时多复述梯度的相互干扰，可通过梯度合并（Prompt-TIES、Prompt-DARE）在低成本下显著提升鲁棒性；传统数据/正则/对比类训练期方法不足以改善逐样本方差。

Abstract: Despite their strong performance, large language models remain highly sensitive to prompt formulation. This issue is typically addressed at inference-time through manual prompt optimization, which introduces overhead and lacks scalability. Conversely, we focus on train-time approaches that build prompt robustness into the model during instruction tuning. A common strategy is to mix multiple paraphrases of each prompt into training. We demonstrate that across trainable parameters, the per-paraphrasing gradients interfere, with 57% exhibiting sign conflicts and the naive gradient average discarding approximately a fifth of the magnitude. Therefore, we develop two gradient-merging methods, Prompt-TIES and Prompt-DARE, that address this interference by leveraging interference-resolution operators from model and gradient merging and applying them to prompt gradients. In this study, we compare the efficacy of our methods to increase model robustness to train-time robustness methods spanning all three established classes: data construction, consistency regularization, and contrastive alignment. The evaluation is conducted across four models from two families at two scales. We observe the interaction between prompt phrasing and the specific examples accounts for 54% of per-example variability on average, and exceeds 70% on tasks such as ANLI and WiC. The gradient-merging methods directly improve this local robustness and nearly halve per-example variance on fully fine-tuned models at little cost to overall accuracy. The other train-time methods enhance raw performance, but fail to improve per-example variance reliably. Code: https://github.com/FSadrieh/prompt-agnostic-llms. Model checkpoints: https://huggingface.co/prompt-agnostic-language-models.

</details>


### [211] [Rank-Aware Differentially Private Release of Listwise Preferences for LLM Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37682)
*Junwei Chen,Manjiang Yu,Pengpeng Qiao,Yang Cao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出排名感知指数机制（RAEM），将listwise偏好数据在本地差分隐私下私有化为低敏感度的二元划分，实现高效listwise对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: listwise偏好反馈比pairwise提供更丰富监督，但完整排名泄露更多敏感偏好；现有隐私保护对齐方法仅针对pairwise，listwise在LDP下尚属空白。直接将LDP扩展到listwise领域面临核心难题：完整排名空间敏感度过高，需要注入过量噪声，抵消了listwise监督的收益。

Method: 分析监督粒度与隐私噪声在下游训练中的交互作用，设计排名感知指数机制（RAEM），利用排名信息采样固定大小的二元划分，将噪声集中在边界邻近项上，而非像随机响应（RR）那样对所有项统一扰动，从而把listwise数据转换为低敏感度粒度。

Result: 在下游LLM对齐任务的实证评估中，在匹配的隐私预算下，该机制持续优于现有LDP基线。

Conclusion: 通过降低隐私化后数据的敏感度粒度，RAEM有效缓解了listwise LDP中噪声过大的问题，证明listwise监督与LDP可兼容并在对齐任务中取得更优表现。

Abstract: Listwise preference feedback offers richer supervision for large language model (LLMs) alignment than pairwise comparisons, but a full ranking also reveals more sensitive user preferences. Existing privacy-preserving alignment methods focus mainly on pairwise feedback, while listwise alignment under local differential privacy (LDP) remains unexplored. Extending LDP to this listwise domain raises a critical challenge: the high sensitivity of the full ranking space demands excessive noise, neutralizing the benefits of listwise supervision. To address this challenge, we analyze the interaction between supervision granularity and privacy noise in downstream training, and introduce a rank-aware exponential mechanism that privatizes listwise preference data into a low-sensitivity granularity suitable for downstream alignment. The mechanism leverages ranking information to sample a fixed-size binary partition, concentrating the noise near borderline items instead of perturbing all items uniformly as randomized response (RR) does. Empirical evaluations on downstream LLM alignment tasks show that our mechanism consistently outperforms existing LDP baselines at matched privacy budgets. The code is available at https://github.com/tdsai-lab/RAEM.

</details>


### [212] [Artifact Distillation: Training-Free Transfer from Frontier to Small Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37680)
*Mustafa Safa Ozdayi,Somin Wadhwa*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出"Artifact Distillation"：教师模型将解题过程外化为可检索的"artifact bank"，学生在推理时查询而无需梯度更新，实现跨模型族的低成本能力迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统蒸馏将学生微调于教师输出，知识迁移受限于训练算力，且迁移内容高度不透明。

Method: 教师模型求解训练实例并将解题程序外化为 artifact bank；学生模型在推理时查询该库获得指导，不进行任何梯度更新（无需训练）。

Result: 在四个 LiveBench 任务上：Claude Opus 4.5 编写的库使 Claude Haiku 4.5 在空间推理上超过无辅助的 Claude Sonnet 4.5（0.707 vs. 0.647），成本为其 60%；在 table joining 上以 89% 的成本达到 Sonnet 4.5 水平。同一原始库使 Qwen3.5-27B 汇总分数从 0.730 提升至 0.800。

Conclusion: 外化式知识迁移无需梯度更新即可有效缩小大小模型差距，且可跨教师模型族泛化，同时提升了迁移过程的可解释性。

Abstract: Closing the gap between frontier and smaller language models is usually approached by distillation: fine-tuning the small model (student) on a frontier model's (teacher) outputs, which binds transfer to training compute and leaves the transferred knowledge largely opaque.
