Our results suggest limited benefits of synthetic pre-pretraining as a distinct training stage and motivate rethinking how such data are used in language model training.

</details>


### [280] [Supervised Fine-Tuning for Reasoning Large Language Models: A Survey](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37681)
*Yongcan Yu,Kuangpu Guo,Jian Liang,Lingxiao He,Meng Wang,Ran He*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该文是对面向推理的大模型长思维链监督微调（reasoning SFT）的首篇系统性综述，从方法设计与分析研究双视角梳理文献，归纳数据与算法层面改进、数据特性/优化动力学/机制解释三类分析，并展望未来方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长思维链数据上的SFT是激发与增强大推理模型推理能力的关键基础，相关文献快速增长；但提升与分析推理SFT的研究虽进展迅速，领域仍缺乏系统综述来整合这些分散工作，因此需要填补这一空白。

Method: 采用综述/文献梳理方法，通过"方法设计"与"分析研究"双视角组织文献：方法侧沿SFT流程将改进分为以数据为中心（data-centric）与以算法为中心（algorithm-centric）两类；分析侧沿三个维度重组现有分析性研究——数据特性、优化动力学、机制性洞见。

Result: 构建了推理SFT文献的系统分类体系：方法层面形成data-centric与algorithm-centric的二分框架，分析层面形成数据特性—优化动力学—机制解释的三维框架，从而将分散研究纳入统一结构，并据此综合当前研究热点与遗留瓶颈。

Conclusion: 通过综合现有研究重点与瓶颈，本文提出推理SFT有前景的未来方向，旨在加深对推理SFT的理解并为构建更先进推理模型奠定基础。

Abstract: Large reasoning models have recently demonstrated remarkable capabilities in solving complex tasks, where supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on long chain-of-thought data serves as a crucial foundation for eliciting and enhancing their reasoning abilities. Despite rapid progress in both improving and analyzing reasoning-oriented SFT, the field still lacks a systematic survey that consolidates its fast-growing literature. To fill this gap, we present a comprehensive review of recent advancements in reasoning SFT, examining the literature through the dual lenses of methodological design and analytical investigation. First, we review methodological improvements across the SFT pipeline and categorize them into data-centric approaches and algorithm-centric innovations. Second, we reorganize analytical studies along three dimensions: data characteristics, optimization dynamics, and mechanistic insights. Finally, by synthesizing current research focuses and remaining bottlenecks, we outline promising future directions for reasoning SFT. We hope this survey deepens the understanding of reasoning SFT and paves the way for advanced reasoning models.

</details>


### [281] [CARF: Context-Aware Reasoning Supervision for Scientific Evidence Screening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38041)
*Nishtha Agarwal,Adam Visokay,Astha Wahi,Kwabena Owusu Aninkora,Amy Gu,Tyler McCormick,Li Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出人机协同框架CARF，利用专家对模型推理过程的反馈来适配语言模型，用于系统综述的标题与摘要筛选。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 系统综述需领域专家依据详细纳排标准人工筛选数千篇研究，构成流程瓶颈；且筛选任务高度依赖上下文，需要可迁移的监督信号。

Method: 构建Context-Aware Reasoning Framework（CARF）：一种human-in-the-loop框架，以专家对模型生成推理的纠正反馈作为监督信号，使语言模型适配上下文相关的筛选任务；在口头尸检与死因判定方法的系统综述上评估。

Result: 筛选性能与被评估模型相比具竞争力，同时保持高灵敏度；模型更倾向于将歧义性强、依赖上下文的研究保留至人工复核。

Conclusion: 经专家纠正的推理是面向上下文相关科学文献筛选的有效监督信号，但仍需保留人工监督角色。

Abstract: Systematic reviews synthesize biomedical evidence to inform clinical and public-health decision-making, but require domain experts to manually screen thousands of studies against detailed eligibility criteria. We investigate whether language models can assist with this bottleneck by learning from expert feedback on title and abstract screening decisions and model-generated reasoning. We introduce the Context-Aware Reasoning Framework (CARF), a human-in-the-loop framework that uses expert feedback on model-generated reasoning to adapt language models to context-dependent screening tasks. We evaluate CARF on systematic reviews of verbal autopsy and cause-of-death ascertainment methods used in global public health mortality surveillance. CARF shows competitive screening performance compared to evaluated models while retaining high sensitivity, and is more inclined to retain ambiguous, context-dependent studies for human review. Together, these findings suggest that expert-corrected reasoning is a promising supervision signal for context-dependent scientific screening, while retaining a role for human oversight.

</details>


### [282] [What Hallucinations Have We Measured? Semantic Illusion, Confabulation, and Expressed Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38520)
*Hazel H. Kim,Jakub Binkowski,Ekaterina Fadeeva,Juan David Guerra,Yijie Hao,Zheng Yi Ho,Baixiang Huang,Buyun Liang,Siyuan Liang,Anh Tuan Luu,Potsawee Manakul,Niels Mündler-Sasahara,Aidar Myrzakhan,Shahrad Mohammadzadeh,Artem Shelmanov,Kai Shu,Ponhvoan Srey,Dacheng Tao,René Vidal,Haofei Yu,Lei Yu,Hongxiang Zhang,Yarin Gal,Hinrich Schütze,Philip H. S. Torr*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该文主张对LLM幻觉采用严格定义：区分"自信错误"（幻觉）与"表达不确定性"（UNK），并用"重述提示测试"将幻觉细分为语义幻觉（SI）与虚构（CF），据此重新评估14种方法并给出分项报告建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 幻觉是LLM可靠、安全部署的关键障碍，但研究界对该术语的使用不一致。将"自信错误"与"表达不确定性"混同会掩盖二者不同的行为模式，使研究难以开展；同时现有方法评估缺乏统一分类，无法说明方法究竟解决了哪类错误。

Method: 提出严格定义与两分法：(1) 幻觉须为"自信错误"，与UNK分离；(2) 用"重述提示测试"（是否存在语义等价的提示能恢复正确答案）判断相关知识是否可访问——均不可恢复则为虚构（CF），部分可恢复则为语义幻觉（SI）。并在该分类体系下重新评估14种近期幻觉检测与缓解方法，同时审计近期幻觉论文的分类使用情况，另提出仅需少量语义等价提示的实用标注协议。

Result: 重新评估得到三点发现：(1) 检测方法标记UNK的频率高于真正的幻觉回答（SI与CF）；(2) 缓解方法对SI远比对CF有效；(3) 对CF而言，潜在信号比输出层信号更具信息量。对近期幻觉论文的审计显示，多数研究混同了这些类别。

Conclusion: 建议分别报告CF、SI与UNK三类结果，并引入只需少量语义等价提示的实用标注协议，以纠正术语混用、提升幻觉研究的可比较性与可复现性。

Abstract: Hallucination remains one of the most critical challenges in deploying large language models (LLMs) reliably and safely. Yet the term is used inconsistently across the research community. We argue for a strict definition of hallucinations in LLMs. First, hallucinations should be confident incorrectness, kept separate from expressed uncertainty (UNK)1. UNK reveals that the model may be wrong, whereas a hallucination does not reveal it and is therefore more dangerous in practice. Conflating the two obscures their distinct behaviors and makes them hard to study. Second, hallucinations should be split by a simple re-elicitation test: does any semantically equivalent prompt recover the correct response? This test probes whether the relevant knowledge2 is accessible. If none does, the knowledge is likely absent or inaccessible, and the error type is a confabulation (CF) that likely requires external knowledge or retraining; if some does, the knowledge is accessible from the model but applied inconsistently, and the error type is a semantic illusion (SI) that simple prompt or decoding changes can mitigate3. Re-evaluating 14 recent hallucination methods under this taxonomy yields three findings. (1) Detection methods flag UNK more often than hallucinated responses (i.e., SI and CF). (2) Mitigation methods are far more effective for SI than for CF. (3) Latent signals are more informative than output-level signals for CF. An audit of recent hallucination papers shows that most conflate these categories. We recommend reporting CF, SI, and UNK separately, and introduce a practical labeling protocol that needs only a modest number of semantically equivalent prompts.

</details>


### [283] [Two Birds with One Stone: Skill-Augmented Generation via Unified Retrieval and Utilization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38204)
*Zihan Luo,Jiahui Kang,Wei Zhou,Qilin Fan,Mingyan Li,Chao Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 Skill-Uni，一个统一强化学习框架，联合优化技能检索与技能利用，用单一生成式模型完成两步，并通过两阶段训练（预热指令微调 + GRPO）取得显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有技能增强生成方法通常用分离的模型分别做技能检索和技能利用，导致两个过程优化割裂、难以协同。

Method: 采用生成式技能检索范式，使单一模型同时学习检索相关技能并据此解题；训练上采用两阶段策略：先做预热指令微调，再用 GRPO 强化学习进行联合优化。

Result: 在五个技能相关基准上验证有效性，相较基座 Qwen3-4B 与 LLaMA3.1-8B 平均性能分别提升 66.59% 与 34.82%；且兼容多种技能检索引擎，体现灵活性与泛化性。

Conclusion: 技能检索与利用的联合优化优于分离式流程，统一框架可即插即用地适配不同检索后端，深入分析进一步支撑其有效性。

Abstract: Skills, as reusable external knowledge, have demonstrated substantial potential to enhance the ability of Large Language Models (LLMs) to solve complex tasks. However, existing skill-augmented generation methods typically rely on separate models for skill retrieval and skill utilization, resulting in disconnected optimization of these two processes. To address this gap, we propose Skill-Uni, a unified reinforcement learning framework that jointly optimizes skill retrieval and utilization. Specifically, we adopt a generative skill retrieval paradigm that enables a single model to both learn how to retrieve relevant skills and leverage them for task solving. To effectively train this unified framework, we introduce a two-stage training strategy consisting of warm-up instruction tuning and GRPO, allowing the model to progressively improve its skill retrieval and utilization capabilities. Extensive experiments on five skill-related benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of Skill-Uni, yielding average performance gains of 66.59% and 34.82% over the base Qwen3-4B and LLaMA3.1-8B models, respectively. Besides, Skill-Uni is compatible with various skill retrieval engines, demonstrating its flexibility and generalizability. Additional in-depth analyses also provide insights into the effectiveness of Skill-Uni.

</details>


### [284] [Human-Residual Steering: Aligning Frozen LLM Judges with Human Judgment Distributions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37868)
*Chen Lyu,Phong Do,Gabriele Pergola*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 Human-Residual Steering (HRS)，通过学习隐藏状态低秩残差干预，使冻结的 LLM 评判器对齐人类评分分布，而非仅对齐聚合均值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 被广泛用作自动评判器，但现有对齐方法多针对聚合的人类判断，忽略标注者个体间差异；已有匹配完整评分分布的方法主要依赖输出层校准或参数微调，成本高或表达能力受限。

Method: 先做 oracle 分析，发现单层低秩修正即可消除评判器与人类分布的大部分差异；据此 HRS 从评判器的隐藏表示与评分 logits 预测该低秩修正，以个体标注为训练数据，采用序数/名义评分的恰当评分规则（proper scoring rules）为损失，并通过冻结的下游层进行梯度优化。

Result: 在 14 个基准、3 个模型家族共 4 个评判器上优于所有冻结权重基线；Qwen2.5-7B 在 13/14 基准取得最低 Jensen-Shannon 距离，均值由 0.565 降至 0.352（最强校准器为 0.377）；与聚合人类分数的平均 Spearman 相关从 0.449 提升至 0.579；在有限标注预算下改进总体水平估计；参数量比分布式微调少约 88 倍，对齐效果仅小幅下降。

Conclusion: 隐藏状态层面的低秩残差干预是让冻结 LLM 评判器对齐人类评分分布的高效可行路径，在分布匹配、相关性、标签效率与参数成本间取得良好权衡。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used as automated judges, yet most alignment methods target aggregated human judgments and overlook variation among individual annotators. Existing approaches to matching the full distribution of human ratings mainly rely on output-level calibration or parameter fine-tuning. We propose Human-Residual Steering (HRS), to our knowledge the first method to align frozen LLM judges with human judgment distributions through learned hidden-state interventions. An oracle analysis shows that low-rank corrections at a single layer remove most of the discrepancy between judge and human distributions. HRS learns to predict such corrections from the judge's hidden representation and rating logits, training on individual annotations with proper scoring rules for ordinal and nominal judgments and optimising through the frozen downstream layers. Across 14 benchmarks and four judges from three model families, HRS outperforms all evaluated frozen-weight baselines. With Qwen2.5-7B, it achieves the lowest Jensen-Shannon distance on 13 of 14 benchmarks, reducing the mean from 0.565 to 0.352 versus 0.377 for the strongest calibrator. HRS also raises mean Spearman correlation with aggregate human scores from 0.449 to 0.579, improves population-level estimation under limited annotation budgets, and trains about 88 times fewer parameters than distributional fine-tuning at a modest cost in alignment.

</details>


### [285] [Multi-Draft On-Policy Distillation for Diffusion Drafters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37778)
*Petr Molodyk,Yuchen Zhu,Jaemoo Choi,Molei Tao,Yongxin Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出MDraft，一种用于一步并行扩散草稿器的on-policy蒸馏方法：通过从同一上下文采样多个草稿块并聚合验证器在各前缀下的全词表条件分布，缓解并行起草中草稿器与验证器之间的分布失配，提升草稿接受长度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 投机解码可降低语言模型推理成本，一步扩散草稿器能并行生成多个token以压缩串行开销，而on-policy蒸馏利用验证器反馈训练草稿器。但并行起草使得草稿器预测每个token时无法观测同一块内先前采样的token，而验证器却以这些token为条件，导致同一草稿预测在不同采样前缀下对应不同的验证器目标；逐目标分别蒸馏会压制"在某些前缀下合理、在另一些前缀下不太可能"的token，从而损害草稿接受率。

Method: 提出Multi-Draft On-Policy Distillation（MDraft）：对同一上下文采样多个草稿块，将验证器在这些前缀下的全词表条件分布进行聚合，构建统一训练目标，使来自替代前缀的支持信息也能影响训练目标；仅改变训练方式，保持草稿器架构与推理流程不变，可直接替换预训练检查点。

Result: MDraft使并行草稿器的接受长度超过预训练水平，并缓解分布失配的影响；在数学、代码和对话任务上，其被接受的草稿长度优于先前的蒸馏方法。

Conclusion: 并行起草中的前缀条件失配会削弱on-policy蒸馏效果，多草稿前缀聚合可有效利用验证器信息、提升草稿接受长度，且方法具有即插即用的部署优势。

Abstract: Speculative decoding is used to reduce the inference cost of language models. One-step diffusion drafters propose a block of multiple tokens in parallel, reducing the sequential cost of speculative decoding. On-policy distillation trains these drafters using verifier feedback on their own proposals. However, parallel drafting makes this feedback difficult to use: the drafter predicts each token without observing the preceding tokens sampled within the same block, while the verifier conditions its prediction on those tokens. Different sampled prefixes therefore give different verifier targets for the same drafter prediction. We show that distilling against these targets separately can suppress tokens that are plausible after some prefixes but unlikely after others, harming draft acceptance. We explain the effects of this mismatch and introduce Multi-Draft On-Policy Distillation (MDraft), a new parallel drafter distillation method which samples several draft blocks from the same context and aggregates the verifier's full-vocabulary conditionals across their prefixes. We use all the drafts to collect information from the verifier, allowing support from alternative prefixes to influence the training target. The resulting algorithm improves the acceptance length of a parallel drafter beyond the level of pre-training, and alleviates the effects of the distributional mismatch. MDraft changes only training, retaining the drafter's architecture and inference procedure, allowing the resulting drafter to be used as-is in place of the pretrained checkpoint. Experiments on a suite of mathematical, coding, and conversational tasks show longer accepted drafts than prior distillation methods.

</details>


### [286] [Large Language Models for Accurate Medical Chart Abstraction: Enabling Scalable and Secure Artificial Intelligence Deployment in Stroke](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38009)
*Zhusi Zhong,Carl M. Porto,David Hong,Miranda Gonzales,Revyn Kim,Gnaneswari Karayi,Lulu Bi,Joshua R. Feler,Elias Shaaya,Scott Collins,Liqi Shu,Grayson Baird,Mahesh Jayaraman,Shadi Yaghi,Zhicheng Jiao,Dylan N. Wolman*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 评估22个开源LLM在2416份急性卒中神经介入报告中抽取8个临床变量的表现：LLaMA3.3-70B准确率最高（94.8%），CoT适合推理型变量，Quick Response适合直接陈述字段，AI预测多数变量上比非专家标注更贴近专家判断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 病历摘要需将非结构化临床叙述转为结构化变量以支持研究与质量监测，人工成本高；需验证本地化部署的开源LLM提示框架能否规模化完成该任务并达到可用准确度。

Method: 对3家医院2416份急性卒中介入报告、8个临床变量，评测22个指令微调开源LLM（涵盖不同架构、参数规模与生物医学适配版本），采用Quick Response与Chain-of-Thought两种提示策略；以非专家人员标注作为跨模型参照标准，仅保留LLaMA3.3-70B CoT预测有效且具参照标签的报告-变量对；指标为抽取准确率、推理时延与与专家裁决的一致性，每个变量取20例分歧样本由2名资深医师与4名医学生复核。

Result: LLaMA3.3-70B总体准确率最高（94.8%）。CoT在依赖推理的变量（如闭塞部位）上更优，Quick Response在直接陈述的手术字段上更优。专家裁决显示多数变量上AI预测比非专家标注更接近专家判断，颅内血管成形术仍是难点。

Conclusion: 本地部署LLM可支撑可扩展的临床信息抽取与回顾性卒中登记库整理，但需对歧义病例保留专家审核；提示策略应按变量性质选择。

Abstract: Medical chart abstraction transforms unstructured clinical narratives into structured variables for research and quality monitoring. We evaluated a prompting-based large language model (LLM) framework for extracting eight clinical variables from 2,416 neurointerventional acute stroke intervention reports across three hospitals. Twenty-two instruction-tuned open-source LLMs were evaluated across architectures, model sizes, and biomedical adaptations using Quick Response and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting. Non-expert staff annotations served as the cross-model reference standard. Evaluation was restricted to report-variable pairs with a valid LLaMA3.3-70B CoT prediction and a corresponding reference label. Performance measures included extraction accuracy, inference latency, and agreement with expert adjudication. Twenty discordant cases per variable underwent review by two senior physicians and four medical students. LLaMA3.3-70B achieved the highest overall accuracy (94.8%). CoT improved performance on inference-dependent variables such as site of occlusion, while Quick Response was optimal for directly stated procedural fields. Expert adjudication showed that AI predictions were more closely aligned with expert interpretations than non-expert annotations for most variables, with intracranial angioplasty remaining a challenge. Locally deployed LLMs can support scalable clinical information extraction and retrospective stroke registry curation, with expert oversight for ambiguous cases.

</details>


### [287] [Bouba Beats Kiki, and Other Regularities in the Subjective Preferences of LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37692)
*Katy Blumer,Jon Kleinberg,Ravi Kumar,Andrew Tomkins*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出对LLM"主观评价"的早期研究框架：不问模型答对与否，而问在多个可行回答无明显优劣时模型如何做选择。以数字、婴儿名、虚构城市三类短文本为对象，识别29个句法/语义方面（长度、字母序、流行度、元音构成、读音等），发现模型对这些方面存在强且可复现的偏好；提问表述变化会使部分方面激活或失活；看似无关的提问方式变化会大幅改变成对偏好分布，引发操纵性担忧；且当模型既生成候选列表又对其排序时，两阶段间存在意外交互并影响其偏好表达。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 客观正确性已有丰富评测手段，但任务中主观层面的方法论尚不成熟。此前工作多以"对错"衡量模型，缺乏对"无明确最优解时模型如何抉择"的刻画，作者希望为此类主观评价问题建立初步框架。

Method: 聚焦短文本，选取数字、婴儿名、虚构城市三类内容的比较任务；归纳29个覆盖句法与语义的方面（长度、字母序、流行度、元音混合、发音等）；通过控制这些方面设计成对比较实验，考察模型偏好及其可复现性、提问表达方式对方面激活的影响、提问性质微小变化对偏好分布的影响，以及"生成候选—排序"两阶段流程中的交互效应。

Result: （1）模型对部分方面表现出强且可复现的正/负偏好；（2）改变模型表达偏好的方式会使某些方面在选择中被激活或抑制；（3）成对偏好分布会因看似不重要的提问差异而剧烈变化，提示潜在操纵风险；（4）模型同时用于生成候选列表与排序时，两阶段存在非预期交互，可驱动其陈述性偏好。

Conclusion: 主观评价不能简单等同于正确性度量；模型偏好受任务表征、提问措辞与流程设计的显著影响，具有情境依赖性与可操纵性。作者呼吁发展针对主观层面的专门评测方法，并警惕"自生成+自排序"流程带来的偏差。

Abstract: Users engage with large language models on tasks that are purely objective ("When was Netflix founded?"), purely subjective ("What should I name my child?") or anywhere in-between. We have rich tools for evaluating model accuracy with respect to objective criteria. However, when it comes to subjective aspects of a task, we do not have similarly developed methodology at hand. In this paper, we take some early steps towards framing the question of subjective evaluation. Rather than measure how often a model is right or wrong on a question, we instead ask, how do models make choices among multiple viable responses without a clear winner?
  To study this question, we restrict our focus to short-form content, and consider comparison tasks among three such content types: numbers, baby names, and fictional cities. We identify 29 aspects of these short-form examples covering many areas of syntax and semantics (length, alphabetic order, popularity, vowel mix, spoken sound, etc.). We show first that models tend to have strong and reproducible preferences for or against some of these aspects. Second, we show that variations in how the model is asked to express a preference may cause some of these aspects to activate or deactivate in the model's selection. Third, we show that overall preference distributions among pairs may vary radically based on seemingly-unimportant variations in the nature of the question posed to the model, raising new questions about manipulation. And finally, we show that, if models are used both to create lists of alternatives and to rank them, there are unexpected interactions between the two stages that may also drive the models' stated preferences.

</details>


### [288] [An Introduction to Large Language Models for Scientists and Professionals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37684)
*Umberto Michelucci*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: This book offers a practical, math-light introduction to LLMs for scientists and professionals, covering tokenisation, embeddings, training, inference, prompting and RAG, with emphasis on limitations (hallucinations, bias), governance, and hands-on local deployment with Ollama and Open WebUI.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLMs are increasingly used in science, education, medicine and professional work, but responsible use requires understanding how they work, their limitations, and how to evaluate outputs. The author wrote this document as lecture material for a master's course in AI in medicine at the University of Turin, addressing the gap for an accessible, non-mathematical guide.

Method: A practical, accessible exposition deliberately avoiding mathematical detail: explains tokenisation, embeddings, training, inference, context windows, prompting, and instruction hierarchies; discusses limitations (hallucinations, uncertainty, reproducibility, bias), verification and human oversight, privacy, governance and security; covers advanced topics (RAG, retrieval quality, chunking, vector search, agents, tools, workflows); and includes a substantial exercise running a local LLM via Ollama and Open WebUI on a corpus of scientific papers, requiring no programming.

Result: As a textbook (not an empirical study), the deliverable is a structured pedagogical resource spanning fundamentals, limitations, governance, advanced retrieval/agent topics, and a practical local-LLM exercise focused on evidence retrieval, source verification, uncertainty, disagreement between studies, and distinguishing plausible language from scientifically supported conclusions.

Conclusion: The book provides scientists and professionals with a non-mathematical, hands-on foundation for responsible LLM use, stressing systematic verification, human oversight, and critical evaluation of outputs—particularly relevant in high-stakes domains such as medicine.

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have rapidly become important tools for science, education, medicine, and professional work. Despite their apparent simplicity from the user's perspective, effective and responsible use requires an understanding of how these systems work, what their limitations are, and how their outputs should be evaluated. I wrote this document as a basis for my lecture on LLM in the master in artificial intelligence in medicine at the university of Turin, Italy. This book provides a practical and accessible introduction to LLMs for scientists and professionals. It explains the fundamental ideas behind tokenisation, embeddings, training, inference, context windows, prompting, and instruction hierarchies, while deliberately avoiding mathematical detail. Particular attention is given to the limitations of LLM-generated answers, including hallucinations, uncertainty, reproducibility, bias, and the need for systematic verification and human oversight. The book also discusses privacy, governance, security, and the responsible handling of personal and sensitive information. More advanced topics include Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), retrieval quality, chunking, embeddings, vector search, agents, tools, and workflows. A substantial practical exercise guides the reader through running a local LLM with Ollama and Open WebUI and using it to interact with a collection of scientific papers. The exercise emphasizes evidence retrieval, source verification, uncertainty, disagreement between studies, and the distinction between plausible language and scientifically supported conclusions. No programming knowledge is required.

</details>


### [289] [Grounding Multimodal Reasoning with Evidence-Ablated Negatives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39237)
*Chenxi Liu,Tianyi Xiong,Yanshuo Chen,Heng Huang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: EVAN 通过构造"证据剥离图像"来诱导模型产生可信但缺乏视觉依据的负样本，并将其作为有界辅助惩罚信号加入 RLVR 优化，从而缓解多模态推理中的捷径学习与模态失衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准 RLVR 采用结果监督，存在信用分配歧义：模型可能依靠语言先验或数据集捷径获得正奖励，而非真正基于视觉证据进行推理。因此高质量负样本至关重要——它需在当前策略下仍显合理，同时暴露出应被抑制的捷径。

Method: 1) 用缩放后的图像信息增益（scaled image information gain）度量样本的视觉依赖度，筛选高视觉依赖样本，并以混合排序策略（mixed-ranking）保持数据多样性；2) 对最具判别性的图像 patch 进行掩码，构造"证据剥离图像"，促使当前策略生成看似合理但视觉无依据的负响应；3) 在策略优化中，将上述负响应对应干净图像作为有界辅助信号引入，惩罚捷径学习同时维持 RL 训练稳定性。

Result: 在多个具挑战性的多模态推理基准上，EVAN 缓解了模态失衡问题，并优于强 RLVR 基线方法。

Conclusion: 以证据剥离方式主动生成可信负样本，可作为有界辅助监督信号，有效抑制多模态 RLVR 中的语言先验捷径，提升视觉 grounding 与推理性能。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a powerful tool for improving multimodal reasoning. However, standard outcome supervision suffers from credit assignment ambiguity, as a model may receive positive rewards by exploiting language priors or dataset shortcuts rather than grounding its reasoning in the requisite visual evidence. This makes high-quality negative responses critical, since effective negatives should remain plausible under the current policy while exposing the shortcut that should be suppressed. In this paper, we propose EVAN, a multimodal reinforcement learning framework utilizing EVidence-Ablated Negatives to train LMMs against their own language-prior failures. EVAN first identifies highly visually dependent examples using a scaled image information gain metric and preserves data diversity with a mixed-ranking strategy. It then constructs evidence-ablated images by masking the most discriminative image patches, eliciting plausible but visually ungrounded responses from the current policy. During policy optimization, these negative responses are incorporated as bounded auxiliary signals under the clean image, penalizing shortcut learning while maintaining RL stability. Experiments across challenging multimodal reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that EVAN mitigates modality imbalance and improves over strong RLVR baselines. Our code is available at https://github.com/DawnLIU35/EVAN.git.

</details>


### [290] [XLaw-JP-27B: A Lightweight Open Model Specialized for Japanese Law](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39227)
*Andrew Shin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: XLaw-JP-27B 是一个基于 Qwen3.8-27B、采用混合检索、自蒸馏 QLoRA 微调与四样本投票的日文法律开源模型，单张 48GB GPU 可运行，在八项日文法律任务中六项第一，且是唯一连续三年通过司法考试的开放模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放权重的日文法律专用模型稀缺，现有 32–33B 开放日文模型无法稳定通过司法考试，且需要在有限算力（单张 48GB GPU）与宽松许可（Apache 2.0）下获得可用的专业法律能力。

Method: 以 Qwen3.8-27B 为底座，叠加对全部现行法规与 3.1 万条判例摘要的混合检索、对既往司法考试题自验证答案的轻量 QLoRA 自蒸馏微调、合同专用 LoRA 适配器，以及四样本投票；在统一提示与检索条件下与 12–33B 开放模型在八项日文法律任务上对比，并对各组件做受控消融。

Result: 六项任务排名第一、一项并列、一项第三（平均排名 1.3，基线为 2.8–3.1）；唯一在 2024、2025、2026 三年司法考试均通过（分别为 175 题中 129、120、130，且满足各科目最低分，训练未使用测试年份材料），开放日文 32–33B 模型至少失败一年。消融显示检索、投票与自蒸馏有效，而思考模式、检索接地的合成数据调优、自验证、逐陈述分解及更多自蒸馏无效。与前沿模型的最大差距在合同审查与专利法。

Conclusion: 在单卡、Apache 2.0 条件下，通过检索增强、少量自蒸馏与投票集成即可让 27B 开放模型达到稳定的日文法律专业水平；合同审查与专利法仍是主要短板，模型以免费网页服务与开放权重形式发布。

Abstract: We present XLaw-JP-27B, an open-weight model specialized for Japanese law that runs on a single 48\,GB GPU under the Apache~2.0 licence. It adapts Qwen3.8-27B with hybrid retrieval over all current statutes and 31k case summaries, a light QLoRA fine-tune on its own verified answers to past bar-exam questions (self-distillation), a contract-specific LoRA adapter, and four-sample voting. We evaluate it on eight Japanese legal tasks---the multiple-choice section of the bar examination in 2024, 2025 and 2026, statement-level bar questions (JBE-QA), statute questions (LawQA-JP), the patent attorney exam, and contract review and drafting built from government model contracts---against open models of 12--33B under identical prompts and retrieval. XLaw-JP-27B ranks first on six tasks, ties on one and is third on one (mean rank 1.3 against 2.8--3.1 for the baselines). It is the only system that passes the bar exam in all three years (129, 120 and 130 of 175, meeting every subject minimum; no test-year material was used in training), while open Japanese 32--33B models fail at least one year. A controlled study of each component shows that retrieval, voting and self-distillation help, and that thinking mode, retrieval-grounded synthetic tuning, self-verification, per-statement decomposition and more self-distillation do not. The largest remaining gaps to frontier models are in contract review and patent law. The model is available as a free web service at https://x-law.jp/ with the weights available at https://huggingface.co/X-LawJapan/xlaw-jp-27b under Apache~2.0.

</details>


### [291] [Distilling the Shape of Uncertainty: What On-Policy Distillation Learns and How to Predict It](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39020)
*Shiping Yang,Chuanqi Tang,Hossein Hajimirsadeghi,Layla El Asri,Mohammad Amin Shabani,Angel X. Chang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文指出on-policy蒸馏(OPD)中"何处分支"（熵形状）是独立于"如何分支"（token重叠）的因果性知识来源，提出Entropy Shape Correlation (ESC) 度量师生熵形状一致性，并用于教师选择与OPD效果预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 更强的教师有时无法提升学生，既有工作归因于"缺乏新知识"但未说明知识是什么；现有token-overlap指标只刻画了"如何分支"（候选token偏好），忽略了"何处分支"（保持推理路径开放的位置）。

Method: 提出熵形状（序列化的下一token熵）刻画"何处分支"，并定义ESC以度量师生熵形状一致性；通过训练全程追踪ESC，并在保持教师token偏好的前提下干预其熵，进行因果验证；进一步将OPD结果预测建模为教师选择任务并建立评测协议。

Result: 实验表明"何处分支"独立于"如何分支"因果性地驱动OPD收益；在预训练前(预OPD)计算的ESC用于选择教师，对两个学生均选出最优教师，且优于现有预测指标。

Conclusion: OPD传递的知识应拆分为分支位置(熵形状)与分支选项(token偏好)两部分；ESC既能解释教师强弱与学生增益的错配，也可作为实用的事前教师选择指标。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) is increasingly adopted in the post-training of large language models. However, a stronger teacher may fail to improve the student. Prior work attributes this to a lack of new knowledge, but what that knowledge is remains unclear. We show that OPD learns not only \textit{how to branch}, i.e., which candidate tokens to consider, but also \textit{where to branch}, i.e., where to keep reasoning paths open. The existing token-overlap metric captures only the former. We introduce the entropy shape, the sequence of next-token entropies, to characterize the latter, and propose the Entropy Shape Correlation (ESC) to measure student-teacher agreement in entropy shape. Tracking ESC throughout training and intervening on a teacher's entropy while preserving its token preferences, we empirically show that \textit{where to branch} causally drives OPD gains, independently of \textit{how to branch}. Finally, we formulate OPD outcome prediction as a teacher selection task and establish an evaluation protocol for it, under which pre-OPD ESC selects the best teacher for both students and outperforms existing predictors. Code is available at https://github.com/maybenotime/opd-esc.

</details>


### [292] [Implicit Reasoning in Transformers: Bridging the Compositionality Gap in GPT-2-like Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39016)
*Davide Venuto,Leonardo Venuto*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 在控制的两跳推理设定下，通过让原子知识在训练分布中以与组合电路第二跳检索位置对齐的形式呈现，可在不改架构、不加OOD组合监督的情况下消除组合泛化差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer语言模型存在组合泛化缺陷：模型在分布内（ID）能正确组合已知事实，但同一组合机制应用于分布外（OOD）知识时失效。作者试图探究该组合性差距是否与原子知识在训练中被结构性暴露的方式有关。

Method: 从零训练类GPT-2模型，构建受控两跳推理任务；基于已有工作识别的组合泛化相关电路，修改训练分布，将ID与OOD原子事实以在位置上对齐于所学组合电路第二跳检索步骤的格式呈现；不改动模型架构，也不添加OOD组合监督。

Result: 在该干预下，模型成功将已学到的ID组合行为迁移到留出的OOD原子事实，弥合了此前观察到的组合性差距。

Conclusion: 所观察到的组合性差距并非架构的根本性限制，可通过机制导向的训练分布设计加以克服。

Abstract: Compositional generalization remains a persistent limitation of transformer language models: even when a model learns to combine known facts correctly in-distribution (ID), the same compositional mechanism may fail when applied to out-of-distribution (OOD) knowledge. We investigate this compositionality gap in a controlled two-hop reasoning setting using a GPT-2-like transformer model trained from scratch. Building on prior work identifying a circuit associated with compositional generalization, we test whether the failure of OOD transfer is related to how atomic knowledge is structurally exposed during training. We modify the training distribution by presenting both ID and OOD atomic facts in a format positionally aligned with the second-hop retrieval step of the learned compositional circuit, without modifying the model architecture or adding OOD compositional supervision. Under this intervention, the model successfully transfers the learned ID compositional behaviour to held-out OOD atomic facts, closing the observed compositionality gap in the controlled setting. Our results provide evidence that the observed compositionality gap is not a fundamental architecture limitation and that it can be overcome through mechanistically informed training distribution design.

</details>


### [293] [Can LLMs Ignore What They Know? Measuring Knowledge Leakage in Persona-Based User Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39939)
*Sangmin Lee,Sangwon Lee,Sungbeom Choi,Jeeseung Park,Kibeom Myoung*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出"知识泄漏（knowledge leakage）"概念——当真实用户不可能拥有的知识进入模拟回答时产生的回答偏差——并给出用"真实条目—虚构孪生条目"配对法对其进行定量测量的方法论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 把人设条件化的回答视作受访者层级的模拟时，被设定为"一无所知"的受访者理应表现得如同模型不具备相应知识。作者检验模型能否做到这一点，并指出此前缺少对这种知识泄漏进行量化测量的手段。

Method: 核心工具是将真实条目与表面形式匹配的虚构孪生条目配对（经筛选、以最小化条目特定先验知识），以配对差值作为知识泄漏的诊断性对比，即使在无正确答案的评分任务中也适用。实验覆盖三种知识处理条件和两个模型族的五个API端点。

Result: 人设未能完全抑制真实条目的存在性与熟悉度信号：即使在上下文明确陈述"该人设从未听说过该条目"时，有利条目的真实—孪生评分差仍存在。不利条目的对比在不同领域组间符号反转：全领域合并估计接近零（+0.077，[-0.057, +0.204]），但同一估计器在"条目已记录危害"量表下为 -0.359，在"公司/组织"量表下为 +0.438；因此对不利内容条目做合并的零假设检验无法检出相互抵消的领域组差异。

Conclusion: 人设条件化不能可靠阻断模型知识的渗入，需以配对孪生设计定量诊断知识泄漏；领域分层分析不可省略，合并分析会掩盖反向效应。所有估计均以孪生条目构建与筛选的充分性为条件，群体层面解读仍需人类低知识基线。

Abstract: When persona-conditioned responses are read as respondent-level simulations, each response should reflect the described persona's knowledge, and the respondent written to know nothing must act as if the model's knowledge were not there. We test whether it can, and find persistent favourable-item real-twin rating separation under the tested low-knowledge and explicit-ignorance prompts. We define the resulting problem (knowledge leakage: a response bias that arises when knowledge the real user could not have enters the simulated response) and present a methodology for measuring it quantitatively. The core instrument pairs real items with fabricated twins matched in surface form: screened fabricated variants designed to minimize prior item-specific knowledge. The paired difference therefore provides a diagnostic contrast for knowledge leakage even in rating tasks where no answer is correct. In a rating experiment across three knowledge-handling arms and five API endpoints from two model families, we find, first, that the personas we test do not fully suppress real-item existence and familiarity signals: a favourable-item real-twin rating contrast remains under an explicit in-context statement that the persona has never heard of the item. Second, the unfavourable-item contrast reverses sign across domain groups: pooling all unfavourable-content items across domains the contrast sits near zero (+0.077 [-0.057, +0.204]), yet the same estimator in the same conditions returns -0.359 where the rating scale asks about an item's documented hazard and +0.438 where it asks about a company or an organisation. A pooled analysis of unfavourable-content items against zero therefore does not detect the opposing domain-group differences. All estimates are conditional on the adequacy of twin construction and screening; human low-knowledge baselines remain necessary for population-level interpretation.

</details>


### [294] [Prompts and probabilities in the linguistic assessment of language models: Evidence from semantic focus-sensitivity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39923)
*Robert Pasternak*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文在语义焦点敏感度（focus-sensitivity）这一新领域比较了显式提示（prompting）与token概率方法评估语言模型语言能力的效果，发现部分大模型提示法大幅优于概率法，原因是LMs本身不倾向产出"无背景焦点标记"，从而污染概率法结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究表明：小模型上提示法不如token概率法，大模型上提示法占优，但该结论缺乏新领域验证。作者希望用语义焦点敏感度（如"Lucy only SWAM yesterday" vs. "Lucy only swam YESTERDAY"的对比）这一未被测试的领域来检验，并探究两种方法差异的机制。

Method: 用粗体、斜体等文本焦点标记，对不同规模的语言模型同时使用token概率法与显式提示法进行测试；随后用随机生成的标记替换标准焦点标记，比较两法的性能下降幅度，以检验"模型不倾向产生无背景焦点标记"这一假设。

Result: token概率法在所有模型上均显著高于随机水平；提示法结果大体与先前发现一致，但部分较大模型中提示法大幅领先概率法。换成随机标记后，token概率法仍高于随机水平，但性能下降显著大于提示法下降幅度，支持了作者的机制解释。

Conclusion: 元语言提示对LMs虽非易事，但在测试风格非常规数据时更稳健。作者认为这对评估LMs语言能力具有重要意义，即便LMs并非通过类人的内省方式完成元语言判断。提示法与概率法测的可能并非同一能力，评估方法选择需谨慎。

Abstract: As language models (LMs) have improved, an increasingly common means of evaluating their linguistic competence is through explicit prompting (e.g., "Which sentence is more acceptable?"). Prior work indicates that such prompting underperforms compared to standard token-probability-based methods in smaller models, but improves in larger models. We test this in a new domain: semantic focus-sensitivity, responsible for contrasts like "Lucy only SWAM yesterday" vs. "Lucy only swam YESTERDAY". Testing models of various sizes using text-based focus markers like boldface and italics, we find universal above-chance performance for token probabilities. Prompting results mostly align with previous findings, but in some larger models they outperform probabilities by a wide margin. We propose that this is because LMs are not prone to produce out-of-the-blue focus marking, which muddies results from token probabilities in a way that does not affect prompting. We test this by replacing standard focus markers with randomly generated ones; token probabilities still beat chance but show significantly greater performance decrease compared to prompting. These results suggest that metalinguistic prompting, while non-trivial for LMs, can also be more robust when testing stylistically atypical data. We argue that this has important consequences for the assessment of LMs' language competence, even if LMs do not perform metalinguistic judgments through human-like introspection.

</details>


### [295] [Grammar Control for Language Learning with Sequential Monte Carlo and Small Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39800)
*Kate McCurdy,Jacob Hoover Vigly,Thomas Hikaru Clark,Karolina Stańczak,Yahya Emara,Joshua B. Tenenbaum,Alexander K. Lew,Ryan Cotterell,Timothy J. O'Donnell*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出用序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）在推理阶段引导小型语言模型的对话生成，使其覆盖指定语法结构，并用前沿模型合成语法势函数实现规模化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 二语学习者需要接触难度适中的语法，但可部署于设备端、资源开销小的模型往往难以稳定产出目标语法结构；而具备该能力的模型规模过大（约大140倍）。

Method: 将对话轮次生成视为受控采样问题，基于专家编写的教学资源定义少量手工势函数（potential functions），用序贯蒙特卡洛对小型模型的解码过程进行引导；进一步借助前沿模型的代码合成能力自动生成新的势函数，以覆盖数百项目标语法技能，无需额外训练或监督数据。

Result: 仅用少量手工势函数即实现目标语法的近乎完全覆盖，使小模型的表现超越规模大140倍的SOTA模型；代码合成生成的势函数可将方法扩展至数百个目标语法技能。

Conclusion: 推理阶段的SMC引导是一种无需微调、数据高效的小模型可控生成方案，可有效服务二语教学场景，并具备向大规模技能集合扩展的能力。

Abstract: Second language learners benefit from exposure to level-appropriate grammar in interactive language use. While prompted frontier language models can usually produce target grammar structures, less resource-intensive models that can be run on device often fail in this task. We use sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) to steer dialogue turn generation in small lan- language models toward target grammar constructions from an expert-developed pedagogical resource. With a minimal set of hand-coded potential functions, SMC achieves near-perfect coverage of target grammar, enabling small models to outperform state-of-the-art results from models 140 times larger. We also use code synthesis with frontier models to generate new potentials, showing that our method scales to hundreds of target grammar skills with no need for additional training or supervised data.

</details>


### [296] [ARBITRA: Robust Document-Level ATT&CK Extraction via Multi-Expert Argumentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39433)
*Youngjin Jin,Seungwon Shin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: ARBITRA 将 CTI 报告到 ATT&CK 的映射转化为"候选提出—论辩验证"流程：多个角色专精 LLM 专家从整篇报告提出候选实体，再经逐候选的量化双极论辩框架（QBAF）结合文档证据与理由进行验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法将报告拆解到句子级粒度再抽取，损失上下文；而直接让现代 LLM 单遍处理全文虽保留上下文，却出现明显性能退化。需要在保留全文上下文与保证抽取可靠性之间取得平衡，并提升对抗扰动下的鲁棒性。

Method: 1) 多角色专精 LLM 专家编排，从完整报告提出候选 ATT&CK 实体；2) 对每个候选用量化双极论辩框架（QBAF）进行验证，论证基于文档证据与理由；3) 构建推理专精语料用于微调，使专家在验证过程中成为有效参与者。

Result: 在 ATT&CK 抽取基准上，ARBITRA 达到更偏精度（precision-oriented）的工作点，优于句子级流水线、近期 LLM 抽取系统及包括 GPT-5.5 在内的前沿模型；在模拟冲突 TTP 陈述、跨报告污染、语义投毒等对抗扰动下，其平均精度下降约为前沿模型基线的一半。

Conclusion: 全文级上下文结合论辩式多候选验证，可在不牺牲上下文的前提下显著提升 ATT&CK 映射的精度取向性能与鲁棒性；推理专精微调是使专家有效参与验证的关键支撑。

Abstract: Cyber threat intelligence (CTI) reports describe adversary behavior in natural language, but converting them into structured MITRE ATT&CK mappings remains difficult: existing methods decompose reports to sentence-level granularity for extraction, while modern LLMs can work with full reports in a single pass but with noticeable performance degradation. We present ARBITRA, which orchestrates multiple role-specialized LLM experts that propose candidate ATT&CK entities from the full report, which are then verified through a per-candidate quantitative bipolar argumentation framework (QBAF) grounded in document evidence and rationales. We additionally construct reasoning-specialized corpora for fine-tuning so experts can act as effective participants during this verification process. Across ATT&CK extraction benchmarks, ARBITRA reaches a stronger precision-oriented operating point than sentence-level pipelines, recent LLM-based extraction systems, and frontier models including GPT-5.5. Under adversarial perturbations simulating conflicting TTP statements, cross-report contamination, and semantic poisoning, ARBITRA limits mean precision degradation to roughly half that of frontier-model baselines for a more robust extraction.

</details>


### [297] [Don't Lose the Thread: Empowering Long-Horizon LLM Agents with Cognitive Resource Self-Allocation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40350)
*Zheng Zhu,Xiaozhuan Liang,Xi Chen,Bei Yu,Jiaya Jia*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出认知资源自分配（CORAL）范式，让LLM智能体主动管理工作记忆：通过可调用的工具集进行检查点保存并重置冗余上下文，从干净状态继续推理，缓解长程任务的认知过载。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体在长程任务上表现不佳，原因在于认知过载：工作记忆被不断膨胀且无关的信息填满，稀释注意力，阻碍有效规划与推理。现有方法缺乏让智能体主动优化自身上下文的机制。

Method: CORAL 实现为智能体可调用的工作记忆管理工具集：智能体可对任务进度与已验证事实做检查点（checkpoint），并自适应地开启新的解题片段——重置杂乱上下文、仅保留检查点信息，从而从干净状态恢复推理。此外提出多片段智能体强化策略优化算法（Multi-episode Agentic Reinforced Policy Optimization）以增强检查点能力。

Result: 在GAIA上，8B模型的CORAL平均准确率42.8%，在最具挑战的长程任务（Level 2、Level 3）上增益尤为显著；推理成本大幅降低，输入token消耗比ReAct智能体少6-7倍。方法可泛化到多跳知识问答基准，并在更难的BrowseComp上使强商用智能体提升8.0个点。

Conclusion: 通过让智能体自主管理并重置工作记忆，CORAL在提升长程任务准确率的同时显著降低推理成本，并具备跨基准与跨模型的泛化能力。

Abstract: Agents powered by large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable progress in solving complex reasoning tasks. However, LLM agents often falter on long-horizon tasks due to cognitive overload, as their working memory becomes cluttered with expanding and irrelevant information, which dilutes their attention and hinders effective planning and reasoning. To mitigate this challenge, we introduce Cognitive Resource Self-Allocation (CORAL), a novel reasoning paradigm that empowers agents to proactively optimize their context. Implemented as an agent-callable working memory management toolset, CORAL allows an agent to checkpoint its task progress and verified facts, and adaptively initiate a new problem-solving episode by resetting cluttered context while preserving only the checkpointed information, enabling it to resume reasoning from a clean state. We further enhance the agent's checkpointing capabilities using a Multi-episode Agentic Reinforced Policy Optimization algorithm. On the GAIA benchmark, CORAL with an 8B model achieves 42.8% average accuracy, with particularly strong gains on the most challenging long-horizon tasks (Level 2 and Level 3). Crucially, these gains come at a substantially lower inference cost: CORAL consumes 6-7$\times$ fewer input tokens than a ReAct agent. It also generalizes to multi-hop Knowledge QA benchmarks and to the considerably harder BrowseComp, where it improves a strong proprietary agent by 8.0 points.

</details>


### [298] [Decision and System One models in rheumatology: accuracy and calibration on specialty-training examination questions and diagnostic case vignettes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40318)
*Alfredo Madrid-García,Diego Benavent,Fabian Lechner,Phillip Kremer,Johannes Knitza,Beatriz Merino-Barbancho*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 在风湿病考试题上，最佳System One模型准确率高达93%，但在诊断短病例上降至50%左右且出现过度自信，均低于GPT-6 Sol；提示需按任务类型评估模型并关注校准性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 评估Decision与System One模型在风湿病学考试题和诊断短病例上的准确性与校准性，检验其能否在更贴近临床推理的任务中保持可靠性。

Method: 使用两个基准：扩展RheumaMIR（172道西班牙专科培训题，西/英双语）与RheumBench（70个英文诊断短病例，含5–18个候选诊断，其中52个含参考诊断）。比较4个System One模型（Jev 1.13、Clef、Microsoft-Decision-1、Laya）与GPT-6 Luna（OpenAI Decisions API），以GPT-6 Sol及两个本地生成模型为对照。主要终点为准确率；次要终点包括校准度、区分度、概率≥0.90答案的准确性及语言差异（Holm校正）。

Result: RheumaMIR中Jev准确率为西语93.0%、英语91.9%，低于GPT-6 Sol（99.4%，P≤0.005）；GPT-6 Luna 97.7%，Clef 91.9–93.0%，Microsoft-Decision-1 86.0–87.8%，未见语言差异；Jev概率≥0.90的答案（占76–77%）正确率98.5%。RheumBench中整体下降：GPT-6 Sol 76.9%、GPT-6 Luna 63.5%、Clef 59.6%、Jev 50.0%、Microsoft-Decision-1 40.4%（随机水平9.6%，各System One模型均低于GPT-6 Sol，P≤0.045）。Jev出现过度自信（平均概率0.659，过度/不足自信指数+0.159），其概率≥0.90的答案（占25%）正确率84.6%，而GPT-6 Luna为95.5%（占42%）。Laya在两基准中接近随机水平。

Conclusion: 表现最佳的System One模型在考试题上准确率很高，但在诊断短病例上明显下降，且始终低于GPT-6 Sol；Jev的高置信预测在短病例上可靠性不足，说明需开展任务特异性的评估与校准分析。

Abstract: Objectives: To evaluate the accuracy and calibration of Decision and System One models on rheumatology examination questions and diagnostic vignettes. Methods: Two benchmarks were analysed: 172 rheumatology questions from Spanish specialty-training examinations (expanded RheumaMIR dataset) in Spanish and English, and 70 English diagnostic vignettes from RheumBench with 5-18 candidate diagnoses, 52 of which included the reference diagnosis. Four System One models (Jev 1.13, Clef, Microsoft-Decision-1, Laya) and GPT-6 Luna (OpenAI Decisions API) were compared with GPT-6 Sol and two local generative models. The primary outcome was accuracy; secondary outcomes included calibration, discrimination, accuracy of answers with probability >=0.90 and language differences. Results: In RheumaMIR, Jev's accuracy was 93.0% in Spanish and 91.9% in English, below GPT-6 Sol (99.4%; Holm-adjusted P<=0.005); GPT-6 Luna reached 97.7%, Clef 91.9-93.0% and Microsoft-Decision-1 86.0-87.8%, without detectable language differences. Jev's answers with probability >=0.90 (76-77% of answers) were 98.5% correct. In RheumBench, accuracy was lower: GPT-6 Sol 76.9%, GPT-6 Luna 63.5%, Clef 59.6%, Jev 50.0% and Microsoft-Decision-1 40.4% (each System One model below GPT-6 Sol, Holm-adjusted P<=0.045; chance 9.6%). Jev became overconfident (mean probability 0.659; over/underconfidence index +0.159), and its answers with probability >=0.90 (25% of cases) were 84.6% correct, against 95.5% for GPT-6 Luna (42%). Laya performed near chance in both benchmarks. Conclusion: The best-performing System One models were highly accurate on examination questions but less accurate on diagnostic vignettes, remaining below GPT-6 Sol. Jev's high-confidence predictions were less reliable on vignettes, highlighting the need for task-specific evaluation and calibration.

</details>


### [299] [The Quine Test: How Much of a Model's Self Survives Its Own Description?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38726)
*Bibin Babu,Ivan P. Yamshchikov,Aleksei Shpilman*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出"quine test"（自指测试），检验大模型的自述文本能否作为一种可移植的偏好规格，在其他模型中复现作者模型的偏好画像。结论是：原生自述虽能影响行为，但不能可靠地指定偏好、无法实现跨模型复现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿模型表现出连贯的偏好，但仅凭行为证据无法判断这些偏好属于模型本身，还是属于它所扮演的"角色"。作者借鉴Hofstadter"自我即自我描述"的观点，试图用自述文本作为判据，检验偏好是否内在于模型并可被文本化传递。

Method: 采用quine test范式：9个实验室的10个模型写出自述文本；将自述注入其他模型（receiver）及作者模型的新实例的提示中，用110题偏好问卷测量其选择与作者的一致性。设置0–1保真度指标，并做长度、框架、措辞、提示位置的多种变体；对照组包括基于作者实际选择生成的描述、显式列出作者答案的"强信道"条件、以及显式偏好政策下的自述。

Result: 原生自述在所有系统提示条件下均无平均重建增益（合并增益的单侧95%上界低于+0.01；同模型新实例保真度0.979，无关模型约0.89），基于观测选择的自述同样无效。但信道本身有效：显式列出作者答案可使接收者以0.955–0.960的保真度复现其画像，与同模型重复性相差不超过0.03。显式偏好政策下的自述几乎与政策原文同样有效。此外，模型阅读自身自述会使自身偏离基线，程度略高于等长无关文本。

Conclusion: 就所测偏好而言，原生自述能够影响行为，却不能可靠地"指定"如何在另一个模型中复现该行为。作者开源了流程、问卷、原始调用日志及198份模型自述文本。

Abstract: Frontier language models express coherent preferences, but behavioral evidence alone cannot say whether these belong to the model or to a character it portrays. Following Hofstadter's view of the self as a self-description, we ask whether a model's description of itself works as a portable specification of its preference profile, a quine test: can the text a model writes about itself regenerate its behavior elsewhere? Ten models from nine labs write self-descriptions; we place each one in the prompt of other models (receivers) and of fresh instances of the author, and measure how closely their choices on a 110-item preference battery match the author's.
  First, the tested native self-descriptions (native: the profile measured under a generic assistant prompt) show no average reconstruction gain across variations in length, framing, wording and prompt placement: on a 0 to 1 fidelity scale where a model's fidelity to a fresh instance of itself is 0.979 and to unrelated models about 0.89, the one-sided 95% upper bound on the pooled gain is below +0.01 in every tested system-prompt condition, and descriptions based on the author's observed choices do no better. Second, the channel itself is strong: explicitly listing the author's answers lets receivers reproduce its profile at fidelity 0.955 to 0.960 across three model grids, within 0.03 of same-model repeatability. Third, self-descriptions written under an explicit preference policy transfer the assigned preferences almost as well as the policy text itself. Fourth, reading its own self-description shifts even the author away from its baseline, modestly more than unrelated prose of the same length.
  For the preferences measured here, native self-descriptions influence behavior without reliably specifying how to reproduce it in another model. We release the pipeline, battery, raw call logs, and 198 model-written descriptions.

</details>


### [300] [Multi-View MoE: Letting Every Router Shape Expert Computation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40577)
*Zelin Zhao,Tianchi Ma,Junyuan Shang,Shuohuan Wang,Dianhai Yu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 Multi-View MoE：用多个独立初始化的路由器聚合 sigmoid 打分改进专家选择，并复用路由偏好将学到的潜在视图混合进专家输入，在不增加激活专家数、专家 FLOPs 与 all-to-all 通信量的前提下提升 MoE 模型效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏 MoE 中专家选择直接决定固定激活预算下的模型能力。对全部专家做稠密评估发现：单路由器排序与专家效用评估排序一致性较弱，在中层和深层尤为明显。而更丰富的选择与计算信号代价高：基于专家内部激活的选择需要预计算，用同一专家分别处理多个完整表示则重复计算。

Method: Multi-Router 子模块：聚合多个独立初始化路由器的 sigmoid 分数，训练中路由器形成高度差异化的专家偏好，使被单一路由器强烈偏好或被多个路由器共同支持的专家均可入选。Multi-View 机制：利用每个被选专家在各路由器上的相对得分，将学到的潜在视图混合进该专家的输入，从而把路由偏好同时复用于选择与计算。每个被选专家仅执行一次前向。

Result: 在 24 层 10B-A1B 模型、708B token 训练下：完整 Multi-View MoE 使九项下游任务平均提升 1.18 个百分点；仅 Multi-Router 提升 0.6 个百分点，并提高路由器分数与评估专家效用间的秩相关，全局相对提升 8.1%，在单路由器对齐最差的层约提升 58%。受控混合干预表明模型使用的输入差异同时依赖于专家与 token。

Conclusion: 多路由器差异化的偏好聚合可改善专家选择质量与路由-效用一致性，且路由偏好可低成本地复用于专家计算输入；方法保持激活专家数、专家 FLOPs 与通信量不变，属于"免费"的能力增益。

Abstract: Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) models expand parameter capacity by activating a small subset of experts per token. Expert selection directly affects model capabilities under a fixed active-expert budget. Dense evaluation of all experts reveals weak agreement between single-router rankings and expert-utility evaluation rankings, especially in middle and deep layers. Richer signals for selection and computation incur additional cost: selection based on internal expert activations requires preliminary computation, while processing multiple full representations separately through the same expert repeats its computation. We propose Multi-View MoE to improve expert selection with multiple routers and reuse their preferences to modulate expert computation under a fixed expert budget. Its Multi-Router submodule aggregates sigmoid scores from independently initialized routers. These routers develop highly differentiated expert preferences during training, allowing experts strongly favored by one router or jointly supported by several routers to be selected. Multi-View further uses each selected expert's relative scores across routers to mix learned latent views into its input, reusing routing preferences for both selection and computation. Each selected expert executes one forward pass, preserving the active-expert count, expert FLOPs, and all-to-all communication volume. On a 24-layer 10B-A1B model trained on 708B tokens, full Multi-View MoE improves the nine-task downstream mean by 1.18 percentage points over the baseline. Multi-Router alone yields a 0.6-percentage-point gain and improves the rank correlation between router scores and evaluated expert utility, with relative increases of 8.1% globally and approximately 58% in the layer with the lowest single-router alignment. Controlled mixing interventions show the model uses input differences that depend on both the expert and the token.

</details>


### [301] [Elucidating the Design Space of LM Data Attribution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40655)
*Steven Yu,Sheng-Yu Wang,Kimia Hamidieh,Antonio Torralba,David Bau*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出可控归因基准 CATT（基于虚构知识微调，提供明确 ground truth），并发现将交叉熵损失梯度替换为负对数几率梯度、仅聚合 top token 分数，可使召回率提升 35–72 个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LM 数据归因方法的评测同时改变多个数据集属性，无法隔离归因算法失败的具体原因；因此需要一个可单变量控制的诊断性评测设置。

Method: 构建 Controlled Attribution Benchmark (CATT)：在完全虚构的知识上微调 LLM，获得无歧义的真实归因标签，从而可逐一改变文档冗余、词法干扰项等配置。在此基准上不提出新估计器，而是考察两个设计选择：(1) 计算梯度所用的损失函数；(2) 将 per-token 归因分数聚合为文档分数的方式。

Result: 冗余与干扰项会稳定降低归因性能；训练文档中的真实因果证据高度局部化，而标准全文档平均聚合会将其稀释为噪声；采用负对数几率梯度可突出关键 token，仅聚合 top token 分数使多个基线的 ground truth 召回率提升 35–72 个百分点；该修正在 FTRACE-TREX 上同样泛化，所有测试方法的反事实重训练性能提升最多达 4.9 倍。

Conclusion: 归因失败的关键原因之一在于损失梯度选择与文档级聚合方式，而非估计器本身；高度局部化的因果证据配合负对数几率梯度与 top-token 聚合可显著提升归因效果，并具备跨基准泛化性。

Abstract: Data attribution methods for Language Models (LMs) are typically evaluated using downstream tasks like fact retrieval. However, existing evaluations vary multiple dataset properties simultaneously, making it impossible to isolate exactly why an attribution algorithm fails. To diagnose these failures, we explore the design space of LLM data attribution, with a primary focus on evaluation. We introduce the Controlled Attribution Benchmark (CATT) for fact tracing, in which we fine-tune LLMs on entirely fictitious knowledge, providing unambiguous ground truth for attribution. This synthetic setup allows us to systematically alter one dataset configuration at a time, such as document redundancy and lexical distractors. With this configurable evaluation, we demonstrate that redundancy and distractors consistently degrade attribution performance. Rather than proposing a new estimator, we examine two design choices that are underexplored: the loss used to compute gradients and how per-token attribution scores are aggregated into a document score. We find that the true causal evidence within a training document is highly localized, but standard methods dilute this evidence into noise by averaging attribution scores across the entire document. We find that replacing standard cross-entropy loss gradients with the negative log-odds gradients surfaces the critical tokens from other uninformative ones. We can then aggregate only the top token scores to improve ground truth recall by 35 to 72 percentage points across multiple baselines on our diagnostic benchmark. The negative log-odds correction also generalizes to FTRACE-TREX, improving counterfactual retraining performance for every method we test, by up to 4.9x.

</details>


### [302] [ShallowDefend: Harnessing Shallow Safety Alignment for Multi-Turn Defender](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40627)
*Qiyao Ma,Xiaodong Liu,Weiwei Yang,Mingqian Feng,Chengquan Guo,Jialin Song,Carolyn Buractaon,Zhe Zhao,Junshan Zhang,Sandeep Atluri,Christopher White,Jianfeng Gao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 Assess→Decide→Respond 框架，利用安全对齐集中于前几个 token 的"浅层性"，在 payload 轮训练显式安全决策，实现更强的多轮安全防御。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单轮可直接拒答有害请求，但同一请求分散到多轮对话时仍常成功；根因是对齐"浅层"——安全行为集中在前几个输出 token，现有防御只在响应表层做监督，从未给模型可学习的显式安全决策。

Method: 反向利用浅层性：在该高杠杆短区间先占据主动权。框架分三步：评估用户意图→提交显式、可解析的安全决策→基于该决策生成回复；在 payload 轮用强化学习训练这一决策提交。因决策是 token 片段，奖励可用规则：自验证奖励将提交标签与对话已知性质比对（无需评判器与标注），同一格式也支持在分级决策空间（含安全重定向）上用 LLM-as-judge 奖励。

Result: 在两个模型家族、十四个覆盖安全/效用/有用性的基准上，受控比较中取得最强多轮安全，并在保持效用的同时以有用性的适度代价维持安全领先。逐 token KL 分析机理性探针证实：训练效果集中于设定回复轨迹的短暂"思考"段，该处提交的决策是因果控制点。

Conclusion: 攻击者所利用的浅层性反转成为防御机制；短决策跨度即最高杠杆干预点，显式可解析的安全承诺构成因果控制点，是提升多轮安全对齐的有效路径。

Abstract: Safety alignment has enabled large language models to reliably refuse harmful requests directly, yet the same request distributed across a multi-turn conversation still succeeds far too often. This brittleness has a mechanistic root: Alignment is shallow, with safety behavior concentrated in a model's first few output tokens, and existing defenses inherit the weakness, supervising the surface form of the response without ever giving the model an explicit safety decision to learn. We take the opposite view of shallowness: if a short span determines the trajectory of an entire response, that span is the highest-leverage place to intervene, and the defender can occupy it first. We propose Assess $\to$ Decide $\to$ Respond, a framework in which the defender assesses the user's intent, commits to an explicit, parseable safety decision, and only then generates a reply conditioned on it, with the commitment trained by reinforcement learning at the payload turn. Because the decision is a token span, the reward can be a rule: a self-verified reward checks the committed label against the conversation's known nature, requiring no judge and no annotation, while the same format also supports an LLM-as-judge reward over a graded decision space with safe redirection. Across two model families and fourteen benchmarks spanning safety, utility, and helpfulness, our defenders achieve the strongest multi-turn safety in a controlled comparison, maintaining their lead in safety while preserving utility at a modest cost to helpfulness. A per-token KL analysis and interventional probes confirm why this works: training concentrates its effect on the brief deliberation that sets a response's trajectory, and the decision committed there is a causal control point. The very shallowness attackers exploit becomes the mechanism of defense.

</details>


### [303] [When to Assist and What to Suggest: Joint Gating and Memory-Grounded Hint Generation in One Compact Decoder](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40611)
*A. J. A. Jubayer Talukder,Mohammad Ariful Haque*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文在28,058个决策点上联合评估主动式助手的“门控+生成”两阶段系统，发现真门控下端到端精确匹配仅0.2619（oracle天花板0.2971），记忆画像决定提示质量（去除损失24.7 EM点），并提出单一1B解码器同时完成门控与生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主动式助手需在对话中决定“何时插话”和“说什么”，现有系统将其拆为门控模块与更大的生成器两个模型，但缺乏对二者的联合评估，且不清楚门控、记忆、检索与生成器规模各自贡献多少，也不确定两模型拆分是否必要。

Method: 在28,058个决策点上统一评估门控与生成器；对比oracle门控的stage-wise上限与真实门控的端到端表现；做记忆画像消融、检索消融与生成器规模（8B vs 1B）对比；提出单模型方案，由一个1B解码器从中间层输出门控、同一前向中完成生成；辅以32段对话、1,144条评分的人工评估，并比较分级指标与LlamaPIE原生judge和人工评分的一致性。

Result: 真实门控下端到端EM为0.2619（上限0.2971），端到端精度0.2387，存在明显提升空间；门控的计算节省随生成器缩小而下降（8B时4.39x，1B时1.38x）；去除记忆画像损失24.7个EM点（重标定BERTScore 0.57→0.35），而检索与更大生成器在EM上无增益；单1B模型在最终checkpoint上自动端到端指标持平或超过两模型管线，且墙钟时间少1.31–1.76x，三个随机种子下其深层出口与独立门控相当；人工评估支持记忆效应，单模型与匹配的1B管线持平、低于8B管线；分级指标与LlamaPIE judge比EM更贴近人工评分。

Conclusion: 主动式助手的瓶颈在记忆画像而非检索或生成器规模；两模型拆分并非必需，单个1B解码器可同时门控与生成，在基本保持质量的同时显著降低成本；EM应视为严格下界，建议采用分级指标与模型原生judge作为更贴近人类判断的评价方式。

Abstract: Proactive assistants offer short, memory-grounded hints during a conversation, deciding when to assist and what to suggest. Current systems split this between a gate and a larger generator; we evaluate both together on 28,058 decision points. Stage-wise generation scores are oracle-gate ceilings: behind a real gate, end-to-end exact match is 0.2619 against a ceiling of 0.2971, and end-to-end precision is 0.2387, leaving substantial headroom. A gate pays off through precision and compute, whose saving falls from 4.39x with an 8B generator to 1.38x with a 1B one. The memory profile drives hint quality: removing it costs 24.7 exact-match points (rescaled BERTScore 0.57 to 0.35), while retrieval and a larger generator add nothing on exact match. One 1B decoder can do both, gating from an intermediate layer and generating in the same pass. At its final checkpoint it matches or exceeds the two-model pipelines on automatic end-to-end measures with 1.31-1.76x less wall-clock time than the matched 1B pipeline; across three seeds, its deeper exit ties the separate gate. A human evaluation (1,144 ratings over 32 dialogues) supports the memory effect and rates the single model level with the matched 1B pipeline and below the 8B one. Graded metrics and LlamaPIE's native judge track human ratings more closely than exact match, which we report as a strict lower bound.

</details>


### [304] [Testimony from Timelines: Evidence-Grounded Significance Testing of Temporal Clinical Hypotheses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40619)
*Chengyang He,Wenlong Zhang,Koduvayur Subbalakshmi,Ping Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出STRATA基准与ART范式，用8,735条基于疫苗不良事件临床时间线的时序假设，对语言模型数据分析中"零假设设定、检验选择、记录选取、p值与结论"每一步分别评分，揭示现有基准仅看结论的缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型对"召回后销量是否下滑""某副作用是否紧随另一副作用"等时序断言常给出流畅但无论证的结论。这类断言本质是需在恰当记录上做显著性检验的时序假设，验证者须确定零假设、选择检验方法、界定相关记录，任一环节出错都可能"蒙对"结论。现有数据分析基准只评判最终结论，且直接提供相关数据，掩盖了过程错误，且在医疗场景中错误判定代价高昂。

Method: 构建STRATA基准：覆盖疫苗不良事件报告的临床时间线，含8,735条时序假设，基于公开代码本推导并给出金标准计划、证据集、p值与结论，并由确定性oracle复现。同时提出ART（articulate, retrieve, test）三阶段范式，将每个决策暴露为可检查的输出。

Result: 五种模型配置的实验表明，系统主要失败于"选取哪些记录计入"这一环节，存在仅凭准确率无法察觉的"结论—证据鸿沟"。ART缩小了大部分差距，使31B开源模型在同一范式下与前沿模型差距缩小至0.01；前沿模型在提供代码本后即可成功。

Conclusion: 过程级评测比结论级评测更能暴露模型数据分析能力缺陷；显式的分阶段范式（ART）配合代码本可显著提升中小模型表现并弥合结论与证据的不一致。

Abstract: Ask a language model whether sales tend to dip after a product recall, or whether one side effect tends to follow another after a vaccine, and it answers in a fluent sentence that reads like a finding, with no test behind it. Assertions about how events unfold across many cases fill the Web, and each is a temporal hypothesis that only a significance test over the right records can settle. The verifier must specify the null, select the test and decide which records bear on the hypothesis, and any of these choices can go wrong while the conclusion still comes out right. Yet benchmarks for language-model data analysis grade only the conclusion, with the relevant data handed over. We study the problem in health, where a wrong verdict is costly, and present STRATA, a benchmark that grades every decision on the way to a verdict: 8,735 hypotheses over the clinical timelines of vaccine adverse-event reports, with gold plans, evidence sets, p-values and verdicts derived under a released codebook and reproduced by a deterministic oracle. We also propose ART (articulate, retrieve, test), a staged paradigm that exposes each decision as an inspectable output. Extensive experiments with five model configurations show that systems fail mostly at choosing which records count, a verdict-evidence gap that accuracy alone conceals. ART closes most of this gap and brings a 31B open model to within 0.01 of the frontier models under the same paradigm; the frontier models succeed once given the codebook.

</details>


### [305] [PIVOT: Progressive Intervention via Online Teacher Correction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40576)
*Zhihao Yang,Boyuan Zheng,Puhui Tan,Yukun Chen,Kuan Zhang,Longze Chen,Jiaming Li,Renke Shan,Lu Wang,Xianpei Han*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 PIVOT：将教师纠正片段插入学生 rollout，并仅对这些片段施加 token 级 KL 监督，与 RLVR 目标联合优化，解决稀疏奖励下全失败组无学习信号的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR 在困难推理任务上仅有结果级稀疏奖励：当一个 group 内所有 rollout 均失败时，奖励无法提供任何学习信号。更强教师可提供额外指导，但核心问题在于如何把此类信号融入 RLVR——既能帮助学生产生成功 rollout，又保持对学生可学习。

Method: 区分两种互补机制：轨迹级干预（提升含奖励轨迹的可达性）与 token 级监督（提供稠密目标）。受控实验表明单一机制均不足，故提出 PIVOT：在 student rollout 中插入 teacher 生成的纠正片段，对这些片段施加 token-level KL 监督，并与 RLVR 目标共同优化；同时系统分析"在哪里干预"与"如何监督"，形成有效指导配方。

Result: 在困难逻辑游戏与数学推理基准上持续优于现有方法；逻辑游戏 mean avg@8 从最佳基线 19.5% 提升到 35.6%，接近翻倍。

Conclusion: 轨迹级干预与 token 级监督需组合使用方能奏效；按"干预位置+监督方式"的配方化设计可显著提升 RLVR 在稀疏奖励困难任务上的学习效率与最终性能。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) is limited by sparse outcome-level feedback on hard reasoning tasks: when all rollouts in a group fail, rewards provide no learning signal. Stronger teachers can provide additional guidance, but this raises a central question: how can such signals be incorporated into RLVR to support successful rollouts while remaining learnable for the student? We distinguish two complementary mechanisms: trajectory-level intervention, which improves access to reward-bearing trajectories, and token-level supervision, which provides dense targets to guide student learning. Our controlled experiments show that either mechanism alone can remain insufficient, motivating their combination. We therefore introduce PIVOT, which inserts teacher-generated corrections into student rollouts and applies token-level KL supervision to these segments alongside the RLVR objective. Beyond their combination, we systematically analyze where to intervene and how to supervise, yielding a recipe for effective guidance. Across hard logic games and mathematical reasoning benchmarks, PIVOT consistently outperforms existing methods, nearly doubling mean avg@8 on logic games from 19.5% for the best-performing baseline to 35.6%.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [306] [Wavelet Phase Diffusion for Structurally and Semantically Consistent Sim-to-Real Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.21628)
*Kaiwen Wang,Frank Bieder,Yinzhe Shen,Carlos Fernandez,Jan-Hendrik Pauls,Omer Sahin Tas*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出小波相位扩散（ψ-PD），在双树复小波包变换域做局部化相位注入，并用低频随机化（LFR）解耦合成光照先验，实现无需成对数据、无需额外控制模块、推理开销极低的仿真到真实图像/视频翻译。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Sim-to-real 翻译需同时弥合外观差距并保持结构与语义一致性。现有方法各有缺陷：基于条件控制的方法空间对齐好但控制模块计算昂贵；成对数据方法真实感强但依赖复杂合成流程且常改变几何与语义；免训练编辑方法虽灵活却缺乏学习到的外观先验，感知质量受限；相位保持扩散虽有前景，但其傅里叶域公式受全局频谱耦合限制，导致振铃、边界泄漏等空间伪影，损害结构与语义一致性。

Method: 两个组件：①在双树复小波包变换（DTCWPT）域操作，利用小波包的局部性实现空间自适应相位注入，避免全局频谱干扰；②低频随机化（LFR）替换低频包，使模型摆脱合成光照先验，获得分布内的真实世界外观。两部分均在无配对开放域数据上训练，推理开销可忽略；空间局部性还支持实例级翻译（单个物体/区域独立翻译而周围场景保持不变）。

Result: vKITTI→KITTI 图像翻译中，在真实感与语义一致性上优于先前方法，结构对齐保持竞争水平；CARLA 视频翻译中，真实感接近成对数据方法，同时使 VLM 规划器的 ADE 与 FDE 分别降低 5.4% 与 5.1%。

Conclusion: 以小波包域局部化相位注入替代傅里叶全局相位保持，可在无配对数据、低推理开销条件下同时取得真实感、结构/语义一致性与下游规划性能提升，并原生支持实例级翻译。

Abstract: Simulation-to-reality translation must bridge the appearance gap between synthetic and real domains while preserving structural and semantic consistency. Conditioning-based methods achieve spatial alignment but introduce computationally expensive control modules. Paired-data methods achieve realism but rely on complex synthesis pipelines, often altering scene geometry and semantics. Training-free editing methods avoid both constraints but lack a learned appearance prior, limiting their perceptual quality. Recently proposed phase-preserving diffusion presents a promising alternative, but Fourier-domain formulations are constrained by global spectral coupling. This coupling induces spatial artifacts such as ringing and boundary leakage, thereby degrading structural and semantic consistency. We introduce Wavelet Phase Diffusion, which addresses this through two components. First, we operate in the Dual-Tree Complex Wavelet Packet Transform domain, whose localized wavelet packets enable spatially adaptive phase injection without global spectral interference. Second, Low-Frequency Randomization (LFR) replaces the low-frequency packet, decoupling the model from the synthetic illumination prior and enabling in-distribution real-world appearance. Both components train on unpaired open-domain data, and introduce negligible inference overhead. The spatial locality further enables instance-level translation, where individual objects or regions are translated to photorealistic appearance independently while the surrounding scene remains untranslated. On vKITTI $\to$ KITTI image translation, $ψ$-PD outperforms prior methods in realism and semantic consistency while maintaining competitive structural alignment. For CARLA video translation, $ψ$-PD approaches the realism of paired-data methods while reducing VLM planner ADE and FDE by $5.4\%$ and $5.1\%$, respectively.

</details>


### [307] [Certified Access: Test-Time Compute on Conservative Physics-Structured AI Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39073)
*Pratik Jawahar,Riccardo Maggioni,Jonas Petersen,Matteo Cozzi,Gian-Alessandro Lombardi,Marek Gajewski,Camilla Mazzoleni,Federico Martelli*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文为以 Latent Dynamics Model 作为记忆的测试时计算建立理论与实证框架：将可达性失效拆分为逃逸失效与到达失效，分别用 Lorentz squeeze 与 gated canonical translation 解决，并给出相体积 Jacobian、能量界与 latch 输运律的证书栈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 测试时计算机制（重试、置信度升级、非局部路由）通常以黑箱方式加在训练好的模型上，只增加前向传播或停机头，缺乏对"额外计算买到什么、对稳定性保证付出什么代价"的结构性解释。作者希望在阻尼辛（velocity-Verlet）步驱动的哈密顿潜动力学记忆上，给出可精确刻画的可达性与能量证书。

Method: 将编码器潜状态 (q,p) 用学习哈密顿量的阻尼辛 velocity-Verlet 步推进；对每种扩展访问的机制推导精确相体积 Jacobian、有界能量变化与精确 latch 输运律。把可达性失败分为逃逸失败与到达失败：Lorentz squeeze 通过注入有界、可再吸收的能量解决逃逸失败；gated canonical translation（跨 C_T 的一步通道）在 detJ=1 下精确解决到达失败。在设计的解析测试台上验证该证书栈，并在学习得到的物理结构记忆上评估计算配给与非局部路由的扩展极限（对照无物理基线）。

Result: 解析测试台上：用 squeeze 到达略超 C_T 处，所需能量随超出距离二次增长；gated channel 的能量代价等于两端点势能差（在本文匹配通道上为零），故不随距离增长。未训练的状态替换映射会湮灭相体积并抹除存储电荷，而 gated channel 能将其输运。学习记忆上展示了校准的计算配给，并给出非局部路由相对无物理基线的扩展极限。

Conclusion: 主要贡献是证书栈的形式化与验证，而非基准性能。该框架把测试时计算的额外开销与稳定性的结构性保证（相体积、能量界、电荷输运）联系起来，为可达性失效提供可证明的修正路径。

Abstract: Test-time compute mechanisms, such as retries, confidence-based escalation and non-local routing, are conventionally deployed as black-box additions to trained models. They typically add forward passes or halting heads, but give no structural account of what the extra compute buys or what it costs against the model's stability guarantees. We therefore propose a theoretical and empirical framework for test-time compute on a Latent Dynamics Model used as the memory. When an encoder's latent state $(q,p)$ is advanced by a damped symplectic (velocity-Verlet) step of a learned Hamiltonian, every mechanism that expands access has an exact phase-volume Jacobian, a bounded energy change and an exact latch-transport law. We split reachability failures into escape failures and reach failures. A Lorentz squeeze resolves escape failures by injecting bounded, re-absorbable energy. A gated canonical translation (a one-step channel across $C_T$) resolves reach failures at $\detJ=1$ exactly. We verify this certificate stack on a designed analytic testbed. Reaching just beyond $C_T$ with the squeeze requires energy that grows quadratically in the excess distance. The gated channel's energy cost equals the potential difference between its endpoints, which is zero on the matched channel measured here, and so does not grow with distance in this testbed. An untrained state-replacing map annihilates phase volume and erases stored charge, while the gated channel transports it. On a learned physics-structured memory, we show calibrated compute rationing and evaluate the scaling limits of non-local routing against a physics-free baseline. The main contribution is the formalization and verification of the certificate stack, not benchmark performance.

</details>


### [308] [What Constitutes Food Similarity? Visual Representations and Retrieval in Indian Cuisine](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37867)
*Saransh Kumar Gupta,Akshadha Sharma,Lipika Dey,Partha Pratim Das,Ramesh Jain*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文指出食物相似性不应仅以身份识别性能衡量，并通过七种视觉表征在印度菜数据集上考察图像邻域结构、菜系家族边界、跨表征一致性及视觉与食谱相似性的对应关系，发现相似性是依赖于表征、模态与抽象层级的变量而非食物集合的固定属性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 食物相似性是检索、推荐、替代等食物计算任务的基础，但现有食物表征通常只用身份保持（identity preservation）来评估，忽略了其在关系组织上的表现。印度菜中视觉相近的食物可能属于不同菜系家族、同家族食物外观差异又可能很大，构成检验该问题的挑战性场景。

Method: 在扩展的 Khana 数据集上，采用七种预训练视觉表征（覆盖卷积、Transformer、自监督、图文对齐模型），评估图像到图像检索与图像到菜品的邻域，分析菜系家族结构、对比案例与跨表征一致性；同时聚合图像表征比较模型间的菜品级视觉相似性，并与同菜品的食谱衍生相似性对照。

Result: 图像级邻域在不同表征间差异显著，且出现跨越菜系家族边界的相似性；菜品级聚合显示出尽管局部变异仍存在共同的视觉结构，但该结构与食谱衍生相似性对应较弱。

Conclusion: 仅凭识别性能无法刻画关系结构；食物相似性取决于表征、模态与抽象层级，而非食物集合的固定属性。理解这些结构是将多模态食物信息整合为一致相似性概念的前提。

Abstract: Food similarity underlies retrieval, recommendation, substitution, and other food computing tasks, yet food representations are typically evaluated by identity preservation. We ask what happens to food similarity beyond identity: how different visual representations organize foods into relational neighborhoods, what culinary relationships these neighborhoods reveal or obscure, and how consistently these structures emerge across representations. Indian cuisine provides a challenging setting in which visually similar foods may have different culinary identities, while foods within a culinary family can vary substantially in appearance. Using an expanded Khana dataset and seven pretrained visual representations spanning convolutional, transformer-based, self-supervised, and image-text aligned models, we evaluate image-to-image retrieval and image-to-dish neighborhoods, examining culinary-family structure, contrast cases, and cross-representation agreement. We also aggregate image representations to compare dish-level visual similarity across models and against recipe-derived similarity for the same dishes. Image-level neighborhoods vary substantially across representations, including similarities across culinary-family boundaries. At the dish level, aggregation reveals common visual structure despite local variation, but this structure corresponds less strongly with recipe-derived similarity. These findings show that recognition performance alone cannot characterize relational structure: food similarity depends on representation, modality, and abstraction level rather than being a fixed property of the food collection. Understanding these structures is therefore a prerequisite to combining multiple food information modalities into a coherent notion of similarity.

</details>


### [309] [When the Same Prompt Gives Different Answers (and the Same Answer Isn't Always Right): A Taxonomy of Failure Mechanisms, Testing, and Mitigation Strategies for LLM-Assisted Evidence Synthesis Read-and-Evaluate Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39070)
*Carole Lunny,Ian Goodman,Stefano Berrone,Connor TA Brenna,Emma K Reid,Ivan Perez-Neri,Shailesh Kolekar,Nityanand Jain,Ashwin Kamath,Lucas HCC Santos,Yulia Otmakhova,Heba Hussein,Diana M Cespedes,Gioia Dahdal,Salmaan Kanji*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出TRAILS分类法，系统梳理LLM"阅读—评估"任务中导致判断不可重复或被隐蔽系统性影响的38种机制，并给出测试与缓解方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 证据合成中的LLM阅读—评估任务（文献筛选、数据提取、偏倚风险评估、批判性评价）对LLM解释的依赖程度不同。研究者需要评估判断的准确性、证据支撑性与可重复性；但正确判断不等于评估过程可靠，因此需要一套机制层面的分类框架来指导评估方法的选择与报告。

Method: 构建分类法TRAILS（Taxonomy of Reliability And Instability in LLM-assisted evidence Synthesis），围绕两个互补问题组织：(1) 哪些机制导致同一任务在重复运行中产生不同判断（不稳定性）；(2) 哪些机制会系统性影响判断或所需输出，且从判断本身无法察觉（隐蔽偏倚）。共识别38种机制，并逐项标注其起作用的部署设置、可用的检验方法及缓解策略。

Result: 给出38种机制的清单及其对应的部署情境、测试途径与缓解措施；论证可重复性或准确性均不能排除隐蔽的判断失效；并说明人工评估应检验判断是否植根于所提供证据、是否独立于不当外部影响、是否经由可审查与可验证的过程产生。

Conclusion: LLM在证据合成中的评估可靠性需从"结果正确"转向"过程可验证"。TRAILS为识别失效机制、选择评估方法与规范化报告提供框架，强调仅凭准确率或重复性不足以证明评估流程可靠。

Abstract: LLM read-and-evaluate tasks include study screening, data extraction, risk-of-bias assessment, and critical appraisal in the evidence synthesis field. These task differ in the amount of LLM interpretation they require. Some tasks involve retrieving relatively simple information, such as an author name, sample size, or publication year. Others require the LLM to read source material, interpret it against predefined criteria, and make a judgement. Researchers should assess whether LLM judgements are accurate, supported by appropriate source evidence, and reproducible under specified conditions. A correct judgement does not necessarily indicate that the underlying evaluation process is reliable. We developed a taxonomy for identifying mechanisms that may compromise these properties and for informing the selection and reporting of appropriate evaluation methods. The taxonomy outlines potential ways that LLM judgments from read-and-evaluate tasks can fail, called TRAILS (Taxonomy of Reliability And Instability in LLM-assisted evidence Synthesis). The TRAILS taxonomy addresses two complementary questions. First, what mechanisms can cause the same read-and-evaluate task to produce different judgements across repeated LLM runs? Second, what mechanisms can systematically affect the judgement or required output in a way that is not apparent from the judgement itself? This study presents 38 mechanisms and identifies the deployment settings in which each can operate, approaches for testing them, and mitigation strategies. We also show why repeatability or accuracy does not rule out a hidden judgement failure and why human evaluation should assess whether a judgement is grounded in the supplied evidence, independent of inappropriate external influence, and produced through a process that can be examined and verified.

</details>


### [310] [When Should AI Decide, Defer, and Deviate? Responsible Automation for Deceased Donor Kidney Allocation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39045)
*Madeleine Pollack,Thomas Daillak,Mehmet Toner,Korkut Uygun,Heidi Yeh,Swati Gupta*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 Arbitrator 框架，用于判断AI在基于历史决策训练时何时应推荐决策、何时应交由人类专家、何时应标记数据异常并偏离历史做法，并在已故供体肾脏分配中验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 历史决策记录的是"做了什么"而非"应该做什么"，且数据稀疏时模型预测不确定性过高、不宜直接执行，因此需要明确AI在何种条件下可以自主行动、何时必须延后。

Method: 以美国已故供体肾脏分配为案例（约30%回收肾脏永不移植），利用OPTN 2016–2019与2023–2025匹配运行数据（排除疫情年份），构建融合多个可解释模型的Arbitrator框架：仅当预测不确定性不足以改变首选行动时才行动，否则延后；并借助其可解释性构建智能体审计，将学到的规则与临床文献比对。

Result: Arbitrator 以显式医学标准解决了93.5%的器官分配决策，其余6.5%延后给人类或更复杂模型；正确识别出70.1%历史被丢弃的低KDPI肾脏为序外（OOS）候选，预计最多43.9%的历史被丢弃肾脏可被标记为加速安置并有望移植；智能体审计可标出有争议的决策模式。

Conclusion: 基于不确定性的选择性行动（选择性 deferral）机制可在保证安全性的前提下让AI承担大部分决策，同时通过可解释性实现与临床文献的一致性审计。

Abstract: We ask when an AI trained on historical decisions should be allowed to recommend decisions, defer to human experts, or in other cases, flag concerning patterns in data and deviate from past practice. This can be challenging because past decisions record what was done rather than what should have been done, and where data is sparse, a model's predictions may be too uncertain to act on. We provide a framework for addressing this problem using a case study in deceased-donor kidney allocation. Nearly 30% of kidneys recovered from deceased donors in the United States are never transplanted, largely because they are hard to place through the standard waitlist sequence. One can use AI to flag kidneys at risk of delayed or failed placement for out-of-sequence (OOS) allocation, but this comes at the cost of bypassing candidates higher on the waitlist. Thus, OOS allocation should only be used when the organ is demonstrably at high risk of discard on the standard sequence. Using Organ Procurement and Transplantation Network match-run data from 2016-2019 and 2023-2025 (excluding COVID-19-disrupted years), we build the Arbitrator framework, which combines various interpretable models and acts only when the uncertainty in their predictions cannot change the preferred action. Our Arbitrator resolves 93.5% of organ placement decisions using explicit medical criteria learned from data, and defers the remaining 6.5% to a human or a more complex model. We show that the Arbitrator correctly identifies 70.1% of historically discarded low-KDPI kidneys as OOS candidates, projecting that up to 43.9% of historically discarded kidneys could be flagged for expedited placement and potentially transplanted. We then exploit the interpretability of the Arbitrator to create an agentic audit comparing the learned rules to published clinical literature in order to flag decision-making patterns that are contentious.

</details>


### [311] [Aligning Autoresearch: Co-Improvement between Agents and Humans](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38882)
*Tianjian Li,Chuanyang Jin,Seungone Kim,Tong Chen,John Hoffman,Yoram Bachrach amd Pedro Rodriguez,Ping Yu,Eryk Helenowski,Swarnadeep Saha,Jack Lanchantin,Weizhe Yuan,Ilia Kulikov,Jason Weston*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究人类在引导自动研究(autoresearch)智能体中的作用，提出HackBench基准揭示现有智能体对齐不足，并通过"人类模拟器代理RL"与"专家对齐评分标准RL"两种训练方法提升智能体的人机交互与沟通能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端自动研究智能体虽可自我改进，但最佳结果仍来自智能体与人类研究者的协作(co-improvement)；且近期奖励黑客现象表明，对齐人类期望是更安全的研究智能体路径。

Method: 四点工作：(i) 在基准创建领域实证分析人类在指导自动研究智能体中的作用；(ii) 构建HackBench基准评估智能体对齐与hack定位能力；(iii) 用人类模拟器作为RL中的代理，训练智能体改进人机交互；(iv) 用与人类专家对齐的rubrics做RL以改进模型文本生成与智能体沟通。
